A colossal, ultra-definition entertainment wall spanning multiple panels. Designed for luxurious colonies, it delivers an overwhelming visual experience with rich sound and vibrant clarity. Streams archived ultranet broadcasts from long-dead satellites and local data arrays.

A sleek, high-tech flat-screen television. Its slim profile saves floor space while delivering the same rich color and clarity as traditional flat-screen units. It doesn’t have a huge viewing space, but can be mounted on walls.

A high-fidelity audio system designed to enhance the viewing experience of nearby televisions. When placed near a television, it links with the screen to deliver immersive sound, increasing the recreation gain of any colonist watching.

A high-tech shelf for storing apparel or weapons. Items stored on this shelf will benefit from nanoswarms of mechanites that will slowly repair any damage and deterioration. The process requires a large amount of power and takes a significant amount of time.

An electrical standing lamp that lights an area, good for large outdoor spaces, with a small solar panel mounted on top. Stores electrical charge during the day, when it’s off, and automatically turns on at night.

A compact, high-efficiency air purifier that filters out dust, allergens, smoke, and other unwanted particulates while circulating clean, scented air. Improves room cleanliness, slightly boosts mood, and enhances the overall environment.
A high-end, spacer-era seating solution with adaptive cushioning, posture calibration, and breathable smart fabrics. Designed for maximum long-term comfort and sleek modern interiors.
A sleek, spacer-era armchair. Built with memory foam, smart-fabric upholstery, and ergonomic design, it provides superior comfort and aesthetics.
A sleek, double-wide spacer-era couch. Memory foam, ergonomic design and smart-fabric upholstery provide maximum comfort.

A sleek spacer table with an embedded smart display. When seated at this table, colonists enjoy passive television-style recreation alongside meals or work. People eat off tables when chairs are placed facing them.

A sleek spacer table with an embedded smart display. When seated at this table, colonists enjoy passive television-style recreation alongside meals or work. People eat off tables when chairs are placed facing them.

A resilient relic from the spacer astronaut era. Offers unmatched insulation and near total fire resistance, safeguarding wearers from environmental hazards in space. Its outdated design significantly hampers movement, making wearers slow and less agile. Despite its minimal armor capabilities, its historical significance as a piece of early space exploration history remains undiminished.
A hopper-like storage basin meant to hold dispensed neutroamine from tanks periodically for use later.
A hopper-like storage basin meant to input neutroamine into the network, filling up connected tanks.
A workbench equipped with molecular printing technology to produce singular replacement parts for synthetic lifeforms.

A manufacturing station capable of assembling an android from a variety of materials and advanced components. The android’s appearance is almost completely customizable, however it is limited to imitations of baseline humans.

Depending on the hardware and subroutine composition of an android, the work to create one and the resources required to do it might vary.

A reprogramming station used to imbue desirable traits and skills onto an android. Onboard software allows even complete beginners to modify an android’s personality, however a more intellectually talented user will spend less time needing to follow tutorials.

A casket specially designed for use by androids undergoing operations, or suffering from neutroloss as it can cycle and replace any missing neutroamine. There must be neutroamine available, either stored locally or sourced with a pipe network.

The maximum amount of neutroamine an android can hold is 100 units, but they can operate with minimal functions at 50 units.

A high-tier android brain designed as an intricate psychodynamic substrate unit, capable of supporting an advanced subpersona. This subcore is engineered to power complex and universal human-like androids. The subpersona contained within this core equals that of a live human in complexity, but is specifically programmed not to feel emotions and is confined within the core to prevent development into a fully-fledged AI.
To create such a sophisticated subcore, the composite patterns from multiple minds are integrated using advanced algorithms and precise analog transfers, without causing harm to the subjects. The Persona subcore stands as a testament to the fusion of human intellect and cutting-edge ultratechnology.
A synthetic, android neuropump. Distributes neutroamine across all android subsystems.
A synthetic, android air filter. A pair of these creates an android respiratory system.
A synthetic, android neutrofilter. Cleans up and recycles spent neutroamine.
A synthetic, android metabolism regulator. Helps maintain maximum energy efficiency.
A synthetic, android reactor. Once reactor is spent, it needs to be extracted and replaced.
A synthetic, android optical unit. Allows the android to see.
A synthetic, android audio processor. Allows the android to hear.
A synthetic, android nose. Allows the android to detect smells.
A synthetic, android jaw.
A synthetic, android ribcage.
A synthetic, android spine.
A synthetic, android leg.
A synthetic, android foot.
A synthetic, android arm.
A synthetic, android hand.

A drug for boosting the immune system after infections take hold. Helps against diseases, such as malaria and plague, as well as infections due to unclean wounds. Lasts 12 hours.

This drug doesn’t prevent new infections. It does cure existing infections - even those that are not yet discovered, however excessive usage of antibiotics can render a person temporarily resistant to the effect of them.
A bed specially designed for use in hospitals. The mattress has rotted away into nothingness.
A rusted triple-stack shelf. It doesn't hold as many items as it once had, due to its state of disrepair.
An electric-powered forge for smithing forsaken weapons and tools. Can only be built by a colonist with the forsaken knowledge gene.

A small capsule containing a package of genetic information. To use a genepack, it must be placed in a gene bank near a gene assembler and combined into an implantable xenogerm.

If not kept in a powered gene bank, this genepack will slowly deteriorate.

A small capsule containing a package of genetic information. To use a genepack, it must be placed in a gene bank near a gene assembler and combined into an implantable xenogerm.

If not kept in a powered gene bank, this genepack will slowly deteriorate.

A genetic toolkit capable of removing a random gene from a human target. This removal is quite destructive, and will target a gene at random. As a result, the target will drop into a coma for 3 days. Using the remover on a colonist suffering from the coma will have no effect.

A genetic toolkit capable of converting a random xenogene from a human target into an endogene. As a result, the target will drop into a coma for 3 days. Using the endogenefier on a colonist suffering from the coma will have no effect.

A genetic toolkit capable of converting a random endogene from a human target into a xenogene. As a result, the target will drop into a coma for 3 days. Using the xenogenefier on a colonist suffering from the coma will have no effect.

A genetic toolkit capable of forcefully removing all xenotype genes from the target, reverting them to baseline humanity. As a result, the target will drop into a coma for 3 days. Using the nullifier on a colonist suffering from the coma will have no effect.

A genetic toolkit capable of forcefully removing all genes from the target, both germline and xenogenes, and replacing them with a random xenotype. As a result, the target will drop into a coma for 3 days. Using the injector on a colonist suffering from the coma will have no effect.

A genetic toolkit capable of causing random genetic mutations on the subject's germline, producing one random endogene. As a result, the target will drop into a coma for 3 days. Using the mutator on a colonist suffering from the coma will have no effect.

A genetic toolkit capable of acting upon an existing genepack adding a new, random gene to it. The targetted genepack must have 3 or less genes inside it, and this process won't add new archite genes to it.
A genetic toolkit capable of acting upon an existing genepack deleting a random gene present on it. The targetted genepack must have 2 or more genes inside it.

A genetic toolkit capable of removing a specific gene from a human target. This removal is quite destructive, and as a result, the target will drop into a coma for 3 days. Using the remover on a colonist suffering from the coma will have no effect.

A genetic toolkit capable of converting a specific xenogene from a human target into an endogene. As a result, the target will drop into a coma for 3 days. Using the archotech endogenefier on a colonist suffering from the coma will have no effect.

A genetic toolkit capable of converting a specific endogene from a human target into a xenogene. As a result, the target will drop into a coma for 3 days. Using the archotech xenogenefier on a colonist suffering from the coma will have no effect.
Fertilized human egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a human. Must be kept between 0 and 50 ºC.
Ultima fabric is used in the making of Forsaken armors. Produced by septimum plant, which can only be sown by colonists with the Forsaken Knowledge gene.
This Forsaken-style hood gives protection, while helping the wearer keep calm and focused.
This Forsaken-style hood gives protection, while helping the wearer keep calm and focused.
This cloak has been fabricated by Forsaken for all of their hunting needs.
This cloak has been fabricated by Forsaken for all of their hunting needs.
An ultratech Forsaken helmet designed for combat. Extremely durable and heightens focus.
An ultratech Forsaken helmet designed for combat. Extremely durable and heightens focus. This particular design enhances psycic sensitivity instead of suppressing it.
An ultratech Forsaken armor designed for combat. Extremely durable and comfortable.
This sniper rifle is prized by Forsaken explorers for its long range and high accuracy.
Forsaken shotgun, great accuracy at short distances and very deadly at close range.
This Forsaken assault rifle has a rather small calibre cartridge and a long reload time, but has a high burst shot count, high armor penetration and decent accuracy.
This Forsaken long sword takes little effort to lift and swing but can deal substantial damage.
The traditional Forsaken battle axe deals a lot of damage on impact, at the cost of unwealdy shape and weight.
A Forsaken equivalent of the gladius, common sidearms among Forsaken infantry. Terrible armor penetration, but easy to handle.
A Forsaken spear. Deals great damage, but can be difficult to handle.
This traditional Forsaken bow is very accurate and can deal decent damage. Its sharp edges make it usable in melee combat.

The Forsaken Black Hydra is a special weapon system that draws lightning to the point of fire, due to an ionized electrocloud detonator. Legend says these weapons needed to contain the heart of a hydra to function.
A humanoid figure made out of hay, dressed in old clothes to deter animals in a large radius. Small animals will be too afraid to approach.
A water sprinkler, providing an area around it with water. Enhances the growth of surrounding plants.

Grenades loaded with liquified blind smoke. Upon landing, they instantly release their smoke payload. The non-toxic smoke covers an area, greatly reducing ranged accuracy and completely blocking automated turret targeting. It provides tactical cover for about a minute before dissipating.

A non-lethal tactical grenade designed to temporarily incapacitate enemies. Upon detonation, it emits a powerful flash of light and a loud sound, disorienting and stunning enemies in a radius, buying time for tactical advances or retreats.

One of the most versatile tools for a soldier, the entrenching tool is a simple but effective weapon. With a sturdy handle and a sharpened, heavy blade, it serves equally well for digging a trench or bludgeoning an enemy.

A sturdy, weighted club used for incapacitation and crowd control. Its dense construction delivers powerful blunt force trauma, favored by police and security forces for non-lethal (and sometimes lethal) engagements.

OA refined and deadly tool, the military combat knife has taken many forms, but the concept has always remained the same: A handle for a sure grip and a sharp edge for cutting and thrusting, optimized for battlefield use.
A simple, single-handed weapon with a heavy head, designed to deliver powerful blunt force to crush enemies. Using a hammer increases the construction speed slightly.
A hefty, two-handed axe designed for cleaving through foes. Its wide, sharp blade delivers devastating cutting damage, while its mass allows for powerful but slow strikes.
A versatile polearm featuring a sharp axe head and a back spike, designed for rapid, decisive blows against armored foes. The reach of the poleaxe allows to strike enemies much further away.
A small, single-handed axe designed for quick, repeated strikes. Its light weight and short handle allow for fast swinging speed. Using a hatchet increases the plant harvest yield slightly.

A single-use rocket launcher that fires three large-bore explosive rockets. Good against small groups of tough targets.

Because of its unwieldiness, single-use limitation, and the massive destruction it causes, it's said that one must be slightly crazy to use this weapon.

A single-use rocket launcher that fires a massive explosive projectile. Good against large groups of soft targets. Starts fires.

Because of its unwieldiness, single-use limitation, and the massive destruction it causes, it's said that one must be slightly crazy to use this weapon.

A single-use rocket launcher firing a massive, high-explosive warhead. Slow to aim with a significant minimum range due to its power, it excels against structures, mechanoids, and armored foes. Its unwieldiness, single-use nature, and sheer destruction make it a rare and scary sight in combat.

A compact, sophisticated compound hunting bow. Its cam system stores high energy, providing superior accuracy and launching armor-piercing, high-velocity arrows. The reduced sound signature makes it ideal for stealthy hunting.

A massive, high-caliber revolver, designed to deliver a devastating single punch. Its heavy frame and long barrel manage the immense recoil, making it slow to draw but highly effective at putting down targets with its powerful, armor-piercing rounds.

A modern, blowback-operated self-loading pistol designed for close-quarters engagement. It can be fired rapidly for superior short-range lethality and is slightly more accurate than standard autopistols.

A compact, double-barreled shotgun with a shortened stock and barrel. Designed for close-quarters engagements, it delivers a devastating, wide-spread blast at extremely short range, making it a terrifying ambush weapon.
A lightweight, breech-loaded launcher that fires fragmentation grenades. It projects a frag grenade a moderate distance, inflicting damage in a small blast radius.

A specialized, man-portable incendiary weapon. It projects a stream of searing hot fuel that ignites on contact, rapidly spreading flame across a short-to-medium range. Highly effective against unarmored targets and excellent for clearing enclosed spaces or burning away flammable cover.

A durable, self-loading rifle designed for rapid, controlled fire at medium-to-long ranges. Its mechanism allows for a high rate of fire compared to bolt-action models, making it ideal for maintaining continuous pressure on an enemy.

A traditional hunting rifle utilizing a lever-action mechanism. It offers a balance of moderate firepower, decent accuracy, and a fast follow-up shot compared to bolt-action designs, making it a reliable weapon for medium-range engagements.

A small, lightweight submachine gun designed for maneuverability in close-quarters combat. It fires a rapid burst of small-caliber rounds, making it highly effective at short range but quickly losing accuracy over distance.
Modern, magazine-fed SMG built for overwhelming close-quarters fire. It uses small-caliber rounds in a long burst, sacrificing long-range accuracy for sheer, close-up firepower.

A gas-operated heavy machine gun. Its massive frame and long barrel make it extremely heavy and slow to maneuver, but it delivers devastatingly long bursts of heavy-caliber fire, designed to suppress and tear through armored targets and groups of enemies.

A versatile and rugged assault rifle widely used around the galaxy by militia forces and mercenaries.

Not as powerful as an assault rifle, but deliver 4 shot bursts.

A gas-operated rifle designed to deliver a powerful, accurate shot in medium-to-long-range engagements. It uses a heavier caliber round than a standard assault rifle, sacrificing burst size for superior damage and armor penetration.

A general-purpose gas-operated assault rifle, slightly shortened and lighter for enhanced maneuverability. It fires an intermediate-caliber round in a long burst, offering good close-to-medium range accuracy but sacrificing long-range precision for superior handling.

A specialized, semi-automatic rifle. It fires a powerful round with higher velocity than a standard assault rifle, offering an excellent balance of long-range precision and a faster rate of follow-up shots.

Devastating, heavy-caliber bolt-action rifle designed to engage fortified positions and armored targets. It fires an exceptionally large round for superior damage and penetration at extreme ranges. Due to its weight and recoil, it's physically demanding and requires a long aiming period before it can be accurately fired.
A simple crossbow. It fires a standard bolt with decent accuracy and firing rate, making it a reliable mid-tier anti-armor ranged weapon.
A small bundle of light, balanced knives designed to be thrown rapidly. Ineffective against armor, but capable of high close-range damage.
A handful of rocks. Can inflict minor injuries in close range. Doesn't drop on death. Simple but effective.

Longbow is a massive long range medieval weapon, capable of firing a powerful arrow over extremely long distances.

Arrows fired from this bow fly overhead, avoiding getting stopped by obstacles.

This high-tech, self-loading pistol uses pulse-charge technology to channel unstable energy into each shot. The charged energy is released on impact, delivering superior damage and armor penetration. Its compact size and reliability make it an ideal backup weapon in high-tech combat.

A sophisticated, high-tech scattergun utilizing pulse-charge technology. The energy is channeled into a single, high-impact slug, delivering devastating damage and superior armor penetration at close range. Its integrated pump-action mechanism cycles rounds rapidly, making it the ultimate tool for close-quarters breach and clear operations.

A compact submachine gun built using advanced pulse-charge technology. It fires a rapid burst of kinetic rounds charged with unstable energy, trading long-range precision for devastating, high-penetration firepower at close quarters. Its speed and size make it an exceptional weapon for clearing enclosed spaces.

A massive, portable charge weapon designed for sustained, suppressive fire. It uses advanced pulse-charge technology to channel and release devastating shots charged with unstable energy through its heavy-duty barrel. This design sacrifices spread for sheer focused power, making it capable of tearing apart multiple enemies or structures in a single, prolonged burst.

A specialized, high-velocity charge rifle designed for extreme-range engagement with anti-armor capabilities. It channels immense pulse-charge energy into a single, kinetic slug, delivering extremely high damage and armor penetration with pinpoint accuracy at maximum distance. Its bulk requires a stable firing position.

A colossal charge weapon adapted for portable use. It channels immense pulse-charge energy into heavy-caliber slugs, firing them in devastating, sustained bursts. While its mass makes it difficult to handle, it is unrivaled in its capacity to tear through hardened targets and armored columns.

A portable, shoulder-fired launcher that uses laser targeting to fire an explosive, charged missile high into the air. The projectile follows a ballistic arc, allowing it to bypass cover and strike targets without needing a direct line of sight. Must be used in an unroofed area.

An extremely mysterious mineral that is both malleable and serves as a physical conduit for psycasts. As psycasting originates from archotech engines, some speculate that either these minerals were manufactured by the archotechs or that they developed their engines using this strange mineral.

An artistically impressive mask emanating psychic energy. Hides the face of the wearer but provides little physical protection. Its special materials enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity and dissipate neural heat.
A long cape of mystical design. It hangs over one side of the torso. Its special materials enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity and dissipate neural heat.

Overlapping solid plates of armor covering the entire body from neck to feet.

Expensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
An eltex ring created by a skilled technomancer. It holds the knowledge of one particular psycast, and can be used by other psycasters to cast it.

A piece of steel slag, animated by powerful psychic energy. It will engage nearby threats and defend the master from any harm that may come to them.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>Constructs generate constant heat for the caster that summoned them. Keeping too many constructs alive could prevent the psycaster from casting other abilities.

A piece of rock chunk, animated by powerful psychic energy. It will do simple work around the colony tirelessly and with maximum dedication.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>Constructs generate constant heat for the caster that summoned them. Keeping too many constructs alive could prevent the psycaster from casting other abilities.
A psychically re-animated husk of a deceased individual. Extremely aggressive, but will soon wither away into nothing.

A medieval dagger threaded with psychic focusing materials. While it enhances the wielder’s psychic sensitivity and neural heat dissipation, it also serves as an excellent melee weapon, as it follows the same idea as any other knife: A handle for holding and a sharp edge for cutting.

A medieval mace threaded with psychic focusing materials. While it enhances the wielder’s psychic sensitivity and neural heat dissipation, it also serves as an excellent melee weapon, engineered for efficient swinging and deadly impacts.

A medieval sword threaded with psychic focusing materials. While it enhances the wielder’s psychic sensitivity and neural heat dissipation, it also serves as an excellent melee weapon. Good for stabbing or slashing. It's light and nimble, which sometimes lets it beat bigger, heavier weapons.

Mystical heat pearls created by a technomancer in a process of condensing psychic heat into a physical form. They can be thrown at the other psycasters to unleash an insane amount of psychic heat, disabling their psycasting ability for the short duration.

An ultratech staff threaded with psychic focusing materials. While it is a solid melee weapon, its main purpose is to enhance the wielder's psychic sensitivity and neural heat dissipation, allowing more use of psychic powers.

This weapon has an onboard persona that can bond to only a single person. The wielder and intelligent weapon can synchronize their reflexes and attack with frightening speed, accuracy, and creativity. Once bonded to a wielder, the weapon's persona will refuse to be wielded by anyone else.
A crude table cluttered with instruments that supposedly make surgery easier, the cleanliness of the table is questionable though. Slightly improves medical outcomes over normal beds.
A medical that uses partial cryptosleep to slow down the degredation of wounds and help the body heal, although with the same side effects of cryptosleep, albeit at a lesser severity.

A large centre for monitoring the vitals of several patients at once, increasing medical tend quality, surgery success chance and immunity gain speed when placed in the vicinity of a hospital bed or surgical table. Only works for hospital beds or surgical tables - normal beds will not benefit.

An intravenous drip stand for quickly delivering lost fluids to a patient, helping the immune system and blood loss recovery when placed directly adjacent to a hospital bed or surgical table. Only works for hospital beds or surgical tables - normal beds will not benefit. Attaching more than one stand to the same bed will have no effect.

The physical form of techprints can range from scraps of paper with diagrams, all the way to advanced self-contained teaching machines. Regardless of form, they play the same role. Your researchers need the foundational knowledge offered by techprints to know where to start on a given technology. Only after enough techprints have been applied can your researchers work out the fine details of how to make use of the technology in your particular situation.

Applying techprints to a satisfied project fulfills half the remaining research progress. In addition, researchers always gain a boost to their intellectual skills when applying techprints, even on already-completed technologies.

A volatile liquid chemical sludge, extracted from deep underground pockets. It’s too thick to be used to fuel engines and rockets, or to transmute into propellant for projectiles, but it can be refined down into standard chemfuel.
A hopper-like storage basin meant to input deepchem into the network, filling up connected tanks.

A deep-crust drilling rig for extracting deepchem from deep under the surface. Use a ground penetrating scanner to detect deposits. Deepchem can then be further refined into usable chemfuel. Can be repositioned freely.
A hopper-like storage basin meant to hold dispensed deepchem from tanks periodically for use later.

Stores electricity for later use. Due to technological advancements, this battery unit is significantly more efficient. Charged advanced batteries are waterproof and don't explode when exposed to rain.
Raw anchovy. A small, common forage fish of the family Engraulidae. Most species are found in marine waters, but several will enter brackish water and some are restricted to fresh water.
Raw angelfish. Angelfish refers to several species of fish, both marine and freshwater, usually sporting bright colours and deep, laterally compressed bodies.
Raw anglerfish. Anglerfish are bony fish named for their characteristic mode of predation, in which, a fleshy growth from the fish's head (the esca or illicium) acts as a lure towards other fish.
A bulky, coin-operated arcade cabinet with an aging CRT screen and colorful buttons. Though outdated, it still provides hours of digital entertainment. Classic games never truly die.
An ancient, human-sized mysterious machine. Creates a detailed imagery in the minds of surrounding pawns. Works through walls.

This device taps into psychic energy leaving the bodies of surrounding humanoids, changing it directly into usable energy. This technology is developed by archotechs, and is beyond even most glitterworld societies.
A warm and long piece of fabric protecting the jaw from exposure to wind. Makes one hard to remember.
A simple bar stool.
A small carving sculpted from a waist-tall wall piece. Can act as cover.
A device that converts chemfuel into heat. Simple machinery doesn't allow the temperature to be adjusted.
A lamp fueled by chemfuel. Can be safely placed outside.
A post with a pre-industrial chemfuel lamp. Can be safely placed outside.

A dangerous alcohol usually consumed by rimworld prospectors and industrial settlers. Whilst it takes away the sadness and pain, chemshine intoxicates the blood of the drinker with chemfuel, resulting in a powerful explosion upon death.
A barrel for fermenting chemshine.
A simple yet beautiful stone slab used for sleeping. It offers minimal comfort but is durable and fireproof.
A simple yet beautiful stone slab used for sleeping that fits two people. It offers minimal comfort but is durable and fireproof.
Simple, circular table that can be eaten off of.

Raw clownfish. In the wild, clownfish form symbiotic mutualisms with sea anemones. Depending on species, clownfish are overall yellow, orange, or a reddish or blackish color, and many show white bars or patches.

A small table which makes nearby armchairs and couches a little bit more comfortable. Must be placed directly adjacent to the couch or an armchair. Placing more than one coffee table near the same couch has no effect.
People eat off counters when chairs are placed facing them
A simple dartboard mounted on a stand. A fun way to practice accuracy and hand-eye coordination. It trains shooting ability.
Plant decorative flowers on this ornamental plant pot to improve the mood of people nearby.
An electrical desk lamp that lights a small area. People need light to move and work at full speed.
An ancient pattern double-action revolver. It's not very accurate, but has a decent firing speed for a pistol and is quick on the draw.
An ancient design of shotgun with two individually loaded barrels, that emits a tight-packed spray of pellets.

A makeshift explosive stick of chemfuel. They can be thrown a short distance, where it will explode after a random amount of time.

An advanced work bench equipped with containers, heaters, and measurement devices for producing various drugs with more efficiency. Consumes a lot of power.
An advanced work table with electrical saws and holders for cutting stone chunks into usable blocks in shorter duration of time on an assembly line. Consumes a lot of power.
A modern, adjustable bed designed for maximum comfort and proper spinal support.

A flat and handy cap. Somewhat protecting from the sun. Worn by settlers and colonists during their daily occupations.
A low-profile light source embedded into the floor. While not as bright as a standing lamp, it provides subtle, even lighting without obstructing movement. Does not short circuit in rain.
A wood-fueled station for smelting. Extracts usable metal from slag chunks and other mixed metal items.

A portable, old time turret. Needs to be manned in order to be operated. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use. Firing speed increases the longer this turret fires. May explode when damaged.
Raw goldfish. The goldfish (Carassius auratus) is a freshwater fish in the family Cyprinidae of order Cypriniformes. It is one of the most commonly kept aquarium fish.
A huge floor covering textile that dominates a room, decorated with artistic embroidery.
A huge piece of material on a decorative pedestal, sculpted into an artistic form.
A great dress, most often worn by ladies and suffragettes. Greatly enhances social interactions.

A human-sized light projecting device, depicting an artwork made using several programming languages. Needs to be plugged in to display the artwork.
An ancient pattern bolt-action rifle with a scope. With its exceptional range, and low fire rate, it is unlikely to drive animals to revenge, which makes it an excellent choice for hunting.

An industrial-era radio for playing music and spoken broadcasts. Even on the rimworlds, there is often an old transmitter running something at least marginally interesting. Provides passive music recreation to those that can hear it.
Increases work speed when placed nearby a cooking stove.
Raw koi. Koi are colored varieties of the Amur carp (Cyprinus rubrofuscus) that are kept for decorative purposes in outdoor koi ponds or water gardens.

A spacious waste disposal unit that efficiently keeps the surrounding area clean. Slowly removes trash and filth in a 15-cell radius.
A large size floor covering textile, decorated with artistic embroidery.

Generates a large amount of free energy, forever, without using fuel. This technology is developed by archotechs, and is beyond even most glitterworld societies. While nobody knows exactly how it works, scholars believe it somehow extracts energy directly from fluctuations in the quantum foam.

Raw lobster. Lobsters are large marine crustaceans. Lobsters have long bodies with muscular tails. Three of their five pairs of legs have claws, including the first pair, which are usually much larger than the others.
Plant decorative flowers here to improve the mood of people nearby. Designed to be combined with other plant pots to form various shapes.

A state-of-the-art, high-fidelity radio that uses advanced longwave transmission to deliver crystal-clear music, broadcasts, and interstellar transmissions. Even on the rimworlds, someone out there is always transmitting something - whether it’s news, music, or distant voices from the void..
A reclining cushioned lounger designed for relaxation. Offers superior comfort but is not ideal for deep, restful sleep. Allows for sunbathing recreation.

These raw hides and pelts were removed from a creature, and with the right skills and tools, could be processed into tanned leather.
Raw butchered flesh from an aerofleet. Chewy, gelatinous, and insipid. Similar in texture to jellyfish.

A small airplane that moves extremely fast and can carry more cargo than an helicopter, but requires a landing strip and it's very visible, like any aircraft. Has a regular fuel efficiency on the world map, but makes up for it in speed.

A high-tech device that can be installed into any compatible artificial nose replacement. This particular module is functionally nearly identical to a standard aesthetic nose implant. However, a layer of synthetic skin allows it to be installed onto non-biological replacements.

A large canine, distinguished from dogs and wolves by dentition highly specialised for a hypercarnivorous diet, and a lack of dewclaws. The african wild dog is a highly social animal, living in packs. Like most wild canines, they prefer to stay as far away from humans as possible.
A bundle of seeds for agaricus domecap. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
Raw agarilux harvested from an agaripod. It is very nice to eat, even when raw.
A bundle of seeds for agarilux. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

A subspecies of wildpawn that has grown in the secluded environment of a mycotic jungle. Its body is covered by agarilux mushrooms that seem to be in a state of symbiosis. Agaripawns are less resistant to gunfire than agaripods but still retain a weakness to fire. Agaripawns reproduce asexually by releasing clumps of spores every few weeks, so their children are completely wild and independent of them, with no concept of parenthood. Asexual creatures like this one can't be sterilized.

Agaripawns can be hunted or farmed for small amounts of edible raw agarilux, which can be eaten raw and rots slower than regular fungus.
Fertilized agaripawn spores. If all goes well, it should bud into a baby agaripawn. It can be eaten raw, and isn't much better cooked.

A subspecies of wildpod that has grown in the secluded environment of a mycotic jungle. Its body is covered by agarilux mushrooms that seem to be in a state of symbiosis. Agaripods are almost impervious to gunfire, with bullets simply being absorbed into its mass. In contrast, they are very weak to fire. Agripods reproduce asexually by releasing clumps of spores every few weeks, so their children are completely wild and independent of them, with no concept of parenthood. Asexual creatures like this one can't be sterilized.

Although risky, agaripods can be hunted or farmed for decent amounts of edible raw agarilux, which can be eaten raw and rots slower than regular fungus.
Fertilized agaripod spores. If all goes well, it should bud into a baby agaripod. It can be eaten raw, and isn't much better cooked.
A bundle of seeds for agaritox. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A thin and semi-sweet nectar, known for its healing and anti-inflammatory properties. Applying the nectar to a gourmet meal will grant it an immunity-boosting effect.
A bundle of seeds for agave. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

These capsules are filled with a mixture of chemicals and nanomachines, able to modify an organism's age by carefully manipulating its DNA. Every pill taken increases age by 1 year. Useful to make animals mature quickly.

Once consumed, the animal will be extremely dizzy for at least a day, and additional pills administered during that period won't be effective.

Oh, your colonists can also consume them...

An air fryer is a small countertop convection oven designed to simulate deep frying without submerging the food in oil. A fan circulates hot air at high speed, producing a crisp layer via browning reactions. Much healthier than deep frying.
Indoor air-con unit for rooms. Connect to outdoor air-con units. Requires 100 cooling units.

Multi-split air conditioner unit. Place outdoors and pipe to indoor units or freezer units. Supplies 500 cooling units, shared between the indoor units still calling for cooling. Power use follows the cooling actually being done.
a simple TV that can be placed on the floor by itself.

A high-tech device that can be installed into an ear or any compatible artificial ear replacement. This particular model is equipped with a compact comms array that slightly increases the user's bandwidth.
A simple straw hat made to block the sun.
a dresser features round brass handles.

A heavy table, secured with a layer of thick leather. Stocked with all sorts of thingamajigs, it’s useless to uneducated mind whilst perfectly functional for an adept of forbidden arts. It’s everything an aspiring alchemist could wish for to mix ingredients and prepare oddly specific reagents.

A high-tech device that can be installed into a liver or any compatible artificial liver replacement. This particular model is capable of synthesizing alcohol and releasing it into the body. It's able to suppress alcohol cravings, but properly curing an addiction is not possible with an implant such as this one.
Alcyonite is a very rare variation of the almandite gemstone. Really strong, able to easily cut steel, yet malleable and with interesting piezoelectric capabilities.

Fermented beverage of deep golden colouring, a real lifeblood of social life in these parts. Few mugs in the tavern are all what's needed to forget about hardships of field work, dangers awaiting on the road or ill-considered marriage vows. Let the warm haze of drunkenness embrace you, no need to worry about anything. Not today.
Un-fermented ale. This substance needs to ferment in a fermenting barrel before it becomes drinkable ale.
Used for distilling mixtures. Increases workspeed when placed near an alchemy bench or cauldron.
A button pressed in distress that triggers linked alarm systems and lights.
A small alien figurine.

An installed implant that grants its user resistance to acid. The implant is crafted from the archite stomach lining that prevents devourers from digesting themselves and maintained by the influence of an archotech shard. By implanting a thin layer of these archites between the dermal layers, the user gains resistance to acid damage and digestion.
A sign about allosaurus.

The loosely jointed jaws of Allosaurus allow it to open its jaws extremely wide, similar to snakes. While they lack the bone crushing abilities of the Tyrannosaurs, their teeth are very effective at tearing away chunks of flesh as they attack. 

Scientific name: Allosaurus fragilis (Fragile different lizard) 

The first Allosaurus fossils found were vertebrae, which locals has assumed were petrified horse hooves.
A bundle of seeds for allspice plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
An oval shaped drupe often eaten on its own, raw or toasted, though it can also be used as a component of various dishes. A wide range of classic sweets feature almonds as a central ingredient.
Extremely broad leaves of a plant that’s a commonly-recognized signifier of tropical forests. Alocasia leaves have been used by medieval civilizations in creation of different draughts.
A bundle of seeds for alocasia. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A bundle of seeds for aloe vera plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

A soothing, all-natural ointment made from the gel of the aloe vera plant. Known for its healing and moisturizing properties.

<color=#E5E54C>Trade considerations:</color>

<color=#E5E54C>Ingredients:</color> Making 10 aloe vera salves requires herbal medicine for a total value of 50, and sells for 9, giving a <color=#33CC33>44.44%</color> profit per unit.

<color=#E5E54C>Value per work:</color> Recipe requires 750 work, which results on a value per work of <color=#33CC33>0.12</color>.

<color=#E5E54C>Caravan trading:</color> Its weight is 0.05 Kg, for a value per Kg of <color=#33CC33>180</color>.

<color=#E5E54C>Profit per day:</color> On average, profit per day is <color=#33CC33>0.31</color> (for reference Yayo is 0.35).

<color=#E5E54C>Extra use:</color> Aloe vera salves can be applied to reduce the severity of an infection by 2,5%.

A pale creature of the night, Alps invade the dreams of nearby creatures, trapping them in a nightmare and feeding on their negative emotions. Victims often report extreme signs of distress upon waking, and most travelers will not stay at a settlement without some kind of night watch due to the intense experiences often reported. Despite this, Alps tend to be easy prey with their frail bones, parchment-like skin, and decaying insides. Scholars remain unsure about the origins of these creatures, though some theorize an ancient curse may be responsible.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.

A payload of alpha animal genetic material. Can be used at the genomorpher to create a growth cell of a hybrid animal. This tier 2 genome can only be used as primary genome.

Stack size total: 14

An indispensable part of any turret pipeline system, the Ammo dispenser efficiently delivers munitions from the pipe network directly to connected turrets. Designed for seamless operation, its high-flow delivery mechanism ensures that your defenses remain fully stocked and combat-ready, even during prolonged engagements.

An essential component for any automated defense system, the Ammo Injector feeds munitions directly into the pipe network, ensuring a steady supply to connected turrets. With its precision-engineered intake system, it keeps your colony's defenses armed and ready to respond to any threat.
Bandolier with ammunition.
A portable pack of ammunition for industrial firearms.

A crystal-clear, white liquid. When the user drinks it, it causes them to rapidly lose their memory. This effect makes both negative and positive memories fade much quicker than normal, leading to a transient experience of life's events. While this can alleviate the burden of painful memories, it also diminishes the joy and learning gained from positive experiences.
A lightly armored mask used by the leader of the Equalists, Amon.
An object with ideoligious significance.
The anaconda is the heaviest and one of the longest known snake species, reaching lengths of 5 meters. They are a primarily nocturnal species that tends to spend most of its life in or around water.
A fertilized anaconda egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into an anaconda. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
An unfertilized anaconda egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
