Processed energy-packed fuel safe for use by androids.
Very efficiently refines wood or chemfuel into android fuel for android consumption. For placement in a Kitchen.

A genetically engineered lepidopteran that was a product of a waste disposal experiment being abandoned and its subjects being released into the wild.

Angel moths are voracious and will mainly consume clothing and textiles. If no clothes are present, they'll reluctantly eat grass. Although they can be used to get rid of unwanted clothing, it is hard to make them discriminate, as they are unruly creatures.

They produce a moth silk that can be harvested to use as a textile. Care must be taken to keep it out of other angel moths' reach, since they can consume it too.
A fertilized angel moth egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into an angel moth larva. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.

A genetically engineered lepidopteran that was a product of a waste disposal experiment being abandoned and its subjects being released into the wild. Angel moth larvae are timid and harmless. They are content with munching on sparse vegetation and will eventually metamorphose into its adult form.

Adult angel moths are voracious and will mainly consume clothing and textiles. If no clothes are present, they'll reluctantly eat grass. Although they can be used to get rid of unwanted clothing, it is hard to make them discriminate, as they are unruly creatures.

Adults produce a moth silk that can be harvested to use as a textile. Care must be taken to keep it out of other angel moths' reach, since they can consume it too.

Small, domestic rabbit that has developed an ability to enhance the neural heat dissipation of anyone they bond with. Unfortunately, as a side effect, it the bonded master of the angora rabbit dies, the rabbit will also die of sadness and loss.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> As long as an Angora Rabbit is bonded to a colonist, this colonist will receive a psychic connection that helps with neural heat dissipation.

A large domesticated ungulate, Angus have better marbling than a typical cow and are bred to produce huge amounts of milk, meat, and leather. They are exceptionally gentle creatures and will never seek revenge, no matter how many times they are harmed. Most of them are so adapted to farm life that they cannot survive in the wild.

A variant of the overgrown colossus native to anima forests. They are reptilian in nature, with cold blood and a slow metabolism. They have six legs, two intertwined spines, and six eyes.

It has a symbiotic relationship with anima vegetation, with several anima trees and mystic cap mushrooms growing on its back. These plants seem to provide sustenance in a symbiotic relationship with the colossus.

When tamed, the anima colossus can be periodically trimmed to obtain wood. It will also very rarely produce a huge, hardened anima pearl, which can be planted to grow a new anima tree.
A smooth, lustrous pearl formed within anima blossoms, faintly humming with psychic resonance. Anima pearls can be consumed to increase psychic sensitivity for some time.
The seed of an anima tree. It can be planted to create a new anima tree which can be used for a psychic linking ritual.
An animal implant that enables the animal to spray a sticky acid substance from glands in the neck up through the mouth and all over the target area. The acid will stick to targets and burn them.

An animal acidic breath implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a ranged acidic breath attack that causes damage over time.

Note that installing this on a creature that already has an acidic breath will have no effect.

An acidic spitter implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a ranged acidic spit attack that causes additional damage over time.

Note that installing this on a creature that already has an acidic spitter will have no effect. This implant can only be used by animals that have a mouth (and not, for example, a beak or proboscis).

An animal archotech arm. Strong enough to crush a thick hardwood branch in its hand, and precise enough to write a sonnet on a grain of rice. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but it's harder to damage than plasteel. Even if it is harmed, it repairs itself over time. Its internal workings are a mystery to all human minds.

An animal archotech leg. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but it can make the animal move lightning fast, and it's harder to damage than plasteel. Even if it is harmed, it repairs itself over time. Its internal workings are a mystery to all human minds.
An animal archotech tail. Indistinguishable from a natural tail, while at the same time providing the animal with a surge of speed and agility.

A barbed quill thrower implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a ranged venomous quill attack that causes toxic buildup.

Note that installing this on a creature that already has a barbed quill thrower will have no effect.
A prosthetic animal leg strengthened with bear muscles, and ending in sharp bear claws that add a powerful melee attack.
An implant that uses bear genes to improve function of the liver. Specially useful for those alcoholic chickens.
A bed designed for animals.

A bioelectric organ implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a powerful ranged electric attack that may paralyze and cause heart attacks.

Note that installing this on a creature that already has a bioelectric organ will have no effect.

An animal bionic arm. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while the biogel nerve-link gives exquisite control. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage. It is better than a biological arm in almost every way.
An animal bionic beak engineered from advanced, durable materials to restore biting and pecking functions. Should be able to replace almost any avian-like beak.

An animal bionic blade built with advanced, resilient materials. Will replace a range of biological structures such as single claws (not claws that are part of a paw, for example) and an insect's headclaw.
An animal bionic ear featuring advanced auditory sensors and real-time threat detection, enhancing the animal's ability to hear and pinpoint approaching dangers.
An animal bionic eye. With its biogel nerve-link, internal signal pre-processor, and wide-spectrum sensors, it is better than a biological eye in almost every way.
An animal bionic gas bag. Should be able to replace hydrogen sacs and other exotic organs keeping hovering creatures in the air.
An animal bionic heart. Equipped with neural-networked sensors, it offers real-time performance monitoring and adaptive response and will outperform any biological counterparts.
An animal bionic horn integrating advanced materials and engineering. It offers superior strength, durability, and potential enhancements such as sensory capabilities.
An animal bionic jaw. Enhanced with quantum-synchronized actuators, cutting-edge nanomaterials and neural interface technology to optimize bite strength and control.
An animal bionic leg. With its biogel nerve-link, powerful mini-servos, and lattice-dust healing system, it is better than a biological leg in almost every way.
An animal bionic nose equipped with advanced olfactory sensors and targeting systems, enhancing the animal's ability to detect and precisely locate targets.
An animal bionic shell built with advanced, resilient materials, offering superior protection and structural support and designed to perfectly mimic natural shells.
An animal bionic spine. Enhanced with bio-feedback algorithms, it offers real-time biomechanical adaptation and proprioceptive feedback. It matches the performance of a biological spine.
An animal bionic stinger incorporating cutting-edge technology to enhance natural stinging capabilities. Engineered for precision and potency.

An animal bionic stomach. It incorporates nano-gastric chambers and hyper-digestive enzymes, synchronized with gastric processors for optimal nutrient absorption and metabolic efficiency. It is better than a biological stomach in almost every way.

An animal bionic tail. It integrates silent mini-servos for strength and a biogel nerve-link for precise control, enhancing agility and speed. This surpasses biological tails, enabling faster and more agile movement.

An animal bionic tentacle that replicates natural tentacle movements, offering superior grasping and manipulation capabilities for the animal. Bear in mind the original animal needs to have tentacles of its own. For extra tentacles, look into Anomaly implants.
A bionic brain implant using thrumbo neural tissue. Superb intelligence and reflexes.
A bionic eye reinforced with specialized photoreceptors from a powerful thrumbo.
A bionic implant adding thrumbo jaws to the creature's mouth. These creatures devour trees, so you can imagine their jaws are up to the task.
An animal bionic wing engineered from lightweight, durable materials and providing enhanced maneuverability. Designed to replicate natural wing movements.
An implant that uses chemfuel to pump blood through the animal's body. This implant is intended for creatures whose heart is failing catastrophically, since it is less efficient than a natural heart.
An implant that uses boomalope genes to improve function of the stomach.
An eye implant that uses genetic splicing with canid genes to give an old (or damaged) eye decent vision. This implant is not meant to replace healthy eyes.

A tail implant that uses genetic splicing with feline genes to substitute a broken or missing tail. This implant is not meant to replace a healthy tail. Note that only creatures with a natural tail can use this.
An animal implant that adds several chemfuel nodules to the animal's skin. These nodules contain unstable chemfuel and will explode upon the animal's death.
An implant that uses chicken brain tissue to patch damaged neurological pathways. This implant is intended for brain-dead creatures.
An implant that uses chicken genes to improve function of the kidney. Birds have large kidneys. Yep, you learned that today.
A bionic heart implant using a reinforced shell of insectoid chitin for protection. This is a heart designed to take a beating. Pun intended, but it's the last one, I promise.
A combination assistant and half-cycler, disables the need to rest of the animal without affecting its consciousness. An animal using this implant will be susceptible to EMP weapons.
An animal mind controller implant. This implant will allow this creature to be drafted and controlled by the player. Counts as a prosthetic when considering animal body size to be installed.
A bionic implant adding a sturdy crocodile spine to the creature's skeletal system.

An animal database containing detailed data of all scanned animals.

If the database gets somehow destroyed it will lose all its data, so you'd better protect it well.

It will display a total database completion on its infobox. Bear in mind you ABSOLUTELY do not need 100% completion, as it will most likely be impossible to attain, especially if you are using modded animals that only appear under special circumstances.

An animal dermal armor gland implant. Releases chemical and nanomachines that transform the user's skin into a built-in suit of armor. The whole epidermis thickens and hardens to resist burns, while jointed exterior keratin plates form everywhere they can - including the head and face.

An animal detoxifier kidney. Using a series of nanofilters, it can rapidly remove a vast range of toxins from the blood, making it effective against environmental toxins, venoms, and injected poisons. It is better than a biological kidney in almost every way.

An animal detoxifier liver. Utilizes advanced technology for precise toxin removal. Enhanced with real-time monitoring, it ensures optimal metabolic health, surpassing natural detoxification processes. It is better than a biological liver in almost every way.

An animal detoxifier lung. Includes a series of nanoweave microfilters that remove any pollutants from the air, allowing the animal to breathe comfortably. It is better than a biological lung in almost every way.
An animal eldritch flesh tentacle. A fleshy, muscled tentacle resembling a partial transformation into a fleshbeast. The tentacle is excellent at manipulation and grabbing targets.

A relatively small machine designed to simulate the environment of a mother’s womb. Once a Growthcell has been inserted, the embryo can start growing all the way to its adult life stage before being released. Provides limited growing room for specimens.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay notes:</color> This electrowomb is very cheap to build, but will produce a failure if the inserted creature has a body size bigger than 1.
This elephant auditory receptor can scan a really wide band of frequencies.
A bionic animal leg reinforced with muscle tissue from a powerful elephant.

An animal enlarger implant that will increase the body size of the animal, making it more resistant and dangerous. The new body size of the animal will be considered when calculating which implants can be installed on it!

NOTE: This implant itself is capable of being installed on any animal, regardless of their body size.

An animal extra gas bag implant that inserts several hydrogen filled structures inside the animals' body, allowing it to gently glide a few feet in the air. This will negate all terrain movement costs.

NOTE: This implant will have no effect on animals that possess this ability innately, such as Aerofleet.

A specialized storage container designed to hold food for feeding your colony animals. Items stored inside will not deteriorate over time and have no impact on the beauty of their surroundings. 

<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> 
Stack size total: 18 
Stack per tile: 9 

Allowed items: Hay, Kibble

An animal fire breath implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a ranged fire breath attack that lights enemies on fire.

Note that installing this on a creature that already has a fire breath of this kind will have no effect.

An animal implant that enables the animal to spit a stream of sticky, flammable bile from the mouth. The bile can ignite anything or anyone it hits, and also form flaming pools on the ground.

The bile is generated and stored by an organ in the neck, along with a separate pouch of hypergolic reactant for ignition.
An animal implant that enables the animal to spray thick fire-retardant foam from glands in the neck up through the mouth. The foam will cover a small area and extinguish any fire it touches.
A goo acidifier increases the acidity of a goo's internal organs, making it explode as soon as it is downed. Basically transforms goos into biological suicide bombers.
A combination coagulator and healing enhancer, combines advanced coagulation and accelerated healing technologies, providing rapid blood clotting and enhanced tissue repair.
An installed animal implant that enables the animal to use the coagulate ability.

A hyper acidic stomach implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a ranged acid attack that causes damage over time.

Note that installing this on a creature that already has a hyper acidic stomach will have no effect. This implant takes the space of the creature's stomach, so it can't be installed in animals that lack one.

An analysis computer which inspects the bloodstream, classifies pathogens, and rapidly prompts the body's natural immune system to respond to them faster than it could alone. This speeds immunity gain significantly.
An animal mind controller implant. This implant will allow this creature to be drafted and controlled by the player.
A bionic implant adding insect mandibles to the creature's face. Insect mandibles improve manipulation and eating, while also working as an offensive weapon
A bionic implant which gives the creature compound insectile eyes. Compared with simple eyes, compound eyes possess a very large view angle, and can detect fast movement.
An implant that uses genetic splicing with insectoid genes to give the ability to detect pheromones, thus improving the olfactory system. Can't be installed on birds and (ironically) insects.

A light focusing lens implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a powerful ranged laser attack that sets enemies on fire.

Note that installing this on a creature that already has a light focusing lens will have no effect. This implant takes the space of one of the creature's eyes, so it can't be installed in eyeless animals.
A bionic animal leg reinforced with tough lizard skin.

A bionic implant adding a small thrumbo horn where the creature's nose used to be. This implant acts as a nose, allowing the creature to breathe and smell, and can be used by the creature in melee. Birds, insects, and creatures that already have a thrumbo horn don't have enough space on their skull to install this implant.
A bionic implant using monitor lizard brain tissue. This highly intelligent reptile has very quick reflexes.
A bionic implant adding a moth tympanal organ to the creature's ear. Moths can hear sounds of a higher frequency than any bat can produce.
An implant that uses muffalo genes to increase breathing capacity.
A spine implant that uses genetic splicing with muffalo genes to give an old (or damaged) spine decent functioning. This implant is not meant to replace healthy spines.

An animal nuclear stomach implant. A micro-nuclear reactor combined with complex chemical synthesis replaces the body's need for food energy. Food is required only to replace matter lost from the body, reducing the animal's intake needs significantly. However, there is little room to shield the reactor, so the radiation increases the risk of cancer.

An animal brain implant which inhibits nociception, or pain sensation. While it does allow the user to accomplish more, it turns out pain has a purpose. When you don't feel it, you can get hurt really bad really easily.

An animal petrifying gaze implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a very dangerous petrifying gaze that will slow down its target, and eventually kill it.

Note that installing this on a creature that already has a petrifying attack will have no effect. And obviously a creature will need eyes to use this attack.

An animal implant that enables the animal to launch a bony spine at targets using a powerful chemical reaction. The spine is propelled through a specialized opening between the collarbones, ensuring precise and effortless aiming.
An animal pouncing leg. Engineered with high-tension springs and advanced composite materials, it enables the animal to make precise, powerful leaps.

A combat-oriented paw replacement consisting of a hooked claw extending besides the animal's original limb. It cuts deep, and it is strong enough to crush a skull like a hand crushes an egg. Its overall ungainliness slows down movement slightly.
An animal prosthetic arm. While it lacks a neural interface, its complex arrangement of internal joints allows it to mimic natural movement quite convincingly. Still, it is inferior to a real arm.
An animal prosthetic beak built with simple materials. Should be able to replace almost any avian-like beak.

An animal prosthetic blade made from basic, sturdy materials. Will replace a range of biological structures such as single claws (not claws that are part of a paw, for example) and an insect's headclaw.
An animal prosthetic gas bag built with simple materials. Should be able to replace hydrogen sacs and other exotic organs keeping hovering creatures in the air.
An animal prosthetic heart. It contains an electric motor that pumps blood smoothly around the body.
An animal prosthetic horn acting as a synthetic replacement for a lost or damaged horn, crafted from durable materials to restore natural appearance and function.
An animal prosthetic jaw, tailored to restore oral function and aesthetics, enabling animals to eat, drink, and interact comfortably.

An animal prosthetic kidney providing elementary filtration capabilities. Though lacking complexity, it offers a simple solution for waste removal, aiding in maintaining basic metabolic balance. Worse than an undamaged natural kidney.
An animal prosthetic leg. While it lacks a neural interface, its complex arrangement of internal joints allows it to mimic natural movement quite convincingly. Still, it is inferior to a real leg.

An animal prosthetic liver offering rudimentary detoxification functions. Despite its simplicity, it provides a straightforward solution for metabolic regulation. Worse than an undamaged natural liver.

An animal prosthetic lung made with simple components, offering basic respiratory support. Despite its simplicity, it aids in oxygenation to a limited extent, supporting the animal's breathing function. Worse than an undamaged natural lung.

An animal prosthetic shell constructed from basic, durable materials, providing essential protection and structural support. Though simple in design, it offers a practical solution for shielding the animal from harm.
An animal prosthetic spine consisting of basic materials and rudimentary construction, offering modest support and mobility enhancement. Worse than an undamaged natural spine.
An animal prosthetic stinger made from basic, sturdy materials and designed to replace a lost or damaged stinger.

An animal prosthetic stomach constructed from rudimentary materials, providing minimal digestive support. It lacks advanced features and offers a simple solution for basic nutrient processing, although it is worse than an undamaged natural stomach.
An animal prosthetic tail, crafted to replace a lost or injured tail, providing support, balance, and expression while facilitating natural movement and comfort.

An animal prosthetic tentacle built with simple materials. Should be able to replace almost any tentacle, though they'll be quite rigid and not very functional, specially if the animal uses it for locomotion. Bear in mind the original animal needs to have tentacles of its own. For extra tentacles, look into Anomaly implants.

An animal prosthetic wing made from basic, sturdy materials, offering essential support for limited flight and gliding. Though simple, it provides a functional solution for basic aerial mobility. Note that base game birds DON'T have wings (yes, really).
A compact workbench for assembling all kinds of prosthetic and bionic implants for animals.

An animal implant that produces a cloud of microscopic archites that induce a state of pseudo deadlife, granting great resilience to an animal without outright killing it. Removing the implant will deactivate the archites and return the animal to normalcy.

A quad tesla cannon implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a powerful ranged plasma attack.

Note that installing this on a creature that already has a quad tesla cannon will have no effect.

A ranged spinneret implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a ranged stunning web attack.

Note that installing this on a creature that already has a ranged spinneret will have no effect.
An animal implant that adds three fleshy spikes to the animal's body, independent of their original limbs. These extra limbs allow them to use a ranged attack.
A bionic heart strengthened by the action of active mechanites.
A bionic implant adding a plasteel structure with active mechanites to the creature's skeletal system.
An advanced animal tail, even more powerful than a natural one. Note that only creatures with a natural tail can use this.
An ear implant that uses genetic splicing with rodent genes to give an old (or damaged) ear decent hearing. This implant is not meant to replace healthy ears.
An implant that uses genetic splicing with rodent genes to give an old (or damaged) nose decent smelling. This implant is not meant to replace healthy noses. Can't be installed on birds and insects.
A scyther tail created by attaching a jury-rigged scyther blade to an animal's tail. Note that only creatures with a natural tail can use this.

An animal shrinker implant that will reduce the body size of the animal, making it more nimble and hard to hit. Bear in mind that the new body size might make it impossible to install certain prosthetics and bionics!

NOTE: This implant itself is capable of being installed on any animal, regardless of their body size.
An animal skin hardener. Releases chemicals and nanomachines that toughen the skin, making it somewhat more resistant to damage.
An animal stealthskin implant that renders the animal invisible by reflecting light around its body, allowing it to seamlessly blend with the environment.

An animal archotech implant that enhances neural connections, improving cognitive functions such as memory, learning, and response times, basically healing the brain and allowing the animal improved function.

An animal thermoregulator implant using sensors and adaptive materials to maintain optimal body temperature in varying environmental conditions, enhancing the animal's ability to thrive in extreme heat or cold.

A workplace accident waiting to happen, the Tissue Grinder takes the corpses of animals and carefully rips and tears them to pieces in order to extract useful genetic data in the form of Genoframes. The hardware is also capable of combining two identical frames into a superior form by comparing and improving upon latent and inferior genetic material.

Workspeed is influenced by someone who actually knows what they’re looking for in order to skip some of the more routine tasks, and possibly shouldn’t be placed into the hands of someone with no concept of ethics, morality or conscience.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay notes:</color> Bear in mind that the cost in corpses effectively doubles for each quality level, making a legendary genoframe prohibitive. The main usefulness of these recipes is to convert two genoframes of a given quality to a higher one, but your main source of genoframes shouldn't be hand crafting them. Go out there and explore abandoned labs!
An animal implant that adds two rending claws to the animal's body, independent of their original limbs.

An animal toxic breath implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a ranged toxic breath attack that causes toxic buildup in its targer.

Note that installing this on a creature that already has a toxic breath of this kind will have no effect.

A large, sharp spike under tension, connected to a touch-activated trigger. If an animal touches the trigger, the spike springs forth and strikes it. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals do not sense these when calm, but they are quite obvious to humans and will be avoided by them.

An animal unstable skip synapsis implant that enables the animal to teleport short distances instantly. By creating controlled neural disruptions and linking them with micro-skipgates, it allows for rapid, unpredictable movement, enhancing the animal's ability to evade threats and reposition quickly in its environment.

An animal vacskin gland. Releases a waxy substance that forms an insulating barrier on the skin, preventing vacuum burns but restricting movement. The gland also regulates blood oxygen levels, allowing longer survival in the vacuum of space.

Animal venom fangs. Injector tubules that are carefully set inside the animal's original teeth, and connected to small sacs of a very powerful venom. Contrary to the human implant, these integrate too much with the animal's teeth and can't be removed afterwards.

A venomous spitter implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a ranged venomous spit attack.

Note that installing this on a creature that already has a venomous spitter will have no effect. This implant can only be used by animals that have a mouth (and not, for example, a beak or proboscis).

An animal wisp fire implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a ranged fire attack.

Note that installing this on a creature that already has a wisp fire will have no effect.
An implant that uses genetic splicing with wolf genes to give an old (or damaged) jaw decent functioning. This implant is not meant to replace healthy jaws.
An animal brain implant that empowers its brain function, allowing it to do complex jobs. This chip enables Clean jobs.
An animal brain implant that empowers its brain function, allowing it to do complex jobs. This chip enables Feed Patient jobs.
An animal brain implant that empowers its brain function, allowing it to do complex jobs. This chip enables Flick jobs.
An animal brain implant that empowers its brain function, allowing it to do complex jobs. This chip enables Harvest jobs.
An animal brain implant that empowers its brain function, allowing it to do complex jobs. This chip enables Hunting jobs.
An animal brain implant that empowers its brain function, allowing it to do complex jobs. This chip enables Mine jobs.
An animal brain implant that empowers its brain function, allowing it to do complex jobs. This chip enables Slaughter animal jobs.
An animal brain implant that empowers its brain function, allowing it to do complex jobs. This chip enables plant Sowing jobs.

A psionically gifted variation of feralisks, most likely artificially mutated, adapted to living in anima forests. Animalisks are the only herbivorous species of lisks, so they aren't as dangerous as the rest of their kin. They consume anima grass and anima trees as a part of their diet.

Animalisks defend themselves by throwing huge webs at their harassers. These webs stun anything they touch, allowing them to close in and finish the kill with their fearsome venom laced fangs.
A fertilized animalisk egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby animalisk. It can be eaten raw or cooked, but it's a spider egg, so it's disgusting either way...

The Animus Hare is a small leporid with latent psionic abilities. Quite intelligent for an animal, but not intelligent enough to properly use psionics. It will however quickly bond with human beings and reach with his mind to make happy everyone that treats it well.

Useful abilities: they will often use a psionic nuzzle on colonists, keeping everyone happier. They also breed very fast.

A small canine with latent psionic abilities. It is intelligent for an animal but not intelligent enough to properly use psionics. It will quickly bond with human beings and reach with its mind to make everyone that treats it well happy.

Animus voxes are often seen as pets, though some wander the wilderness looking for someone to bond to.

One of the most proven nootropics. Known to help increase memory capacity, learning ability, and focus. As such, this drug was used heavily by glitterworld students.

Causes extreme mental decline after use, which may be lethal when combined with other health problems.
A sign showing the ankylosaur and related dinosaurs.

Ankylosaurus is perhaps the largest of its kind and has formidible defences, with a thick skull, bony plates covering its back and a collar of bone protecting its neck. If any predators do try to find a gap in its armour the dense club on its tail is more than capable of shattering the bones of large therapods - and the bodies of smaller ones. 

Scientific name: Ankylosaurus magniventris (Fused lizard with a wide belly) 

There have been relatively few fossils found of Ankylosaurus compared to other related dinosaurs, it owes its fame largely to a scale model of it being displayed at the 1964 World's Fair.
a classic design desk. The brass handles are the focal point.

A lab-grade machine designed to analyze disease samples and develop antigens. It requires an inserted sample and a researcher to operate it. All previous antigens research requirements must be met for it to function properly.
Install this in a pawn. When that pawn dies, anyone else within a large radius also dies.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. This particular module comes with a compact storage and launch system for deploying antigrain warhead IED traps from a distance. The implant needs to be loaded with an antigrain warhead in order to function.
Antitox reduces the amount of toxic particles absorbed from the air by coating the lungs with a chemical filter.

A clear, vibrant teal liquid. When the user drinks it, it enhances their resistance to toxins, fortifying their body against harmful substances. Additionally, this draught actively works to remove any existing toxic buildup within the user’s system, purifying their body and preventing the detrimental effects of toxins.
An object with ideoligious significance.
A large metalworking tool with a flattened top surface to strike objects on such as weapons and armor.

An armored personnel carrier with hardened armor, good cargo capacity and all-terrain support. However, it's slow, very visible, and not very fuel-efficient, and has a slightly lower defense on the rear.

A non-alcoholic, pleasantly light, citrusy and slightly bitter aperitif that owes its flavors and aromas to sweet and bitter oranges, rhubarb, and imperial craftsmanship. Drinking it induces heavy but painless vomiting, completely clearing the stomach and taste buds. Aperitif recipe is kept secret by the Hospitality guilds of the Empire, and noone was quite able to recreate this fine delicacy on the rimworld surface.

Imperial nobility loves aperitif for its ability to clear out food from the digestive system, allowing them to consume even more of the finest imperial food.

A wooden box-like structure with a series of shelves, lattices, and chambers. When placed near flowers the apiary will naturally attract wild bees which will make it their new home. Over time these bees will produce honey which can be harvested and eaten directly, or later fermented into mead.
A wooden hanging sign use to symbolize the purpose of a room.

A legendary elixir renowned for its extraordinary healing abilities, rapidly accelerating recovery from injuries and significantly enhancing the body’s ability to develop immunity. Upon consumption, it grants full immunity to a range of common and deadly diseases, making it an invaluable remedy in dire situations.
A mixture of apothecary's miracle. Needs further brewing in order to be used.
A crate packed with clothing, armor pieces, and wearable gear.

A large metal locker with a window designed to keep your apparel safe, secure, and easily accessible for outfitting your colonists. Items stored inside will not deteriorate over time and have no impact on the beauty of their surroundings. 

<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> 
Stack size total: 20 
Stack per tile: 10

Allowed items: Apparel, Armor, Headgear

A larger metal locker with a window designed to keep your apparel safe, secure, and easily accessible for outfitting your colonists. Items stored inside will not deteriorate over time and have no impact on the beauty of their surroundings. 

<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> 
Stack size total: 20 
Stack per tile: 10

Allowed items: Apparel, Armor, Headgear
Freshly pressed apple juice, a sweet and refreshing drink. Ferment for a few days at target temperature to turn into cider.
Apples sliced and diced into smaller pieces. Needs to be pressed to become juice.
A pie that uses sliced apples for its principal filling ingredient, mixed together with profound spices. Typically covered with a lattice patterned crust then sprinkled with sugar for its finish.
Raw apples.

A leather or cloth apron covering legs, waist and chest.

Apron like that is often used by craftsmen, doctors and chefs due to useful pockets and protection it provides.
A sturdy and comfortable chair.
A bed mainly used in dormitories and similar facilities.
A cushioned table with rails for playing various billiards games. Used to practice shot skills.
A slightly luxurious chair.
An ancient game of kings. Even played alone, it can entertain for hours and improve intellectual ability. Requires a nearby chair or stool.
A luxurious seat that can accommodate multiple people.
A double bed mainly used in dormitories. Can sleep two people.
A dresser for storing clothes. Improves bedroom comfort.
A small table placed beside a bed for holding small items.
An entertainment device for everyone to enjoy.
A screen used to provide privacy.
A screen used to provide privacy.
A pot for growing small plants.
A table for playing gambling-style card games such as poker. Perfect for testing strategic thinking and a bit of luck. Requires adjacent chairs or stools.
A luxurious gold-inlaid bed fit for the highborn. Extremely comfortable and beautiful, it is a work of art. Fits two.
A dresser that provides a small comfort bonus to nearby beds. Multiple dressers do not stack.
A small table placed beside a bed for holding small items.
A screen used to provide privacy.
A screen used to provide privacy.
A carpet used to decorate floors.
A carpet used to decorate floors.

A carpet used to decorate floors.
A simple chair.
A table used for dining or relaxation.

A table used for dining or relaxation.
An entertainment device for everyone to enjoy.

Raw arapaima. On old Earth, it was among the world's largest freshwater fish, reaching as much as 3 m in length. It was an important food fish.

This is an adept catch that is caught in addition to other fish.
A powerful crossbow. Fires a heavy bolt over extreme distances, but takes a long time to cock it due to the need to use the cranequin.

Although cumbersome to carry, the heavy crossbow is capable of inflicting heavy damage and piercing armored foes. Longer range and higher damage than the crossbow but takes time to reload. This makes the heavy crossbow a formidable defensive weapon and otherwise most effective in a group.

Complex lump of ancient mechanical systems, engineered with precision and knowledge that surpasses current technological understanding. The ability to replicate these components has been lost over generations, making them rare and essential for construction of the ARCs.
A heavy two-handed arc welding wrench. An electrical arc is formed between the two prongs, melting a filler metal which then cools to form strong joints.
A wooden hanging sign use to symbolize the purpose of a room.
A simple archery target mounted on a wooden stand. It's relaxing, and allows oneself to test their accuracy and train over time without risking fatal confrontation.

A heavy tri-spire console built with archite-routing conduits and branching nanoflux matrices that split the injection stream into parallel mutagenic pathways. The array’s central node glows with shifting colors as it maps new routes for rogue archite clusters.

Provides a chance to gain a second random archite gene or a second random offset gene after a successful injection.

Up to 1 archite pathing array can link to a single archogen injector.

A two-chamber nanite reclamation unit fitted with siphon coils and phase-binding spirals that draw unstable archite residue back into a containment loop. Inside, a dense mesh of microfiltration veins reassembles loose nanite clusters into a usable capsule.

Refunds the archite capsule on a rejected injection when linked to an archogen injector.

Up to 1 archite recycler can link to a single archogen injector.
The Archocentipede is the end result of the Archotech Project, aiming to provide a

machine superintelligence with a capable body. Even though this centipede is forcefully loyal to the colonists, and can be somewhat controlled by them, most other inhabitants of the planet will consider its existence to be an abomination, since dabbling in archotech usually signals the end of comprehensible human life.

Useful abilities: What do you mean useful? You have WON the game. The Archocentipede is basically unkillable by normal means, just use it to lay waste to everything on the planet. You don't have enemies now, you have pets. Ooooor... the archotech may kill all your colonists. One of the two.

Based on concept art for the Nydus Worm by Federico Dallocchio from Blizzard Entertainment at the Starcraft wiki, https://starcraft.fandom.com/wiki/Nydus_worm/Development.

The archotech version of the Genomorpher, this machine combines the best genetic material of all the animal branches into a single Archocentipede Growthcell. The way it functions is beyond understanding and is impossible to replicate even with the best glitterworld technology.

In order for this machine to function, it requires multiple connecting DNA Storage Banks which each have the complete genetic data from the different animal branches. Each storage bank will be completely drained in order to ensure that the resulting Growthcell is perfect in every single way.

The resulting Archocentipede Growthcell requires its own special Archowomb, as it is impossible to replicate the necessary nurturing environment.

Genomes needed:

An ancient, hermetically sealed pod designed to induce powerful but chaotic genetic alterations through archovapor immersion. A primary slot seems to feed archite capsules into a destabilization chamber, where they are vaporized and channeled into the host body. Efforts can be made to control the process from there, but perhaps trying to harness this power is what left this machine abandoned in the first place.
									

Used to inject a colonist with archite capsules, triggering genetic alteration and producing a random, special archite gene with possible side effects. Success can be improved by linking it with additional ancient equipment.
An archotech apparel-integrator. It integrates with worn any apparel by mysterious methods and ensures the condition of any worn apparel will not degrade from their current state.

An artificial ear built by an archotech. It perceives infrasound and ultrasound frequencies and is sensitive enough to make out a whispered conversation across a construction site. Its internal workings are a mystery to human minds.

An advanced artificial ear built by an archotech. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but it's harder to damage than plasteel. Even if it is harmed, it repairs itself over time. Its internal workings are a mystery to all human minds.

A relatively massive machine designed to simulate the environment of a mother’s womb specifically for the Archocentipede. Once the Growthcell has been inserted, the embryo can start growing all the way to its adult life stage before being released.

Care should be taken before beginning the process, as the resulting energy signature will force any and all hostiles to attack the colony before the monstrosity can be born. The procedure will last 15 days and once finished, the creature will be under the player’s control with peerless combat prowess.

An advanced genome extraction device that is capable of self-arming and self-guiding at the touch of a button. The best genetic material can be found in the brain and the automated design instantly compresses this material into a usable genome. Each device holds up to three charges before it becomes useless.

The desired subject needs to be docile and trusting of the user who intends on scooping out their brain in a process that is guaranteed to be painless and instantaneous. It is recommended to anesthetize the creature as any sudden movement on their part will interrupt the whole process. Alternatively, it will also work on a dead body... The device is much better at compressing material and as such can be used on even the largest of organisms.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> This excavator can be used to acquire the following genomes:

A portable, archotech-made casing designed to hold an embryo until it is transferred to a relevant Electrowomb, similar to fertilized eggs that require incubation. This particular one is completely stable and contains the embryo of an Archocentipede, which can only grow in an Archowomb.

Care should be taken before beginning the process, as the resulting energy signature will force any and all hostiles to attack the colony before the monstrosity can be born.

An artificial heart built by an archotech. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but can somehow pump far more blood throughout the body without putting additional strain on the cardiovascular system. Its internal workings are a mystery to human minds.

An artificial jaw built by an archotech. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but it's harder to damage than plasteel and is strong enough to bite through power armor. Its internal workings are a mystery to human minds.

An advanced artificial jaw built by an archotech. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but it's harder to damage than plasteel. Even if it is harmed, it repairs itself over time. Its internal workings are a mystery to all human minds.

An artificial liver built by an archotech. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but is immune to chemical damage and liver diseases and is capable of efficiently breaking down toxins and contaminants in the users bloodstream. Its internal workings are a mystery to human minds.

An advanced artificial liver built by an archotech. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but it's harder to damage than plasteel. Even if it is harmed, it repairs itself over time. Its internal workings are a mystery to all human minds.
An artificial lung built by an archotech. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but can hold, pump and absorb far more oxygen than a natural lung. Its internal workings are a mystery to human minds.

An advanced artificial lung built by an archotech. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but it's harder to damage than plasteel. Even if it is harmed, it repairs itself over time. Its internal workings are a mystery to all human minds.
An enigmatic device guided by a persona core. Within its pale shimmer, matter unravels and takes on a new form, as though it had always been that way.
An enigmatic logistics device guided by a persona core. With a brief shimmer, it folds the space between two points, making distant cargo vanish and reappear where it is needed.

An artificial arm built by an archotech. It's strong enough to crush a thick hardwood branch in its hand, and precise enough to write a sonnet on a grain of rice. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but it's harder to damage than plasteel. Even if it is harmed, it repairs itself over time. Its internal workings are a mystery to all human minds. 

The arm houses a wide range of surgical tools attached to telescoping appendages capable of independent movement.  It allows the user to perform several tasks simultaneously greatly increasing their working speed.  It’s fitted with a small self-replenishing medical gel system that can be secreted from the wrists to rapidly tend wounds.  It also has a self-replenishing reservoir of super mechanites that can cure otherwise incurable ailments and regenerate missing pieces of the body.

This brain implant remotely interfaces with the user's synapses to effectively grant a photographic memory. It is theorised that implants such as these were created to function as black boxes for the human agents of archotechs. Its internal workings are a mystery to all human minds.

An artificial nose built by an archotech. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but is sensitive enough to detect traces of chemicals as diffuse as one part per trillion and is harder to damage than plasteel. Even if it is harmed, it repairs itself over time. Its internal workings are a mystery to human minds.

An artifical arm built by an archotech fitted with retractable wrist blades. It's strong enough to crush a thick hardwood branch in its hand, and precise enough to write a sonnet on a grain of rice. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but it's harder to damage than plasteel. Even if it is harmed, it repairs itself over time. Its internal workings are a mystery to all human minds.

An advanced artificial stomach built by an archotech. It uses some unknown system to replaces the body’s need for food and water. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but it's harder to damage than plasteel. Even if it is harmed, it repairs itself over time. Its internal workings are a mystery to all human minds.
A mysterious wearable archotech device that creates shuttles from thin air at will. This must be the technology Voyager used.

An artificial spine built by an archotech. It looks and feels like natural bone, but can bear the weight of most cars, and it's harder to damage than plasteel. Its internal workings are a mystery to human minds.

An advanced artificial spine built by an archotech. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but it's harder to damage than plasteel. Even if it is harmed, it repairs itself over time. Its internal workings are a mystery to all human minds.

An archotech neural implant with a human consciousness stored on it, commonly referred to as a neural. Can be implanted directly into a person's or sleeve’s spine in the neck to bring back the person stored on the stack.

An artificial stomach built by an archotech. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but is immune to food poisoning and stomach diseases and is capable of efficiently breaking down practically any material. Its internal workings are a mystery to human minds.

An advanced artificial stomach built by an archotech. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but it's harder to damage than plasteel. Even if it is harmed, it repairs itself over time. Its internal workings are a mystery to all human minds.

An artificial larynx built by an archotech. It allows the user to speak with a demonic, spine chilling growl, or to sing with a hauntingly beautiful resonance, or to perfectly copy any voice, accent, dialect or other sound they've heard before, or to speak as a choir of many voices. It even includes a subpersona AI that autonomously learns and flawless converts the user's speech into a vast array of languages. Its internal workings are a mystery to all human minds.

An artificial womb built by an archotech. Its harder to damage than plasteel, and even if damaged, it repairs it's self over time. There has been no record of any miscarriage or maternal death of a mother with an archotech womb and children born from one are gestated twice as fast and are said to live long lives and display an uncanny connection to a distant archotech. It's internal workings are a mystery to all human minds.
A small canine native to tundra and boreal forests. It's capable of hunting much bigger prey, and is often found in packs, similar to a wolf.

An unusual result of trying to bring back extinct animals through messy data, this lizard-bird hybrid very likely never actually existed previously. While not much of a runner, they are however well adapted to arctic environments and can swim long distances in the freezing water in search of prey.

Arctic Draks are solitary creatures that prefer to hunt prey that surface at breathing holes, with remarkably efficient fur of hollow hair strands similar to a polar bear. They have long, powerful arms ending in clawed, webbed-fingers, and males additionally sport plumage at the back of the skull to attract mates.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.

A descendant of the lion that were specifically engineered as ambush units for extremely low temperature environments. Even though its danger and capabilities are common knowledge, many people still attempt to hunt them for their unique light reflecting fur and tough leather that provides surprisingly high thermal insulation.
White thick leather covered in a long, rugged mat of fur. Harvested from an arctic lion. This thick skin insulates from cold and protects really well.
These raw hides and pelts were removed from a creature, and with the right skills and tools, could be processed into tanned leather.
These raw hides and pelts were removed from a creature, and with the right skills and tools, could be processed into tanned leather.

Trophies for the accomplished hunter, animal rugs are formed from stained and stuffed animal hides sewed to felt and padding to form rugs. A variant of the wolf, arctic wolf rugs tell the story of a hunter who braved dangerous temperatures and conquered starving predators biologically designed for survival.

A space-borne creature that inhabits the asteroids of a system's asteroid belt. They are usually not found on a planet's surface unless they are somehow brought to it. Their bodies are light and they have no problems flying through a terrestrial atmosphere. They also have electricity based defense mechanisms and a faint regenerative ability.

Arcturan sky eels require very little sustenance and can be trained as simple pets.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.

An advanced, combat-focused artificial arm. Razor-sharp, retractable and powered by silenced nano-motors which replace the radius and ulna. When extended, the blade allows for devastating attacks, offering unparalleled swiftness and precision. When retracted, neuromuscular synchronisation makes it appear and function like a normal arm.
These raw hides and pelts were removed from a creature, and with the right skills and tools, could be processed into tanned leather.

An armchair designed like a pilot’s seat.
Its ergonomically designed seat provides comfort even during long hours of use.
Useful in various situations, such as at tables or workbenches.
Not paintable.

An armchair with a smooth texture and a distinctive rounded form.
Its ergonomically designed seat provides comfort even during long hours of use.
Useful in various situations, such as at tables or workbenches.
Only the seat area can be painted.
A finely crafted, ergonomically shaped plate helmet that provides complete protection of the entire head, face,, shaped in such a way to optimize deflection of what would otherwise be direct blows.
A thickly padded cap most often worn beneath heavier helmets for an additional layer of protection. Quite insulating and offers a bit of blunt protection on its own.

Many warriors see their weapons as tools, and so the most common swords are those most practical. Arming swords, praised for their light weight, fullered blade, and efficient craftsmanship, prove useful for both novices and veterans alike. Swords can bring warriors wealth, so when choosing the tool for warfare, one would be lucky to wield an arming sword.
A lifesize replica of a knight.

A dose of semi-coherent mechanites which modifies muscle and tissue to create a durable subdermal layer of armour in order to protect the host.

For ease-of-use the mechanites are designed to be self-installable via a small handheld injector.  Due to how mechanites work only one strain can exist harmoniously inside the host’s body.  Upon injection any existing strain will be eliminated by the newly injected mechanites.  It is possible to remove mechanite strains entirely from a host, however it requires an expensive and difficult surgery.

Armor-piercing shells are designed to explode upon impact and destroy anything they hit, completely bypassing the armor of the target. Their explosion radius is almost non-existent, and armored targets need to be hit directly for the shell to destroy them. They are very accurate and travel at extreme speeds.

A lightly armored car, intended to provide mobile fire support. It's armor is effective against small arms, but is vulnerable in the rear. Can carry three people along paved roads, but is less fuel-efficient in the world map.
A rig equipped with bulletproof armor plates. Its lightweight model can be concealed underneath an outer garment, providing effective protection for the entire upper body.
A rig equipped with bulletproof armor plates. Its heavy-duty structure can provide effective protection but does not protect the legs.

An armored, portable automatic turret. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use. Extra armor plating allows the turret to provide some cover, makes it more resistant to enemy fire and prevents explosion in case of severe damage. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.
A wooden hanging sign use to symbolize the purpose of a room.

This engorged, tick-like creature has a writhing mass of tentacles where its head would normally be, sensing their surroundings by a combination of touch and echolocation. They have lost their capacity to burrow underground, but they are capable of powerful psionic attacks.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All insectoid hybrids have good armor and no toxic sensitivity, but they are always sterile and can't reproduce, even if a fertility booster is used to create them. Produces eldritch insect jelly, a very nutritive and enjoyable food.
A detailed army manual, explaining a multitude of combat-related topics.

An ancient firearm with a smoothbore barrel, the arquebus delivers powerful shots at decent range. The lead balls lose velocity and damage with distance, and are extremely ineffective against armor. Due to the chempowder reaction when firing the arquebus, plumes of blindsmoke are ejected from the barrel.

An advanced transmitter device, cobbled together into a makeshift mech-band array node. An incomprehensible mess of cables and hardware links the transmitters into a single, powerful array, allowing a mechanitor to interface with it.

Array nodes must be tuned to a specific mechanitor, doing so will add 8 bandwidth to that mechanitor's total bandwidth, allowing them to control more mechanoids.
An infinite supply of arrows, placed in a small cage. Colonists can resupply arrows from this station.
A compact quiver bundle of field replacement arrows.
A simple sign that points at something
A large cabinet filled with art supplies. Increases work speed when placed near an easel. The more art cabinets, the faster the painter can access their tools.
A messy art palette.
A rack with chisels, hammers, and other carving tools. Increases work speed when placed near an art bench. One workbench can only use one tool stand.

Long extinct giant arthropods, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest known land invertebrate of all time. Arthropleuras are huge, solitary, herbivorous millipedes that are mostly harmless, and will attack only in self-defense.
Some maniacs are willing to pay unreasonable amounts of money for eggs of this beast.
Fertilized arthropleura egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into an arthropleura larva. It can be eaten raw, but it tastes horrible.
An artificial bone that works as a suitable replacement for an organic one.
An artificial nose that works as a suitable replacement for an organic one.

A powerful, manned artillery cannon designed for long-range bombardment. Though it fires slower than a mortar, its improved targeting systems allow for far greater accuracy, making it ideal for precise strikes against enemy structures or high-value targets. Can be crewed by two people to double its firing speed. Capable of providing fire support across the world map, but only on revealed locations.
A high caliber artillery piece for indirect fire at extended ranges.

A multi-chambered, purpose-built vessel designed for fermenting a wide range of ingredients, from dairy to grains and fruits. This fermenter allows precise control over complex fermentation processes, enabling the creation of a variety of artisan products like vinegar, miso, kefir, and sake. Ideal for producing high-quality goods with distinct flavors and textures from various cultures. Includes a meat curing chamber.

A flexible workshop dedicated to various small-scale artisanal processes that don’t fit into larger categories. It provides space and tools for specialized crafting, ensuring no resource goes to waste in the colony's production line.

Can also be used as a low efficiency workshop to press oils, churn butter and create jams.

A high-quality grinder built for processing fruits, vegetables, and grains into artisanal products like flours, chips, zests, and purees, adding refinement to culinary and crafting processes. Not to be confused with Artisanal Grindr. We don't handle that.

A fermented tea derivate known for its light effervescence, delicate sweetness, and refreshing acidity. Naturally rich in probiotics and with a hint of tang.

<color=#E5E54C>Ingredients:</color> Making 50 artisanal kombucha requires 125 tea leaves for a total value of 137.50, and sells for 6, giving a <color=#33CC33>54.17%</color> profit per unit.

<color=#E5E54C>Fermentation time:</color> 12 days.

<color=#E5E54C>Caravan trading:</color> Its weight is 0.3 Kg, for a value per Kg of <color=#33CC33>20</color>.

A plaid beret worn by creatives and labourers alike. Pretentiousness sold separately.

A set of artist's clothes: a smock, plaid cullotes and a frayed, striped shirt. Perfect for creatives and labourers to get down and dirty in.
A full body jumpsuit made out of thick fabric or leather, inspired by the outfit of Asami.
A full body jumpsuit made out of thick fabric or leather, inspired by the outfit of Asami.
Simple armor made to protect the peasantry. Lightweight and easy to make.
A simple conical helmet which gives the wearer slight protection. Designed for the peasantry to be lightweight and be easy to make.
An ashtray, full of cigaretts.
A glass ashtray.

Asphalt, or bitumen, is a sticky, black and highly viscous liquid or semi-solid, composed almost entirely of petroleum. It is present in most crude petroleums and in some natural deposits, such as tar pits.

Asphalt can be used to build tarmac roads, greatly increasing movement in difficult terrains.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm replacement. This particular model includes a modified assault rifle that can be fully retracted outside of combat, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

An advanced brain implant designed to assist the user in crafting-related tasks and act as a digital encyclopedia on that particular subject. The subpersona can save and display blueprints along with detailed information about various materials and components.

A brain implant of such complexity requires time to synchronize with and adapt to its host in order to avoid excessive strain on the central nervous system, its effectiveness will slowly increase during this process. It's capable of syncing with other enhancements made to assist in similar tasks, greatly increasing efficiency.
A trusty wagon to carry novelties, artifacts, and goods across the unforgiving lands of the rim. Can be used to store items.
A bundle of seeds for aster. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
Small perennial wildflowers that grow in alpine climates. Astragalus flowers have been used by medieval civilizations in creation of different draughts.
A bundle of seeds for astragalus. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

A compact multi-tube missile platform that shoots a volley of four rapid missiles that explode and carry a payload of astrofuel, setting the area hit on astrofire. Meant for fast, hard-hitting strikes against exposed gravships and unarmored surface forces. Requires a linked targeting terminal with an operator to function. It draws power directly from the grav engine.

A heavy weapon that can spray a stream of astrofire into an area. It can shoot in an arc over allies without harming them. The flame burns off rapidly, so it will only ignite the most flammable targets.

While the main flamethrower can be used without limit, the weapon also comes equipped with an astrofuel-powered mega-burner unit which generates a massive blast of astrofire from a pressurized astrofuel charge. The mega-burner unit must be refueled after each use.

A high-energy synthetic fuel. Used to power gravship thrusters and boosters, or to generate electricity in specialized systems. Extremely combustible, it burns violently even in low-oxygen environments.

A gravtech unit that enhances the precision and stability of astrofuel refinement. When placed next to an astrofuel synthesizer, it enables perfect 1:1 conversion from chemfuel to astrofuel, though the process takes twice as long.

A specialized personal movement pack designed for rapid traversal in zero-gravity environments. Utilizing a contained oxygen supply for controlled thrust, it allows for long-distance, high-speed jumps in space. The pack's design eliminates movement penalties on space terrain, though the amount of long range jumps is limited by the oxygen supply.

A strange semi-insectoid creature that undergoes radical metamorphosis, similar to butterflies. Atispecs are huge, carnivorous, and venomous flying predators. There have been attempts to domesticate the adult atispecs but it is not as effective as growing them during their 2 year long phase as a larva.
A fertilized atispec egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into an atispec larva. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
An unfertilized atispec egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.

A high-tech device that can be installed into a lung or any compatible artificial lung replacement. This particular model greatly reduces the intake of toxins found in heavily polluted air by utilizing a series of advanced microfilters.

A high-tech device that can be installed into any compatible artificial spine replacement. This particular model is capable of greatly enhancing its host's body by supplying it with additional energy produced by a miniature nuclear generator. It has to be regularly fueled with uranium in order to function.

Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The ancestor of domestic cattle, the aurochs, was to modern cows what wolves are to dogs.
Larger, tougher, faster, but producing less resources and eating more than today's cattle.

A wispy-looking creature that is the only known example of plasma-based life. It is believed that they were created as a lifeform capable of surviving in the atmosphere of red dwarf stars, for utterly inscrutable purposes.

Aurora sylphs don't seem to be affected by gravity much, so they can also be found stranded in the gravity well of a planet. They are immune to temperature extremes and the vacuum of space, though very fragile and easy to damage. They don't need to eat, as they will replenish their energy simply by absorbing light. If they are content, they will periodically influence the magnetic fields of a planet and cause beautiful auroras.

A self-loading large-bore cannon. Its large-caliber shells do heavy damage over significant ranges. It's slow to aim and it cannot fire at close-up targets.

Being an extremely heavy weapon, this gun requires a power armor to be effectively used.

This weapon has limited number of uses.

A colossal industrial furnace built to contain the immense heat and pressure needed to bond base materials into exotic alloys like plasteel.

Factory buildings need factory hoppers for input and output. They produce significant heat and consume much power, but can be overclocked for higher efficiency, increasing both heat generation and power consumption.

An industrial-grade press capable of automatically manufacturing various artillery shells from raw materials.

Factory buildings need factory hoppers for input and output. They produce significant heat and consume much power, but can be overclocked for higher efficiency, increasing both heat generation and power consumption.

An automated industrial machine for assembling complex items like components and advanced components.

Automatically refines biological matter like wood or plant matter into chemfuel.

Factory buildings need factory hoppers for input and output. They produce significant heat and consume much power, but can be overclocked for higher efficiency, increasing both heat generation and power consumption.

An automated industrial preserving system for the mass production of canned goods from various raw ingredients, requiring no manual labor.

Factory buildings need factory hoppers for input and output. They produce significant heat and consume much power, but can be overclocked for higher efficiency, increasing both heat generation and power consumption. Needs to be constructed on factory floor.

An automated industrial distilling system for the mass production of beer and spirits from raw crops, requiring no manual labor.

Factory buildings need factory hoppers for input and output. They produce significant heat and consume much power.

An automated deep-crust drilling rig for extracting minerals from deep under the surface. Capable of extracting stone chunks, but also any metal it finds.

Factory buildings need factory hoppers for input and output. They produce significant heat and consume much power, but can be overclocked for higher efficiency, increasing both heat generation and power consumption.

A fully automated assembly line capable of mass-producing various drone types. While requiring substantial power and cooling, it operates much faster than manual construction.

Factory buildings need factory hoppers for input and output. They produce significant heat and consume much power, but can be overclocked for higher efficiency, increasing both heat generation and power consumption.

A large, automated machine that combines the functions of a sower and harvester, moving back and forth across a designated outdoor zone to harvest mature plants and sow new crops. It deposits harvested goods into attached factory hoppers or drops them on the ground if hoppers are not present, and its operation can be set to automatically cycle once the majority of plants in the zone are fully grown.

An industrial fish breeding and harvesting facility designed to automatically extract fish from bodies of water with fish populations.

Factory buildings need factory hoppers for input and output. Needs to be constructed in shallow water.

An industrial machine capable of cutting resources into usable materials.

Factory buildings need factory hoppers for input and output. They produce significant heat and consume much power, but can be overclocked for higher efficiency, increasing both heat generation and power consumption.

An industrial-grade loom designed for the automatic production of textiles and apparel, it efficiently weaves materials like cloth and leather into various finished goods. It can only output goods of normal quality.

Factory buildings need factory hoppers for input and output. They produce significant heat and consume much power, but can be overclocked for higher efficiency, increasing both heat generation and power consumption.

An automated industrial facility designed for the precision manufacturing of various weapons, armor, and complex equipment. It can only output goods of normal quality.

Factory buildings need factory hoppers for input and output. They produce significant heat and consume much power, but can be overclocked for higher efficiency, increasing both heat generation and power consumption.

A series of automated saws and mincers capable of processing corpses into processed mince.

This otherworldly bear has repulsive, purple coloured tentacles protruding from its maw. Its pelt has a strange wooden-like appearance. Massive, fluffy murder babies is just one of the many “cute” nicknames made for this animal, their only downside being that they’re unable to purr. Because they’re so large, they often end up knocking over the people they’re trying to show affection to before laying on top of them for warmth.

An ursine hybrid with recessive feline genes. Retaining their intelligence and being faster and more fierce in combat, they are adorable killing machines that love to nuzzle. They prefer easier prey and can be slaughtered for a valuable pelt, you monster.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All primary bear hybrids have stun attacks. Like all cat hybrids, they have an improved melee dodge ability and a short nuzzle period. The pelt can be sold or used in the art workbench to create rugs.
This enormous bear pelt is probably valuable as a trade good. Or it can also be repurposed as a huge rug.

A surprisingly clean animal dubbed the “owl-bear” by those that find them amusing as they attempt to fly by rapidly flapping their stubby vestigial wings. That is until they get their eyes pecked out and flattened by their weight.

An ursine hybrid with recessive avian genes. Slightly dumber but easier to train, they lay eggs every couple of days and have the strength to protect their clutch. Slower than a bear but their ability to hover over terrain means they perform better in harsh terrain.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All primary bear hybrids have stun attacks. Although too heavy to fly, it can use its wings to nullify terrain movement costs.

A wonderful animal for those cold winter journeys, very popular as travellers snuggle into their fur at night to keep warm. Fights have even broken out over who gets to sleep with the oversized rug.

An ursine hybrid with recessive muffalo genes. Very filthy but a decently intelligent pack animal that produces good-quality wool and milk. Performs very well in cold environments and is more than capable of defending itself.

Milk from a bearffalo. Quite high in fat content, and very nutritive.

Their body’s efficiency means they’ll get a task done when it needs to, and not a moment sooner. What makes it worse is that they’re smart enough to know that they’re cute - and powerful - enough to get away with it.

An equine hybrid with recessive ursine genes. The inherent hibernating nature of bears has combined with the high energy of horses to create this particular hybrid that requires little in the way of rest and a much more efficient and versatile digestive system. They are quite a bit slower as a consequence, along with their higher body mass.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All equine hybrids are good for caravaning. A caravan with one of them needs a shorter resting period, only stopping to rest between 23:30 PM and 4 AM.

A terrifying combination of the raw power of a bear and the intellect of a human, resulting in a creature that loves to abuse its prey. Not quite as strong due to the strange hand-paw shapes, but very energetic and eager to get their victims to catch these hands.

An ursine hybrid with recessive humanoid genes. Very high intellect but comparatively fragile compared to similar hybrids. Their bodies contain oversized and overstimulated adrenal glands that are found just under the surface of the skin, which can be regularly extracted for a substance analogous to Go-Juice.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Humanoid hybrids will periodically engage other colonists in conversation, talking about a variety of topics. This increases the social recreation needs of those they interact with by 10% (subject to diminishing returns like all joy types). If using Ideology, humanoid hybrids are subject to precepts.

Not many people get to see a naked bear, and fewer still want a repeat viewing. This oversized mole-rat inspires plenty of fear with its massive teeth, but gets a lot of love and affection from those wanting a large, hairless pet that gnaws on the furniture.

An ursine hybrid with recessive rodent genes. Very slow both mentally and physically along with dietary restrictions, but very fierce in combat and immune to pain. Also they have the added benefit of having a short reproductive cycle, low metabolism and being completely fearless in hunting prey.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All primary bear hybrids have stun attacks. No pain sensitivity. This hybrid won't be knocked down in combat due to pain.

The dinosaur nerds out there should love this hybrid. Got one hell of a nasty bite and even the claws will both knock you down and make you unable to get up. Often bred for hunting by the bored one percenters who want to eat massive drumsticks, caveman style.

A reptile hybrid with recessive ursine genes. Highly intelligent and an exceptional frontline trooper, with a venomous, stunning attack, fast movement speed and high health pool.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All reptile hybrids have good temperature tolerance ranges and venomous attacks.

An absolute unit of an insectoid hybrid, this massive chubster is incredibly smart and hard to kill. All the excess blubber has been replaced with either chitin or muscle fibre, so don’t go making comments about their bulk.

An insectoid hybrid with recessive ursine genes. Very thick armour plating and a calm temperament make this hybrid an excellent combat animal. Requires little in the way of retraining and can dish out respectable damage as well.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All insectoid hybrids have good armor and no toxic sensitivity, but they are always sterile and can't reproduce, even if a fertility booster is used to create them.

Great care must be taken before considering raising this chonky boy, as they have a metabolism that matches their high ferocity and movement speed. Pretty useful in keeping egg-laying animal populations in check.

An ursine hybrid with recessive canine genes. A very fierce and intelligent combat hybrid with an incredible appetite. As they are almost constantly hungry, they will dig for berries when they’re hungry provided it’s growing season.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All primary bear hybrids have stun attacks.
A large semiaquatic rodent with a flat, paddle-shaped tail and webbed hind feet. Beavers are renowned for their innate construction skills, building their homes, or

, out of sticks, twigs, rocks, and mud in lakes, streams, and tidal river deltas. Beavers are well known for building dams across streams and constructing their lodges in the artificial ponds which form.

An incredibly quick - mentally and physically - hunter with an overactive castoreum gland, effectively allowing them to actively convert meat and trees into vegetables. Technically vegans should be fine with it since, much like bees, it needs to be harvested and the beaverwolf will absolutely let you know if it doesn’t like you touching it.

A rodent hybrid with recessive canine genes. A very quick but cautious predator, this hybrid is both intelligent and frequently looking for its next meal. Able to freely roam and doesn’t require a pen, they are both carnivorous and dendrovorous while also offering daily harvests of castoreum which functions as a vegetable in dishes.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All rodent hybrids have fast gestation, as long as a fertility unblocker was used when creating them in the genomorpher.
Castoreum is a yellowish exudate from the castor sacs of beavers. It is historically used as a food additive and natural flavour, often as a substitute vanilla flavour.
