It uses a complex process to unlatch the biocoding from the original item, which transfers the biocoding onto the biodecoder, breaking it in the process. Biodecoder can also be used on biosecured crate to open them. This device is often used in sensitive operations where the presence of biocoding could compromise the mission.

A bioferrite arm. Even though it lacks a neural interface, the eerie properties of bioferrite let it bend in response to the user's movements. While inferior to a real arm, it allows for a greater connexion to the void.

A bioferrite arm. Even though it lacks a neural interface, the eerie properties of bioferrite let it bend in response to the user's movements. Superior to a real arm, perhaps due to its connexion to the void.

A bioferrite leg. Even though it lacks a neural interface, the eerie properties of bioferrite let it bend in response to the user's movements. While inferior to a real leg, it allows for a greater connexion to the void.

An advanced artificial bladder. A chemical recycling system breaks down waste products from the body into molecules which are recycled with the remainder released as gas, the downside of this being that it gives the user gas.

An advanced artificial arm with a built-in concussion effect designed for knocking down walls. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while the biogel nerve-link gives exquisite control. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage.

An advanced artificial arm with multiple built-in tools used in a variety of culinary tasks. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while the biogel nerve-link gives exquisite control. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage.

An advanced artificial leg with multiple built-in tools used in general cleaning work. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while the biogel nerve-link gives exquisite control. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage.

An advanced artificial arm with multiple built-in tools used in general construction work. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while the biogel nerve-link gives exquisite control. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage.

An advanced artificial arm with a built-in snake drill, which allows the miner to rapidly find and exploit weak lines in the rock. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while the biogel nerve-link gives exquisite control. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage.

A bionic faceplate with toxin filtering and enhanced sensory capabilities. Nerve-gel split-links extending from the optic nerves allow the user to process visual stimuli from an array of digital eyes, granting greatly enhanced vision and night sight. This disturbing implant is most commonly seen upon members of the most brutal and savage of urbworld transhumanist gangs.

An advanced artificial arm with multiple built-in telescopic finger-like protrusions that can simultaneously harvest from several points on the same plant, or precisely sow several holes at once. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while the biogel nerve-link gives exquisite control. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage.
An advanced artificial kidney. With its self-cleaning filters, synthetic glands and lattice-dust healing system, it is better than a biological kidney in almost every way.
An advanced artificial kidney. It has synthetic muscle fibers and a lattice-dust healing system. It is better than a biological kidney in almost every way.
An advanced artificial liver. With its self-cleaning filters and lattice-dust healing system capable of repairing chemical damage, it is better than a biological liver in almost every way.
An advanced artificial liver. It has synthetic muscle fibers and a lattice-dust healing system. It is better than a biological liver in almost every way.

An advanced artificial locomotive spine. It is designed to replace the lower parts of the spine of a snake-like being. Unlike a regular bionic spine this one will significantly aid locomotion for such beings.

An advanced artificial lung. It has synthetic muscle fibers for a realistic breathing, plus fractal diffusion chambers for higher oxygen absorbtion. It is better than a biological lung in almost every way.
An advanced artificial lung. It has synthetic muscle fibers and a lattice-dust healing system. It is better than a biological lung in almost every way.
An advanced artificial nose. With its biogel nerve-link, ultradense chemical receptors and lattice-dust healing system, it is better than a biological nose in almost every way.

An advanced artificial arm fitted with retractable power claw blades. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while the biogel nerve-link gives exquisite control. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage.

An advanced artificial arm with multiple built-in tools used in a variety of production tasks. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while the biogel nerve-link gives exquisite control. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage.

An advanced artificial leg. With its biogel nerve-link, powerful mini-servos, and lattice-dust healing system. This version is usually somewhat inferior to the bionic leg for baseline humans, but is slightly better for beings with more than two legs.
An advanced artificial tail. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while a biogel nerve-extension on the Coccyx gives exquisit control.

An advanced artificial womb. It can monitor and optimise nutrient level and apply growth stimulators to improve gestation speed, it's articulated construction allows for safer labor and it has a mechanite based sperm sorting system to enhance fertility. It is better than a biological womb in almost every way.
A work station for assembling and disassembling bionics.

When properly treated and processed, sewage sludge becomes biosolids that offer a small boost to terrain fertility. Useful for harsh environments with limited space to grow. Biosolids also produce a large boost to the fertility of sand which can make it fertile when combined with irrigation.
A composter for turning sewage into fertilizer for increasing the fertility of diggable terrain.

A high-tech device that can be installed into a heart or any any compatible artificial heart replacement. This particular model frequently releases a small swarm of biowelder mechanites throughout the host's body, greatly increasing the rate at which their wounds heal.
These raw hides and pelts were removed from a creature, and with the right skills and tools, could be processed into tanned leather.

Some birds, when taught by expert trainers, are capable of flying to a designated location before returning to their home roost. This allows for communication with neighboring factions, assuming one can afford the costly requirements of obtaining and training the bird, as well as feeding the animals with meat. Requires the scribe table for correspondence.
These are small curtains measuring 2x1. They are perfect for covering windows.

A medium sized omnivorous mammal adapted for cold climates. Bears' thick blubber and fur keeps them warm in winter.

While their usual diet consists of fish, berries, honey, and scavenged meat, the black bear is capable of using its massive strength and deadly claws to kill live prey. They are startlingly quick for such lumbering creatures.
Cute Easter bunny themed costume. But the area covered by the clothes is reversed.

An incredibly rare and monstrously large insectoid of the Black Hive geneline. Unlike its Sorne counterpart, the black empress is not worried about creating offspring, feeling more concerned about acting as an absolute nightmare in close quarters combat. She can tear through heavy armour as if it wasn't there, but what makes her particularly dangerous is her ability to absolutely melt any mechanoids it encounters with a ranged spit attack. Upon death, it’s possible to extract a Black Hive pherocore from her body.
A beautiful, dignified yet lively black evening gown, with layered hemlines that adorn the figure.

Black garlic is a type of aged garlic that undergoes a fermentation-like process, resulting in soft, dark-colored cloves. Unlike regular garlic, black garlic has a sweet, mild flavour with hints of molasses, balsamic vinegar, and tamarind, lacking the sharp pungency of fresh garlic.

<color=#E5E54C>Trade considerations:</color>

<color=#E5E54C>Ingredients:</color> Making 25 black garlic requires 50 garlic for a total value of 55, and sells for 5.50, giving a <color=#33CC33>60%</color> profit per unit.

<color=#E5E54C>Fermentation time:</color> 1.66 days.

<color=#E5E54C>Caravan trading:</color> Its weight is 0.05 Kg, for a value per Kg of <color=#33CC33>60</color>.

<color=#E5E54C>Profit per day:</color> On average, profit per day is <color=#33CC33>0.26</color> (for reference, Yayo is 0.35).
A black chiffon nightdress with a semi transparent texture that is faintly visible.

Jelly stored and used as food by oversized insects. It is smooth, rich, and fulfills the recreation need of those who consume it. Because of its unique biological properties, it can nourish almost any creature and never rots. This particular insect jelly is pitch black in color and seems to be more nutritious than usual.

Oddly, its texture and nutrient blanace makes it an ideal baby food.
An advanced device that disables lethal properties of black ICE. It has a small chance of being detected by the ICE and may cause a brief explosion that destroys the device.
Hard overlapping scales of insectoid chitin. It is exceptionally durable in combat, but provides little protection from weather.

A giant, genetically-engineered insectoid responsible for creating new Black Hive spawn. A mother to the insects in her hive, a black queen doesn’t do heavy work, and tries to avoid combat if possible. As massive as an adult thrumbo, the queen instils fear in most opponents. Her thick chitinous armour makes her hard to kill, whilst long, deadly blades can tear through plasteel shielding in seconds. Despite being quite slow in open terrain, an insectoid black queen is capable of creating new black swarmlings at a rapid pace, and should never be allowed to settle down.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> The Black Queen regenerates health.

The juvenile form of a black hive insectoid, larva are harmless, slow and easy to kill. After some time has passed, it undergoes a metamorphosis, turning into an adult black hive insectoid. There is no way to tell what kind of insect will crawl out of its cocoon.

A novel and luxurious take on regular mayonnaise, black mayonnaise is made by blending mayonnaise with black garlic. This gives it a unique, earthy sweetness and deep, umami-rich flavor, along with a striking dark color.

<color=#E5E54C>Trade considerations:</color>

<color=#E5E54C>Ingredients:</color> Making 10 black mayonnaise requires mayonnaise and black garlic for a total value of 530, and sells for 150, giving a <color=#33CC33>64.67%</color> profit per unit.

<color=#E5E54C>Value per work:</color> Recipe requires 4000 work, which results on a value per work of <color=#33CC33>0.38</color>.

<color=#E5E54C>Caravan trading:</color> Its weight is 0.3 Kg, for a value per Kg of <color=#33CC33>500</color>.

<color=#E5E54C>Profit per day:</color> Depends on so many factors it's hard to give a concrete number.

A pheromone controlling micro-organ. It is necessary to construct certain types of insectoid hives. Pherocores have been embedded deep into the brains of geneline leaders which allowed ancient civilizations to control the hives.

This pherocore belongs to the mechanoid hunting geneline known as the Black Hive.
Bunny themed strappy stilettos.

A huge herbivorous mammal with a temperamental disposition. Black rhinos differ from their white relatives in their slightly smaller size and in lip shape. The black rhino has a pointed upper lip, while whites have a squared lip, a difference related to the animals' diets - black rhinos are browsers that get most of their sustenance from eating from bushes.

A large genetically-engineered beetle that is a part of the black hive, an artificial ecosystem of insectoids designed to fight mechanoid invasions. The black hive was designed to be much more aggressive than usual, and several new species were created to increase its lethality.

Black scarabs are little more than cannon fodder, released ahead of the main insectoid horde to draw enemy fire. A eusocial creature, it cannot reproduce individually. These insects can cause additional damage to mechanoids.

A bioengineered insectoid the size of a sheep. It is a part of the black hive, an artificial ecosystem of insectoids designed to fight mechanoid invasions. The black hive was designed to be much more aggressive than usual, and several new species were created to increase its lethality.

The spelopede is the middle caste of a hive, taking care of most work tasks as well as fighting with its digging claws. It's dangerous in combat, but slow on open ground. Its ranged attacks cause acidic damage to mechanoids and toxic damage to living creatures.

The juvenile form of Black Hive insectoids, black swarmlings are more or less harmless, slow and easy to kill. After some time has passed, they undergo a metamorphosis, forming a cocoon from which an adult Black Hive insectoid will emerge. There is no way to tell what kind of insect will crawl out of its cocoon.
Raw black truffles. A delicious and valuable variety of fungus.

A small, nocturnal member of the weasel family that feeds on other, smaller mammals. It has a long body and yellowish-brown fur with a blackish wash of fur on its back, and a black mask around its eyes.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.
A flat stone-like surface for writing on with chalk. Placing a board marks the area as a classroom, which can then be assigned classes.

An implant that allows the user to temporarily partially shift into the void. The implant is crafted from modified noctolith sensors, using archotech shards to control the phase mechanisms. The user can activate the device, causing them to move and attack far faster in darkness. However, the inverse is true in light. While active, the user is unthreatened by unnatural darkness.

A quintessential tool of the forge, the blacksmith hammer is designed for shaping molten metal and forging formidable weapons and armor. Though its primary function lies in crafting, its heavy head and stout handle make it a formidable weapon in its own right, capable of battering through defenses with the same efficiency it shapes ingots.

A genetically-engineered insectoid the size of a bear. This creature is a part of the black hive, an artificial ecosystem of insectoids designed to fight mechanoid invasions. The black hive was designed to be much more aggressive than usual, and several new species were created to increase its lethality.

The blackspider is designed for heavy work and combat. Its thick chitinous armor makes it hard to kill, while its long ripper-blades make it deadly at close quarters. Its ranged attacks cause acidic damage to mechanoids and toxic damage to living creatures.
An object with ideoligious significance.
Blast turret is designed for close range area damage. It launches a burst of 3 frag grenades at a time. Beware of friendly fire.
A bundle of seeds for blisscap. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

A mutant variation of the feralisk that has adapted to extremely cold climates. Blizzarisks attack by throwing huge webs at their prey. These webs both stun and freeze anything they touch, allowing them to close in and finish the kill with their fearsome venom laced fangs.

A mutant variation of the feralisk that has adapted to extremely cold climates. Blizzarisks attack by throwing huge webs at their prey. These webs both stun and freeze anything they touch, allowing them to close in and finish the kill with their fearsome venom laced fangs.

This blizzarisk is larger than usual, and is carrying a clutch of eggs on its back. This sounds like a recipe for disaster if not dealt with quickly.
A fertilized blizzarisk egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby blizzarisk. It can be eaten raw or cooked, but it's a spider egg, so it's disgusting either way...

These fruit seem to be as hard as the trunk of the plant they are harvested from, and equally covered in spines. The inner flesh of the fruit tastes like blood-drenched meat, and herbivore animals will refuse to consume it.

Specifically treated candles producing a dim red light over a small area. The sanguine glow is particularly pleasing to individuals with the bloodfeeder gene. Often used to illuminate sacred places such as musoleums and crypts.

A tall candelabra holding severeal candles producing a dim red light.The sanguine glow is particularly pleasing to individuals with the bloodfeeder gene. Often used to illuminate sacred places such as musoleums and crypts.

Raw blood leech. This bright red lamprey-like creature feeds almost exclusively on the blood of larger aquatic organisms, although it is not adverse to taking a bite from some terrestrial ones that come near the water. It tastes metallic and unappealing.

A smaller relative of the raptor shrimp, the blood shrimp lacks the impressive regenerative abilities of its larger counterpart. They compensate this disadvantage by being faster and more agile.

Blood shrimps are vampiric, feeding on blood and being able to regenerate their wounds when drinking the blood of live animals.

A specifically treated sepulchral brazier used to illuminate sacred grounds with a red flame.The sanguine glow is particularly pleasing to individuals with the bloodfeeder gene. Will light the surroundings and create heat.
A sepulchral statue holding a brazier in its hands to cast a bloodflame upon sacred grounds. Will light the surroundings and create heat.
A stone bas relief of Bloody Gothic imagery for decorating a floor.
A stone bas relief of Bloody Gothic imagery for decorating a floor.
A bundle of seeds for bloomaris. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
Very light and thin blouse, great for hot climates.
A primitive horn used to signal danger or call for aid. Can be used as a weapon in a pinch.
The first version of the club, which is also more practical in battle. The metal head allows for greater armor penetration and can easily break the bones of unarmored foes.
Even though these mushrooms look weird, they are very nice to eat, even when raw.
A syrupy residue extracted from aerofleets that can be refined into an energy-dense compound. The compound can be used to build powerful batteries and generators.

Can store more electricity than regular batteries thanks to the energetic make-up of blue gel. As a downside, they are highly flammable. Charged blue gel batteries explode when exposed to rain or fire.

A glass filled with a faintly glowing blue liquid. Of course it’s only a decoration—drinking it would be unthinkable!
Its unnatural color gives off an otherworldly vibe.

Slightly increases room beauty, but has no other effect.
The heart of an Ancient Troll, prized for its alchemical properties.
An old blue jar.
A crested songbird known for its striking blue, white, and black plumage.
A fertilized Blue Jay egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a chick. It can be eaten, but why would you do such a thing?
An unfertilized Blue Jay egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
A fancy intricate silk rug tailored for nobility.
Milk substitute from a frostbound behemoth. Very nutritious but the bluish color is more than a little unsettling.

A large, vividly-colored parrot easily recognized by its striking blue back and wings against a golden-yellow chest. Unlike its rainforest relatives the blue-and-yellow macaw shows a strong preference for swampy habitats, where it nests in the trunks of dead trees. These birds are known for forming strong, long lasting social bonds with other birds of their type but also with humans, and have long been kept as companion animals and status symbols.

Its calm temperament has carried it across every level of human technology in turn, kept the same way in a medieval longhouse as in an industrial factory town or an spacer-tech outpost.

This species is also known as Blue-and-gold Macaw.
A fancy intricate silk rug tailored for nobility.
A bundle of seeds for bluebell. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A sweet, edible fruit hailed as a
, blueberries are commonly eaten fresh as a dessert fruit and can be baked in a variety of pastries.
A bundle of seeds for blueberry plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

A heavy burlap sack filled with sand, connected to a touch-activated trigger. When the victim disturbs the trigger, the sack springs forth and bludgeons the victim. Contrary to other traps, these can be placed next to each other. Animals can sense these when calm.

The two wings found at the base of the spear socket act as barriers to halt oncoming attacks. They also prevent the spear from penetrating too far and thus getting stuck, making the boar spear effective for hunting as well as quick thrusts.
A strong furry pelt harvested from a vicious direboar. Harder than regular boar pelt and insulates well against cold.
These raw hides and pelts were removed from a creature, and with the right skills and tools, could be processed into tanned leather.
Humans began with canoes, created wooden boats, and today's various types of ships.
Boat oars have appeared alongside canoes since the Neolithic Age.
Adding contact plates on both sides of the canoe and adding lateral supports inside the hull, the initial form of a wooden boat is formed.
These hats are woven primarily from dried plant fibers. Some are made of fabric or leather.

A huge insect engineered to feed on the gigantic flowers of a utopian idyllic meadow. Although based on an insectoid geneline, they have been carefully designed to produce meat that is virtually indistinguishable from beef.

Bobeenes are peaceful, unintelligent beasts that are content with buzzing around the meadows, and make for excellent dairy cattle and pack animals. They hover over terrain, thus ignoring movement costs.
A long strip of cloth wrapped tightly around the chest. Provides a small boost to medical treatment.
A simple, yet hearty meal consisting of beans and chopped onion boiled in a light lentil broth.

A single-use man-portable explosive device. Deployed on the ground, it becomes armed and can be detonated with a press of a button. It generates a big explosion thanks to a wired-in antigrain warhead, making it capable of destroying critical infrastructure and personnel alike.

Bone from animals, including humans, can be used as a general material. Bone weapons and armor offer poor durability but accessible protection. Buildings and art inlaid with bone provide decoration to otherwise poor or dull materials. Although easy to acquire, using bones as entire structures, such as a wall or door, should be cautioned. The best use of bone, whether for armor or art, should be to elevate other materials.
An object with ideoligious significance.
Special plating that made from Unhold bones. WWhile intimidating the fearful, the cloak also grants the ability to shrug staggering hits
A weak broth made from animal bones. Not so filling on its own.
An incredibly large and bright-burning bonfire made out of a carefully organized pile of logs on a stone base. Used heavily during flame-based rituals and can only be placed outdoors.

The bonobo is a great ape, a smaller relative of the chimpanzee with a rounder skull and flatter face. Bonobos have longer legs, shorter arms, and a narrower trunk. Bonobos exhibit remarkably different social behavior from chimpanzees, with an emphasis on peacemaking, and sex as a tool to manage and diffuse tension.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.
A decorative pot containing an artificial, miniature tree that has been sculpted to mimic the scale and shape of a full size specimen. Pleasant to look at.
A book left out is a great way to make yourself seem sophisticated, you just have to hope that no one asks you what it is about.
An object with ideoligious significance.
An old book case filled with books.
A shelf for storing miscellaneous items. Items stored in this will not affect room beauty and they won't deteriorate, even if outside.
A book giving a lot of detailed and specialized information on a single cooking condiment.
A book covering astrological and mystical topics, enhanced by uncanny archotech knowledge.

A small plinth to display a single open book. Books stored here will passively enhance academic work done nearby, and increase the beauty of the plinth. The stored books will never deteriorate. Beauty of a book stored on a plinth is multiplied by 10.
A wooden table equipped with inkwells, quills, and parchment, designed for writing manuscripts and scrolls.
A pile of books.
A crate of books, manuals, and assorted written materials.

A sturdy bookshelf designed to hold books and other written materials. The bookshelf is constructed from durable wood and features multiple shelves for storing books, scrolls, and documents. It is designed to keep the written materials organized and easily accessible for reading. Can be used to increase Research speed. 

<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> 
Stack size total: 32 
Stack per tile: 16 

Allowed items: Books

A bookshelf for storing and displaying up to twelve books. Books stored here will passively enhance academic work done nearby, and increase the beauty of the bookshelf. The stored books will never deteriorate. It can be placed on top of other buildings.

A payload of boom genetic material. Can be used at the genomorpher to create a growth cell of a hybrid animal. This tier 1 genome can be used as either a primary or secondary genome.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All boom hybrids explode on death. Farm hybrids produce chemfuel, while combat hybrids can use exploding abilities.

<color=#E5E54C>Extraction:</color> Can be extracted via the genome extractor table or any genome excavator from:
installed

An improvised explosive trap built out of... best if you don't think about it. Cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm. Less potent than regular high-explosive shell traps.

Originally intended as a way to make boomalopes more combat viable, their powerful muscles have instead been focused on compressing its produced chemfuel as a way to store greater amounts of chemfuel without care of how dangerous it is.

A boomalope hybrid with recessive ursine genes. Consumes more than twice as much compared to a boomalope but produces deepchem instead. They’re also capable of defending themselves should any predator be foolish enough to go after them.

A biological weapon in compact form, these living, breathing, shitting bombs are ideally assembled into a massive horde and sent squawking at the enemy. Allegedly, this particular hybrid has been brought up in certain court cases as the original creator thought it would be funny to create “lethal egg timers”.

A boomalope hybrid with recessive avian genes. Produces edible eggs very slowly, but can lay a clutch of explosive eggs twice a day. They’re both reasonably intelligent and quick on their feet.
Fertilized Boomachicken egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into one of these abominations. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Unfertilized Boomachicken egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.

The boomalisk is a boomalope / dunealisk hybrid that produces a weird spider silk know as boomthread. This silk is as strong as synthread, but it is also an excellent thermal insulator. Boomalisks also catch their prey with exploding webs, which... sounds dangerous.

Useful abilities: Produces chemfuel, boomthread and attacks with explosive webs.
These skin nodules can be integrated in a human's torso, causing a huge explosion if the subjects dies violently.

While more of a risk to keep around, they are considerably more efficient and don’t eat your crops as much. Plus their permanent sad expression just makes you want to pet them, how can you say no.

A perfect boomalope animal, paragon of all similar animals with no needless junk genetic data. Besides the various improvements to the baseline animal’s abilities, this paragon produces deepchem instead and explodes on death in a much more violent fashion.

Outright refuses to let anyone else milk them for their chemfuel as they view it as a violation of their humanoid rights. They make for a good conversation partner even if their stance can be a little volatile.

A boomalope hybrid with recessive humanoid genes. Instead of supplying a regular amount of chemfuel, this hybrid will syphon themselves to top up a limited number of machinery powered by chemfuel, such as generators and pod launchers.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Humanoid hybrids will periodically engage other colonists in conversation, talking about a variety of topics. This increases the social recreation needs of those they interact with by 10% (subject to diminishing returns like all joy types). If using Ideology, humanoid hybrids are subject to precepts. Boomen periodically refuel some machines powered by chemfuel in a 10 tile radius (chemfuel generators and pod launchers).
Due to some insane experiment, these cute, fluffy rodents create a powerful fire-starting explosion when killed.

For lovers of xenomorphs everywhere, this bomb-ass bombadier is ready to launch sacs of acidic chemfuel at your enemies for fun and profit. Don’t expect a second pair of jaws though, that mouth is for spitting only.

An insectoid hybrid with recessive boomalope genes. Quite temperamental for a hybrid, but they prove to be worth it as they store caustic chemfuel in their sacs which can then be lobbed at a distance. Practically useless in melee, so keep them safe and provide fire support. Can be ordered to detonate auxiliary acid sacs as a defensive measure, but that will also self-harm.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All insectoid hybrids have good armor and no toxic sensitivity, but they are always sterile and can't reproduce, even if a fertility booster is used to create them.

Combining the frequent nuzzling of a cat and the deepchem production of a primary boomalope hybrid is surely in no way going to end badly. Better not to ignore them should they complain loudly about wanting dinner.

A boomalope hybrid with recessive feline genes. They make for an interesting companion for those who desire chemfuel production but also want to be able to cuddle said creatures. They can also be butchered to retrieve an internal gland filled with deepchem.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Like all cat hybrids, they have an improved melee dodge ability and a short nuzzle period.

People love efficiency and having one thing to cover all their needs. Well this isn’t it, but it gets damn close. The chemfuel sacs have mixed with milk-producing glands, which make for a milk that smells like pure gasoline and could almost power a vehicle.

A boomalope hybrid with recessive muffalo genes. Has a large appetite due to it producing multiple products, namely deepchem, thin wool and an unusual milk that shares properties with Chemshine.

Inherently less effective at refining chemfuel when allowed to rest at its leisure while also being a good pack animal and riding companion. During distant travels, the long periods of engagement for their muscles actively puts their glands into overdrive. Quite effective should there be a vehicle that uses chemfuel, but don’t ask how that would work out. Maybe it’s the desire to compete against machinery or knowing that if the vehicle breaks down it's gonna have to do all that bloody walking again.

An equine hybrid with recessive boomalope genes. While they are comparatively slower, their inherent need to exercise means that their capability in producing chemfuel is severely hampered if their muscles aren’t engaged for long periods of time. When travelling as part of a caravan, their chemfuel production speed is effectively quadrupled.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All equine hybrids are good for caravaning. A caravan with one of them needs a shorter resting period, only stopping to rest between 23:30 PM and 4 AM.
The Boomnotherium is an hybrid between a boomalope and a large prehistoric relative of modern-day elephants. In latin, boomnotherium roughly translates as
tanky

Clearly someone was a sore loser in playing pretend games as a child, but had either the brains or the money to prove themselves right.

A large, genetically-engineered tick. For those who wished they could equip their canines with explosive vests, the Boomwolf stores pressurised - almost solidified - chemfuel which can be remotely discharged as a non-explosive gas. A cataphract helmet, which was secretly modified by a fashionable person, was painted with the logo of a famous ancient clothing store.
A cataphract helmet, which was secretly modified by a deranged killer, was adorned with a skull and the word 'Slaughter'.

The perfect companion in compact form, this tiny terror is willing to throw down with its surprising bulk. And good lord, what an affectionate beefcake.

A feline hybrid with recessive ursine genes. Can both take and dish out punishment disproportionate to its size while being clever enough to actively hunt for prey not much larger than itself. Incredibly easy to train and will intermittently dig up burrowed rats.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Like all cat hybrids, they have an improved melee dodge ability, which in the case of these small animals is ideal to get out of a fight. Stunning attacks like bear hybrids.

This smart little shit knows where to kick so it hurts, and that’s often the eyes. The unusual genetic makeup has made their claws as long as a human thumb, so best to pet it when it wants to and avoid touching the belly.

A feline hybrid with recessive avian genes. A little slow for its size, it makes for a vicious attack animal if it can be permitted to get in melee range. Be careful as it can’t take much punishment.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Like all cat hybrids, they have an improved melee dodge ability, which in the case of these small animals is ideal to get out of a fight. Go for the eyes: Catchicken attacks have a 25% chance to affect the victim's eyes.

Someone couldn’t bear being separated from their trusty feline companions when away on trips. So they decided to make one that everyone would want to take with them on long journeys. Also they look incredibly adorable with their little baggies.

A feline hybrid with recessive muffalo genes. While not great as a pack animal, they make for a fantastic caravaning companion as they will actively forage for prey during trips. This creates a stacking effect of boosting the amount of food foraged for every other catffalo in the trip. They’re quite hardy too but should be kept away from combat.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Like all cat hybrids, they have an improved melee dodge ability, which in the case of these small animals is ideal to get out of a fight. Forages for small prey while caravaning, increasing the amount of foraged food by 10% (and it stacks per catffalo on the caravan!).
A bundle of seeds for cathedralis. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

Tell me, do you want a cat large enough to ride at speeds that would be illegal on most urbworld city streets? Of course you do, and if you say otherwise you’re a coward. This ferocious feline is ready to tear up the track and hunt prey comically smaller than itself. They’re also incredibly smart and have a tendency to stalk their owners when their backs are turned. Don’t worry though, it only wants to pin you down and drown you in fur and saliva.

An equine hybrid with recessive feline genes. Quite durable and combat capable for a pack animal, they can be drafted to execute at-will pouncing to close distance with the enemy. They are only slightly less effective as horses in riding but have better stamina, in exchange they are pure carnivores so their diet can be rather restrictive.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All equine hybrids are good for caravaning. A caravan with one of them needs a shorter resting period, only stopping to rest between 23:30 PM and 4 AM. Like all cat hybrids, they have an improved melee dodge ability, making them perfect for the front lines, and a short nuzzle period. Always starts as draftable, even if not using a controller booster to create it. Pounce ability: when drafted, the player can use the pounce ability to make the hybrid jump around. The ability can be triggered every 2 hours.

You seriously have to wonder who comes up with ideas to play with things beyond their understanding. Have you ever had an octopus attach itself to your face and try to climb down your throat? Well now you can find out, with an extra helping of teeth, claws and furballs.

A feline hybrid with recessive Eldritch genes. Comparable to a regular big cat, such as a panther, however its bite not only causes blindness but also inflicts bouts of insanity from the lingering touch of the tentacles. Oddly enough it also enjoys fondling its master with those same tentacles, notably without its teeth out. Oh, did I not mention the fact it has teeth along those tentacles?

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Like all cat hybrids, they have an improved melee dodge ability and a short nuzzle period. Its bites cause suffocation and it slowly regenerates health.

Just the sweetest little kitty cat you’ll ever encounter, they were bred as tiny caretakers to look after people in hospital wards. Despite being a health violation, they were extremely popular with the infirms as they not only fed patients but also engaged in conversation and gave friendly headbutts. It is also alleged that their purring helped broken bones heal quicker, but no conclusive evidence has been shown.

A feline hybrid with recessive humanoid genes. Quite slow and fragile, comparatively speaking, with a low damage output and lower hunger rate. However, they make for very good bedside companions for the ill and will regularly feed those that cannot feed themselves.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Humanoid hybrids will periodically engage other colonists in conversation, talking about a variety of topics. This increases the social recreation needs of those they interact with by 10% (subject to diminishing returns like all joy types). If using Ideology, humanoid hybrids are subject to precepts. Catmen are compassionate animals that will help with feeding medical patients around the colony.

Everyone can agree that cats and rabbits have incredibly soft fur, so can you imagine how cute and fluffy they would be if you mixed their traits together? They also love to be pet multiple times a day, so everyone can get in on this pet so fluffy it's to die for.

A feline hybrid with recessive rodent genes. While a somewhat independent carnivore, this hybrid is ideal inside a colony as it not only provides a  non-stacking mood boost to those nearby from its cuteness, but it also nuzzles every few hours. They’re also very fast breeders.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Like all cat hybrids, they have an improved melee dodge ability, which in the case of these small animals is ideal to get out of a fight. Gives non-stacking +3 mood to everyone in a 8 tiles radius.

For some reason people really want cats to be able to carry stuff, depicted often in consumer media. Well this palico should have you sorted, however despite numerous efforts it has proved impossible to train them in using brooms.

A feline hybrid with recessive canine genes. An incredibly fast hauling companion that can also defend itself, these creatures borne forth from pop culture are incredibly smart and incredibly clean. They can’t carry much, but having a whole army won’t cause your base to fill with filth, just the normal degenerates.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Like all cat hybrids, they have an improved melee dodge ability, which in the case of these small animals is ideal to get out of a fight. Produces (and spreads) absolutely no filth.
A bundle of seeds for cauliflower plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A large round vegetable that has a hard white centre surrounded by green leaves, naturally high in fiber and B-vitamins.

A row of sharpened spikes laid low across the ground. Designed to maim or cripple those who attempt to charge through, especially fast-moving animals or mounted units. Can be placed next to other cavalry spikes. Upon being triggered, cavalry spikes will need to be rebuilt.

An enormous reptile, halfway between serpents and dragons. One of the few creatures truly incapable of feeling fear. Any daredevil who manages to get past the mighty yet nimble tail and pierce a hardy scale will be splashed with corrosive blood. Lindwurm blood is the most powerful acid known yet — dissolving even the thickest steel, eating through the flesh in seconds.
A nutrient-rich moss that can be used to feed cave animals, but not humans.
A bundle of seeds for cave moss. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A small stack of CD-Roms.
Cools a room by circulating air. Includes a built-in lamp.
Cools a room by circulating air. Includes a built-in lamp.

A vegetable consisting of a long fibrous stalk tapering into leaves. The leaves are strongly flavored and are used less often, either as a flavoring in soups and stews or as a dried herb. Celery is a staple in many soups.
A bundle of seeds for celery plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A collection of advanced mechanites able to strategically fortify and reinforce the users body in response to the types of damage it commonly sustains.
The subject is quadrupedeal with a humanoid torso.
The subject is quadrupedeal with a humanoid torso.
The subject is quadrupedeal with a humanoid torso.
The subject is quadrupedeal with a humanoid torso.
The subject is quadrupedeal with a humanoid torso.
The subject is quadrupedeal with a humanoid torso.

A carefully designed and decorated set of armor made from a series of reinforced metal or wooden sheets, forming somewhat of a carapace without sacrificing too much dexterity. Such armor is known to embolden one's mental fortitude.

A carefully designed and decorated helmet made out of a single large piece of wood or metal. A wide open gap near the mouth and eyes allows full peripheral vision and unmuffled communication. This particular helmet includes accoutrement to inspire both its wearers and onlookers, when fighting side by side a centurion even pain itself seems dulled.
A cute plush dinosaur.

An interlink node scavenged from the cerebrex core of a mechhive. It can be used to summon mechanoids or mechanoid transport pods from the planet-wide mechanoid satellite network.

This implant is self-installable but since it interlaces deep within the brain tissue, it can only be removed after death.

A traditional serrated ceremonial sword, wielded by the most skilled and powerful of the Keshig families. It is difficult to use by inexperienced users due to it's size and unusual shape, but it can cause painful lacerations and wounds.
An object with ideoligious significance.
This is a helmet worn by soldiers. Since it is made of cloth or leather, not metal, there are concerns about its defensiveness.
An object with ideoligious significance.
A thick hood forged from chains of metal provides excellent protection to the head against slashing and thrusting attacks.

A thick hood forged from chains of metal with an added plate-metal noseguard to almost entirely protect the face. Makes it a bit difficult to see, but otherwise offers excellent protection against cuts.
A thick hood forged from chains of metal with additional protection reinforcing the lower face. Provides excellent protection to the entire head against piercing and slashing attacks.

A strong medieval helmet that provides full-head coverage. While it offers fantastic protection, ones vision is grealy obscured, thus it is only recommended for front line infantry, particularly those foregoing shields.

A strong medieval helmet that provides full-head coverage. While it offers fantastic protection, ones vision is grealy obscured, thus it is only recommended for front line infantry, particularly those foregoing shields.
A wide-rimmed kettle helmet paired with a chainmail coif, offering excellent protection of the head while providing comfortable shade from the sun.
A chainmail coif coupled with a simple round nasal helmet, offering excellent protection of the head.

A variation of the chain skull cap crafted as a chainmail coif coupled with a nasal helmet. Offers the same level of protection for the head, but the strip of red cloth tied around the forehead displays authority.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm replacement. This particular model includes a modified chain shotgun that can be fully retracted outside of combat, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

A heavy duty tri-barreled machine gun. It can throw down a torrent of inaccurate bullets which whittle down armor and defenses. The longer air-cooled barrels and large magazine allow it to fire for longer.

A powerful handheld cutting tool equipped with a motorized chain and teeth that rotate around a guide bar. Used primarily for felling trees, pruning branches, and cutting lumber, the chainsaw is a versatile and efficient tool in forestry, landscaping, and construction. It enables users to quickly and precisely cut through wood with ease, making it indispensable for tasks requiring fast and precise cutting in outdoor environments.

An early design of the full-faced helmet, consisting of a reinforced flat-top helmet with an additional face-plate and a mail coif. Offers great protection of the entire head, but hinders eyesight and breathing.

An early design of the full-faced helmet, consisting of a reinforced flat-top helmet with an additional face-plate and a mail coif. Offers great protection of the entire head, but hinders eyesight and breathing.

Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

Despite what its bizzare appearance could suggest, chalicotherium is most closely related to horses and rhinoceroses.
It walks on its knuckles and uses its huge sloth-like claws as both a rake and a mean of defense against predators.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.

A long-haired domesticated bovid that has evolved a survival mechanism to camouflage itself in response to different stimuli. It changes its very metabolism according to the environment it is inhabiting at the time.

Chameleon yaks will change their temperature tolerance depending on their environment and even produce different types of wool. This change occurs at the cellular level and is very fast, but doesn't harm the animal in the slightest.
A coarse tan wool with long fibers and a pseudo-crystalline lattice of organic support structures underneath. Quite strong and very good at keeping the desert heat out.
A coarse green wool with long fibers intertwined with a keratin like substance. Super strong, but not very good for insulation.
A coarse brown wool with long fibers. Quite strong and warm.
A coarse white wool with long fibers. Quite strong and specifically adapted to extremely cold climates.
Inspired by the design of traditional doorways, this bed is minimalist yet beautiful. Perfect for hipsters who love the simple but exotic, and historians who narrowly escaped the field.
A stylish and versatile hood with a wrapped tail, favored by diplomats and merchants. It lends an air of authority, subtly improving negotiation skills.
A heavy, pulse-charged rapid-fire blaster mounted on a barricade to grant cover. Needs to be manned in order to fire. Requires plasteel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use.

A modified charged-shot revolver that incorporates mechanoid technology. Recovered thump cannons have been reversed engineered to allow for a powerful charge revolver with two shooting modes to be created. Charged shot mode will eliminate any close targets with a powerful, armor-piercing blast, whilst a Thump shot mode allows users to incapacitate enemies and break any defenses they might be hiding behind. Modes can be changed with a press of a button.
Automated charge EMP machine gun mounted on a quadpod.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm replacement. This particular model includes a modified charge lance that can be fully retracted outside of combat, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.
Automated charge rotary machine gun mounted on a quadpod.

A cutting-edge, pulse-charged, rail-assisted weapon system that fires a short burst of high-velocity projectiles, energized with unstable plasma as they leave the rail. The resulting shots pierce armor and bodies alike, but the turret requires new plasteel barrel after use. It cannot fire at close range, and may explode when damaged.
A field power cell for recharging spacer weapons.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm replacement. This particular model includes a modified charge rifle that can be fully retracted outside of combat, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

A modified charged-shot assault shotgun that incorporates mechanoid technology. Recovered thump cannons have been reversed engineered to produce a portable ranged weapon capable of firing blunt projectiles. Quite powerful but short ranged, with high performance against structures and heavily armored targets.

A portable automatic charged-shot turret. Pulse-charge technology charges each shot with unstable energy as it leaves the barrel. Requires plasteel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.
A charged high caliber artillery piece for indirect fire at extended ranges.

A fertilized blizzarisk egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby blizzarisk. It can be eaten raw or cooked, but it's a spider egg, so it's disgusting either way...

This egg seems to be developing at an alarmingly accelerated rate!

A fertilized dunealisk egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby dunealisk. It can be eaten raw or cooked, but it's a spider egg, so it's disgusting either way...

This egg seems to be developing at an alarmingly accelerated rate!

A fertilized feralisk egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby feralisk. It can be eaten raw or cooked, but it's a spider egg, so it's disgusting either way...

This egg seems to be developing at an alarmingly accelerated rate!

A station where androids can recharge power cells. Requires batteries and a powerful power grid to support.

(art pending)
A fancy intricate silk rug tailored for nobility.
A sharp-tasting wheel of cheese, created by a special process of purposely curdling animal milk. It makes for both a tasty treat on its own, as well as a versatile ingredient in meals.
An open cupboard to store and display objects in an efficient manner.
Delve into the bubbling cauldron of fondue, where the melted cheese conceals the secrets of its savory companions, inviting you on a journey of culinary exploration
A delightfully gooey soup consisting of cuts of melted cheese curd housed in a rich broth of garlic-spiced ale. A hearty dish best served warm, soothing for both the body and soul.

These cats are lean and lanky, allowing them to reach incredible speeds. They have tan-colored fur with solid black, round spots, very long legs, a long narrow tail for balance, and a deep chest that contains large lungs.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.

A high-tech work-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm replacement. This model is equipped with a simple bioanalyzer and a variety of cooking utensils. It is also highly resistant to heat, which allows the user to safely make contact with hot surfaces and substances. A compact support system makes it easy and comfortable to carry around.

An advanced brain implant designed to assist the user in cooking and act as a digital encyclopedia on that particular subject. The subpersona can quickly analyze a food item's temperature, consistency and accurately predict the taste with just a quick glance.

A brain implant of such complexity requires time to synchronize with and adapt to its host in order to avoid excessive strain on the central nervous system, its effectiveness will slowly increase during this process. It's capable of syncing with other enhancements made to assist in similar tasks, greatly increasing efficiency.
A tall, round, pleated hat usually worn by the chefs.
A thick cloth coat protects from the heat of stoves and splattering of boiling liquids.

A pheromone controlling micro-organ. It is necessary to construct certain types of insectoid hives. Pherocores have been embedded deep into the brains of geneline leaders which allowed ancient civilizations to control the hives.

This pherocore belongs to the great geneline from the planet Chelis, known for their locust-like appearance and ability to fly for thousands of miles.
A Chemfuel Brazier. Will light the surroundings and create heat.

A deep fryer is a kitchen appliance used for deep frying, and this particular model uses chemfuel to power itself. Deep frying is a method of cooking by submerging food into oil at high heat, typically between temperatures of 350 °F and 375 °F (175 °C to 190 °C).
A tall chemfuel-powered lamp that lights an area, able to be placed outside without catching fire, making it ideal for road lighting and only turns on at night.
A reinforced bionic heart that acts like a miniature 4-stroke internal combustion engine powered by chemfuel to pump blood through the body.
A device that burns chemfuel to produce heat.

An ant-like creature created as a replacement for the ubiquitous boomalope. Chemfuel myrmidons consume both meat and vegetables to ferment them into a powerful chemfuel mixture, which can be periodically extracted from the animal.

Contrary to the boomalope, chemfuel myrmidons are resistant to damage, especially damage caused by high temperatures. They are perfectly content living in red-hot semi liquid ground.

A large storage structure designed to hold barrels of chemfuel for use in generators, vehicles, and other machinery. Items stored inside will not deteriorate over time and have no impact on the beauty of their surroundings. 

<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> 
Stack size total: 60 
Stack per tile: 15 

Allowed items: Chemfuel
Soup is ancient as time itself, well almost. This is a chemfuel powered cooking pot, which needs chemfuel to work.
A Chemfuel powered deep-crust drilling excavator for extracting minerals from deep under the surface. Great for caravaning due to its portability.
Extracts usable metal from slag chunks and other mixed metal items. Consumes a lot of chemfuel and runs very hot.
A chemfuel-powered station for smithing non-mechanical weapons and tools.
A reinforced bionic stomach that uses a combination of gastric acid and chemfuel to efficiently digest food.
An chemfuel-powered stove with an attached countertop for preparing meals.
An industrial lamp which lights an area brightly enough to grow crops, but consumes a huge amount of chemfuel. It also has a slightly lower lighting radius. Automatically turns itself off at night.
A Chemfuel-powered wall light that lights an area. People need light to move and work at full speed. Can be safely placed outdoors.
An chemfuel-powered standing lamp that lights an area. People need light to move and work at full speed.
A light coat worn to protect clothing from substances used in a lab.

A high-tech device that can be installed into any compatible artificial spine replacement. This particular model is capable of greatly enhancing its host's body by supplying it with additional energy produced by a miniature chemfuel generator. It has to be regularly fueled with chemfuel in order to function.
A bundle of seeds for chemroot. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
Tiny purple-red sweet cherries. Cherries are notable for requiring a brief freezing season, as such they quickly became a favorite among northern occidental cultures.
A trusty wooden chest to store your personal belongings. Items stored in this will not affect room beauty and they won't deteriorate, even if outside. Multiple chests do not stack comfort bonuses.

A small, single-tile wooden chest designed for storing a limited amount of items. Items stored inside will not deteriorate over time and have no impact on the beauty of their surroundings. 

<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> 
Stack size total: 4 
Stack per tile: 4 

Allowed items: Everything except Foods, Corpses and Chunks

A traditional beverage made from purple corn, spiced with cinnamon and cloves, and flavored with fruits like pineapple. Known for its rich, deep purple color and refreshing sweet-tart taste, chicha morada is not only a cultural staple but also rich in antioxidants due to the high anthocyanin content of purple corn.

<color=#E5E54C>Trade considerations:</color>

<color=#E5E54C>Ingredients:</color> Making 10 chicha morada requires corn, pineapple, spices and sugar for a total value of 99.40, and sells for 35, giving a <color=#33CC33>71.60%</color> profit per unit.

<color=#E5E54C>Value per work:</color> Recipe requires 7500 work, which results on a value per work of <color=#33CC33>0.05</color>.

<color=#E5E54C>Caravan trading:</color> Its weight is 0.3 Kg, for a value per Kg of <color=#33CC33>116.66</color>.

<color=#E5E54C>Profit per day:</color> On average, profit per day is <color=#33CC33>1.09</color> (for reference Yayo is 0.35).

An unholy amalgamation of fungus, crustacean, insect and... chicken. Can this creature even be considered to be truly alive?

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> This psionic chicken lays A LOT of purple eggs. What's not to love?
Fertilized chicken of Mi-go egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked. The purple shell is incredibly disconcerting. If all goes well, it should hatch into a chicken of Mi-go.
Unfertilized chicken of Mi-go egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked. The purple shell is incredibly disconcerting.
A small plush chicken.

For something so small, this animal has a hell of an appetite. Lacking in many departments, but the nutrition has to go somewhere and that’s for those looking for a non-vegan friendly option of getting high. The person who thought it would be a good idea to inhale the burning feathers of this plump creature is one stoners everywhere praise while they blaze.

An avian hybrid with recessive ursine genes. Has a considerably larger appetite and inherent wildness, but reproduces quickly.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Can be regularly plucked for chickenbear feathers. When these feathers are turned into powder at a Drug lab, they can be rolled into a joint to be smoked.
Fertilized Chickenbear egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into one of these abominations. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Unfertilized Chickenbear egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Chickenbear feathers can be gathered and processed into a fine powder called featherdust, which produces a mild euphoric sensation when burned and inhaled.

Respectably intelligent as well as lethal, these egg-laying, plump beasties love nuzzling their owners and biting their enemies. Sometimes those are different people.

An avian hybrid with recessive feline genes. Quite clean with a low gestation period, they make for an average farm animal and an average combatant with good speed. They still require a pen, so they make for good home defence.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Like all cat hybrids, they have an improved melee dodge ability and a short nuzzle period.
Fertilized Chickencat egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into one of these abominations. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Unfertilized Chickencat egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.

You wouldn’t think something so small could eat so much, but that’s the price you pay for the sake of convenience. That convenience is sporadic, low in nutrition and very thin, an effect commonly described as “nerfing”.

An avian hybrid with recessive muffalo genes. Loves to wander so it must be securely penned, but they make for a surprising pack beast. Capable of producing the holy trinity of milk, eggs and wool, however they can be quite lacking in substance.
Fertilized Chickenffalo egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into one of these abominations. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Unfertilized Chickenffalo egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Milk from a chickenffalo. Looks like watered down milk. Probably not much better than water.

An agile avian that most people expect to be more yellow in colour and go “wark” every now and then. A delightfully speedy mount that can pull off some impressive turns, this hybrid has been bred even further with other species to make for more colourful and genetically stable bird mounts. Some speculate that this particular creature is the original ancestor of the Ave, while the Royal Ave came from those that were bred more for plumage than performance.

An equine hybrid with recessive avian genes. Comparatively smaller than a purebred, but incredibly fast both in a singular location and as part of a caravan. A rather unusual hybrid in that it reproduces very slowly in a safe, similar environment, however this changes on caravan trips. Constant new sights and experiences puts their reproductive cycle into overdrive as it tries to spread its species over a broad horizon, however these eggs are genetically sterile so that they instead provide a healthy protein supplement for those who can only gather fruits and vegetables.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All equine hybrids are good for caravaning. A caravan with one of them needs a shorter resting period, only stopping to rest between 23:30 PM and 4 AM.
Fertilized chickenhorse egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into one of these abominations. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Unfertilized chickenhorse egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.

Chickens are basically an evolution of dinosaurs, so someone decided to turn them back. Unfortunately they didn’t exactly bother to check that they should still be avian rather than reptilian, so it resulted in this nasty little thing that reproduces at an insane rate and empties your fridge. But hey, they’ll spit on your enemies and their right to shit everywhere, especially where they eat.

A reptile hybrid with recessive avian genes. This particular farm animal is smart enough that it doesn’t need a pen and breeds faster than other reptiles. A very large appetite for a creature so small, which supports its ability to spit out nasty toxins on their enemies and create messes on the floor. Very easy to train and has a good memory.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All reptile hybrids have good temperature tolerance ranges and venomous attacks.
Fertilized chickenlizard egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into one of these abominations. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Unfertilized chickenlizard egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
The chickenlodon is a very weird cross between one of the most fearsome predators ever existing... and a chicken. A saber-toothed chicken, if you will.
Fertilized chickenlodon egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked. If all goes well, it should hatch into a chickenlodon.
Unfertilized chickenlodon egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.

The ideal companion for those who love the smell of fried eggs and napalm in the morning. Regretfully they’re far too birdbrained to receive any direction, and most owners have been noted saying “I’ve made a huge mistake”.

An avian hybrid with recessive boomalope genes. Very dangerous if allowed to breed uncontrollably, so consider liberal fireproofing and selling the excess. Produces chemfuel daily as well as an egg every 2 days.
Fertilized Chickenlope egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into one of these abominations. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Unfertilized Chickenlope egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.

One of the few unusual animal hybrids that come with their own warning labels despite being almost entirely harmless. All it took was one absent-minded vegan to cause a single couple of “Breeders” to overpopulate and devastate the ecology of an entire continent. Fairy tales surrounding the fluffy terror have done nothing to help it be taken seriously.

An avian hybrid with recessive rodent genes. An incredibly low metabolism coupled with an incredibly high reproduction rate, these animals are very sensitive to temperature and are unusually keen on escaping to the wilds.

Fertilized Chickenrabbit egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into one of these abominations. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked. The colonists swear it was coloured like this when the animal laid it.
Unfertilized Chickenrabbit egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked. The colonists swear it was coloured like this when the animal laid it.

For the unusual connoisseur who both enjoys a healthy breakfast and the feel of silk pyjamas. A very niche market, but considering the amount of money paid for the development, people like that are too rich to be considered mad. They’re simply eccentric with refined tastes, or “tossers” as the disenfranchised call them.

An insectoid hybrid with recessive avian genes. Quite large and difficult to train for an animal that lays eggs, this particular hybrid should always be kept warm due to the various functions taking up valuable space. Capable of producing not only eggs but also valuable silk, and is protected by thin, flexible scales to resist cuts.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All insectoid hybrids have good armor and no toxic sensitivity, but they are always sterile and can't reproduce, even if a fertility booster is used to create them.
Unfertilized Chickenspider egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked. Since insectoid hybrids are always infertile, these eggs can never be fertilized.

The Tiny Terror with a disconcertingly large mouth and sharp teeth. These comic flightless web-footed little bastards may finally unwittingly help man to fathom the uncharted depths of just how dangerous they can make a living creature the size of a basketball.

An avian hybrid with recessive canine genes. Doesn’t produce much in the way of eggs but makes up for it by having a shorter gestation period and a very nasty bite. They’re also incredibly smart and agile, making them ideal for swarm tactics.
Fertilized Chickenwolf egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into one of these abominations. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Unfertilized Chickenwolf egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
A bundle of seeds for chickpea plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
One of the earliest cultivated legumes. Chickpeas are high in fibre and protein and are a good source of iron, phosphorus, and folic acid.
A small dog, just a little bit bigger than a rat. Back in ancient times considered to be reincarnations of different deities and are to this day considered sacred.
These raw hides and pelts were removed from a creature, and with the right skills and tools, could be processed into tanned leather.
A bundle of seeds for chioggia beet plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

An herb-like vegetable widely cultivated for humans and livestock alike. Though these look like ordinary beets from the outside, on the inside they have distinct red-and-white-striped flesh. These are highest on the sweetness scale.

A variety of crunchy, flavorful bites made from seeds and thinly sliced, dried, or fried produce. These nutrient-packed treats offer a satisfying crunch and can be seasoned or flavored to suit any taste.

A small rack filled with various chisels. Increases work speed when placed near a stonecutter’s table. One workbench can only use one chisel rack.
A sign about a frilled dinosaur and its relatives.
Sweet chocolate cake
ChocolateCake, plastic fake.

A rich, thick liquid made by grinding cacao beans into a smooth paste and fermenting it. It retains both the cocoa solids and cocoa butter, creating a deep, intense chocolate flavor.

A mixture of cocoa, water and sugar, forming a bitter-sweet pourable syrup, perfect for coating desserts. Applying the syrup to a gourmet meal will grant it a mood-boosting effect.
A stone bas relief of christian imagery for decorating a floor.
A stone bas relief of christian imagery for decorating a floor.

A suit of advanced chrysalis power armor. Improved protection over standard power armor, offered by molecular plasteel integration throughout the suit as well as on-board processors to assist movement and dampen pain receptors.
An advanced power armor helmet, with a solid plasteel-weave shell and complex visual system for near-360-degree viewing angles and tactical telemetry feed, including aim assist.
A bundle of seeds for chrysanthemum. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A sign about chungkingosaurus, a relative of stegosaurus.
A chunk of rock, carefully picked to have the highest smashing potential.

A rich, tangy-sweet condiment made by combining fruits, spices, and vinegar. Chutneys vary in texture and flavor, from smooth to chunky, and are used to add a burst of flavor to savory dishes, balancing sweetness with a hint of tartness and spice.

Apple juice that is fermented for a few days to develop its alcoholic content. Consuming enough cider can make you drunk.

A barely alcoholic beverage meant to be refreshing and fruity. Try as anybody might it is pointless trying to get inebriated by cider alone, thus it is popular among those with prior addiction. Anecdotally, many praise it for supposed antioxidant properties.
Wooden high-grade cigar box.
A cigar placed on a porcelain plate.

A huge spider adapted to living close to the calderas of dormant volcanoes. They were originally engineered for their durable and heat-resistant silk, but once they escaped into the wild they began multiplying uncontrollably.

Cinderlisks attack by throwing huge webs at their prey. These webs stun and burn anything they touch, allowing them to close in and finish the kill with their fearsome fangs. Their fangs are also burning-hot and can light things on fire.
A fertilized cinderlisk egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby cinderlisk. It can be eaten raw or cooked, but it's a spider egg, so it's disgusting either way...
This silk is as strong as synthread, but it is also an excellent thermal insulator. It is completely non-flammable.

Also called the golden heart pigeon, this is a medium-sized ground-dwelling dove with a distinctive color pattern native to tropical environments where it forages along the jungle floor, lowlands, and foothills. These birds are not domesticated and will wander.
A fertilized cinnamon ground dove egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a chick. It can be eaten, but why would you do such a thing?
An unfertilized cinnamon ground dove egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
The pale, yellow quartz known as citrine is one of the lowest-valued crystals. Decorating jewelry with this gem increases wealth, even if by a smaller margin than more valuable gems.
This citrine-embedded necklace slightly increases wealth for the men and women seeking to improve their social status.
This citrine-embedded ring slightly increases wealth for the men and women seeking to improve their social status.

A light blue liquid that’s sparkling with a subtle effervescence. When the user drinks it, it restores some of their psychic focus and enhances their psychic sensitivity, allowing for clearer mental processing and heightened awareness. However, this increased mental activity significantly raises the user's hunger rate, making them need to eat more often. Additionally, the relentless mental buzz from the draught leads to a noticeable drop in mood due to the overwhelming flow of thoughts.

A portable heavy machine gun loaded with high-velocity ammunition. A deadly mix of accuracy and penetration, it fires fast bullets capable of piercing and shredding armor, but that do little damage by themselves.

A bullpup assault rifle loaded with high-velocity ammunition. High range and short bursts make it an incredibly capable weapon, the bullets can pierce tough armor with blinding speed, but do little damage by themselves.
A quiet, incredibly slow to alert chime used to signal the start of classes. A teacher will manually ring this to call students.
An ancient bag of classic thin cut salted potato chips. and packaged with nitrogen gas making it difficult to spoil.
A classical painting placed upon an easel.
An confidential intelligence map that records a certain location.

An advanced artificial tail. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while a biogel nerve-extension on the Coccyx gives exquisit control. It's extended support structures and enhanced mini-servos give the user unrivaled versatility when it comes to carying and moving objects.
A chunk of clay. Can be cut into blocks and than fired in a kiln for useable material.
Blocks of solid clay. Clay is a relatively soft rock and chips easily.
Simple, hand-formed containers crafted from natural clay. They are beautiful to look at.

A brutal, ancient weapon of heavy knights, the claymore can be used cleave through enemies with ease.

This weapon has a chance to deal a critical strike, stunning the opponent.
An unfinished drone. This will deploy into a drone.
A table to clean loot and ready them for display.

A heavy-duty kitchen knife characterized by a broad, rectangular blade with a thick spine and a sharp edge. Designed for chopping through tough cuts of meat and bone with ease, the cleaver offers precision and power in food preparation tasks. Its weight and sturdy construction allow for efficient cutting, making it a versatile tool in butcher shops, restaurants, and home kitchens alike.
A sturdy rack holding sharp cleavers and knives. Increases work speed when placed near a butchering table. One workbench can only use one cleaver rack.
A classic clipboard.
Petals of an unusual plant with tall, pretty flowers, called ‘bush lily’ by some. Clivia petals have been used by medieval civilizations in creation of different draughts.
A bundle of seeds for clivia. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A sign about cloning dinosaurs.
A sign showing how the first genespliced dinosaurs were made.
A sign explaining the cloning process.
The sealed oxygen cylinder, designed for combat in severe environments, contains a minor amount of doping gas, enhancing the user's combat effectiveness.
A closet to store clothes efficiently and beautifully. Place near beds for a slight comfort bonus
A closet to store clothes efficiently and beautifully. Place near beds for a slight comfort bonus
A set of hangers holding old pieces of clothing.

A common antipsychotic medicine used to treat bipolar disorder and other mental conditions. It can help prevent some pawns from fully acting out impulsive behavior and extreme mental breaks. Large doses may cause vomiting.

Mortar shell that is designed to split mid-air and release three high-explosive shells. Separated shells are ejected in random directions, following the same vector as the cluster shell. Explosions cover a high area but the accuracy of the shells leave a lot to be desired.

A high-tech device that can be installed into a heart or any any compatible artificial heart replacement. This particular model releases coagulating factors in response to blood loss, reducing bleeding rate significantly.
Coal is a black combustible chunk of rock formed by mostly carbon. A good source of fuel for stoves and furnaces.

A highly intelligent parrot known for its expressive crest and famously powerful, nut-cracking beak. Cockatoos are among the most food-motivated and trainable of all birds, but also among the most emotionally demanding, notorious for close, sometimes possessive bonds with a single handler.

The cockatoo family is very adaptable, ranging from dense rainforest to sparse woodland, farmland, and even arid scrubland.
A fertilized cockatoo egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a chick. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
An unfertilized cockatoo egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
A bundle of seeds for cocoa bush. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

The edible fruit of the coconut palm. Coconut flesh is high in fat and can be dried or eaten fresh or processed into coconut milk or coconut oil. The liquid of the nut, known as coconut water, is used in beverages.
A steel can of coffee.

A liquor that combines the bold, roasted essence of coffee with a smooth, alcoholic base. It is typically made by infusing roasted coffee beans in a distilled spirit, often with added sweetness and spices, creating a rich, bittersweet flavor.
