A white coffee mug.
A black coffee mug.
A bundle of seeds for coffee plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A cheap and easy to build coffin. It is not the most glorious resting place, but it is leagues above simply rotting in a dirt hole.

A slim neuro-cascade module lined with mnemonic pulse coils and echo-field dampers that cycle through soft, rhythmic memory stabilization waves. Its internal neurogel reservoir circulates thought-restorative pulses that soothe post-archite neural disruption.

Reduces the duration of the injection coma by 1 day when linked to an archogen injector.. Up to 6 cognitive recovery arrays can link to a single archogen injector.
A close-fitting and lightly padded coif often worn beneath mail or a helmet, or on its own for warmth in cold weather.

A powerful single-shot coilgun. Magnetically charged coils accelerate a metallic sabot to high speeds, turning it into a deadly and accurate long-range projectile that pierces through armor and flesh.
Some dilapidated shelves.
a simple TV that place on a stand and use.
a simple TV that place on a stand and use.

A huge, floating gelatinous creature propelled by the hydrogen it collects from water and various plant matter. These squishy creatures wander the lands, aimlessly bouncing off objects in their path.

This aerofleet has somehow grown to extreme size. A small number of younger aerofleets seem to be attracted to it and follow it everywhere.

Colossal aerofleets produce a thick, gelatinous substance known as blue gel. This syrupy residue can be collected and refined into an energy-dense compound. The compound can be used to build powerful batteries and generators with the appropriate research.

A payload of colossal genetic material. Can be used at the genomorpher to create a growth cell of a hybrid animal. This tier 3 genome can only be used as primary genome.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Extreme increase in size, health, damage and market value at the cost of slower attack speed.

installed

The gigantic, graceful creature has somehow been improved even further, proving infallibly that there’s always a taller mountain. Significantly easier to train and with a more efficient digestive system, this creature is possibly how the thrumbo originally was when first bred in a lab before it got tainted through terraforming.

A perfect colossal animal, paragon of all similar animals with no needless junk genetic data. Besides the various improvements to the baseline animal’s abilities, this paragon makes for an excellent mount for caravans and can forcibly rush itself, getting faster and creating dust clouds that impede ranged attacks.

A deep indigo liquid. When the user drinks it, it induces a chemically controlled coma, significantly slowing down their metabolism. This state allows the body to conserve energy and potentially aid in healing processes under controlled conditions.
An object with ideoligious significance.

A companion to the light line of suits, the combat variant offers better protection and durability for frontline combat. While it is decent for surviving suppressing fire, it will still buckle against large calibers and high explosives.
An automatic gas regulated shotgun, which can be quickly fired thanks to a series of revolving magazines. Good range and a higher fire rate makes it very deadly.

A companion to the light line of suits, the combat variant offers better protection and durability for frontline combat. While it is decent for surviving suppressing fire, it will still buckle against large calibers and high explosives.

A heavy-duty suit of powered armor designed for combat in the vacuum of space. The multi-layered, reinforced plating offers superior protection against ballistic attacks compared to standard vacsuits. While neuro-memetic assistors partially mitigate the bulk, the suit still imposes a penalty on movement speed and manipulation, though less severe than the standard model.

A heavy-duty, reinforced helmet for the combat vacsuit. It features layered plasteel-weave armor, a built-in status computer, and superior protection. Efficiently recycling oxygen, it permits extended vacuum operation, though periodic repressurization is required.
A rustic comfy bed made up of silk embroidered covers and soft pillows.
A rustic comfy bed made up of silk embroidered covers and soft pillows. Double-wide bed that fits two people.
A rustic comfy bed made up of silk embroidered covers and soft pillows.
A rustic comfy bed made up of silk embroidered covers and soft pillows. Double-wide bed that fits two people.
A rustic comfy bed made up of silk embroidered covers and soft pillows.
A rustic comfy bed made up of silk embroidered covers and soft pillows. Double-wide bed that fits two people.

The pinnacle of mechanitor engineering, a monumental sarcophagus that embodies absolute power and technological majesty. Fusing mechlink and biosculpter technologies, it allows the enclosed user to command their legions from absolute safety. However, its true power lies within: a highly complex replica of a 'Cerebrex' brain is integrated into its core. This allows the casket to pierce atmospheric interference and connect directly to the global mechanoid network in orbit. By hijacking the processing power of these orbital systems, the mechanitor can broadcast their commands over colossal distances, controlling their mechs even when world tiles away.
A distinguished, brimmed hat adorned with a badge of bravery, meant to inspire cooperation in one's subordinates at any cost.

A set of implanted vibrational speakers and throat mic allowing for short range remote communication between users. Variants of this implant are commonly found among the civilian and military populations of innumerable worlds of varying tech levels.

This implant allows users to socially interact with each other from anywhere on the local map.

A space-efficient, gravship-powered biofuel refinery designed for use aboard gravships. Despite its smaller frame, it refines biological matter like wood or plant matter into chemfuel. It draws power directly from the grav engine.

A miniaturized version of the biosculpter pod, designed to fit within the confined spaces of a gravship. It performs a variety of biological alterations including age reversal and pleasure-giving. The pod biotunes to its user at the end of a cycle. While biotuned, it cannot be used by anyone else, but cycles will complete 25% more quickly. Biotuning resets if the pod is unused for 80 days. It draws power directly from the grav engine.

A space-efficient, gravship-powered drug lab designed for use aboard gravships. Despite its smaller frame, it’s equipped with containers, heaters, and measurement devices for producing various drugs. It draws power directly from the grav engine.

A space-efficient, gravship-powered fabrication bench designed for use aboard gravships. Despite its smaller frame, it’s equipped with advanced tools for producing technological marvels from simpler materials. It draws power directly from the grav engine.

A miniaturized version of the gene bank, designed to fit within the confined spaces of a gravship. It stores genepacks and makes them usable for creating new xenogerms when placed near a gene assembler. It draws power directly from the grav engine and prevents genepacks from deteriorating while slowly repairing deterioration.

A space-efficient, gravship-powered machining table designed for use aboard gravships. Despite its smaller frame, it’s ideal for assembling machinery like guns and ammunition, or breaking down dead mechanoids. It draws power directly from the grav engine.

A miniaturized version of the multi-analyzer, designed to work aboard a gravship. While taking up less space, it performs the same essential function: increasing research speed when placed near a high-tech research bench and unlocking advanced projects. Each bench can only benefit from one multi-analyzer. It draws power directly from the grav engine.

A space-efficient, gravship-powered neural editor designed for use aboard gravships. It connects to a neural matrix and allows the user to modify neural stacks and perform other complex tasks, such as resetting biocoding.

A miniaturized version of the high-tech research bench, designed to fit within the confined spaces of a gravship. Despite its compact size, it features the same computers and electronic equipment, providing the same research capabilities and unlocking advanced projects as its larger counterpart. It draws power directly from the grav engine.

A space-efficient, gravship-powered smithy designed for use aboard gravships. Despite its smaller frame, it can be used to smith non-mechanical weapons and tools, as well as extract usable metal from slag chunks. It draws power directly from the grav engine.

A space-efficient, gravship-powered stove designed for use aboard gravships. Despite its smaller frame, it contains a high-efficiency cooktop and integrated prep surface, as well as a butchering slate. It draws power directly from the grav engine.

A space-efficient, gravship-powered tailor bench designed for use aboard gravships. Despite its smaller frame, this workbench comes with a sewing machine for rapid tailoring of clothes. It draws power directly from the grav engine.

A dryad caste specialized in general protection and utility for the gauranlenkins. Companion dryads are strong, fierce and loyal, and will accompany their mother wherever they are needed. They can clean, haul, fight and carry packs in caravans.

In general, dryads are mammal-like creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. They reproduce together with their tree, which contains a hidden dryad queen. Dryads can morph into various specialized castes.

A tall stabilization unit filled with layered geno-harmonic plates and oscillating phase regulators that smooth out chaotic complexity spikes within the archite stream. Its internal synchronizer cores emit low rhythmic pulses as they bring tangled genetic pathways into orderly alignment.

Prevents genetic complexity from reducing success chance, but each point of complexity will increase the injection procedure duration by 1 hour.

Up to 1 complexity harmonizer can link to a single archogen injector.
A cylindrical barrel for general storage. Items stored in this will not affect room beauty and they won't deteriorate, even if outside.

Four bulletproof plates firmly protect the dress. Use four fourth level PE plates for protection, keeping its weight within an acceptable range. Due to being too bulky, flak vests cannot be worn anymore. Integrated with some tactical vest features, providing a bulletproof level of power armor.

Combat clothing made of aramid material, when paired with a composite bulletproof vest, offers the benefits of lightweight mobility and significant protection. This type of attire was frequently worn by ancient soldiers.

This hybrid humanoid / insectoid eye provides improved vision in a wide range of different wavelengths, including those usually outside the human range, completely modifying the way the subject perceives their surroundings.
A mixture of condensed ashes, toxins and most importantly, scarlet mechanites. The resource is worthless on its own, but can be processed further for the valuable byproduct.
A platform meant to intercept and hold compressed scarlet sludge from refineries.
An ancient computer case.

A compact automatic autocannon turret equipped with retractable armor plating and a submersion mechanism. It only takes half as much damage when submerged. Requires steel to refurbish its barrels after heavy use. May explode when damaged.

A compact automatic charge turret equipped with retractable armor plating and a submersion mechanism. It only takes half as much damage when submerged. Requires plasteel to refurbish its barrels after heavy use. May explode when damaged.

A compact automatic flamethrower turret equipped with retractable armor plating and a submersion mechanism. It only takes half as much damage when submerged. Requires chemfuel to attack. May explode when damaged.

A compact automatic shotgun turret equipped with retractable armor plating and a submersion mechanism. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.

A compact automatic turret equipped with retractable armor plating and a submersion mechanism. It is capable of submerging into the ground, becoming impossible to target. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.
Concrete barriers marked with warning signs

Sturdy, utilitarian cement blocks for crafting any sort of infrastructure. While not as durable as granite or as gorgeous as marble, it is a clear improvement over weaker materials such as slate or sandstone.
A strong hollow cylinder meant for transporting fluids and flowing solids. Strong pipes are the ideal solution for moving heavier resources, thicker fluids and highly reactive chemicals.

A thick, sweetened dairy product made by reducing milk, commonly used in desserts, baking, or as a long-lasting ingredient for various recipes.

a suitable home computer. Do not expect too much from this computer.

A powered construction emitter that focuses local gravitic fields into four amber constructor beams. With one colonist at the console, it can remotely finish frames whose materials have already been delivered, repair damaged structures, and carry packaged buildings to their install sites — all without anyone walking over.

A high-tech work-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm replacement. This model is equipped with a variety of retractable multi-purpose tools and measuring equipment that greatly speed up repair and construction efforts. A compact support system makes it easy and comfortable to carry around.

An advanced brain implant designed to assist the user in construction-related tasks and act as a digital encyclopedia on that particular subject. The subpersona can quickly analyze and measure different materials without the need for specialized tools.

A brain implant of such complexity requires time to synchronize with and adapt to its host in order to avoid excessive strain on the central nervous system, its effectiveness will slowly increase during this process. It's capable of syncing with other enhancements made to assist in similar tasks, greatly increasing efficiency.
Impact-exploding fragmentation grenades. Small rounded bombs covered in triggers which make the payload ignite as soon as collision happens, if the pin is pulled.

Self-assembling machinery that fuses with the specimen’s nerve centers during the growth process. Effectively allows hybrids to be drafted but increases the chance of failure due to introduction of invasive foreign material.
A simple staff used for rituals and conversion. Greatly boosts conversion power and spread factor. This staff is not great for fighting.

An industrial-grade furnace designed for the automated destruction of unwanted items, especially corpses and tainted apparel, using extreme heat.

Factory buildings need factory hoppers for input and output. They produce significant heat and consume much power, but can be overclocked for higher efficiency, increasing both heat generation and power consumption.

An industrial oven for the automated mass-production of simple, shelf-stable, and packaged meals.

Factory buildings need factory hoppers for input and output. They produce significant heat and consume much power, but can be overclocked for higher efficiency, increasing both heat generation and power consumption.
A table full of useful cooking equipment. Increases work speed when placed near a rustic cooking table.

A high-tech device that can be installed into a lung or any compatible artificial lung replacement. This particular model is able to remove excess heat from the body when it's in an uncomfortably or dangerously warm environment.
An auxiliary interface that allows a copilot to assist in launching and piloting a gravship. It draws power directly from the grav engine.

Dried chunks of cordax resin. A viscous slurry of organic compounds, this nectar-like liquid is used by the carnivorous Keening Cordax plant to trap insects. It is extremely sticky and can be used as a very efficient sealant.
The core sample drill allows you to acquire standard rock types not usually present in a particular biome. It needs to drill pretty deep to do so, and thus it costs quite a lot to build.
Historically used for cattle herding, Corgis quickly became popular on imperial worlds and are recognized as a symbol of royalty.
A bundle of seeds for corn plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

A corpse fridge that can keep up to 12 corpses frozen.

It does not work well in temperatures above 100°C.
Pirates have to use everything to get rum, this invention turns corpses into delicious rum!

A stone bas relief of corsair imagery for decorating a floor.
A workbench for tailoring costumes by hand.
Harvested soft fluffy cotton, which can be spun into cloth.

A white two-seater sofa.
Its ergonomic design fits the body perfectly, offering comfortable seating even for long periods.
Ideal for a luxurious recreation room or a cozy reading corner.
Partially colorable.
These raw hides and pelts were removed from a creature, and with the right skills and tools, could be processed into tanned leather.

Trophies for the accomplished hunter, animal rugs are formed from stained and stuffed animal hides sewed to felt and padding to form rugs. Cougars are prized for their luxurious pelts, which in turn makes for a valuable alternative to basic rugs.
People eat off tables when chairs are placed facing them.
A posh dress for posh ladies.
A clay pot designed for storing various items. Items stored inside do not affect the beauty of their surroundings.
A praire wolf native to desert and shrubland areas. It's capable of hunting much bigger prey, and is often found in packs, similar to a wolf.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.

A compact support system makes it easy and comfortable to carry around.
A simple bench stocked with equally simple tools meant to assist in the crafting of primitive goods and weapons.
Blocks of solid cragstone.

A large, long legged bird species, cranes are a symbol of royalty and nobility and often populate royal gardens. It is believed that people of imperial rank will appreciate having plenty of cranes around them.

Raw crayfish. Crayfish are freshwater crustaceans resembling small lobsters (to which they are related). Some species are found in brooks and streams, where fresh water is running, while others thrive in swamps, ditches, and paddy fields.

This is an adept catch that is caught in addition to other fish.

A very large peaceful herbivore that originated from a mysterious rimworld orbiting a very faint star, perpetually covered in darkness. This was the home planet of an elusive race known as the forsaken, and crepuscular beetles were often used as domesticated beasts of burden.

Crepuscular beetles are active during dusk and don't need a lot of rest, expending much less time than other creatures to replenish their energy.
A fertilized crepuscular beetle egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby crepuscular beetle. It can be eaten raw or cooked, but it's a beetle egg, so it's disgusting either way...
An unfertilized crepuscular beetle egg. It can be eaten raw or cooked, but it's a beetle egg, so it's disgusting either way...

A generally harmless iguanian lizard that feeds on vegetation and small arthropods. They are unusually intelligent and can be kept as pets.

When the crescendo anole becomes aggressive in any way, usually in self defense, an unstable cocktail of growth hormones and biomechanical mechanites causes a runaway growth of the creature's cells, turning it into a hulking crocodilian nightmare. This effect is temporary, lasting a few hours, and afterwards the anole must recover its strength to be able to go through it again, becoming extremely hungry in the interim.
A fertilized crescendo anole egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby crescendo anole. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
An unfertilized crescendo anole egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
A compact double-tiered bed designed for gravship use. Maximizes limited space by allowing two crew members to rest in the footprint of one bed.
A set of compact lockers designed for gravship crew quarters. Provides a small comfort bonus to all nearby bunk beds. Placing more than one locker near the same bed has no effect.
A cozy bed with safe latticed sides, perfect for a sleepy baby. A high quality crib will make a baby happy. Multiple cribs can be placed in a bedroom without turning it into a barracks.
A faintly glowing, red bulb. It contains strong bio-chemical polymer agents that are vital for the production of advanced medicines.
A bundle of seeds for crimson bulb. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
Raw meat from a manchicken. Unbelievably tasty, and unbelievably unethical. Light, nutritive and with no poisoning chance.

A dossier containing critical information about the Shattered Empire. In order to protect the information from the Imperial counterintelligence, the information needs to be stored in a physical form. It can be used to plan high-profile assassination attempts, but it can also be exchanged into standard intel via the contraband system.

A large semi-aquatic reptile, most often found on the river banks. It's predatory insticts combined with an extremely strong jaw allow them to tackle much larger prey. Older crocodiles can grow to monstrous sizes.
A fertilized crocodile egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a crocodile. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
An unfertilized crocodile egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.

A rather muscular hybrid with an impressively long snout, this ravenous reptile combines adaptability with mobility. Unusually, its terrifyingly long maw filled with curved teeth is not used to tear flesh to eat but to imbue toxins and the required muscles to spray those toxins out. This means they have to eat a lot more due to their subpar digestive system and their favourite activities include lounging in the sun and moving with disturbing quickness when the dinner bell is sounded. Also it… kinda looks like a weird shoe if you look at it, but, uh, don’t put your foot in there.

An equine hybrid with recessive reptile genes. A rather slow hybrid for its category, its main advantage is that it is very durable and it has a ranged toxic breath attack. Quite durable and comfortable in a wide range of temperatures, they present a hidden danger for those foolish enough to attack an otherwise easy target.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All equine hybrids are good for caravaning. A caravan with one of them needs a shorter resting period, only stopping to rest between 23:30 PM and 4 AM.

A super-heavy suit of bulky powered armor, built for the most protection at the cost of agility. Layers on layers of plasteel-coated uranium plating offer unmatched protection against both ranged and melee attacks. Heat-scattering shields strategically welded onto weakpoints protect against beam weapons and radiation. To help with the immense weight of the suit, ancient-pattern neuro-memetic assistors and hydraulic components aid in holding up the armor.

This armor was one of the first patterns of power armor engineered by man, and remains one of the most protective models to use due to the reliable armoring and analog controls.

A pair of ultraheavy power armor gauntlets, with fingers to elbow covered by reinforced plasteel plating capable of deflecting even the most grievous attacks.

Numerous neuro-memetic assistors manage to provide the wearer unimpeded use of their hands. Additionally, the considerable weight of the gauntlets add weight to the wearer's melee strikes, as well as acting as a natural recoil buffer.

An excessively armored powered helmet, with a large bulletproof pane of plasteel-glass for full vision. Various plasteel-coated uranium plates protect against concussions or bullets, while a built in life-support system allows the wearer to survive in environments without oxygen.  Built in spring-suspensions around the neck aid in wearing the helmet and lowering the impact of projectiles.

A pair of ultraheavy power armor boots, laden with reinforced plasteel plates that are capable of stopping even the largest projectiles in their tracks.

Numerous servomotors allow the wearer to move unimpeded, while hydraulics inside the boots provide additional stability and carry capacity.
A weapon that fires frozen pellets or liquid nitrogen, rapidly lowering the temperature of the target to freeze or immobilize it. Frostbite damage bypasses armor.

A glittertech heart replacement that renders the user’s blood mutated and fire‑immune. It protects all body cells and the skin from ignition, but it also lowers antibody counts and compromises the immune system, reducing blood filtration efficiency.

While it can save lives during short-term fire exposure, it becomes highly unstable and harmful after prolonged extreme temperatures exposure.

A high-tech device that can be installed into any compatible artificial spine replacement. This particular module is capable of producing immense amounts of a cryogenic microgas and trapping it in a bubble-like barrier it projects around its host, slowly freezing everything within its range. While the user is safe from being directly affected by the implant when it's active, it will harm both enemies and allies that do not possess sufficient protection.

A high-tech animal implant that can be installed onto the spine or any compatible artificial spine replacement. This particular module comes with a set of advanced artificial micro-organs that produce a cryogenic venom-like substance that has a high likelihood of causing hypothermia in any being it comes in contact with. The substance gathers around the body parts that its host uses for combat, allowing it to be injected into or launched at its target with each bite, scratch or strike.

A high-tech device that can be installed into any compatible artificial limb or spine replacement. This particular model, upon detecting an attack on the user, sends out a directional burst of cryogenic micro-gas toward the attacker through the module's vent-like openings. Due to its limited effective range it is most potent in close-quarters combat, especially against assailants within melee range.

Low-powered plasteel carapace armor draped with an unknown but impossibly durable cloth sash affixed over one shoulder, the armor emits a low electrical hum and feels smooth to the touch. The power supply itself features embedded cryptocasket technology and will use a stasis effect to slow one's bleeding.

A lower-powered helmet with an unknown but impossibly durable cloth hood. It's theorized that either a long-lost or far-advanced civilizations scout troopers would adorn this helmet before recon missions during the mechanoid wars. The helmet itself features embedded cryptocasket technology and will use a stasis effect to slow ones bleeding.

A high-tech device that can be installed into any compatible spine replacement. This particular module consists of a drone-like turret platform suspended mid-air, powered entirely by a gravcore and a chip-like implant that keeps the floating construct anchored to its user. While no outside input of fuel or energy is necessary for it to function, it does require time to self-recharge and for that reason the user is tasked with deciding when to activate it. This specific gravdrone is equipped with an advanced cryptostinger turret which, while lightweight, consumes more energy than other models of similar size, which reduces the amount of time it can remain active.

A heavy, high-tech axe with a cryogenic-coated edge that delivers crushing strikes. On impact, it inflicts deep frostburns, flash-freezing flesh and lacing wounds with cryptofreeze, slowing movement and dealing substantial hypothermic damage over time.

A high-tech crossbow rifle that fires cryogenic-coated bolts with devastating impact. On penetration, the bolts inflict deep frostburns, flash-freezing flesh and lacing wounds with cryptofreeze, drastically slowing movement and causing severe hypothermic damage over time.
A high-tech, advanced model of coagulator incorperating embedded cryptocasket technology that uses a stasis effect in response to blood loss to slow one's bleeding.
An array of advanced pumps and artificial glands placed throughout the body, designed to rapidly tune metabolic levels to normal rates after exiting cryptobiotic stasis.
Raw Crystal Horn. Only partially organic: part of its structure is clearly crystalline. Edible, but uncomfortably crunchy.

A heavily modified medium-sized wild cat, the crystalline caracal can be seen lazying around in the sun, recharging its internal energy. It can later use this stored energy to release a powerful blast of concentrated light. Typically nocturnal, they are highly secretive, territorial, and difficult to observe.

Contrary to other purely photosynthetic creatures, they can also hunt small prey, and it needs both kinds of sustenance to survive.
Useful for building structures and weapons. It is a good fuel for campfires.

These brittle crystalline strands can be extracted from crystal flowers. Not flammable, but not strong at all. Internally, the are formed by a fine lattice of exotic crystals, creating a structure that is incredibly good at maintaining a constant temperature.

A pebblemit that has been genetically modified to feed on minerals. Crystalmits have a partly silicon-based biology, so they can derive sustenance from eating scattered rocks.

Crystalmits were created as a quick way of removing rock rubble from mining operations, but wild ones may prove to be a nuisance for colonies who'd rather use rocks for something useful.

Iä! Iä! Cthrumbo fhtagn! Ph'nglui mglw'nfah Cthrumbo Rimworld wgah'nagl fhtagn! A gigantic, squid-like creature that feeds on fear and nightmares. <color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All colossal hybrids have very slow attacks, but hit very hard, and possess natural armor. Invoke hell blast: twice a day, the Cthrumbo can fire a devastating hellsphere blast.

A thick, padded hood favored by cultists, offering insulation and minor blunt protection. Its sturdy design provides decent head protection on its own.
A medieval game of luck. Played with a leather cup and some dice.

An unwieldy, multi-barrel machine gun. Once the barrels spin up, it fires very fast. While most self-loading guns are powered by the gunpowder energy, minigun uses an electric motor to rapidly cycle cartridges through the weapon. 

It comes equipped with a separate, overdrive engine that utilises bioferrite to greatly accelerate the rate of fire. The overdrive can be used two times before the minigun needs to be reloaded with bioferrite.

Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

A fabled legend amongst commonfolk, a gigantic deer with with a body of a bear... or was it a bear with the horns of the deer, nevertheless, its maws does not discriminate for when the beast hungers for prey.

A daer's caracass contain majestic antlers that can be recovered by butchering, as well as providing meat that gives a mood bonus.
A daers's antler. It's heavy, rock-hard, and priceless in most markets. This is a true trophy that brings awe to whoever beholds upon it.

The fabled leather of a daer, made from skinning one of the mighty beasts. That said, it is a heavy material to work with.

Where do you store your collection of silk Qipao that will make all eyes turn to you when you slip into them at an evening party? In this wardrobe, that's where. Its spacious interior can accommodate everything from the finest silks to the occasional secret agenda. It's perfect for those who believe that neatly folded and hung nicely is a fashion revolution.

Despite its infamous reputation, the beast is still hunted often, not only for their thick hide or ample supply of meat, but also by warrior societies as a rite of passage.

These deployable mechanite clouds can cover a huge region, blanketing it in darkness, and it is thought that the darkbeast was created as a terrorist weapon to attack settlements by depriving them of sunlight, affecting their agricultural yields. Darkbeasts have naturally evolved over the centuries making them extremely unstable and they will only release enough mechanites upon death. Predators usually give them a wide berth.
A Darklight Chemfuel Brazier. Will light the surroundings and create heat.

An industrial lamp which lights an area with Darklight enough to grow crops, but consumes a huge amount of chemfuel. It also has a slightly lower lighting radius. Automatically turns itself off at night.

A low-intelligent microcomputer that integrates seamlessly with the user's visual cortex, automatically adjusting the incoming light to a darklight spectrum.  This ensures that users who are accustomed to darklight conditions can venture into brightly lit areas without discomfort or visual impairment.

A sepulchral statue holding a specifically treated brazier in its hands to cast a darklight upon sacred grounds. Will light the surroundings and create heat.
A non-lethal air gun used to reduce irritability or agitation in animals or humans via anesthetic drugs commonly referred to as tranquilizers.
Increases research speed when placed near a research bench. One research bench can use only one data server.

A portable electronic device resembling a tablet, commonly used in science fiction settings. It serves as a versatile tool for data storage, communication, and information retrieval. Featuring a touchscreen interface and wireless connectivity, the datapad allows users to access databases, analyze data, send messages, and perform various tasks on-the-go. With its compact design and advanced functionality, it is an indispensable tool for scientists, engineers, and spacefarers navigating futuristic environments.
Raw dates. Nice to eat, even when raw. They are sweet, nutrient-rich fruit harvested from date palms. They keep well in warm climates and provide a reliable source of energy.
A bundle of seeds for daylily. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

A high-tech device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. This particular module is capable of producing a cloud of deadlife dust around its user by releasing a concoction of volatile chemicals and dormant archites through vent-like openings. Syncing with other modules of the same model allows it to work with greater efficiency.

An implant that makes the user far stronger as a shambler, and revives them as one upon death. The implant consists of a strange archo-organ surrounded by twisting bioferrite pipes and uses an archotech shard at it's core to maintain and supercharge any deadlife archites present in the user’s body.

A high-tech device that can be installed into any compatible artificial lung replacement. This particular module produces and mixes specialized chemicals that can be sent through the airways and launched out of the mouth or nose. The resulting chemical reaction activates the dormant archites stored in the module and creates a wave of deadlife dust. Syncing with other modules of the same model allows it to work with greater efficiency.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. This particular module comes with a compact storage and launch system for deploying deadlife IED traps from a distance. The implant needs to be loaded with deadlife shells in order to function.

A bioferrite power claw that can be surgically installed on a ghoul, granting it a powerful attack. Each of the nerve shredder's jagged digits contain a resevoir of deadlife dust filled fluid that, while not inherently harmful, will raise anyone killed with it as a shambler allied to the ghoul. These clawed hands are harder to hold things with.

Due to the extremely painful nature of the prosthetic, only ghouls can tolerate this enhancement.
A chest implant for preventing enemy use of captured equipment and bionic. Upon the user's death, it releases powerful chemicals that dissolve the user. Sometimes used to prevent being captured.
A bundle of seeds for deathbell. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

An artificial secondary vascular system that unseals during deathrest, vastly improving the rate of hemogenic circulation and deathrest regeneration.

Can only be installed on pawns with the deathrest gene.

Releases a constant supply of saguine chemicals and specialised mechanites that slow down deathrest degredation.

Can only be installed on pawns with the deathrest gene.
An usually large and vicious wasp, hunting prey in a collective swarm. Its thick shell and deadly stinger makes them dangerous when fighting. A eusocial creature, it cannot reproduce individually.

A large, winged flightless lizard that inhabit places with abundant vegetation. Decay drakes release a nauseous cocktail of volatile pheromones that quickly accelerates the rotting process of plants, turning vegetation around them into mounds of fermented organic matter. They will consume these and usually get incredibly drunk in the process. They have four separate livers in order to process the huge amounts of alcohol.

They aren't easy to domesticate, but if they can be coerced to accept humans, they might be useful hunting companions, especially if provided with alcohol. Humans have been known to consume the rotting vegetation they generate in desperate times, but most people would rather starve.
A nice decoration to put inside or outside building.

Fish tenderized then filleted, then rolled in a thick batter before being submerged in hot oil and fried. The end result is a crunchy, unhealthy yet tasty soul food - Not quite as filling as a meal, but very pleasing to eat. Deep frying meats in this matter reduces shelf life as well unless frozen

Sushi is one of the healthiest foods about. So sooner or later someone was going to deep fry it and make it the opposite. The end result is a crunchy, unhealthy yet tasty soul food - Not quite as filling as a meal, but very pleasing to eat. Deep frying sushi reduces shelf life as well unless frozen.

Vegetables julienned then patted dry before being dunked into hot oil until golden brown. As crispy and pleasing as they are, these deep fried treats are not as filling as a normal meal, nor as healthy. Deep frying vegetables in this matter reduces shelf life as well unless frozen.

A deep fryer is a kitchen appliance used for deep frying. Deep frying is a method of cooking by submerging food into oil at high heat, typically between temperatures of 350 °F and 375 °F (175 °C to 190 °C).

Desert Aves are amazing mounts, much faster than horses. If properly trained, they can be ridden into battle at incredible speeds.

Originally an elaborate suit of prestige armor, this has been modified to make greater use of eltex weave in order to improve the performance of psycasters. This comes at a cost of removing interfering armor plating, but enhances psychic sensitivity and neural heat dissipation.

The amount of intel received is determined by the rank of the noble person. The person affected by a Deserter Declassifier dies in the process, and when used on neutral visitors, it is treated as an act of war.

A heavily-armored high-tech helmet, with a solid plasteel-weave shell and indirect visual system for non-frontal view angles. It protects against all but the most powerful or luckily-aimed shots.

Originally a standard cataphract helmet, this has been modified to include a gunlink at the cost of removing the faceplate, sacrificing defense to improve offensive capabilities.

Can be crafted in drug lab.

Diseases that can be sampled are listed below.
I was told by the customer to engineer them with as big a head as possible. I did exactly what I was told. (Project:
, attempt 412)

A synthetic mixture of protein, carbohydrates, and vitamins, amino acids and minerals. Everything the body needs, and absolutely disgusting. This paste is even worse than the paste produced by a nutrient paste dispenser and people will hate eating it. It is cheap, though!

It is completely indigestible for herbivores.
A large turret that rapidly fires powerful lasers with a low chance to ignite.

Plastic tubes filled with bioferrite. On impact, the flare burns, creating a bright flash and a local psychic disruption. This stuns psychically sensitive creatures, revealing those that are invisible, and reducing their consciousness and movement speed for a short while. Afterwards, the flare continues to burn, lighting up a wide area for some time.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial leg replacement. This particular model includes a disruptor flare dispenser which can be used similarly to a standard grenade belt or its contents can be launched directly from it with a swift leg motion. It is relatively small and well-hidden, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks. Needs to be reloaded with bioferrite after use.
A semi-automatic marksman rifle commonly used for hunting or protecting fields. It has a scope which enables a longer range and good precision, but it must be fired slower to not lose accuracy.

A vital piece of archotechnology that is part of the process in creating an Archocentipede.

This machine is able to extract genetic material from live hybrids and stores it for later use, preventing deterioration. Depending on the base Genoframe, the amount of viable genetic material extracted will vary.

Each storage bank can only store the genetic material from a single animal branch, such as ursine or feline. Inserting a hybrid into the database yields half as much valuable data compared to a paragon. DNA storage banks need to be in line of sight of the archocentipede former to connect to it properly.

Detailed yields for paragons (half for hybrids):

Awful quality: yields 1%
Poor quality: yields 3%

Sanitary clothing worn by surgeons, nurses and other workers involved in patient care. They are designed to be simple, easy to launder and cheap to replace if damaged or stained.
There are many maps in it.

Meticulously crafted accessory tailored to meet the demands of scholars, academics, and professionals engaged in comprehensive research endeavors. Constructed from durable and high-quality materials, such as leather or nylon, it features a sophisticated yet functional design optimized for the organization, protection, and transport of research materials. This includes academic papers, reference books, journals, electronic devices, and writing implements.

A flightless bird rendered extinct at the hands of ancient humans, they have been portrayed as fat, clumsy creatures but were actually well-adapted to their ecosystem. Their last home was the forests along the dry coastal areas of an isolated island, and their diet consisted mostly of fruit which was digested with the help of gizzard stones.

Dodos were one of the first widely-known animals to have been brought to extinction solely by the influence of humans on Terra, and were flightless because of many centuries living without predators, laying only a single egg for their clutches. They prefer warmer climates with plentiful berry bushes and their only means of defense is their considerably large beak.
A fertilized dodo egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a dodo. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
An unfertilized dodo egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.

This armoured rodent is an hybrid of a raccoon and a Doedicurus. The Doedicoon breeds fast, and its armor can be useful in the frontlines.

Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest known glyptodont. Its huge carapace is nearly unbreakable to any predator.

Man’s best friend who is also himself? Have you ever thought that the folds on a dog’s skin can act almost as pockets? What if those folds held a knife and the dog could wield it? Well look no further, as this pup will answer those questions with violence.

A canine hybrid with recessive humanoid genes. A smart hybrid capable of holding conversations with their technical superiors and will sometimes obey commands to slaughter other tamed colony animals.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Humanoid hybrids will periodically engage other colonists in conversation, talking about a variety of topics. This increases the social recreation needs of those they interact with by 10% (subject to diminishing returns like all joy types). If using Ideology, humanoid hybrids are subject to precepts. Dogmen will periodically obey commands to slaughter other colony (tamed) animals.
A lace doily.

A reinforced spear imbued with Dominus-derived psychic circuitry. Allows the wielder to challenge a single opponent into a psychic duel, creating a focused maelstrom that amplifies attacks within. The spear channels the wielder’s will, projecting a shield around the duel and enhancing damage output within the duel’s radius.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm replacement. This particular model includes a compact storage and deployment apparatus for doomsday rocket launchers. After firing, what remains of the launcher is safely ejected and a replacement one can be loaded. Due to its small size and low weight, the wielder can carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

A smooth slope that never hinders passage.
Fits naturally when placed just beneath a door.

Slightly improves room beauty, but has no other effects.

Dragoon armor is less protective than standard chrysalis armor, but next-gen neuro-memetic assistors allow for improved mobility and easy flanking of hostile forces on the battlefield. 

Includes a package of pain inhibitors to ensure the wearer can fulfil their objective until their dying breath.
A variant of the chrysalis armor helmet with a simple classifier AI, to analyze terrain composition and guide the user, effectively eliminating terrain movement penalties.

A mostly harmless, cat-sized lepidopteran with brightly coloured wings. Drainers were originally blue morpho butterflies that mutated due to exposure to high levels of radiation in one of the many toxic worlds that exist. Though they can feed on grass if there is no other food available, they are actually electrovores, feeding on any available source of electricity.

Drainers undergo metamorphosis like most other lepidopterans, though their larval stage is pretty short, and doesn't have the energy draining abilities of the adults.

The user can unbind the functions of the core, causing new flesh to sprout in place of their wounds. However, if used too frequently, there's a chance of the regeneration going rampant, incapacitating the user as huge masses of flesh sprout from their body, becoming fleshbeasts.
A chunk of dark archotechnology salvaged from the remains of a dreadmeld. Fetid flesh slowly oozes from it's lattice of black metal. Meat seems to writhe and blister in it's presence.

A near-intelligent microcomputer which automatically analyses new memories when the user is asleep. It will boost positive memories, making them last longer, while trying to suppress negative ones. As a positive side effect, the user will always experience pleasant dreams.

A portable, manually-operated tool used for drilling holes in various materials such as wood, metal, and plastic. Consisting of a handle, a chuck to hold drill bits, and a rotating mechanism, the hand drill allows users to exert controlled force to create precise holes without the need for electricity. Versatile and convenient, it's an essential tool for woodworking, DIY projects, and tasks where mobility and simplicity are valued.

A high-tech work-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm replacement. This model features a retractable drill which can act as both a useful tool and a deadly, albeit odd weapon. A compact support system makes it easy and comfortable to carry around.

A versatile drilling assistant pad designed to enhance stability and precision during drilling tasks. Its ergonomic design offers comfort and control, reducing fatigue and improving efficiency. Compatible with various drills, it provides a reliable foundation for accurate drilling, suitable for both professionals and DIY enthusiasts alike.
A heavy box loaded with beer, spirits, and other beverages.

A dense, self-contained fusion of computation and power storage, designed to serve as the central processing unit for a drone. It houses the drone's core logic, operational parameters, and a hidden library of factory-loaded schematics.

Decrypting the core's data logs at a research bench can unlock schematics for a new type of drone, allowing its construction.
A small antenna mast that establishes a local drone network, enabling nearby drones to operate within its transmission radius.

An advanced pharmaceutical processor for the mass-production of basic medical supplies and drug batches from raw materials. It efficiently grinds, synthesizes, and packages items like medicine, psychite drugs, and smokeleaf joints.

Factory buildings need factory hoppers for input and output. They produce significant heat and consume much power, but can be overclocked for higher efficiency, increasing both heat generation and power consumption.
A secure container holding a mix of recreational and combat drugs.
A drum that can hold up to 3 stacks of various items.
A large wooden drum that is reinforced to support multiple people sitting on top of it. However, this slightly impairs its musicality.
A large wooden drum that is reinforced to support a person sitting on top of it. However, this slightly impairs its musicality.
A small nest of logs and twigs created by the awakened woodmaker dryad. Animals can sleep in it, but it can also be deconstructed for precious building materials.
A roll of DuctTape.
Compact weights for versatile strength training. They help target specific muscle groups.

A mutant variation of the feralisk that has adapted to extremely hot climates. Dunealisks attack by throwing huge webs at their prey. These webs both stun and burn anything they touch, allowing them to close in and finish the kill with their fearsome venom laced fangs.

This dunealisk is larger than usual, and is carrying a clutch of eggs on its back. This sounds like a recipe for disaster if not dealt with quickly.
A fertilized dunealisk egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby dunealisk. It can be eaten raw or cooked, but it's a spider egg, so it's disgusting either way...

A medium-sized bioengineered insectoid the size of a goat. The durapod is the lowest caste of the Xanides geneline, taking care of most work tasks. Its extremely thick rock carapace makes it very slow but also very durable, but excessive damage will chip away the armor exposing the weak spots.
An advanced textile, stronger and more resilient than traditional cloth, offering enhanced durability for crafting while maintaining versatility.

A result of failed animal weaponization trials, it is an ideal killing machine, built and modified to satisfy the requirements of fast-paced warfare. The fierce nature of the night prowler is reinforced further by the muscular protrusions on their back, which simultaneously act as both accelerators and as weapons.

Their capability to overrun even the most well defended military facilities resulted in the systematic purge that was commissioned by some intergalactic federations centuries ago, in hopes of driving the prowlers to extinction. Thus, very few prowler sightings are reported nowadays.

A widely-hated rodent known for soiling kitchens and spreading disease, rats have a way of following humans everywhere they go. It eats almost anything and lives almost anywhere.

This rat seems to be different from other rats. It is purely nocturnal and has four glowing eyes.

Raw dusky sprat. The dusky sprat is a nocturnal marine forage fish, although they can also be found in freshwater estuaries. Like most forage fishes, dusky sprats are highly active, small, oily fish. They travel in large schools with other fish and swim continuously throughout the night.
A hopper-like storage basin meant to input Dye into the network, filling up connected tanks.
A hopper-like storage basin meant to hold dispensed Dye from tanks periodically for use later.
Makeshift explosive sticks of chemfuel strapped to a belt. They can be thrown a short distance, where they will explode after a random amount of time. Can be reloaded using dynamite.

A massive raptor with a wingspan that can exceed two meters. They can be found across mountains, tundra, coastal cliffs, and open country.

Eagles have been flown by falconers since before mankind kept written records, and across myriad worlds those traditions continue today with hunters still partnering with trained eagles to pursue all manner of prey up to and including wolves and even wargs; often the falconer follows from a mount after sending their eagle out to immobilize prey, and the hunter comes in to strike the final blow. On glitterworlds and industrialized worlds special academies exist for the powerful and elite to learn these specialized skills. On medieval and primitive worlds these skills are passed down through generations by specially skilled handlers, often passing from parent to child as an honor among families.
A fertilized eagle egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a chick. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
An unfertilized eagle egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
A very strong and semi-sweet fruity tea. Floral notes dance around one's pallet at even the most dull scent. People who finish the drink feel strangely urged to colonize.
A full body jumpsuit made out of thick fabric or leather, used by the engineers of the earth empire.
A head protection used by the engineers of the earth empire.
A helmet used by the Earth Empire.
A lightly armored uniform used by the Earth Empire.
An upright easel, used to create paintings.
A simple woven reed surface used as a low table for eating.
A bundle of seeds for echeveria plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

A high-tech device that can be installed into an ear or any compatible ear replacement. This particular module is capable of gathering data through an echolocation-like process and sending it directly to the brain. It is then received in a form of a subconscious understanding of the surrounding area, including objects outside of one's field of view.

A slate-gray liquid that when drunk, enhances the user’s global work speed and reduces their energy depletion, allowing them to work faster and longer without feeling tired. However, the intense boost in productivity comes at a significant risk, increasing the chance of a heart attack due to the strain on the body. After the potion's effects diminish, the user experiences a sharp increase in the rate at which they become sleepy, necessitating immediate rest to recover.

A rich, creamy holiday drink made from milk, eggs, and sugar, often spiced with nutmeg. Eggnog is sweet and comforting, but its festive charm is enhanced when spiked with alcohol, leading to warmth—and potential overindulgence.
A bundle of seeds for eggplant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A bulbous purple fruit of the nightshade family. Eggplant is rarely served as a side, generally filling the role of the main component of the dish.

An advanced implant which allows a mechanitor to protect their mechanoids from harm through sheer force of will. This reduction to damage received is proportionate to the mechanitor's social skills.

This implant can be self-installed without surgery.

The Elasmobearium is a hybrid of a bear and the ancient ancestor of the rhinoceros. The Elasmobearium is a pretty aggressive omnivore, using its horn to impale its victims and then mauling them with their vicious paws.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All primary bear hybrids have stun attacks. Aside from obviously being a very powerful creature, they produce a wool of excellent quality.

Elasmosaurus used its long neck to get close to prey without them noticing. A swift flick of the neck could catch them unawares. Its long, narrow teeth were perfect for piercing and trapping small, soft prey. Scientific name: Elasmosaurus platyurus

Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest horned rhinoceros of all time. Elasmotherium uses its giant singular horn, placed on its forehead, to fight, attract mates, sweep snow, and dig in the ground in search of water and plant roots.
An elasmotherium's horn. Not nearly as deadly in human hands, but can still prove to be a relatively decent weapon.
Wool from an elasmotherium. The most exclusive kind of wool imaginable. It's as great for cold weather as it is beautiful.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm replacement. This particular module is nearly identical to a standard elbow blade implant in terms of functionality.

A simplified genome extraction device designed to be usable by even the most simple-minded goon, as such it resembles a caulking gun that works in reverse. The best genetic material can be found in the brain and the automated, single-use design instantly compresses this material into a usable genome.

The desired subject needs to be docile and trusting of the user who intends on scooping out their brain in a process that is not-quite instantaneous. It is recommended to anesthetize the creature as any sudden movement on their part will interrupt the whole process. Alternatively, it will also work on a dead body...

Jelly stored and used as food by oversized insects. It is smooth, rich, and brings incredible joy to those who consume it. This milk is purple coloured, and its smell is indescribable. It whispers to you...
A stone bas relief of eldritch imagery for decorating a floor.
A stone bas relief of eldritch imagery for decorating a floor.
This wood-like material has been extracted from the tentacles of an eldritch creature. Let's make a cupboard out of them!

A decorative lamp consisting of paper stretched over a wooden frame, inside which an electric light sits. A beautiful alternative to the standing lamp.
An electric oven designed for baking cookies, pastries, and cakes with reliable, consistent heat distribution for perfect results every time.
Produces a variable amount of heating units for radiators and hot water tanks. Manually controlled power setting. Can be controlled by thermostats.
An elaborate, artistic electrical standing lamp that lights an area. People need light to move and work at full speed.
A powered chair fitted with restraints and a wired helmet for electrocuting a captive.
A powered press that applies steady electric pressure to turn milk into cheese faster than a normal cheese press.
An electrically-powered all in one solution to grind, cure and shape concrete blocks.

An electric pot used to boil patchleather.

It is typically used to simmer soup over an extended period of time. Ingredients are submerged in water and left to cook over an extended period, allowing the flavors of the ingredients to gradually deepen and blend over time.

Soup on an unpowered electric pot will spoil extremely rapidly. Beware of solar flares!
Pumps water from wells to water towers. Pumping capacity: 1500 L/day.
A heater designed specifically for creating a sauna room, using a sauna regularly reduces the risk of heart attacks, heats a room to 60c.
An automatic bell used to signal the start of classes. More reliable than a regular bell, as it doesn't need to be rung manually.

Revolutionize the process of wool and fur harvesting by harnessing the power of electricity to enhance efficiency and productivity. A electrically-powered countertop with a kettle, spoons, and anything else needed for brewing tea.
A workbench with automated sorters and electric tools, used in recycling wastepacks into other resources. Can work without electricity at 50% of normal speed.

An assembly of somewhat conductive metal cords bundled inside a thick protective sheath. Electrical cables may be used for transmission of electrical power or signals over longer and more exposed distances.

This dress is gorgeous and graceful.

A psychic rifle of ultratech design. Through its array of sophisticated eltex lenses, the weapon is capable of magnifying psychic power into a concentrated bolt of energy that grows in power the more psychically sensitive the wielder is. However, the psionic nature of the projectiles is a double edged sword, with psychically dull enemies like mechanoids being able to reduce the damage to a minimum.

Each attack deals additional 5 damage that doesn't scale with psychic sensitivity.

A compact psychic firearm of ultratech design. Through its array of sophisticated eltex lenses, the weapon is capable of magnifying psychic power into a concentrated bolt of energy that grows in power the more psychically sensitive the wielder is. However, the psionic nature of the projectiles is a double edged sword, with psychically dull enemies like mechanoids being able to reduce the damage to a minimum.

Each attack deals additional 4 damage that doesn't scale with psychic sensitivity.

A psychic warmace of ultratech design. Using an array of sophisticated eltex lenses embedded in its handle, the weapon is able to magnify psychic power and project it into an energy field around its head that grows in power the more psychically sensitive the wielder is. However, the generated psychic field wanes when hitting psychically dull foes such as mechanoids due to psychic field dissonance between its wielder and target.

Each attack deals additional 7 damage that doesn't scale with psychic sensitivity.
A cleaver stuck to a surface. Can be placed on top of tables for decoration.
A hardy gemstone with a primarily green hue. The value brought by this crystal adds value to any ornament, be it a gem on a sword hilt or embellishment in a ring.
A set of dice of varying valuable gemstones; although small, each die is worth more than a pretty coin.
A shelf for storing miscellaneous items. Items stored in this will not affect room beauty and they won't deteriorate, even if outside.
This gold necklace, embedded with a pristine emerald, offers a significant increase of wealth to its wearer and is often seen on nobles and merchants.
This gold ring, embedded with a pristine emerald, offers a significant increase of wealth to its wearer and is often seen on nobles and merchants.

An emergency power source capable of fully powering a gravship by adjusting its output to match demand. It is designed to be kept for emergencies, as it will always cause a critical breakdown and an EMP detonation when it produces all the power it’s able to generate. It is capable of producing up to 50,000 W/d before it breaks down.

An implanted emergency vac barrier, An ultrasonic barrier that prevents depressurization in space. The field compresses air molecules near the threshold, preventing gases from escaping. The device can be activated while the pawn is down, though it can only hold a limited number of charges and will need refueling with chemfuel between uses.

A high-tech device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. This particular module is capable of producing an EMP blast around its user. While the host is shielded from the blast, any nearby allies or structures will be affected. Syncing with other modules of the same kind allows it to work with greater efficiency.
Install this in a pawn. When that pawn dies, all electronics nearby will be shut down. Useful for disabling turrets.
Electromagnetic pulse grenades damaging to electronic equipment strapped to a belt. They can be thrown a short distance, where they'll explode, disabling any electronics for a brief duration.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial leg replacement. This particular model includes an EMP grenade dispenser which can be used similarly to a standard grenade belt or its contents can be launched directly from it with a swift leg motion. It is relatively small and well-hidden, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm replacement. This particular model includes a modified EMP launcher that can be fully retracted outside of combat, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.
Automated EMP heavy machine gun mounted on a quadpod.

A full-body internal defense system designed to safeguard from electrical surges, such as those caused by EMP blasts, lightning strikes and electroshock weapons.  Upon detecting a surge, the system temporarily isolates and disables all bionic components to prevent permanent damage.  This emergency shutdown can briefly disrupt the user's motor functions and cognitive focus, leading to momentary disorientation and loss of task awareness.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. This particular module comes with a compact storage and launch system for deploying EMP IED traps from a distance. The implant needs to be loaded with EMP shells in order to function.

An incredibly rare and monstrously large insectoid of the Sorne geneline, the empress insectoid is incredibly effective at birthing offspring. Her specialized larval chambers allow her to spawn large swarms of swarmlings quickly. While she's not as dangerous in close quarters, the vast numbers of her offspring can easily swarm and overwhelm enemies. While all insectoids are almost equally terrifying, many who have seen the empress find the sight of her even more disturbing, as she embodies all that is wrong with genetic engineering. Upon death, it’s possible to extract a Sorne pherocore from her body.

A butterfly that originated from an extremely rare type of planet – a paradise glitterworld. These planets have reached an extreme level of technology, but their inhabitants are very psychically sensitive, using their technology to offset any impact they might have on the planet's ecosystem and thereby anima. The empress butterfly was engineered as the perfect pollinator. They gather pollen from genetically engineered plants that increase the fertility of the surrounding terrain and release it nearby.

Adult empress butterflies have strict dietary constraints, as they demand a very specific type of food - flowers from the plant known as pollen trumpet, a long-lived decorative plant that was created to be in symbiosis with the butterfly. If they can't find pollen trumpets nearby, they will resort to eating farm crops nearby.
A fertilized empress butterfly egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into an empress butterfly larva. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.

The empress butterfly was engineered as the perfect pollinator. They gather pollen from genetically engineered plants that increase the fertility of the surrounding terrain and release it nearby.

Larvae are small, slow, and practically useless but they have no special dietary constraints.

A neural implant built by an archotech which can store a human consciousness, commonly referred to as a neural. Once implanted directly into a person's spine in the neck, it will download their consciousness and safely store it. Unlike common neural implants, it is far more robust, will carry psylinks between bodies and, if needed, act on its own to protect whoever's consciousness is stored inside it. Its internal workings are a mystery to all human minds, even those lucky or cursed enough to become its new inhabitant.

Extremely rare, heavily restricted and hard to produce, these implants are rare on non-ultratech worlds.

A dehumanizing plasteel-woven helmet equipped with a built in advanced status computer and air filtration system. It's light yet fairly protective against both conventional weaponry and environmental hazards, and the computer helps spot and track targets the user designates. The on-board filter system has the side effect of distorting speech, making the wearer more intimidating.

Masks like these are commonly worn by urbworld peacekeepers, as its qualities are perfect for suppressing dissidents, tracking fugitives, and resisting effects of chemical warfare; common fare on any urbworld.

A grotesque mass of writhing tentacles, mouths and eyes, quivering in violent spasms as it strives to breathe. This poor creature knows only pain and suffering, and will be glad to inflict it upon others. Created by infusing an animal with the strange energies from an extradimensional corruption.
An object with ideoligious significance.

Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest mustelid ever discovered. Enhydriodon is a bear-sized ancestor of modern otters, and a very dangerous predator that used to be a big threat to early humans.
Great swimmers, surprisingly swift on land.

A fully sealed suit of powered armor. Layered plasteel plates woven into flexible heat shields protect vital bodyparts from both ballistic and energy weapons while still allowing full range of motion. The sealed environment inside of the suit allows the wearer to survive for prolonged amounts of time in environments without oxygen, and protect from toxins and gases. Small fabric pouches on the waist of the suit store extra ammunitions, allowing faster reload times.

Armor like this is a common sight amongst space-faring empires or militias.

A pair of advanced light power armor boots, with plasteel plates efficiently placed to cover all the important parts of the foot. Interwoven heat shields in the plating offers superior heat protection, and sophisticated servomotors allow the wearer to perform evasive maneuvers that would otherwise be impractical.

A pair of advanced light power armor gloves, with plasteel plates carefully placed to protect the majority of the wearer's hand. Heat shields are interwoven in the plating, which provides superior heat protection. Sound-absorbing padding helps to muffle the actions of the wearer, and refined tactile amplifiers help the wearer to reload quickly and deflect blows.

A fully enclosed powered helmet equipped with a miniaturized life support system widely used by space-faring soldiers. Thin layered plasteel plates are woven into flexible heat shields to offer both protection from conventional weapons and protection from the heat, meanwhile the built-in breathing apparatus offers protection from airborne toxins
A simple paper envelope.

Thin, layered plasteel-weave plates, advanced molecular adaptation layers and a state-of-the-art air filtration system allow for full protection against heat, cold, psychic and toxic effects. It limits the movement and visibility of the wearer while not offering much protection in combat.

Originally created for workers in zero-G and other extreme working conditions, it soon found popularity with needlecasters, explorers and medical professionals alike and has been widely adopted on a multitude of worlds.

A lightly armored, impermeable, airtight helmet with hyperweave lining designed for work in extreme conditions. Provides full protection against heat, cold, psychic and toxic effects alongside the enviro suit.

A small internal module connected to the respiratory system that filters the incoming air of environmental toxins and gases.  The gathered toxins are later harmlessly excreted from the body.  The implant allows the user to survive longer in polluted environments.  Additionally, it negates the irritation of acidic smoke and prevents lung rot.
A lightly armored jumpsuit used by the Equalists. Light and designed to increase the ability for chi blockers to dodge bending attacks.
