A stationary bike used for cardio training. Builds endurance and works the glutes and thighs more intensely than running.
A cushioned mat for floor-based workouts. It enhances comfort and safety during exercises like yoga, stretching, or core training, increasing efficiency.

A pheromone controlling micro-organ. It is necessary to construct certain types of insectoid hives. Pherocores have been embedded deep into the brains of geneline leaders which allowed ancient civilizations to control the hives.

This pherocore belongs to the exoinsectoid geneline that evolved in the vacuum of space, known for their vacuum resistance and endurance.

Not actually a leech, an exoleech is a bioengineered insectoid roughly the size of a bear, adapted to survive the frigid vacuum of space. It possesses an incredibly sharp mouth capable of dealing substantial damage in combat. While heavily protected by thick chitinous armor and deadly at close quarters, It is quite slow in open terrain.

A large bioengineered insectoid roughly the size of a deer. The exopede is heavily armored and adapted to survive the frigid vacuum of space, and functions as a middle-caste hive worker, performing most tasks and defending the hive with its powerful appendages. While heavily protected and dangerous in combat, its movement is relatively slow on open ground.

A wearable frame, powered by a system of hydraulics, electric motors, levers and pneumatics, designed to permit quick movement. Whilst it does not provide any protection, it allows the user to walk faster, lift heavier objects and maintain balance more easily.

A large, genetically-engineered worm-like insectoid, adapted to survive in the vacuum of space. Once the worker caste of an artificial ecosystem designed to fight mechanoid invasions, it is now often encountered without its deadlier insectoid cousins. Still, its size and rapidly regenerating body makes it a durable and dangerous foe in combat. A eusocial creature, it cannot reproduce individually.

A massive, writhing knot of bioengineered exoworms, tangled together in a singular, terrifying entity. Its formidable size and complex, interwoven bodies grant it extreme durability, but damage causes individual exoworms to violently rupture from the mass and continue the fight. Its bite carries a risk of implanting parasitic exoworm larvae, which gestate slowly within the host.

The Explorer's Archive can be linked to the Explorer's Workbench./nDepending on the level of Hideouts you want to locate, up to 8 may need to be linked to the Workbench./nIt can also be used to store up to 9 torn notes.
A belt with explosives.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. This particular module comes with a compact storage and launch system for deploying explosive IED traps from a distance. The implant needs to be loaded with high-explosive shells in order to function.

A emotion weaving mechanoid micro-organ engineered to magnify and regulate extrasensory mental force. It artificially amplifies emotions and the resulting psychic energy while limiting damage to the mind. It is necessary to produce certain advanced types of mechanoids and equipment. A mechanitor can study this chip to help unlock higher tiers of mechtech research.

A grotesquely enlarged eye, crawling around with the help of a few fleshy tentacles. Not very useful at all. Created by infusing an animal with the strange energies from an extradimensional corruption.
A protective covering, usually made of cloth, for an injured eye. Or just for style.
A glitterpanel specialized in applying fabric-related recipes. It allows the formation of hyperweave and synthread. The process is very mysterious and requires a powerful glitterheart to function.

A sensitive micro-processor array designed to enhance the speed and efficiency of industrial factory buildings. It links with nearby factory machines to extend their maximum overclocking limit by an additional 100 percent, allowing for drastically increased production speeds. One factory can use up to three factory boosters.

A cooling system designed to draw excess heat away from industrial factory buildings. It links with nearby factory machines to reduce their total heat output by 25%, mitigating the risk of overheating and fire. One factory can use up to four factory heatsinks.
A wall-mounted string of lamps that light up a small area using electricity. It is much less powerful than a standing lamp, but can be mounted on walls.
A bundle of seeds for fairy washboard plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A stout, broad-bladed falchion, often found in the hands of militiamen and peasantry due to the ease of its manufacture and use. Best used for slashing, but can still thrust in a pinch.

A high-speed bird of prey distinguished by sleek, pointed wings and a unique notched beak with a 'tomial tooth' that allows it to 'snip' through cervical vertebrae of small prey creatures like a pair of scissors.

The broader falcon family ranges from the legendary Peregrine Falcon to tiny Kestrels and Pygmy Falcons to the unusual Laughing Falcon and more, and can be found in a wide range of climates from subarctic to subtropical.

These birds have been kept, bred, and trained as hunting companions for millennia throughout human history. Despite their small size they are fierce predators, with sight and speed that allow them to capture prey that elude most other hunters.
A fertilized falcon egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a chick. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
An unfertilized falcon egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
An all-purpose car with good passenger and cargo capacity, high fuel efficiency, and lower visibility, but it will struggle to move on hills, snow or winter tiles.
An unfinished drone. This will deploy into a drone.

An abundant material, fat serves multiple purposes. In food, added fat improves meals and fills a colonist’s gut longer, but too much and the colonist will more likely get sick. In survival, fat can be added to flames, whether in a torch or a bonfire, to maintain heat longer. Finally, rendered fat can mold into candles, soaps, sculptures, and more.

A high-tech device that can be installed into an eye or any compatible artificial eye replacement. This particular model is able to quickly analyze an animal's health and behavior. The collected data is then forwarded to the user via a simple, non-intrusive interface. Additionally, it is able to emit complex light signals and display special patterns on the eye's surface that most animal species can be trained to respond to.
An artificial plant in a sturdy metal pot. It requires no light, water, or air, making it perfect for adding beauty to even the most inhospitable gravship environments.
Chickenbear feathers can be gathered and processed into a fine powder, which produces a mild euphoric sensation when burned and inhaled. Featherdust use can produce a dependency.

An incredible, large fur baby that not only wants you to scratch its belly, but regularly and without fear of getting your eyes gouged out by their massive claws. A simplified genome extraction device designed to be usable by even the most simple-minded goon, as such it resembles a caulking gun that works in reverse. The best genetic material can be found in the brain and the automated, single-use design instantly compresses this material into a usable genome.

The desired subject needs to be docile and trusting of the user who intends on scooping out their brain in a process that is not-quite instantaneous. It is recommended to anesthetize the creature as any sudden movement on their part will interrupt the whole process. Alternatively, it will also work on a dead body...

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> This excavator can be used to acquire the following genomes:

A specialized extraction module that is equipped to extract the genomes from a subject’s corpse. The material is converted into a soupish-mixture which is then condensed into the relevant genome. Processing speed is influenced by intelligence, as it relies on knowing which button to press, when to press it and where to find it under the intimidating number of submenus.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> The genome extractor table will only work for tier 1 genomes. For tier 2 (insectoids, reptiles, equines) and tier 3 (colossals) you will need genome excavators, built on the genetics tinkering table or found on abandoned labs.

A specialized extraction module that is equipped to extract the genomes from a subject’s corpse. The material is converted into a soupish-mixture which is then condensed into an extremely complex genome. Completely useless by itself, but functions as a template which can be compared to another genome. The procedure removes any excess genetic information and renders them completely identical.

Bear in mind that this machine cannot duplicate some genomes, such as colossal.

A large quad-node stabilizer rig packed with geno-dampening regulators and microphase baffles that mute unstable metabolic signatures. Its internal attenuation plates hum softly as they pare down excessive gene volatility during archite infusion.

Reduces the metabolism strength of the random side-effect gene by 1 when linked to an archogen injector.

Up to 4 genomic attenuators can link to a single archogen injector.

A machine where the miracle - or horror - of birth happens using automated procedures, a little genetic hand-waving and a great heaping dose of lost sleep. The inserted Genoframe is influenced by two genomes, one dominant and one recessive, and can be modified with optional boosters.

The process isn’t perfect, due to material contamination, missing chromosomes or simple bad luck, and can result in something completely unwanted being developed. For the machine, it makes no difference whether it’s trying to grow an animal or a comically large fruit. The resulting growth cell has a limited lifespan as the embryonic fluid will start breaking down if not allowed to gestate properly.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay notes:</color> If the process to deliver ingredients to the genomorpher is interrupted, the ingredients that have already been inserted in it will deteriorate and be lost.

An advanced ultratech device that dramatically increases the size of a gravship.  It extends the area in which substructure can be built, and increases the amount of substructure that a gravship can support. Must be built near a grav engine. A gravship can support up to four grav field amplifiers.

An advanced ultratech device that dramatically increases the size of a gravship but makes the gravity field slightly weaker, resulting in a decrease to the amount of substructure that can be built. Must be built near a grav engine.

A gravship can support only one grav field dilutor.

A massive gravtech reactor that channels and amplifies gravitational wave energy into immense electrical output. Its reinforced coils can handle extreme flux, making it one of the most potent power sources available for gravships. Adjacent gravcore power cells will multiply the power output by 15% for each gravcore power cell.

The gravhulk is a colossal class of gravship, engineered to transport entire megacolonies, orbital platforms, or mobile city-cores across the skies of a planet. The grav engine generates lift by inverting and intensifying the effect of gravity in a field around itself. This engine can lift upwards, but does not produce forward thrust. It can't function far from a large gravity well like a planet, so it is useless for interplanetary travel.

When launched, anything on substructure that's connected to the grav engine will be transported to a new map.

Gravhulks are the pride of glitterworld infrastructure fleets, often used to deploy prefabricated settlements, floating arcologies, or deep-strata excavation hubs. Their sheer scale demands enormous production facilities and crew specialization, making them one of the rarest and most powerful gravships ever built.

A compact gravtech engine designed for short-range jumps within a planet’s atmosphere. The gravjumper engine creates a brief, localized distortion in gravitational flow, allowing rapid vertical lift, but does not produce forward thrust. It can't function far from a large gravity well like a planet, so it is useless for interplanetary travel.

When launched, anything on substructure that's connected to the grav engine will be transported to a new map.

Often used by explorers, scouts, and smugglers, gravjumper engines are prized for their agility and minimal power requirements. They are simpler to produce than full gravship engines, but still rely on high-grade materials and advanced fabrication.

A specialized device that masks the energy signature of a gravship launch, reducing the impact the gravship launch has on other inhabitants of the planet, making it less likely that the gravship will be detected.

A gravship can support two gravlaunch cloakers.

A complex vertical launch and stabilization platform integrated into the gravship’s core structure. The gravlift provides the immense thrust required for vertical takeoff from planetary surfaces and stabilizes orbital insertion, allowing the gravship to remain suspended in space. It also softens the crash landing greatly, reducing the damage taken and ensuring substructure does not suffer critical damage.

Designed using the same technology as a gravlock tether and turned inside out, a gravlock emitter is designed to drag wreckages in orbit towards the host ship.

It draws everything from the grav engine on the same substructure, which is shut down for as long as the tow lasts.
A gravship 2-tier shelf that can hold up to 6 stacks of various items.

They are not very resilient and are easily dispatched. However, they have slow regenerative capabilities.
A fertilized great devourer egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby great devourer. It can be eaten raw or cooked, but it's a worm egg, so it's disgusting either way...

A greatly ornamented full-plate great helmet, often worn by jousters and heraldic champions and notable figures of notable houses in war. Portrays one’s noble status while still offering considerable protection in battle. 

This great helm carries the colours of the Ulrik order.

With its intricate patterns and exceptional durability, griffon leather is prized among craftsmen for its ability to fashion garments and goods of unparalleled quality and prestige.

A grill is a device that cooks food by applying heat from below. This is a chemfuel powered grill that needs chemfuel as fuel to work.
Used for sharpening weapons. Increases workspeed when placed near medieval workbenches.

The horned groundffalo is a great pack beast (albeit a bit slow) capable of producing milk and wool, as well as mining for your colony. Compared to a Groundrunner it won't be as efficient on its mining work, but the other characteristics make up for this.

Useful abilities: Produces wool, milk, acts as a pack beast and  mines rocks and minerals.

A hybridization of a bear and mole, groundrunners originally came from mineral-planets. They are used as walking heavy tools by the locals when they hit parts that plasteel can’t break, and for hauling large boulders that their owners can’t lift. Due to their domesticated origins, they are surprisingly docile and easy to tame. Their incredible strength and sharp claws allows them to break hard materials with ease.

If trained properly, groundrunners will help colonists mine rocks and minerals. Despite that, they can be quite lazy and get distracted easily.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.

A portable, human-made casing designed to hold an embryo until it is transferred to a relevant Electrowomb, similar to fertilized eggs that require incubation. The embryonic fluid is unstable due to the unnatural genetic combination, so it will need to be implanted within 7 days after its creation. This growth cell has to be kept at a temperature between 0 and 50 degrees Celsius.

Gunkanmaki is a special type of nigirizushi: an oval, hand-formed clump of sushi rice that has a strip of nori wrapped around its perimeter to form a vessel that is filled with some soft, loose or fine-chopped ingredient that requires the confinement of nori such as roe.

A handheld weight used in ancient times, utilized for various exercises to strengthen muscles.

A versatile hand tool featuring a heavy head attached to a sturdy handle, typically made of wood, metal, or fiberglass. Used for driving nails, breaking objects, and shaping materials, the hammer is a fundamental tool in construction, carpentry, and general household tasks. With its simple yet effective design, it delivers controlled force and precision, making it indispensable for a wide range of applications.

A classic pairing of tools for precision work in various trades and crafts. The hammer, with its heavy head and sturdy handle, delivers controlled force to the chisel's sharp blade, allowing for accurate cutting, shaping, and carving of materials such as wood, stone, or metal. Together, they form an essential toolkit for sculptors, masons, carpenters, and artisans, facilitating the creation of intricate designs and precise cuts with ease.
Hampshires are a robust breed of pigs and are typically gathered for its lean meat and taste. They are an efficient source of meat, and are easy to feed because they will eat almost anything.

An ancient crude but deadly firearm, the hand cannon fires a devastating grapeshot over a short distance. The lead balls lose velocity and damage with distance, and are extremely ineffective against armor. Due to the chempowder reaction when firing the arquebus, plumes of blindsmoke are ejected from the barrel.
An object with ideoligious significance.
A hand mortar used to launch flaming mortars at a safe distance. It has a very slow rate of fire.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm replacement. This particular module is nearly identical to a standard hand talon implant in terms of functionality.
A longer version of the hatchet, the handaxe’s long shaft allows for stronger swings at a distance. Due to its easy use and practicality, this axe is a favorite against shielded enemies.
A steel handcuffs.

War changes as the handgonnes take to the field; through powder and ignition, warriors fire hot shrapnel forward to pierce multiple targets. The long handle and heavy barrel make the weapon cumbersome to carry, but one skilled shot can turn the tides of battle in an instant.

A heavy weapon meant as a portable turret, dismantled from its base and now carryable by strong individuals, power armor, or a powered exosuit. Despite this, the gun still requires hand cranking to reach maximum fire rate and now has a limited ammo supply.

As a last line of defense, many frontiersmen claim to land incredibly lucky shots with this weapon, swiftly turning enemies into fine red mist.

Mortar launcher. Lobs bombs over walls. Very inaccurate but long-ranged. It's slow to aim and it cannot fire at close-up targets.

Woven from smokeleaf, hardweave, sometimes called canvas, has threads alternated over and under adjacent threads to create a strong and even surface. Whilst not as insulating as cloth, it’s much more resistant to damage.
Capsules containing genetic stabilizers that help maintain the dominant-recessive genome relationship. Effectively reduces the chance of the hybrid having the opposite intended result.

A primitive tool used by apprentice lumberjacks, the hatchet is useful for both woodworking and chopping attacks. A great and accessible alternative to swords should the enemy hide behind a shield wall.

An unfinished drone. This will deploy into a drone.

An opulent symphony of flavor and form, where the finest ingredients and masterful technique unite in a transcendent culinary masterpiece. Provides exquisite mood when eaten, and ensures that colonists eating it together will form strong opinions of each other.

Hawk trainability has made them a favorite among falconers for millenia. A fertilized hawk egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a chick. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
An unfertilized hawk egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.

It is possible to remove mechanite strains entirely from a host, however it requires an expensive and difficult surgery.

Meat tenderized then filleted, then rolled in a thick batter before being air fried. The end result is a tasty soul food - Not quite as filling as a meal, but very pleasing to eat.

A heavy leather breastplate meant to provide warmth and protection to heavy infantry during battles in frigid tundras. Unfortunately, this armor leaves one slowed and more vulnerable to melee attacks.

A strong medieval helmet that provides full-head coverage. While it offers fantastic protection, one's vision is greatly obscured, thus it is only recommended for front line infantry, particularly those foregoing shields.

Overlapping solid plates of armor covering the entire body from neck to feet. The plates have been reinforced which offers significantly more protection, but at the cost of mobility.
A bulky medieval helmet that provides full-head coverage. Offers a considerable amount of protection but restricts the wearer's field of vision.

A pair of heavy power armor boots, layered with thick plasteel plates and fitted with enough servomotors to keep the wearer unimpeded. Its sturdy build and heavier weight helps to keep the wearer stable.

A pair of reinforced power armor gauntlets, with plating going from fingers to forearm without sacrificing fine motor control. They are fitted with reflex synchronizers that help guide the user to make clean, efficient strikes.

An ornate favorite among wealthy lawmen and bandits alike for its increased firepower and range at the cost of reload speed.

Tales of steamworld gunslingers would imply this weapon and ones like it are capable of occasional incredibly lucky shots.
A heavily fortified square shield that covers one's body from shin to shoulder, heavy enough to slow those wielding it at the benefit of incredible protection.

An extremely well-armored version of the siege pod, able to withstand a lot of attacks and equipped with four machineguns and a rocket launcher. Can drop on enemy territory to serve as an instant bunker or even a mobile base. It's very visible when traveling, and requires several rockets to lift it up, which must be rebuilt in order to leave the area again.

A very strong and wide pipe meant for transporting fluids and flowing solids. Heavy-duty pipes are not necessarily ideal for most plumbing needs but they might be the only viable solution in moving resources for the most complicated, industrious projects.

Hedgehogs are diminutive mammals with cone-shaped faces, short legs and bodies that are covered with porcupine-like quills. When in danger, the hedgehog rolls into a ball so that the quills cover the entire area of their exposed body and protects the animal from predators.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.
A great chair to pair with your dining table.

A basic aircraft that doesn't require a landing strip, but can transport people very quickly. It has less cargo capacity and speed than airplanes, and while it's very fuel-efficient, it's very easy to spot when they move.

A genetically modified strain of the leopard slug intended as a fast corpse disposal aid. The helixien constantly secretes a foul-smelling, corrosive gas that produces an uncomfortable, itchy sensation in living beings. This gas is mostly harmless, unless it comes into contact with decaying organic matter. The gas greatly accelerates corpse rotting, liberating a black putrid liquid known as corpse bile. The helixien happily feeds on this liquid sludge, although it can also feed on other organic matter if needed.

The sight of a helixien is quite revolting and watching one wallowing in a pile of human corpses is a deeply traumatizing experience.
An extractor machine mounted on a pocket of helixien gas. This machine pumps out valuable gas and needs to be connected to other gas-based utilities using the pipe network.

Not actually a beetle, the hellbeetle is a genetically-engineered giant insectoid the size of a bear. Designed for the forges of the planet Nuchadus, hellbeetles have brittle armor, but are capable of spitting liquid fire from their giant jaws. In close quarters, the sharp horns and ripper-blades will dispose of flesh and metal alike. It is, however, quite slow in open terrain.

A ultra-high-power energy pulse projector designed for siegebreaking. The hellsphere cannon must hold a bead on its target for several seconds while charging, before it releases a devastating tsunami of power. The explosion is capable of melting concrete in its blast radius. The heat of the explosion will ignite anything nearby. It cannot fire at close-up targets.

A pair of retractable, spring-loaded plasteel canines, connected to a vaccum pump. The user can bite an enemy, extend the fangs, and suck the blood from the target, converting it directly into a moderate amount of hemogen.

Can only be installed on pawns with the hemogenic gene.

An advanced device designed to expedite the deathrest process at the cost of blood consumption. By connecting with a deathresting person, this apparatus employs intricate blood analysis and potent sanguine stimulants to maximize the efficiency of the deathrest casket. As it hastens the character's recovery, the Hemodynamic Accelerator demands a continuous supply of hemogen to fuel its powerful operation. To function, it must be connected to a deathrest casket, ensuring the swift rejuvenation of its occupant.

A high-tech device that can be installed into a heart or any compatible artificial heart replacement. This particular model is equipped with a variety of advanced filters that help break down and eliminate harmful elements from the host’s blood.
A medical crate containing hemogen packs.
A hopper-like storage basin meant to input hemogen into the network, filling up connected vats.

A rich, crimson liquid crafted from concentrated hemogen packs. When the user drinks it, it enhances all traits and abilities tied to their hemogenic nature, boosting physical and mental capacities. Additionally, this draught replenishes the user's hemogen supply over time, maintaining their vitality and enhancing their overall function.
Animal hemogen. Increases regeneration and combat capabilities of the user, but greatly decreases the capability to communicate with others.
Tainted, rotting hemogen from a cadaver. Greatly weakens the carrier of this hemogen type, but increases the blood filtration significantly.
Pure, thick hemogen of another bloodfeeder. The most rare of all hemogens, it gives the carrier a powerful boost to all capacities.

A device specifically engineered to enhance the durability of deathresting characters by manipulating the molecular structure of their skin. Utilizing an array of bioresonant projectors and blood-based nano-agents, the solidifier targets the hemogen within the character's body, fortifying and thickening skin molecules. As the deathresting individual slumbers, the Hemogen Solidifier weaves a dense, protective layer around them, rendering their skin more resilient and damage-resistant. The device must be connected to a deathrest casket to operate, ensuring its occupant emerges from their rest with an augmented defensive capacity.
A hopper-like storage basin meant to dispense hemogen for later use.

An improved set of artificial hemogen glands that allow a sangophage to more efficiently convert blood into hemogen.

Can only be installed on pawns with the hemogenic gene.

An advanced biorefinery that folds and compresses hemogen into a denser state, allowing a sangophage to store more within their body.

Can only be installed on pawns with the hemogenic gene.

Engineered for hemogen production, the hemolope grows a large sac of pure hemogen on its back. Due to genetic instabilities, unlike a boomalope, it has a very short lifespan and is generally weaker. It has rarely been encountered in the wild, as it is only kept by more ethical sanguophages for corporations for hemogen production. It can be milked to produce hemogen.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.

A high-tech device that can be installed into a stomach or any compatible artificial stomach replacement. This implant model refines excess nutrients and typically indigestible biological material, repurposing it to produce extra blood using the host's cells. Once a sufficient amount has been produced, it can be packed into hemogen packs and ejected from the implant. The amount of hemogen produced depends on the amount of food consumed by its host. Sanguophages and other genetically modified humans that are incapable of naturally producing their own hemogen cannot make use of this implant.

When striking isn’t enough, brave warriors can close distances with the hooked blade’s curved head. The sharp point can puncture both flesh and metal, ensuring a tight grip to pull in enemies. Deals impressive damage for an agricultural tool but shines thanks to its utility.
The reach of the hooked blade allows it to strike enemies much further away.
A bundle of seeds for hop plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A spiky bed that puts spikecore style to shame.
A stone bas relief of Horaxian imagery for decorating a floor.
A stone bas relief of Horaxian imagery for decorating a floor.

A specialized rack designed to display numerous melee and ranged weapons for armories and outposts. Items stored inside will not deteriorate over time. 

<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> 
Stack size total: 16 
Stack per tile: 8 

Allowed items: Ranged weapons, Melee weapons, Explosives
A horizontal weapon rack that can display up to 6 weapons.
An object with ideoligious significance.

A large bird distinguished by an oversized bill topped with a hollow structure called a casque, used for foraging, display, and occasional territorial disputes.

The hornbill family spans a striking range of habitats from dense rainforest canopy species that rarely descend to the ground, to open savanna specialists that spend most of their lives walking rather than flying.
A fertilized hornbill egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a chick. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
An unfertilized hornbill egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
An unfinished drone. This will deploy into a drone.
A deathly sweet liquid secreted by the black hornets. Consuming it leads to numbing the sensation of pain but sharpening one's reflexes, improving melee and shooting abilities.

Jelly stored and used as food by oversized insects. It is smooth, rich, and fulfills the recreation need of those who consume it. Because of its unique biological properties, it can nourish almost any creature and never rots.
A jovial hat that mimics the appearance of an equestrian, party animals far and wide know it to be an epitome of comical relief.
A standard pair of clothing for burghers and nobility alike.
A hospital device.
A hospital device.
A hospital device.
A comforting and creamy beverage offering a rich chocolate flavor that warms both body and soul. Perfect for cold days or as a delightful treat, it’s a simple yet indulgent classic.
A potent, spicy sauce made from blending and simmering chilis and other spices. Applying the sauce to a gourmet meal grants it a pain-resistance effect.
Hot tub used for hydrotherapy, relaxation, or pleasure. Filled with water from water towers on first use. Self-heated and does not require a sewage outlet.
Stores hot running water for showers and baths. Connect to any boiler to heat.
Stores hot running water for showers and baths. Connect to any boiler to heat.
A thick plate bascinet helmet coupled with an extended pig-faced visor, which allows for easier breathing. Still quite hindering to see out of, however.

A small, gregarious songbird with a stout bill and a streaky brown body, where the males are distinguished by a rosy-red face and breast
.
A fertilized House Finch egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a chick. It can be eaten, but why would you do such a thing?
An unfertilized House Finch egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
A simple sign usually used to mark homes

A high-tech device that can be installed into any compatible artificial spine replacement. This particular module utilizes gravcore technology in order to allow its user to gently hover above the ground, letting them traverse rough terrain with ease.
an elegant curved single bed made of metal.
This huge anima pearl seems to be bursting with barely contained living energy. It can be planted and an anima tree will grow from it.
This enormous bear pelt is probably valuable as a trade good. Or it can also be repurposed as a huge rug.
A bear pelt rug. Taxidermy seems to be in vogue on the Rim!
A bearcat pelt rug. This thing seems to be quite more exotic than other pelt rugs!

A nondistinct paste mimicking the texture of lobster, crab, or other shellfish. Only, this one... is made with human meat. A delicacy for cannibalistic Rim tribes, and a profoundly disgusting and taboo culinary experience for anyone else.
Fertilized human egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a human baby. It definitely shouldn’t but can be eaten raw. Eating it is treated the same way as killing a baby.
These raw hides and pelts were removed from a creature, and with the right skills and tools, could be processed into tanned leather.

Trophies for the accomplished hunter, animal rugs are formed from stained and stuffed animal hides sewed to felt and padding to form rugs. Human rugs are prized trophies admired by some and loathed by others, but like-minded cannibals will find comfort in its decor.

A payload of humanoid genetic material. Can be used at the genomorpher to create a growth cell of a hybrid animal. This tier 1 genome can be used as either a primary or secondary genome.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All humanoid hybrids have a somewhat decent level of intelligence and can do various tasks around the colony.

<color=#E5E54C>Extraction:</color> Can be extracted via the genome extractor table or any genome excavator from any sentient humanoid.

There is a saying that all of life is a circle, and that eventually everything returns to its origins only to begin again. This particular humanoid has undergone some mental evolution while at the same time suffering from physical devolution, resembling more closely humanity’s distant evolutionary ancestors. Just don’t say monkey.

A perfect humanoid animal, paragon of all similar animals with no needless junk genetic data. Besides the various improvements to the baseline animal’s abilities, this paragon can drive man’s curiosity ever forward by providing a boost to research speed with a well-placed insightful word of wisdom.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Humanoid paragons will periodically engage other colonists in conversation, talking about a variety of topics. This increases the social recreation needs of those they interact with by 10% (subject to diminishing returns like all joy types). If using Ideology, humanoid hybrids are subject to precepts. Research drive ability: offers investigative insights to nearby researches, allowing them to more easily reach a breakthrough by increasing research speed by 10%.

A High-Mobility Multipurpose Wheeled Vehicle (HMMWV). It's incredibly versatile, able to transport passengers and cargo, with light armor for protection. Works well in any terrain, with minor issues in winter.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. This particular model includes a compact storage and deployment apparatus for hunter packs. The core functions of the pack remains the same and it has to be replaced after each use as a result. Due to its small size and low weight, the wielder can carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

An advanced steel mask equipped with a weak toxin filter and advanced heat-based sensors which allows the wearer to stalk prey with more stealth.

This headgear is associated with pride and power, it makes the wearer more confident and is usually worn by Venator hunters for ceremonial purposes.
A hearty stew consisting of boiled sausage sauteed in a vegetable broth with minced cabbage.

A simple and short weapon, the hunting bow mixes dense wood for the belly along with springier wood for the front. This allows the dense wood to bend, but the wood always fights to return to the straight, and so ousts arrows pulled along the strand at great force. Smaller than the war bow, resulting in less distance and penetration, but deadly in the hands of a skilled archer or hunter.

An extremely cursed riding companion that can vocally explain in excruciating detail the troubles it goes through as a beast of burden. Most people don’t like to be reminded that animals are capable of feeling, especially if they can vocalise themselves in human speech. Don’t be surprised if no one wants to eat or wear butchered parts of this creature, as it looks like a misshapen human with cloven hands.

An equine hybrid with recessive humanoid genes. Very intelligent and relatively low maintenance, they make for a decent rideable pack animal. Their main advantage comes in their ability to cheer up the travellers in a caravan, however it doesn’t understand social cues and can throw out some devastating social commentary.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All equine hybrids are good for caravaning. A caravan with one of them needs a shorter resting period, only stopping to rest between 23:30 PM and 4 AM. Humanoid hybrids will periodically engage other colonists in conversation, talking about a variety of topics. This increases the social recreation needs of those they interact with by 10% (subject to diminishing returns like all joy types). The hurseman engages caravan members too while caravaning, causing mood boosts (up to +15). 10% of the time however it will insult them, making them loose mood (up to -30). If using Ideology, humanoid hybrids are subject to precepts.
It is the jacket of the honored cavalryman. It inspires the heart of the wearer.
A vibrant, sweet-smelling flower with a fresh, green fragrance that adds depth to gardens and perfumes alike.
A bundle of seeds for hyacinth. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A bundle of seeds for hyacinth. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
Overlapping plates of hardened chitin. Really durable in combat, but provides little protection from weather.
Light, pliable sheets of scaly skin. Light, strong, and insulates well.
Fabric spun from silk fibers. Resists blunt and sharp damage easily, but provides almost no protection against extreme heat.
A dense, mechanite-based powder that helps heal wounds and scars, similar to the healing properties of luciferium. Take once every 15 days for the effect to occur.

The Hydra is a fearsome creature, mutated by the toxic environment to become a three-headed snake. Living primarily in water, two of its heads remain submerged while only one absorbs oxygen. Quick and vicious in its attacks, the Hydra's bite is lethal, delivering a potent venom with each strike. Its ability to adapt to even the harshest of environments makes it a formidable predator, and one that should be approached with caution. The Hydra's three heads are a symbol of its adaptability and resilience, making it a force to be reckoned with in the polluted biomes.
A fertilized hydra egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby hydra. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
An unfertilized hydra egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
A bundle of seeds for hydrangea bush. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

A cunning predator, possessing features of felines and canids alike. An easily underestimated creature by those taking their peculiar chuckling gurgles as a playful sign of harmlessness. While a pack of hyenas might hesitate to attack a group of man in the open, they will show no mercy to a lonesome vagabond. Being eaten alive to the accompaniment of satisfied giggles must be a terrible end.
A large dog-like carnivore most often found in the shrublands and deserts. A common trope in tribal legends, the laughter produced by these animals can sow fear during the long desert nights.
A soft furry pelt harvested from a hyena. It is difficult to pierce and insulates well against heat.
These raw hides and pelts were removed from a creature, and with the right skills and tools, could be processed into tanned leather.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.

A warm robust coat sewn from a hyena's fur. Wearing the pelt displays owner's strength, as it is proof that they have slain a ferocious hyena to don the trophy. While intimidating the fearful, the pelt also grants strength and confidence in battle.

Trophies for the accomplished hunter, animal rugs are formed from stained and stuffed animal hides sewed to felt and padding to form rugs. Hyena rugs are small but the lavish patterns, from stripes to dots, make the piece a beautiful addition to decor.
Releases mechanites that break down dead skin cells and other detritus on the skin and hair releasing it harmlessly into the air.

An implant that enhances the speed and pain resistance of the user after taking damage. The implant is crafted from the archotechnological adrenal glands of a chimera, using an archotech shard to stimulate the release procedure. By pumping a combination of synthetic superadrenaline and archites into the bloodstream, the user is able to move much faster and ignore their pain for a period of time after recieving enough damage. Unfortunately, the presence of hyper-adrenaline in the body boosts aggression levels, leading to increased chances of social fights.

A beamcasting-band synchronization micro-organ. It is necessary to produce certain advanced types of mechanoids and equipment.

A mechanitor can study this chip to help unlock higher tiers of mechtech research. Dropped by the Infernus.

Synthetically produced hypnotol, an extremely addictive substance that causes mild cognitive decline. Hypnotol is used as a blackmail drug to force users to do things they would not otherwise do. It is often used by advanced pirates to recruit leaders of other factions into their gangs.

Can be used to temporarily recruit prisoners, as long as they keep their addiction.
The fleshy bright red fruit of an iashiphus plant.
Water which has been frozen to create blocks of ice. Will melt in temperatures above freezing.

A medium-sized bioengineered insectoid adapted for extreme cold. In frigid temperatures, razor-sharp blades emerge from its limbs, turning it into a swift and deadly predator. However, when exposed to warmth, the blades retract, and the creature becomes sluggish, its movements slow and cumbersome. Highly dangerous in icy environments but far less threatening when overheated.

Crafted from the rare frostberries, is a sought-after elixir known for its enchanting qualities. The frostberries, harvested during the first winter's frost, yield a wine with a crisp, sweet flavor and a hint of winter's chill. Ice Wine imparts a subtle frost resistance to those who drink it, fortifying them against the harshest cold. This magical beverage is a favorite among adventurers and travelers braving icy terrains, offering both warmth and protection in a single, refreshing sip.
Crushed frostberries. Needs to undergo fermentation in a rustic fermenting barrel in order to become wine.

A crystalline draught brewed from frost leaves. It hums with a biting cold, said to sharpen the senses, steady the hand, and leave a lingering trail of winter across the tongue. Excessive consumption can lead to alcohol blackouts and, over time, addiction.

<color=#E5E54C>Trade considerations:</color>

<color=#E5E54C>Ingredients:</color> Making 15 iced elixir requires 150 frost leaves for a total value of 15, and sells for 10.30, giving a <color=#33CC33>90.29%</color> profit per unit (very high, as the leaves can't be cultivated).

<color=#E5E54C>Fermentation time:</color> 5 days.

<color=#E5E54C>Caravan trading:</color> Its weight is 0.3 Kg, for a value per Kg of <color=#33CC33>34.33</color>.

<color=#E5E54C>Profit per day:</color> On average, profit per day is <color=#33CC33>1.86</color> (for reference, Yayo is 0.35).
An.. id card.
An object with ideoligious significance.

A pair of ADP shells connected to a trigger which detonates on touch or bullet impact. The explosion can paralyze mechanoids for a few seconds. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.

A pair of armor-piercing shells connected to a trigger which detonates on touch or bullet impact. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.

A pair of cluster shells connected to a trigger which detonates on touch or bullet impact. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.

A pair of shrapnel shells connected to a trigger which detonates on touch or bullet impact. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.

A pair of tar shells connected to a trigger which detonates on touch or bullet impact. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm. Creates a puddle of tar that is very difficult to move across. It is also very difficult to remove, and tends to also remove other floors because it sticks to them and ruins them. All things considered, I wouldn't detonate one of this in my kitchen.
An infantry fighting vehicle, providing protection and firepower to the many soldiers it can carry. It's also capable of launching smoke screen. The rear armor is thinner and more vulnerable.

A synthetic skin substitute that is much thicker and a much better insulator than human skin. This provides a measure of defense but, more importantly, makes the subject more resistant to high temperatures.
A sign about ancient iguanodons.

A plant-eating dinosaur that mostly walked on all fours but could stand on two legs if need be, primarily for feeding purposes. Its large thumb spikes are used in defense.

Scienfitic name: Iguanodon bernissartensis
a beautiful king-size bed with geometric patterns engraved on it.
a beautiful bed with geometric patterns engraved on it.

A small durable core of archotech design said to make its host immortal through rapid regeneration.  Its inner workings are a complete mystery, it’s unclear how it can endlessly regenerate a person seemingly from nothing.  Once implanted the core cannot be removed without damaging the device rendering it inert.

A dose of semi-coherent mechanites which travel throughout the body in order to fight off diseases within the host.  While mechanite strains normally conflict with one another this one is designed to remain in sleep mode the majority of the time and only awaken temporarily to deal with threats to the host’s health.  As such it’s able to coexist with other more aggressive mechanite strains.  Unfortunately, this has the downside of the mechanites being unable to remain active long enough to fight off existing conditions that have had time to take hold in the host’s system.

For ease-of-use the mechanites are designed to be self-installable via a small handheld injector.  It is possible to remove mechanite strains entirely from a host, however it requires an expensive and difficult surgery.

An amber-colored drink with tiny particles floating in it that bolsters the immune system of anyone that drinks it. While it helps them fight off sickness better, the downside is that it makes the user feel much more tired after drinking it, as well as overall makes the user get sleepy much faster than usual. The effects of the draught are strongest immediately after consumption, and then slowly fade away over the following days.
Capsules containing genetic restorative medicine that helps prevent genomes from breaking down prematurely. Effectively helps mitigate the possibility of the hybrid ending in complete failure.

A high-tech device that can be installed into a liver or kidney along with any compatible artificial replacement. This particular model boosts the user's resistance to diseases by releasing small swarms of viruskiller mechanites throughout the body.
A grim sculpture depicting a lesser demon perching. Often used to decorate tombs and crypts, it is said to guard the dead and scare away spirits and ghosts.

A terrifying handheld cannon specially loaded with impact-tip shells. Each shell creates a large explosion on hit, pulverizing people and fortifications.

The cannon has a long range, making it perfect for demolishing defenses from far away.

A heavy automatic rifle specially loaded with impact-tip ammo. Each bullet violently explodes once it reaches its target, turning unarmored foes and enemy structures alike into mist.

The scope and extendable stock make the weapon more accurate.

A solid semi-automatic shotgun specially loaded with impact-tip flak ammo. Each flak pellet violently explodes once it reaches its target, turning unarmored foes and enemy structures alike into mist.

The built-in chainsword bayonet and tight pellet spread make it deadly in close quarters.

A robust burst-fire SMG specially loaded with impact-tip ammo. Each bullet violently explodes once it reaches its target, turning unarmored foes and enemy structures alike into mist.

The weapon of choice for aspiring imperial marines, and spaceborn zealots.

A compact pistol specially loaded with impact-tip ammo. Each bullet violently explodes once it reaches its target, turning unarmored foes and enemy structures alike into mist.

Small and portable, it's ideal as a sidearm.
A decorative strip of cloth hanging from a vertical wooden frame. Appropriate for royal rooms.

A captivating dress adorned with exquisite golden jewelry, creating a dazzling and sophisticated look. The intricate details of the shimmering gold accents perfectly complement the elegance of the fabric, making it a truly eye-catching ensemble.

A captivating dress featuring golden jewelry and striking straps that cross over each other at the front, adding a touch of bold elegance. The intricate gold details enhance its allure, while the design of the straps creates a flattering and eye-catching silhouette, making it a truly mesmerizing piece.

An advanced shielding apparatus, the Imperial mega high-shield projects a vast momentum repulsor field, allowing shots to exit but preventing any from entering. Specifically calibrated for high angles, it's adept at deflecting incoming mortar rounds, aerodrone strikes and even orbital slicer beams. The unit can be temporarily disabled by EMP attacks, either by shocking the projector unit itself, or using EMP munitions on the shield. Draws huge amounts of power.
A stoney bas relief of imperial imagery for decorating a floor.
An object with ideoligious significance.

This particular machine can be explained as a simplified and miniaturized version of a Genomorpher, using only a single genome which influences an inserted Genoframe. Instead of trying to create an entire animal, it instead creates very specific limbs or organs. Due to the vastly simplified process and minimal variables, no complications arise during the process and the resulting product is similarly influenced by the quality of the Genoframe.

The Implant Augmentator can be used to create implants for animals - not just hybrids - with the quality of Genoframe dictating the deficits or bonuses those implants provide. Not all implants are created equal, some being inferior replacements and others providing new capabilities provided the animal in question can support them. Human implants are also a possibility.

Self-assembling machinery that fuses with the specimen’s nerve centers during the growth process. Effectively allows hybrids to be drafted.

This booster can't be crafted, only scavenged.

Self-assembling machinery that fuses with the specimen’s nerve centers during the growth process. Allows hybrids to be drafted and causes sharp plasteel claws to grow from one of the creature's limbs.

This booster can't be crafted, only scavenged.

Self-assembling machinery that fuses with the specimen’s nerve centers during the growth process. Allows hybrids to be drafted and creates a strong mechanite skin that protects the animal from harm.

This booster can't be crafted, only scavenged.

A fertility booster that also forces the produced embryo to develop female characteristics. Effectively allows hybrids to reproduce with the exact same species.

This booster can't be crafted, only scavenged.

Note: Insectoid hybrids are always incapable of reproducing.

A fertility booster that also forces the produced embryo to develop male characteristics. Effectively allows hybrids to reproduce with the exact same species.

This booster can't be crafted, only scavenged.

Note: Insectoid hybrids are always incapable of reproducing.

Capsules containing genetic stabilizers that help maintain the dominant-recessive genome relationship. Greatly reduces the chance of the hybrid having the opposite intended result, at the expense of more processing time.

This booster can't be crafted, only scavenged.

Capsules containing genetic restorative medicine that helps prevent genomes from breaking down prematurely. Greatly helps mitigate the possibility of the hybrid ending in complete failure, at the expense of more processing time.

This booster can't be crafted, only scavenged.

A high-tech device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. This particular module is capable of producing an incendiary explosion around its user by releasing a concoction of volatile chemicals through vent-like openings. While the host is shielded from the blast, any nearby allies or structures will be affected. Syncing with other modules of the same kind allows it to work with greater efficiency.
Install this in a pawn. When that pawn dies, explodes like a molotov cocktail.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm replacement. This particular model includes a modified incendiary launcher that can be fully retracted outside of combat, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. This particular module comes with a compact storage and launch system for deploying incendiary IED traps from a distance. The implant needs to be loaded with incendiary shells in order to function.
An incense holder.
A decorative vessel made for burning sticks of incense. An ornament that increases the beauty of any space containing one.

The Indian elephant is one of the largest unmodified land animals. In general, Indian elephants are smaller, have smaller ears, but relatively broader skulls and larger trunks than African elephants, and have the highest body point on the head.
A sturdy backpack that distributes weight and increases the wearer's carrying capacity.
A less-than-lethal applicator of blunt trauma to foreheads. This one is made from industrial-grade steel and more sophisticated than the ones one could smith together from whatever material.
A single-use industrial-tier launcher that fires a high-explosive rocket.

A steel doorframe.
Its reddish rusted surface evokes the look of an old, well-worn starship.

Slightly improves room beauty, but has no other effects. Not paintable.

A short sword invented by the Romans. Its main use is to stab. And then twist. This one is made from industrial-grade steel and more sophisticated than the ones one could smith together from whatever material.

A nifty tool/weapon that can both be used to put nails in, and allows you to cosplay that your enemies are nails. This one is made from industrial-grade steel and more sophisticated than the ones one could smith together from whatever material.

One of the oldest tools in human history - a blade with a handle. Useful for stabbing people and there's not a single job that doesn't benefit from a knife. This one is made from industrial-grade steel and more sophisticated than the ones one could smith together from whatever material.

A two-handed, long-bladed weapon invented for one-to-one combat. Useful for slashing and stabbing. This one is made from industrial-grade steel and more sophisticated than the ones one could smith together from whatever material.

A weapon designed for tackling mechanoids. Mounted electrical capacitors reload with the strikes and discharge EM Pulses to stun the attacked machine. This one is made from industrial-grade steel and more sophisticated than the ones one could smith together from whatever material.

A combination of two ancient designs: a hammer, and a long stick. It's used to bludgeon enemies' armor inwards, hurting them with blunt trauma and sharp edges of their own apparel. This one is made from industrial-grade steel and more sophisticated than the ones one could smith together from whatever material.
A shiny metal sign. Looks better than the plain kind of sign.

An industrial-grade skip designed to hold various types of waste, including corpses, chunks, slags, and wastepacks. Items stored inside will not deteriorate over time and have no impact on the beauty of their surroundings, however you will still need to freeze certain items. 

<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> 
Stack size total: 18 
Stack per tile: 9 

Allowed items: Chunks, Corpses, Wastepacks, Recycle packs, Fecal sludge

Possibly the oldest and most prolific weapon design in history of mankind. A tipped blade on a long stick. This one is made from industrial-grade steel and more sophisticated than the ones one could smith together from whatever material.

The industrial tool set for crafting is a comprehensive collection of high-quality tools specifically engineered for precision work in manufacturing, construction, or fabrication industries. This robust kit comprises a diverse range of instruments tailored to handle various materials and tasks with efficiency and accuracy.
Chemically inactive flasks. Can be placed on top of tables for decoration.
Chemically inactive vials. Can be placed on top of tables for decoration.

A small, floating gelatinous creature propelled by the hydrogen it collects from water and various plant matter. These squishy creatures wander the lands, aimlessly bouncing off objects in their path.

Aerofleets are genderless, and reproduce by strobilation, a form of asexual reproduction. Asexual creatures like this one can't be sterilized. As a floating creature, aerofleets ignore terrain movement costs.

Aerofleets slowly produce a thick, gelatinous substance known as blue gel. This syrupy residue can be collected and refined into an energy-dense compound. The compound can be used to build powerful batteries and generators with the appropriate research.

This aerofleet seems to have been affected by prolonged exposure to the gases emanating from an ocular forest. Red pustules and blisters are appearing in its exterior membrane and its hydrogen seems to be in the process of being turned into an acidic gas.
An incendiary-shot mini-artillery device. It fires a large incendiary warhead.
Slowly extracts deepchem using atoms extracted from the air and deep crust. A sustainable way to extract Deepchem indefinitely.

Infused oil is crafted by steeping rich oil with herbal medicine or aromatic spices inside an infuser, allowing their flavors and essences to meld over time. The result is a fragrant, golden liquid.

<color=#E5E54C>Trade considerations</color>:

<color=#E5E54C>Ingredients:</color> Making 10 infused oil requires 10 oil plus 10 herbal medicine for a total of 200 value, and sells for 45, giving a <color=#33CC33>55.56%</color> profit per unit.

<color=#E5E54C>Fermentation time:</color> 10 days.

<color=#E5E54C>Caravan trading:</color> Its weight is 0.3 Kg, for a value per Kg of <color=#33CC33>150</color>.

<color=#E5E54C>Profit per day:</color> On average, assuming corn to create the oil plus herbal medicine, profit per day is <color=#33CC33>1.07</color> (for reference Yayo is 0.35).

A specialized workstation designed to steep herbs, fruits, and exotic ingredients into other artisan crafts. By carefully controlling temperature and infusion time, it creates infused oils, vinegars, and other artisanal delicacies.
Infusion obtained from opium poppy. It can be injected or re-purified to produce a more potent opioid.
Infusion obtained from peyote fruit; it is known to have hallucinogenic properties.
The infusion obtained from the thorn weed contains a neurotoxin. It is ineffective and harmless in small doses.
A shelf for storing miscellaneous items. Items stored in this will not affect room beauty and they won't deteriorate, even if outside.
Ingots stacked in an efficient manner to save more space.
Ingots stacked in an efficient manner to save more space.
Ingots stacked in an efficient manner to save more space.
Some shelves scattered with syringes and medical supplies.
A wooden hanging sign use to symbolize the purpose of a room.
Sweet insect jelly pudding
Insect jelly processed into a sweetener. Applying the sweetener to a gourmet meal will grant it a mood-boosting effect.
An object with ideoligious significance.
A humanlike being with four arms, four eyes, and four times the chance of frightening outlanders.
Sweet insect jelly pudding, plastic fake.
An extremely thick composition of rare minerals and biomass, commonly found in a form of insect exoskeletons.
These raw hides and pelts were removed from a creature, and with the right skills and tools, could be processed into tanned leather.

A payload of insectoid genetic material. Can be used at the genomorpher to create a growth cell of a hybrid animal. This tier 2 genome can only be used as primary genome.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All hybrids with insectoid genome get 100% toxic resistance as well as an armor increase. Combat hybrids get a further increase to armor.

<color=#E5E54C>Extraction:</color> Can only be extracted via any genome excavator from:
installed

A terrifying callback to the original Sorne geneline, this mobile hive was originally designed to engage the mechanoid enemy head-on. By carrying an entire colony of insects with hardened mandibles, their ability to practically disassemble the mechanical menace proved just as effective at turning against their human overlords.

A perfect insectoid animal, paragon of all similar animals with no needless junk genetic data. Besides the various improvements to the baseline animal’s abilities, this paragon is extremely intelligent and carries a dangerous brood of warrior flies. A burst of pheromones summons the drones to protect their hive and queen, shredding apart all other nearby creatures.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All insectoid hybrids have good armor and no toxic sensitivity, but they are always sterile and can't reproduce, even if a fertility booster is used to create them. Insect clouds ability: twice a day it can create insect clouds around it that damage any animal crossing them, except insectoid paragons, which are immune.

A giant, genetically-engineered insectoid responsible for creating new spawn. A broodmother to the insects in her hive, the princess doesn’t do heavy work, and tries to avoid combat if possible. As massive as an adult thrumbo, the princess instills fear in most opponents. Her thick chitinous armor makes her hard to kill, whilst long, deadly blades can tear through plasteel shielding in seconds. Despite being quite slow in open terrain, an insectoid princess is capable of creating new swarmlings at a rapid pace, and should never be allowed to settle down.
These hybrid humanoid / insectoid receptors can be implanted in a subject's nose, completely modifying the way the subject

An instructions manual to assemble furniture. You WILL have a spare bolt.

An ancient, specialized implant involved introducing carefully selected parasites into the body, endowing the subject with a body akin to bulletproof fibers and enhancing muscular strength. However, the technology behind it has been entirely lost and cannot be replicated.

An intelligence map that records a certain location.

Pot for red wine.

A giant, genetically-engineered insectoid responsible for the hive defense. The incredible claws the size of a failed vidtuber’s ego can break and crush anything trying to harm the new spawn. A giant beetle genetically engineered by a mining company a long time ago. It's a peaceful farm animal that occasionally sheds metallic husks that can be used as steel, thus negating the need for heavy machinery in mining operations. As a downside, the beetle consumes a huge amount of wood from live trees.

The mining company responsible for the ironhusk beetles didn't account for this and several planets are now a barren ecological disaster.

Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

It is not a very good runner, and to compensate for that, it sports huge incisors that could prove very dangerous to lesser predators.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.
Wool from a josephoartigasia. Provides good insulation from both cold and heat. Very fluffy.

The gland forms a network of cryptotechnological thermoregulating structures across the epedermis that prevent frostbite and greatly increase resistance to extreme temperatures.
A drug developed by Urbworld governments to keep their citizens in check. It produces a strong euphoric high and is very addictive.

A high-tech device that can be installed into any compatible artificial spine replacement. This particular model comes with a modified jump pack. It is compact enough to fully retract into the body and can be carried around with ease, though it has a lower charge capacity as a result. The module uses chemfuel in order to function and has to be reloaded after use.
A full body jumpsuit made out of thick fabric or leather. Excellent for general body protection and manual labour.

A mutant variation of the feralisk that has adapted to living in deep, dark jungles. Some even say that the junglelisk is the progenitor of all the variants of lisks. They reproduce at a very fast rate and female junglelisks can store the genetic material to lay eggs long after they've been fertilized.

Junglelisks attack by throwing huge webs at their prey. These webs stun and cover anything they touch in acid, allowing the junglelisk to close in and finish the kill with their fearsome venom laced fangs.
A fertilized junglelisk egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a junglelisk. Inedible.
An ordinary footprint.
Kaleidos crystal, used to make vitamin f.

This pherocore belongs to the mutated geneline from the toxic world of Kemia, known for their ability to use toxins to dispose of their enemies.
A simple square of fabric that keeps hair off the face. Improves cook speed and cleaning speed.
A flowing peice of fabric that covers the head and ears. Improves plant work speed and yield.
A thick sauce made from stewing tomatoes. Applying the sauce to a gourmet meal grants it a mood-boosting effect.
A cast-iron weight with a handle, used for dynamic strength exercises.
A keyboard.
A long strip of cloth that is wrapped over the eyes to block vision. Children have a habit of peeking out of it, even when told not to.
A child-sized garment that conceals the wearer's entire head and body.
A nice-looking collared shirt with buttons. A step up from the regular t-shirt, and worn by children who want to be treated like adults.
A short cape of elegant design. It hangs over one side of the torso. It is the dream of many children to own one.

A suit of heavy powered armor, built for maximum protection at the cost of mobility. Heavy layered plasteel-weave plates with solid ablative coatings stop all but the most well-aimed or powerful attacks. Neuro-memetic assistors prevent the suit's massive weight from immobilizing the wearer entirely, but the suit is still quite cumbersome.

Completely impractical for any child to wear even if assigned to patrol their outpost, it is worn only in the most desperate emergencies. If children are being sent to siege a position in this armor, their commander should re-evaluate their choices as of late.
A small crown-like piece of headwear made of metal. The mark of any worthy heir to the throne.

A crown of metal with an elaborate design. Even most nobles consider a crown of this complexity for a child to be utterly wasteful. To see such a crown for a child is either a sign of great wealth, or misplaced priorities.

A child-sized duster coat for blocking the sun and grit of the outdoors. Essential for any frontier deputy, and good protection if the most dangerous thing around your settlement is a manhunting rabbit.

A lightweight helmet designed for psychic focusing. While it provides little physical protection, its special materials enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity and dissipate neural heat. Children in these helmets are often those selected to become great psycasters.

A long robe embedded with special psychic focusing materials. These enhance psychic sensitivity and help dissipate neural heat. Coveted amongst the most elite psycasting apprentices of the empire, it is a symbol of top students.

A shirt embedded with special psychic focusing materials. These enhance psychic sensitivity and help dissipate neural heat. The fashionable choice among aspiring psycaster apprentices, they are hard to find outside academics of the empire.

A tight skullcap designed for psychic focusing. It provides no physical protection, but its special materials enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity and dissipate neural heat. A favorite choice of children destined to become imperial psycasters.

A thin vest embedded with special psychic focusing materials. These enhance psychic sensitivity and help dissipate neural heat. Coveted by children of the upper class in psycasting apprenticeships as a sign of true class and old money wealth.
A lightweight combat helmet with a complex design, reinforced with plasteel. For the especially valuable conscript, to keep them alive long enough to die as an adult instead.

A small yet tough fabric jacket with armor plates sewn in. While it's not as good as solid armor, it offers effective protection against raiders and opportunistic wargs while remaining quite comfortable. It is credited with saving the lives of many children on the rimworlds by giving adults time to reach and rescue them.

A child-sized pair of pants with armor plates sewn in. Popular among military school cadets for both their comfort and protection, they are often flaunted as a status symbol to those with mere regular pants.
A small vest with armor plates inserted on the chest and back. Popular among hussar cadets and warworld conscripts, if a child is wearing this, something has gone terribly wrong already.
A decorated formal shirt with buttons. Mostly worn by the children of colonial governors in the empire, and other well mannered offspring of society's best.
A vest embroidered with complex decorative designs. Appropriate for both the junior gentlemen and young ladies of the court, this garment is the mark of a distinguished noble-to-be.
A simple garment sized for kids, made for training.

A variant of marine armor with an integrated frag launcher on the shoulder. The armor is slightly less protective than standard marine armor. The launcher can only hold a limited amount of ammo and must be reloaded after use.

Cadets assigned this armor are typically enrolled near sites of mechanoid activity. It is not recommended for regular use, but can help children create an opportunity to escape a fight or stop a mechanoid in its tracks.

A heavy shoulder-belt for keeping spare munitions close at hand. It allows quick access to bullets, grenades, arrows, or whatever the user needs, reducing their weapon's ranged cooldown. Due to its bulk, it can't be worn under other clothing. Children tend to pick up cool rocks and sticks and store them in their bandoliers as well.
A tough jacket to stop scrapes and bruises, and to keep one warm in chilly weather. A favorite of schoolyard bullies, it is often worn by children who say the parka is worn by wimps.
A simple and casual robe sized for kids. It offers a relaxed fit for any season.

A knee-length overcoat worn over other clothing. While children are too young to conduct research alongside adults, the lab coat helps them to focus on their studies. It also has deep pockets for various shiny things they find neat.

A variant of recon armor with an integrated burst rocket for short-ranged flight. Locust armor is slightly less protective than standard recon armor. Each jump consumes a burst of fuel, so the armor must be reloaded after several uses.

Unlike most ultratech military units, locusts train primarily with melee weapons. These child-sized suits of armor are typically used for training by fighting small animals, or to leap out of the way of a raiding party. It does not stand up to any extended fight, and is best utilized to position cadets behind the adults and out of harm’s way.

A child-sized suit of powered armor. Layered plasteel-weave plates are very effective at stopping attacks, with few vulnerable joint sections. Neuro-memetic assistors allow a human to wear the armor and still move easily.

Armor like this is often gifted to military cadets showing great potential, and lets them survive long enough to reach said potential.

A child-sized power-assisted armor suit packed with mechanitor-assistance gear. The mechlord suit dramatically amplifies a mechanitor's bandwidth, but is somewhat less protective than dedicated heavy armor. Ideally, a child should not be commanding mechanoids.

A variant of cataphract armor with a shoulder-mounted flamebolt launcher. This armor is slightly less protective than standard cataphract armor against normal damage, but is especially flame-resistant. The flamebolt launcher has very limited ammo and must be reloaded after use.

Phoenixes specialize in clearing out very confined spaces full of enemies, with training programs for cadets in this armor being more rigorous than most. They can absorb hits while moving down a corridor, fill rooms with flame, and emerge from the smoke unscathed.
Plate armor pieces paired with a thick gambeson offer any young squire near full body protection.

A suit of heavy powered armor, built for maximum protection at the cost of mobility. Heavy layered plasteel-weave plates with solid ablative coatings stop all but the most well-aimed or powerful attacks. Neuro-memetic assistors prevent the suit's massive weight from immobilizing the wearer entirely, but the suit is still quite cumbersome.

Expensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity. But even this does not prevent most from seeing it as an expensive joke, as most children prefer mobility to learn and play.

A child-sized suit of powered armor. Layered plasteel-weave plates are very effective at stopping attacks, with few vulnerable joint sections. Neuro-memetic assistors allow a human to wear the armor and still move easily.

Expensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those destined to become high ranked military officers. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.

A child-sized suit of light partially-powered armor, designed to permit quick movement. Plasteel-weave plates block attacks without compromising mobility, and neuro-memetic assistors in the lower body allow a human to wear the armor and still move easily.

Expensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for the scions of esteemed military officers. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
A child-sized, flowing robe embroidered with complex decorative designs. Fit for a prince or princess waiting to ascend the throne.
A thin helmet containing finely-tuned sheets of psychically-absorptive foil. This genius invention was made to protect the children of the rimworlds from government psycasters.

A child-sized suit of light partially-powered armor, designed to permit quick movement. Lightweight plasteel-weave plates block attacks without compromising mobility, and neuro-memetic assistors in the lower body allow a human to wear the armor and still move easily.

Armor like this is often used by hussar-xenogerm candidates and glitterworld police cadets, and is coveted by many warworld conscripts.
A long, flowing robe without a hood. This one is child sized.

A long strip of material worn over one shoulder. It offers minimal protection from heat, cold, and attacks. Popular among youth scouting organizations, children add badges and patches to mark their achievements.

A thick cap made from animal skin with a wide brim, these hats are beloved by youth scouting organizations as a symbol of self reliance and authority. They are commonly worn by children alongside adults in tailcaps in the cold seasons.
A hard cap that partly covers the wearer's scalp. Most children view this headpiece as silly and uncomfortable.
A grand crown of metal with an elaborate, overbearing design. An incredibly wasteful use of materials, and too heavy to comfortably sit on a child's head.
A hard facial mask that resembles a stylized face. Very popular at ceremonial events like birthday parties, or for regular use by the socially shy.
A small and simple war mask. It hides the wearer's face and makes them less scared. It does not however, make them any less easy to kill.

Koalas are easily recognizable for their stout body and large, round heads with fluffy ears. They typically inhabit arid and temperate woodlands, but can rarely be seen in tropical areas. Favoured by royal families, koalas are great household animals due to their wonderful nuzzling effect.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.

A full body jumpsuit made out of thick fabric or leather, inspired by the outfit of Avatar Korra.
