People eat off tables when chairs are placed facing them.
People eat off tables when chairs are placed facing them.
People eat off tables when chairs are placed facing them.
A cathode ray tube display for showing moving pictures with sound. Even on the rimworlds, there is often an old transmitter running something at least marginally interesting.
A wall-mounted lamp that lights an area using electricity. It is less powerful than a standing lamp, but can be mounted on walls.
Automated rotary machine gun mounted on a quadpod.
A tabletop microphone.
A mysterious archotech tome with uncanny crafting abilities.
A small military backpack that is broken, but seems to contain something inside.
A soft, flat crowned hat. Often worn by the military as a symbol of valor.
A standard rank-and-file military cap meant to be worn during non-combat procedures, though brave officers are known to wear them during combat as well.
An all-purpose helicopter, with some armor to protect is passengers, useful for missions in remote areas.

A thick fabric military formal jacket used for certain ceremonies, receptions and celebrations. It contains orders, medals insignia and campaign ribbons. It is considered a symbol of courage and valor.
Inspired by the miner’s pickaxe, the military pick consists of a long shaft with a pointy spike designed to puncture armor more effectively than the tool that inspired its design.
Some shelves with scattered military supplies.

A refined turret with military-grade stabilization, targeting routines, and hardened casing. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.
A thick, protective coverall with a military camouflage.

Since ancient times, lords provided militia spears to their fyrd, the peasants who take up arms during wartime. Their reasoning was simple: rather than practice the bow or sword, one with low melee skill will be more effective hidden behind a shield and jabbing with a long, pointy stick. Low damage, but decent armor penetration and easy to use.
Sweet and tasty and bound to make anyone happy, this dessert has a tendency to disappear on the morning of December 10th. Fear not, however, as when it disappears, it increases festive favor greatly.
A small round stone for grinding raw plants.

A ravenous, animalistic being created by genetically modifying humans so intensely, they are no longer human. Mimes are psionically gifted parasites, using their mental powers to disguise themselves as normal humans. They infiltrate human communities and live among its members for weeks, months, or even years.

Their voracious appetites cause them to constantly consume the easily available food provided by a stable colony. They will only resort to directly attacking their hosts when the food runs out.
Mimic

A high-tech device that can be installed into an eye or any compatible artificial eye replacement. This particular model is able to quickly analyze a person's facial expression, speech and body language. The collected data is then forwarded to the user via a simple, non-intrusive interface. It's currently the closest thing to contactless mind reading a non-psycaster can hope for.
Useful herb that is used in creation of several powerful medicines.
A bundle of seeds for mindwort. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
An unfinished drone. This will deploy into a drone.

An advanced brain implant designed to assist the user in mining and act as a digital encyclopedia on that particular subject. The subpersona can quickly and accurately analyze different types of stone, soil and ores to plan out the most efficient way to unearth them.

A brain implant of such complexity requires time to synchronize with and adapt to its host in order to avoid excessive strain on the central nervous system, its effectiveness will slowly increase during this process. It's capable of syncing with other enhancements made to assist in similar tasks, greatly increasing efficiency.

A small holo glass panel.
It can be placed on tables or dressers as a simple decoration.
Due to its compact size, it doesn’t emit enough light to serve as a lamp.
A mini pallet that can hold up to 3 stacks of various items.
A small burst-oriented flamethrower used by mechanoids.
A compact, short-range shotgun designed to be mounted on a light combat mechanoid.

A high-tech device that can be installed into any compatible spine replacement. This particular module consists of a drone-like turret platform suspended mid-air, powered entirely by a gravcore and a chip-like implant that keeps the floating construct anchored to its user. While no outside input of fuel or energy is necessary for it to function, it does require time to self-recharge and for that reason the user is tasked with deciding when to activate it. This specific gravdrone is equipped with a standard mini-turret, whose low weight and energy consumption allow for faster recharging and longer operational time compared to most other models.
A small pack of ammunition and components that control a shoulder mounted mini-turret.

A multi-barrel machine gun mounted on sandbags to grant cover and provide stability. Where most self-loading guns are powered by the energy from the gunpowder, the minigun uses an electric motor to rapidly cycle cartridges through the weapon. Needs to be manned in order to fire. Requires steel to refurbish its barrels after heavy use.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm replacement. This particular model includes a modified minigun that can be fully retracted outside of combat, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

A heavy automatic turret. Its multi-barrel mechanism unleashes sustained fire at high speed, shredding lightly armored targets at mid-range. It may explode when damaged. Requires steel to refurbish its barrels after heavy use.
A set of tools designed for mining resources deep in the earth. Increases mining speed when placed near mining spots.
These raw hides and pelts were removed from a creature, and with the right skills and tools, could be processed into tanned leather.
A straw coat for cold of temperatures. Big and cumbersome.

Something went terribly wrong. This wretched creature is struggling to keep breathing. Whilst it doesn’t pose any real threat and it seems quite friendly, it requires a tremendous amount of love and attention for it to find the strength to live another day.

Bitter espresso mixed with cream or milk, then further mixed with mint oil and garnished. Cool and velvety coffee gives way to an even cooler, soothing aftertaste, not to mention great smelling breath.
Mint leaves are infamous for their cooling effect on one's mouth, as well as ease of seeping into an array of teas or delicately garnishing a dish. Mint leaves rot quite fast.
A bundle of seeds for mint plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
Black tea leaves mixed with mint leaves and deeply steeped, then garnished with additional mint leaves. Leaves your breath surprisingly fresh.
A handheld mirror.
Some shelves with scattered goods.
a lamp that shines light upwards.

A traditional paste made by fermenting soybeans with koji, known for its rich, savory flavor. It’s commonly used in soups, marinades, and sauces, adding a deep umami taste to a variety of dishes.

<color=#E5E54C>Trade considerations:</color>

<color=#E5E54C>Ingredients:</color> Making 5 miso requires 50 soybean with a total value of 55, and sells for 23, giving a <color=#33CC33>52.17%</color> profit per unit.

<color=#E5E54C>Fermentation time:</color> 18 days.

<color=#E5E54C>Caravan trading:</color> Its weight is 0.05 Kg, for a value per Kg of <color=#33CC33>460</color>.

<color=#E5E54C>Profit per day:</color> On average, profit per day is <color=#33CC33>0.51</color> (for reference, Yayo is 0.35).

A siege vehicle that needs to be deployed before combat, but is capable of launching heavy missile attacks in the area. It's vulnerable to enemy fire, and must be operated by a two-man crew to keep up its fast firing speed.
A tall, regal ceremonial headdress meant to adorn the head of leaders of Christian faith.
A simple pair of mittens.

A versatile kitchen appliance designed for combining, blending, and whipping ingredients together to create various culinary concoctions. Featuring a motorized base with multiple speed settings, a mixing bowl, and interchangeable attachments such as beaters, whisks, and dough hooks, the mixer offers convenience and efficiency in food preparation tasks.

A very large herbivore flightless bird native to the Earth islands of New Zealand. The moas lacked even the vestigial wings that all other ratites have. Moas feed on a range of plant species and plant parts, including fibrous twigs and leaves taken from low trees and shrubs.
A fertilized moa egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby moa. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
An unfertilized moa egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
A well-crafted pair of leather moccasins.
Coffee mixed with sweet and luxurious chocolate, very fun to drink. Those of snobbish persuasion would argue mocha is more of a dessert than an actual coffee drink.
A clothing model dummy.
A clothing model dummy.
A modern painting placed upon an easel.

Molasses is a thick, dark syrup created as a byproduct of the sugar refining process, especially from sugarcane. It has a rich, bittersweet flavor and is often used in baking and cooking.

<color=#E5E54C>Trade considerations:</color>

<color=#E5E54C>Ingredients:</color> Making 50 molasses requires 10 sugar for a total value of 121, and sells for 8, giving a <color=#33CC33>69.75%</color> profit per unit.

<color=#E5E54C>Value per work:</color> Recipe requires 1250 work, which results on a value per work of <color=#33CC33>0.32</color>.

<color=#E5E54C>Caravan trading:</color> Its weight is 0.05 Kg, for a value per Kg of <color=#33CC33>160</color>.

<color=#E5E54C>Profit per day:</color> On average, profit per day is <color=#33CC33>0.25</color> (for reference Yayo is 0.35).
A biochip that reduces pain sensitivity, allowing the subject to survive pain shock.

Far too independent to be a combat animal but certainly can both dish out and take pain. Works best in the background, minding its own business and digging up metals it finds. No one is really sure why but it probably has to do with those massive whiskers.

A rodent hybrid with recessive ursine genes. An independent predator with a very low metabolism and high toughness. Has an unusual behaviour where it’ll periodically dig for treasures, typically raw metals.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All rodent hybrids have fast gestation, as long as a fertility unblocker was used when creating them in the genomorpher.
A workstation for dismantling dead mechanoids with atomic precision. Mechanoid remains processed using this technology will yield double the usual products. Mechanoid slag will also yield plasteel.

An oversized naked mole-rat with frighteningly large chompers, however they’re not as dangerous as they look as they are quite timid and use said teeth for chewing up tough vegetables. Objectively cute when you give them a good brushing, but have a nasty habit of overshooting hand-fed snacks and biting on hands due to poor eyesight. A saddle is recommended for riding, as there is little fat and no fur to cushion their boney structure and loose skin.

An equine hybrid with recessive rodent genes. Quite small and lacking in durability, but surprisingly capable as a mount. Exceedingly filthy for an animal that eats so little, however this is tied to its rapid gestation and faint regenerative capabilities.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All equine hybrids are good for caravaning. A caravan with one of them needs a shorter resting period, only stopping to rest between 23:30 PM and 4 AM.

A hulking monstrosity that is genuinely caring for those around them, taking great joy and actual personal pleasure through working diligently and caring for those it considers friends and family. Evidently, it was bred specifically by megacorporations to work in dangerous mines, because human greed never changes.

A rodent hybrid with recessive humanoid genes. Very low hunger rate and very intelligent, these gentle giants enjoy digging with their hands. They will sometimes work mining orders given the chance but they’re very slow due to their bulk.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Humanoid hybrids will periodically engage other colonists in conversation, talking about a variety of topics. This increases the social recreation needs of those they interact with by 10% (subject to diminishing returns like all joy types). If using Ideology, humanoid hybrids are subject to precepts. Molemen will periodically obey commands to mine. This will also work with the Quarry mod.
a cheap office computer. Play some classic games on it.

Glass bottles filled with flammable liquid, with a burning cloth in the neck, strapped to a belt. A favorite weapon of hooligans and desperate warriors from rim to rim. They can be thrown a short distance, where they'll explode, damaging anything and anyone nearby, setting chemfuel on fire. Can be reloaded using molotovs.
A decorative CRT Monitor.
A decorative CRT Monitor.
A decorative CRT Monitor.
A traditional heavy robe with the hood down

A crystal-metallic variation of an arm-blade, infused with mechanites that maintain a monomolecular cutting edge. It cuts through even thick armor with ease, and its light weight permits fast attacks. When retracted, neuromuscular synchronisation makes it appear and function like a normal arm.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. This particular model is equipped with a retractable, flexible and razor-sharp mantis-like blade. Can be adjusted to fit a variety of fighting styles.

It has been enhanced using mono weapon components, resulting in combat performance and effectiveness comparable to that of a monosword.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. This particular model is equipped with a set of plasteel claws that can be fully retracted outside of combat, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

It has been enhanced using mono weapon components, resulting in combat performance and effectiveness comparable to that of a monosword.
It is a round and stylish monocle. They look smart.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into a jaw or any compatible artificial jaw replacement. This particular model comes with a set of razor-sharp plasteel teeth and compact hydraulics that allow the user to bite with incredible force.

It has been enhanced using mono weapon components, resulting in combat performance and effectiveness comparable to that of a monosword.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. This particular model’s retractable parts allow the whole limb to become a deadly chainsaw-like weapon.

It has been enhanced using mono weapon components, resulting in combat performance and effectiveness comparable to that of a monosword.

A high-tech device that can be installed onto the forehead. Its modular design allows it to instead enhance the host's horn or horns if they already possess any. This particular model comes with a pair of sharp plasteel horn-shaped protrusions which can act both as an odd fashion statement and an unusual weapon.

It has been enhanced using mono weapon components, resulting in combat performance and effectiveness comparable to that of a monosword.

A high-tech device that can be installed onto any tail or compatible tail replacement. This particular model is equipped with a retractable plasteel blade along with various skeletal and muscle enhancements that allows an animal to use it in combat as if it were an additional limb regardless of how unfit for fighting its natural tail may be.

It has been enhanced using mono weapon components, resulting in combat performance and effectiveness comparable to that of a monosword.

A massive, powerful, and deeply intelligent creature that can somehow ascertain when they are close to death. They'll instinctively direct themselves to an arid shrubland known as the gallatross graveyard, and die there alone, far from their group. A gallatross might expend as long as two decades roaming around a graveyard.

This gallatross knows it's nearing death and is preparing to die alone.
A fierce and deadly mace loved by raiders and bandits for its blunt damage, as well as puncturing damage thanks to the spikes mounted around the head.
Rice mash. This substance needs to fermented and aged in a sake barrel before becoming drinkable sake.
A derivative of opium poppy latex. This much stronger opioid also acts as a powerful painkiller, usually lasting 2 to 3 hours.

A traditional culinary tool consisting of a sturdy bowl (mortar) and a blunt, club-shaped instrument (pestle). Used for grinding, crushing, and mixing herbs, spices, and other ingredients, it offers a timeless method for preparing flavorful concoctions and unlocking the aromas and flavors of various substances through manual pulverization.
A sign about a huge prehistoric sea creature.

Mosasaurus swam using its long crocodile-like body in an undulating motion to swim and devoured all kinds of prey with its massive jaws and sharp, cone-shaped teeth. It lives and hunts the well-lit surface waters of the oceans.

Scientific name: Mosasaurus hoffmannii
A very tough silk extracted from angel moths. Very poor insulator.
Starched fabric that covers the head and ears.

A motorcycle that can quickly and discretely transport a single person and a small amount of cargo. Has a good fuel efficiency in the world map, and can move well in any terrain except snow, or during winter.
A bundle of seeds for mountain flower. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A slender-bodied, long-tailed dove recognized by its delicate gray-brown plumage and soft, mournful cooing call. These birds are not domesticated and will wander.
A fertilized mourning dove egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a chick. It can be eaten, but why would you do such a thing?
An unfertilized mourning dove egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
A bionic vomeronasal organ that allows the subject pheromonal communication with other animals, increasing the chance of taming and training them successfully.

A massive, mobile hive of giant exo-geneline insects, propelled by the coordinated effort of numerous emerging exoworms. When sufficiently threatened, the entire structure animates to actively defend itself, attacking nearby foes.

Raw mud splasher carp. A species of oily freshwater fish from the family Cyprinidae. These carps are fond of mud-saturated waters, where they remain motionless, buried in the mud, and wait for prey to come within ambush distance before pouncing.
Blocks of solid mudstone.

A payload of muffalo genetic material. Can be used at the genomorpher to create a growth cell of a hybrid animal. This tier 1 genome can be used as either a primary or secondary genome.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All muffalo hybrid animals are pack animals, with primary muffalo hybrids getting 50% increased capacity caravaning. All muffalo hybrids have an increase to minimum comfortable temperature.

<color=#E5E54C>Extraction:</color> Can be extracted via the genome extractor table or any genome excavator from:
installed
By implanting muffalo mammaries into a colonist... Wait, what??? Who came up with this idea????? Anyway... this implant allows your colonist to be milked... What the...

A return to simpler times, when everyone could have sworn blind that muffalos used to be able to produce milk but were instead fooled by hornless paragons.

A perfect muffalo animal, paragon of all similar animals with no needless junk genetic data. Besides the various improvements to the baseline animal’s abilities, this paragon also produces milk and can be slaughtered for a valuable pelt, which can either be used for decoration or sold.
Cool! You can now make your own Game of Thrones / Rimworld cosplay! Or it can also be repurposed as a comfy rug.
A muffalo pelt rug. Taxidermy seems to be in vogue on the Rim!
A plush muffalo.

A synthetic skin substitute that is much thicker and a much better insulator than human skin. This provides a measure of defense but, more importantly, makes the subject more resistant to low temperatures.
By weaving muffalo muscle strands with the subjects muscular system, strength, resilience and carrying capacity are greatly increased.

An absolute unit of a muffalo hybrid with muscles bursting underneath the layers of fur and fat. An excellent caravan companion for those wanting to transport lots of goods and hot muffalobear milk makes living in eternal winter seem almost worth it.

A muffalo hybrid with recessive ursine genes. While they are slower and eat more compared to a regular muffalo, they are better at self defence and offer the highest carry capacity of all primary muffalo hybrids. They also produce good thick wool and delicious yet simple milk.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All primary muffalo hybrids have 150% carrying capacity on caravans.
A delicious milk with roasted overtones. Very pleasurable to eat, but not very nutritious.

Combining fierce independence with an animal suited for travelling long distances might not have been the best idea. But critics have clearly never been nuzzled by a giant cat only to be buried alive in a pile of insulating hair in the winter, so what do they know.

A muffalo hybrid with recessive feline genes. Not the best for caravan duty but their regular grooming produces bundles of thick wool and can be milked for a rather disgusting milk filled with hair. A low maintenance way of getting more hair than you bargained for.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Produces wool without needing to be sheared. All primary muffalo hybrids have 150% carrying capacity on caravans. Like all cat hybrids, they have an improved melee dodge ability and a short nuzzle period.

Don’t let its adorable appearance fool you, this beastie is ready to fly off its handle at a moment's notice. The more it’s hurt, the more pissed off it gets and the faster it’ll try to rip its enemies to shreds.

A muffalo hybrid with recessive avian genes. A bit too slow and weak for a caravan companion but it makes  for a vicious and suicidal protective companion. Produces a thick, chunky milk that tastes like a protein shake.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> The melee cooldown of its attacks scales with the percentage of lost health, up to 6 times faster. All primary muffalo hybrids have 150% carrying capacity on caravans.
This lumpy milk seems to have concentrated protein chunks, tasting like chicken nuggets. Disgusting, but colonists seem to like it.

Belligerent bulls with a penchant for the tastes of the wild wastes. A herd of these creatures can be occasionally seen trawling through regions, consuming practically all edible vegetation and leaving fertile waste in their path. Some argue that this is the ideal form of muffalo for nomad tribes, as they produce everything they need to survive winters and are large enough to feed said tribe through the harshest of seasons.

An equine hybrid with recessive muffalo genes. Very unusual in that it doesn’t help a caravan speed along, largely due to it excessively foraging and eating various vegetation from new locations, as well as roughage to help with digestion. The benefit from this behaviour is that this stimulation is the only way it’ll produce milk and wool, so herds of these hybrids can be taken on a long journey to provide produce vital to small and starting colonies.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All equine hybrids are good for caravaning. A caravan with one of them needs a shorter resting period, only stopping to rest between 23:30 PM and 4 AM.

Milking snakes for venom in order to create medicine is an extremely dangerous career. While this particular beast of burden proved to be capable in other areas, it was mainly synthesised in order to provide a safer way of sourcing an anaesthetic coagulant to be used in emergencies. Or someone was trying to get high by milking a reptilian space cow, who really knows.

A reptile hybrid with recessive muffalo genes. A strong pack animal with a massive appetite and a proportionate filth rate. Quite durable and will prove a fatal mistake for any animal that attempts to hunt them, as their fangs, horns and claws are all venomous. Can be milked every ten days for a vial of paralysing coagulant, best used for large animals that are suffering from multiple lacerations.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All reptile hybrids have good temperature tolerance ranges and venomous attacks.

The animal we’ve all been waiting for, namely one that not only cleans up after itself but for others as well. Their fur is surprisingly soft and has antibacterial properties, which it uses along with its fingered paws to clean surfaces. Once the fur starts to become matted is when it needs to be trimmed.

A muffalo hybrid with recessive humanoid genes. Quite intelligent but they lose out on a lot of their progenitor’s hardiness against the cold. They are also very clean animals and will clean areas around the colony, and can be sheared regularly for a decent amount of wool.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Humanoid hybrids will periodically engage other colonists in conversation, talking about a variety of topics. This increases the social recreation needs of those they interact with by 10% (subject to diminishing returns like all joy types). If using Ideology, humanoid hybrids are subject to precepts. All primary muffalo hybrids have 150% carrying capacity on caravans. Muffalomen are clean muffalo hybrids that will periodically clean around the colony.

A very naughty hybrid that can be told to relieve itself on command, creating puddles of chemfuel-infused urine around it. For those who just want to watch the world burn in the most vulgar way.

A muffalo hybrid with recessive boomalope genes. A bit too slow for a caravan companion but make up for it with intelligence and an unusual chemfuel ability that lends itself for defence.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All primary muffalo hybrids have 150% carrying capacity on caravans.

An oversized grub with udders that extrude jelly instead of milk, its hard-headedness serves it well in both getting what it wants and nutting anyone foolish enough to think they’re better than them. Allegedly there was a case where the owner was prevented from shearing the creature for so long that the overlapping plates completely prevented it from moving, who was afterwards thanked with a kick in the nether region.

An insectoid hybrid with recessive muffalo genes. Higher metabolism compared to other insectoid hybrids as well as stubborn, any predator foolish enough to think of them as an easy meal will be responded with a headbutt like a sledgehammer. Can work as a pack animal but refuses to haul comparatively heavy loads. Regularly produces precious jelly and can be sheared for chitin, which overlaps and protects the animal well from blunt attacks.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All insectoid hybrids have good armor and no toxic sensitivity, but they are always sterile and can't reproduce, even if a fertility booster is used to create them.

Breeding a muffalo hybrid into such a small package means they have very little capacity for either wool or milk. They’re very quick though, and your handlers better be quicker on their daily milking and shearing.

A muffalo hybrid with recessive rodent genes. Very weak as a pack animal but they breed quickly and can be milked and sheared daily. The amount of product is small, but it’s thick wool and nutritious milk.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All primary muffalo hybrids have 150% carrying capacity on caravans.

Someone clearly wanted multiple muffalos that would be capable of tearing foolish attackers to shreds. They eat a ton but those massive teeth of theirs aren’t just good at chewing up vegetation. Plus they’re incredibly cute when they wag their massive tails.

A muffalo hybrid with recessive canine genes. The combination of lethality, speed and high intelligence makes this hybrid a fierce pack animal, both figuratively and literally. Capable of pack tactics with other muffalowolves that further increase their melee dodge, hit chance and dps.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> The pack tactics ability will give any muffalowolves around bonuses to melee dps, melee dodge and melee hit chance. All primary muffalo hybrids have 150% carrying capacity on caravans.
An object with ideoligious significance.
An object with ideoligious significance.
Warm shoes crafted with ancient techniques. They take a long time to craft, but keep snow off your feet.
Raw mulberry.

Produced from the luscious bounty of mulberry orchards, often associated with the mulberry tree's role in nurturing silk worms. Aged vintages whisper tales of sophistication, beckoning connoisseurs with their intricate flavors, a staple of esteemed gatherings and royal banquets.
Crushed mulberries. Needs to undergo fermentation in a rustic fermenting barrel in order to become wine.

A state-of-the-art device optimized for material acquisition and crafting in futuristic settings. This advanced tool integrates cutting-edge technology, including molecular scanners, energy manipulators, and nano-fabrication capabilities. It can analyze and harvest raw materials from various sources, manipulate their molecular structures, and fabricate them into desired components or objects. With its compact design and versatile functionality, the sci-fi multitool revolutionizes resource procurement and crafting processes, making it an indispensable tool for explorers, engineers, and artisans across the galaxy.
An embalmed and mummified corpse
An embalmed and mummified corpse
Also known as a sausage cat, this new cat breed has distinctively short legs. Sweet natured, playful and people-oriented, these cats are perfect companions for people with lazy lifestyle.
An odachi with an eerie red blade said to have been stained with the blood of all those lives it has taken. Legend says that a Muramasa is a demonic blade with a supernatural thirst for blood.

A distant relative of the nightling. They are not as fierce as the nightling nor are they proficient hunters, often scavenging in packs for scraps left behind by predators.  Their most distinctive features are the elongated structures on their snouts, which produce specific vibrational sequences that allow for discrete communication between pack members. Their physical weakness is compensated for with above average intellect, allowing them to outsmart many types of animals.

A murkling can spread the bubonic plague upon biting living creatures. The delicate tendrils on their snouts can dissolve nearby corpses and turn them into semi-liquid carrion that they can consume.

A high-tech device that can be installed onto a kidney or any compatible artificial kidney replacement. This particular model utilizes specialized mechanites and advanced filtration systems specifically engineered to detect and combat muscle parasites, granting complete immunity to their infections. It is largely ineffective against other diseases and infections.
A fragrant soup consisting of minced sauteed mushrooms in a rich milky broth, making for a bold-tasting, somewhat hearty meal.
These mushroom stalks have been hardened by age until they are almost as firm as a low quality wood. Very flammable, and not very resistant.
A bundle of seeds for mushrooms. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

A long-barreled, smoothbore firearm, the musket is a weapon of the line infantry. The lead ball loses velocity and damage with distance, and is extremely ineffective against armor. Due to the chempowder reaction when firing the musket, plumes of blindsmoke are ejected from the barrel.

A massive containment engine built around a tri-core genoquench reactor and layered inhibition plates designed to neutralize runaway mutagenic surges. Thick conduits cycle suppressive counterwaves that smother mutation cascades before they can form.

Removes all mutation outcome chances entirely when linked to an Archogen Injector, but greatly increases the rejection chance.

Up to 1 mutagen inhibitor core can link to a single archogen injector.
This arm twitches and bends in strange unnatural ways, as if it had a mind of its own. Something seems... off about it, as if it wasn't a completely natural creation.

This eye constantly blinks on its own, like a nervous tic, and a second set of vertical eyelids seems to be present behind the normal, human ones. Something seems... off about it, as if it wasn't a completely natural creation.

Raw mutant flatfish. A relative of the oceanic sole, this three-eyed flatfish is a bottom-dwelling species feeding on small crustaceans and other invertebrates. It inhabits both saltwater and brackish waters.
This leg seems to be covered in a slick secretion that constantly drips from every pore. Something seems... off about it, as if it wasn't a completely natural creation.

A variant of the overgrown colossus native to mycotic jungles. They are reptilian in nature, with cold blood and a slow metabolism. They have six legs, two intertwined spines, and six eyes.

It has a symbiotic relationship with fungi, with several mutant agarilux mushrooms growing on its back. These fungi trap insects and seem to provide sustenance in a symbiotic relationship with the colossus.

This colossus reproduces by sporulation, so its children are completely wild and independent of it, with no concept of parenthood. Asexual creatures like this one can't be sterilized.

When tamed, the mycoid colossus can be periodically trimmed to obtain raw agarilux mushrooms.
Fertilized mycoid colossus spores. If all goes well, it should bud into a baby mycoid colossus. It can be eaten raw, and isn't much better cooked.

Cotton-like, edible fabric extracted from mycothread mushrooms. It’s soft to the touch and easy to work with, deteriorates quickly, has an unusual color, and oddly still smells and tastes like mushrooms.
A bundle of seeds for mycothread mushroom. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A bundle of seeds for mystic cap. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A ghoul is often described as a reanimated corpse with an insatiable appetite for human flesh. Legends depict it is particularly drawn to burial sites and desolate locales.
A ghoul is often described as a reanimated corpse with an insatiable appetite for human flesh. Legends depict it is particularly drawn to burial sites and desolate locales.
Sharp, twisted horns from a Nachzehrer, known for their hardness and used in crafting powerful weapons or ritualistic items.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.
A polearm with a single edged bladed at the end. The naginata is the iconic weapon of ancient female samurai warriors.
An ancient ornate armet masterfully smithed by the under-forges of the ancient empire. It gives great protection for one's visage and embelishes an awe inspiring grace.

Few men can don armor as protective as the full plate set, which offers the greatest protection in the form of layered metal plates. They are nobles, lords, and men with the fortune required to purchase the masterfully crafted armor that effectively blocks many attacks. Light shining against the polished metal tells the enemy that the wearer is not only rich but also a lord of war.

A heavier version of the two-handed axe, the greataxe’s weight allows for high raw damage as well as solid durability. A great option for splitting shields or unarmored enemies. Requires great strength to wield effectively.

A humongous, two-handed sword with a long blade, capable of cleaving enemies with fierce swings and chops. Decent at long thrusts as well. 

An ancient relic of the long forgotten under-empires. A masterfully crafted blade able to carve through plates of steel with its edge unwavering.
The reach of the greatsword allows it to strike enemies much further away.

A humongous, two-handed sword with a long blade, capable of cleaving enemies with fierce swings and chops. Decent at long thrusts as well. 

An ancient relic of the long forgotten under-empires. A masterfully crafted blade able to carve through plates of steel with its edge unwavering.
The reach of the greatsword allows it to strike enemies much further away.

A humongous, two-handed sword with a long blade, capable of cleaving enemies with fierce swings and chops. Decent at long thrusts as well. 

An ancient relic of the long forgotten under-empires. A masterfully crafted blade able to carve through plates of steel with its edge unwavering.
The reach of the greatsword allows it to strike enemies much further away.

A versatile pike with three deadly ends—a blade for strikes, a hook for grappling, and a spear-like point for puncturing chainmail and metal plates.
The reach of the halberd allows it to strike enemies much further away.

A versatile pike with three deadly ends—a blade for strikes, a hook for grappling, and a spear-like point for puncturing chainmail and metal plates.
The reach of the halberd allows it to strike enemies much further away.
The two-handed version of the winged mace, the long handle not only allows for higher damage but also greater armor penetration. The protruding flanges decimate both shields and metal plates.
An upgrade to the mallet, the two-handed hammer stacks a heavy metal head to multiply the force dealt to targets. The sheer force of hammer blows can crack solid plates and split strong shields.
An upgrade to the mallet, the two-handed hammer stacks a heavy metal head to multiply the force dealt to targets. The sheer force of hammer blows can crack solid plates and split strong shields.
This is a (relatively) modest dining table. It's perfect for the average family dining table.

Two seats, one destiny. The Nanjing Sofa combines the stately grace of traditional Qing-era design with just enough modern flair to hint at bold aspirations. Its sturdy frame and elegant curves invite you to sit and plot your next great endeavor, whether that’s uniting a divided space or simply sharing whispers of ambition. A perfect centerpiece for those who appreciate history—and know when to take the reins. Bold visions start here, one conversation at a time.

An advanced, self-repairing, multi-dimensional optical data storage drive containing a vast amount of knowledge.

A researcher can study the data on the drive to unlock neural digitalization and sleeve gestation research.
A great chair with armrests, backrest, wheels, and height adjustment. Recommend it for anyone who has to sit for long periods of time.

A narrow two-tier bookcase for storing and displaying up to twelve books. Books stored here will passively enhance academic work done nearby, and increase the beauty of the bookcase. The stored books will never deteriorate.
A narrow display cabinet that can hold up to 3 stacks of various items.
A tall and narrow shelf that can hold up to 3 stacks of various items.
A narrow wardrobe that can hold up to 3 pieces of apparel.
A sign usually used to convey information about wildlife or plant life in the area.
A stone bas relief of oceanic imagery for decorating a floor.
A stone bas relief of oceanic imagery for decorating a floor.

A highly concentrated mixture of antibodies enhanced with spacer technology that rapidly spreads through the user's bloodstream. It can be ingested, granting instant immunity to necroa. Powerful glitterworld medicine makes it highly effective and capable of killing even parasites.
A necroa archovirus pathogen that's a crucial ingredient in producing biological weapons. It must be kept indoors at freezing temperatures to stay fresh and usable.

A sample of necroa archovirus. Can be used as fuel for virus replicator to produce valuable necroa pathogens.

Can be obtained by using disease sampler on a living creature infected with necroa or crafted from necroa pathogens.
A barrel full of necroa gas. Ignites upon getting shot, which results in a massive gas explosion infecting everyone around it.
A military-grade necroa gas grenade launcher intended for anti-infantry use.
A shell filled with necroa gas. Can be fired from mortars. Explodes when damaged infecting everyone nearby.

A syringe containing a carefully prepared mixture of antigens. It prevents getting sick from necroa for 8 days and provides full protection from necroa pathogen gas.

Note that it does not cure existing infections.

A long-range weapon used by mechanoids. Named after its needle-like projectiles, it fires single shots with great accuracy. While it does less damage than charge weapons, it can reach over very long distances.

This mechanoid weapon is a compact version of the needle gun. Named after its needle-like projectiles, it fires single shots with great accuracy. The needle launcher has less range than its counterpart but is lightweight, allowing it to be wielded by fast-moving mechs.

This abomination is part chicken, part sentient cactus. If cactus nuggets weren't a thing, they are now. You can think of them as solar-powered egg layers.

Useful abilities: Needlechicken are decent egg layers. They can defend themselves with tiny poison barb attacks, and they almost don't need sustenance (except for a large amount of sunlight).
A fertilized needlechicken egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a needlechick. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
An unfertilized needlechicken egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.

A cactus genetically modified to be given sentience. It was given a mobile body, an infantile intelligence, and toxic barbs. Needleposts can derive nutrition from very small amounts of rotting vegetables but they need a huge amount of sunlight over anything else. Nights won't affect them, but a solar eclipse is usually fatal to them.

Needlerolls are needleposts that have evolved to grow in extremely arid and dry environments. Needlerolls need almost no sustenance, absorbing all the energy they need from sunlight and minute amounts of water that they extract from morning dew. They need a huge amount of sunlight. Nights won't affect them, but a solar eclipse could be fatal to them.
A colorful glowing sign used to welcome visitors to a bar. Uses a very small amount of power.
A colorful glowing sign used to welcome visitors to a business. Uses a very small amount of power.

A bioferrite power claw that can be surgically installed on a ghoul, granting it a powerful, paralytic attack. Each of the nerve shredder's jagged digits contain a resevoir of paralytic biotoxin. These clawed hands are harder to hold things with.

Due to the extremely painful nature of the prosthetic, only ghouls can tolerate this enhancement.
An ordinary footprint.
A sophisticated workbench that connects to a neural matrix and allows the user to interface with it. Allows the modification of neural stacks and other complex tasks, like resetting biocoding.
A glitterpanel specialized in applying mech serum recipes. The serum forming process is very mysterious and requires a powerful glitterheart to function.
A device of incredibly complex and esoteric construction, able to safely absorb and normalise chaotic psychic energies.

A cutting-edge cybernetic implant engineered for seamless neural integration, allowing users to hack systems at the speed of thought.  The Neural Intrusion Interface deploys microscopic neural tendrils and nanofiber conduits that directly link to the user’s brain and sensory pathways, eliminating latency and enabling highly intuitive, almost instinctual control over intrusion processes.

The implant boasts quantum-grade encryption spoofing and advanced adaptive cloaking algorithms, dramatically increasing hacking stealth and reducing the risk of detection even by intelligent security AIs.  Wireless penetration is near-limitless, while its dynamic interface can auto-configure to any signal or protocol without the need for manual intervention.

An ultratech implant which allows for a neural stack to cast its stored human consciousness remotely into the body it is installed in. It is required for a sleeve to become a viable needlecasting target.

An ultratech neural implant with a human consciousness stored on it, commonly referred to as a neural. Can be implanted directly into a person's or sleeve’s spine in the neck to bring back the person stored on the stack.

A glittertech device designed to store and manage medical nanobots. These nanobots are capable of clearing residue anesthetics from all patients in room after surgery, making recovery almost instantaneous, but still painless.

The nanobots require glitterworld medicine as a material source.
A biochip using animal stem cells to reinforce the natural abilities of human neurons, increasing learning and research speed.

A compact neural-phase regulator fitted with microtuned synapse coils and a vented cortex lattice that emits a steady hum of stabilizing neurostatic fields. Its core uses drifting neuroflux anchors to calm archite turbulence during injection cycles.

Improves the success chance of archite injections when linked to an archogen injector. Up to 10 neurostabilizer Arrays can link to a single archogen injector.

A complex piece of machinery designed to stimulate the brains of vat-growing pawns through gentle electrical pulses. Increases the vat learning rate of all adjacent growth vats by 50%. Attaching more than one neurostimulator to the same growth vat will have no effect.

A neural implant capable of simulating audio-visual stimuli. Picks up transmissions from ancient satelites and ubiquitous data cards.

This implant allows it's user to recreationally stream music or vidtube anywhere without the use of additional infrastructure.
A hopper-like storage basin meant to input Neutroamine into the network, filling up connected tanks.

An advanced workstation designed for the mass extraction of neutroamine from various manufactured goods. The process is destructive to the primary ingredients, leaving behind only the chemical through the use of glittertech material fission.



<color=#808080>Pssst... It's configurable in mod settings</color>
Specialized parts and tools for installing a neutroamine incubator in a victim.

An advanced chemical facility designed for the automated synthesis of neutroamine from organic feedstocks. It operates by converting rendered animal fat and chemfuel into neutroamine.

Factory buildings need factory hoppers for input and output. They produce significant heat and consume much power, but can be overclocked for higher efficiency, increasing both heat generation and power consumption.
A hopper-like storage basin meant to hold dispensed Neutroamine from tanks periodically for use later.

Engineered for neutroamine production, the neutrolope grows a large sac of pure neutroamine on its back. Though it is weak and fragile for its size, other animals avoid it similarly to a boomalope, despite the fact it does not explode when it dies. It can be milked to produce neutroamine.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.

A guided neutron particle generating engine. A scrapped prototype for an experimental neutron ship thruster turned into a deadly handheld weapon, it generates high-velocity neutron particles, directing them towards a general direction thanks to the barrel. These particles irradiate flesh they come in contact with causing cells to stop functioning and die.
A festive New Year themed lingerie, the text on it seems to imply something.

A perishable newspaper. Reading it will provide colonists with joy.

Out of date newspaper cannot be read and needs to be cleaned up.
A rimgazette newspaper.
A Newtons Cradle desk toy.
a dining chair with a somewhat ergonomic design.

A large flightless bird that is as black as the night. Night aves originated from a mysterious rimworld orbiting a very faint star, so they have adapted to environments with low sunlight and are purely nocturnal animals.

Night aves are amazing mounts, much faster than horses. If properly trained, they can be ridden into battle at incredible speeds.
A fertilized night ave egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby night ave. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Thick leather, darker than the darkest night. This thick skin insulates and protects very well.
These raw hides and pelts were removed from a creature, and with the right skills and tools, could be processed into tanned leather.
Very nutritious but the jet-black color is more than a little unsettling.
An aramid bulletproof helmet, used in conjunction with night vision goggles, enhances the wearer's shooting accuracy. It was commonly worn by ancient soldiers.
This dark hued wool is soft, light and provides very good insulation. Stronger than other similar wools.

The nighthrumbo is a fearsome predator. Armed with strong jaws and its horn, as well as ranged quill attacks, it will make quick work of any prey it decides to attack. It is also a nocturnal animal, sleeping during the day and being active at night.

Useful abilities: Ranged quill attacks.
Fertilized nighthrumbo egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby nighthrumbo. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.

A sleek predatory beast with rows of quills on its back. The nightling is a purely nocturnal hunter and will prey on much larger animals than itself. Apart from its strong jaws, nightlings can throw the quills on their backs to overpower their prey.
A fertilized nightling egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby nightling. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
An unfertilized nightling egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.

A hardy pack beast used for transporting loads or doing other heavy work. Nightmules originated from a mysterious rimworld orbiting a very faint star, so they have adapted to environments with low sunlight. They were domesticated by an elusive race called the forsaken hundreds of years ago and can be found roaming around other planets.

Nightmules are stronger than muffalos, though they produce a very low amount of milk and no wool. Their back is crowned by dangerous quills, though they lack the capacity to throw them as defensive weapons.

A stubborn herbivore that shares much of its genome with the predatory nightling. The nightram originated from a mysterious rimworld orbiting a very faint star, so they have adapted to environments with low sunlight. They were domesticated by an elusive race called the forsaken hundreds of years ago.

When found on other worlds, the nightram are exclusively nocturnal, instinctively avoiding natural sunlight. Nightrams are peaceful unless disturbed or threatened.

Complex nigiri sushi assembled with care from a wide selection of ingredients. Nigirizushi consists of an oblong mound of sushi rice that the chef presses between the palms of the hands to form an oval-shaped ball, and a topping (the neta) draped over the ball.
The perfect cabinet for your giant TV. Put all the stuff in here which you don't want to see.
A dark covering for those who wish to remain hidden. Offers minor protection but increased dodge chance.
A set of ninja tools used for stealth and light combat. Doesn't cover much and nudists won't mind.
A well forged and masterfully balanced arming sword, ornately decorated and finely finished. Both a fine weapon and a work of art.

A chunk of dark archotechnology salvaged from the wreck of a nociosphere. Strange lightning flickers and refracts within it's cracked crystalline core, causing a sensation of pins and needles to those nearby.

A chunk of dark archotechnology salvaged from the wreck of a noctolith. The sickly yellow lens set into it's sleek, oily surface seems to reflect a cruel mockery of the world, rendered in jagged, black metal
Popular amongst roaming tribals, the nomad mace features a wide and heavy metal head. While damage inflicted will be similar to other maces, the circumference of the head causes higher armor damage.

A turret designed to fire rubber bullets at intruders or unruly colonists. It causes pain and blunt trauma with low chance of fatal injury, making it ideal for non-lethal suppression. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.

An ancient Kashmiri tea mixing tea leaves, a pinch of salt and baking soda, which results in an striking pink beverage that is famous for being not only delicious but also healthy for the body. Used for treating muscle parasites.
Simple norimaki sushi made from a few ingredients. Norimaki are a type of sushi wrapped with seaweed.
A stone bas relief of Norse imagery for decorating a floor.
A stone bas relief of Norse imagery for decorating a floor.

This hairy omnivore is descended from escaped pigs and evolved for living in the northern forests.

Its tusks make it a better fighter than its domesticated pig cousins. Unfortunately, it is too unruly to be trained in the most complex tasks.
A cat adapted for very cold climates due to the top coat of glossy, water-shedding hair.
A small notepad and pen.
A small desk stocked with numerous notes and pieces of paper. Increases work speed when placed near a research bench. One workbench can only use one notes stack.

A pheromone controlling micro-organ. It is necessary to construct certain types of insectoid hives. Pherocores have been embedded deep into the brains of geneline leaders which allowed ancient civilizations to control the hives.

This pherocore belongs to the hyper-aggressive geneline from the volcanic planet Nuchadus.

A high-tech device that can be installed into any compatible artificial spine replacement. This particular model comes with a modified jump pack. It is compact enough to fully retract into the body and can be carried around with ease. Unlike a normal jump pack, it uses uranium as fuel instead of chemfuel, allowing it to store more charges. Frequent cooldown periods between jumps are necessary in order to properly shield the user from radiation.

A high-tech device that can be installed into a stomach or any compatible artificial stomach replacement. This particular model is equipped with a micro-nuclear reactor and chemical synthetic system, significantly reducing the required food intake. However, there is little room to shield the reactor, so the radiation increases the risk of cancer.

An incredibly rare and monstrously large insectoid of the Exo geneline, the nullipede is an insect leviathan perfectly adapted to the frigid vacuum of space. It possesses extreme cellular regeneration, allowing it to knit together grievous wounds and heal damage almost instantly. Direct exposure to fire completely shuts down its biological repair systems. Its sheer resilience makes it a dreaded, virtually indestructible horror among the stars, and the main reason many adventurers prefer to stay planet-side. Upon death, it’s possible to extract an Exo pherocore from its body.
A pious set of robes for ladies. But go ahead, put your men in them too.
A beautiful headpiece. Improves social impact.

A bedside device that feeds a person lying in bed whenever they are hungry, provided that nutrient paste dripper is connected to a nutrient paste vat. It must be placed directly adjacent to and facing the head of the bed. Placing more than one nutrient paste dripper near the same bed has no effect.
A small pipe output that allows colonists and citizens to pick up nutrient paste.

A slurry of liquefied organic pulp fills this reinforced glass vat. This solution is used by genetic experiments, and increases work speed when placed near a bestiagenic workbench. One workbench can use to up to two nutrient vats.
A bundle of seeds for nutrifungus. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A bundle of seeds for oat plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

The grain of the oat plant. Oats have numerous uses in foods; most commonly, they are rolled or crushed into oatmeal. Oatmeal is chiefly eaten as porridge, but may also be used in a variety of baked goods. Oats are also used for production of milk substitutes.
A stone obelisk with a carving on it for marking things.

A decorative set featuring an obsidian core suspended within a sleek metal frame.
The mechanism that keeps the obsidian floating remains a complete mystery.

It provides a slight boost to room beauty, but offers no additional effects.
Only the metal frame can be recolored.

The ocular cactus seems to be a Needleroll that has been corrupted by a strange extra-dimensional energy.

Ocular cacti need almost no sustenance, absorbing all the energy they need from sunlight and minute amounts of water that they extract from morning dew. Like needleposts and needlerolls, they need a huge amount of sunlight (or equivalent). Nights won't affect them, but a solar eclipse could be fatal to them.

If you have Alpha Biomes, a dying ocular cacti will produce several sessile sprouts when killed.
An experimental device that emmanates strange waves making everyone love the truly alien weather.
Raw ocular fish. A completely alien breed of fish. Its single, huge yellowed eye seems to be looking in all directions simultaneously.
This device needs a small amount of electricity to condense atmospheric gases and spew a large cloud of ocular gas. This gas blocks ranged attacks greatly, working as a constant smokepop belt.

A stabilization matrix that synchronizes hellsphere turbulence into a coherent firing pattern. Without one, any ocular beam platform would tear itself apart. It is necessary to produce certain advanced types of mechanoids and equipment. A mechanitor can study this chip to help unlock higher tiers of mechtech research.

An animal that seems to have some biological similarities with aerofleet, being filled with a buoyant gas, but its effects on terrestrial ecosystems are unusual. The creature releases clouds of reddish gas that is harmless to animals. However, when flora is exposed to it, it mutates and turns into strange specimens that share 98% of its genome with the jelly. This flora is almost inedible and its relationship with the ocular jelly remains as of yet unexplained. As a floating creature, ocular jellies ignore terrain movement costs. Asexual creatures like this one can't be sterilized.
Raw butchered flesh from an ocular jelly. Chewy, gelatinous, and insipid. Similar in texture to jellyfish.
A mutated nightling created by infusing the animal with strange energies from an extra-dimensional corruption. Sturdier and more docile than normal nightlings.

This amorphous translucent creature seems to lack everything but the most basic instincts, moving around slowly and sometimes devouring any plant it comes in contact with, incorporating it into its cytoplasm. To make its appearance even more unsettling, bloodshot eyes of various sizes float inside it, blinking spasmodically at random intervals.

Ocular originators are warped versions of the teratogenic originator, twisted by the strange energies of a perverse extra-dimensional realm of pure madness. The strange mutant eyes can be periodically excised from the creature and used at will. Ocular originators can't reproduce and only one will be present on a map at a given time.
A large, mutated scorpion. A multitude of twitching eyes look around nervously.
A great sword used in the field of battle. This oversized brother to the katana can be used to cleave a man in two.
An off-roader explorer made to travel in difficult terrain of any kind. Has decent cargo and fuel efficiency. It's not the fastest vehicle and can be a bit too visible, but still faster than walking.
An office binder full of inane Post-It notes. Most of what's inside is useless.

A versatile, high-quality liquid used for cooking, crafting, and various artisan processes. Extracted from natural sources, it plays a crucial role in both culinary and industrial applications.

<color=#E5E54C>Trade considerations</color> (assuming oil press is used):

<color=#E5E54C>Ingredients:</color> Making 10 oil requires 50 ingredients at an average of 1.1 value (55), and sells for 10, giving a <color=#33CC33>45%</color> profit per unit.

<color=#E5E54C>Value per work:</color> Recipe requires 1000 work, which results on a value per work of <color=#33CC33>0.1</color>.

<color=#E5E54C>Caravan trading:</color> Its weight is 0.3 Kg, for a value per Kg of <color=#33CC33>33.33</color>.

<color=#E5E54C>Profit per day:</color> On average, profit per day is <color=#33CC33>0.33</color> (for reference Yayo is 0.35).
A metallic oil lamp that shines bright as a regular torch and lasts longer. Can be refueled with tar. Fuel consumption rate is not affected by rain.
An oil painting, the frame is decorated with gold edge.

A specialized building where fruits, nuts, and seeds are processed into high-quality oils. Essential for crafting cooking oils, skincare products, and artisan goods. Includes a butter clarifier accesory and a small frier.
Edible green seed pods, famously known for their slimy or sticky texture when cut open. Okra is a powerhouse of valuable nutrients.
A bundle of seeds for okra plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
Empty supermarket freezer.

A small, egg-shaped black or green fruit that is used as food or for making oil. Olives freshly picked from the tree contain oleuropein, which makes the fruit unpalatable for immediate consumption. They must be brined or fermented to be used.
An extra long spear used in ancient times. This simple and straight forward weapon was one of the main weapons of the samurai. This yari provides the wielder with longer reach than the standard yari.

An ominous-looking obelisk of pure chiseled stone. It seems to radiate an aura of hopelessness and despair.

The Corruption need of any colonist in an obelisk's radius of effect won't decrease.

A rugged, all-purpose hacking module designed for adaptability in the vast expanse of space.  The Omni-Link implant features a configurable retractable data jack, stored discreetly within a subdermal compartment near the lower rib cage, capable of interfacing with a wide range of terminals, locks, and security devices.  Wireless connectivity is included for systems without physical access points, though its range and encryption are limited compared to more advanced models.

While reliable and versatile, it lacks direct neural integration, requiring manual input through connected devices.  It’s hacking stealth algorithms are basic, offering only minimal protection against detection, making careful timing essential during use.
