if he could buy some
. She replied that she could not speak French, which annoyed him, as he could also not speak French. A bystander suggested that Sheffield was asking for

While metal plates prove difficult to puncture, many warriors instead opt to damage the armor with a warhammer. Short, and thus wieldable with a shield, the warhammer continues to be a solid choice for battling rich nobles and heavily armored knights.
A high-tech suit of powered armor made from reinforced and high grade materials. This armor is designed for rapid deployment wherever the powerful corporations need their enforcers.
A charged-shot cannon. It fires a powerful charged shot that can travel great distances and hit with good armor penetration and stopping power.
A high-tech armored helmet made from reinforced and high grade materials. This helmet is worn by corporate enforcers for intimidation and control.
A heavy high-tech club designed to smash opponents with blunt damage and break through armor.

This black and white mineral alternates its colors through parallel bands, sometimes in harmony and other times in disarray. However, the chaotic colors don’t devalue this gem, yet instead increase its wealth, especially in carvings and jewelry.
This necklace, black as onyx itself, speaks of more incredible wealth than the average man or woman as the gem inside continues to glint despite its dark color.
This ring, black as onyx itself, speaks of more incredible wealth than the average man or woman as the gem inside continues to glint despite its dark color.
Blocks of solid onyxglass.

The visored-less bascinet helmet features a conical shape with a retractable visor, allowing for versatility in protection and visibility. It offers defense to the head while granting improved breathability and vision compared to fully enclosed helmets. Though it sacrifices some protection, its open design ensures greater comfort and ease of movement for wearers in combat scenarios.
A wooden box made up of planks designed to store resources in an efficient manner. Items stored inside will not affect room beauty and will never deteriorate, even if outside.
A wooden box made up of planks designed to store resources in an efficient manner. Items stored inside will not affect room beauty and will never deteriorate, even if outside.
Open paper file full of.. papers.
Open paper file full of.. papers.
An open shelf that can hold up to 6 stacks of various items.
The opened Weapon case has nothing inside.
A weapon case that has been pried open. It seems to have something inside.

A high-grade subcore specialized in gravship combat. It can link with a single gravship artillery piece and control it the same way a crewmember manning a targeting terminal can. It’s combat capabilities are subpar, but it allows for autonomous artillery batteries without the need for human operators.
Raw opium poppy. Requires cleaning for further use.

A cyberpod subsystem with exceptional computing power, used to optimize hacking algorithms. It boosts the pod's hacking speed.

Three coprocessors of this type can link to a pod.

An implant which increases hacker's speed.

This implant can be installed up to 3 times to increase its effect and requires an advanced cyberlink to function.

It can be self-installed without surgery.

An implant which increases hacker's speed.

This implant can be installed up to 3 times to increase its effect. To go higher, a more advanced module must be used.

It can be self-installed without surgery.
Spherical and perforated, oranges are notoriously annoying to peel and quite pulpy, but known as one of the absolute juiciest fruits with a bright tang and sour aftertaste.

A great ape invented and patented on Sophiamunda, orangutans are intelligent and can hold a normal conversation with humans. They are often used as home teachers in the Empire, educating young nobles in history, arts and correct etiquette.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> When holding sophisticated conversations with humans, they boost their social recreation. Furthermore, each conversation with an orangutan gives a little bit of XP to a random skill.
An object with ideoligious significance.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. This particular model includes a compact storage and deployment apparatus for orbital bombardment targeters. The core functions of the targeter remain the same and it has to be replaced after each use as a result. Due to its small size and low weight, the wielder can carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. This particular model includes a compact storage and deployment apparatus for orbital mech cluster targeters. The core functions of the targeter remain the same and it has to be replaced after each use as a result. Due to its small size and low weight, the wielder can carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. This particular model includes a compact storage and deployment apparatus for orbital power beam targeters. The core functions of the targeter remain the same and it has to be replaced after each use as a result. Due to its small size and low weight, the wielder can carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.
A delicate and exotic bloom with a subtle, sweet scent that varies by species, often used in sophisticated perfumes.
A bundle of seeds for orchid. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A bundle of seeds for orchid. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A cylindrical barrel for general storage. Items stored in this will not affect room beauty and they won't deteriorate, even if outside.
A trusty wagon to carry novelties, artifacts, and goods across the unforgiving lands of the rim. Can be used to store items.

An exceedingly complex stationary musical instrument crafted at a smithy. A series of tuned pipes are played from the keyboard which releases pressurized air to produce the desired pitch, which lasts as long as the key is pressed. The complex and intricate design, along with the unique sound it produces, make it an ideal apparatus for instigating concerts of the nobility as its music reaches far and wide.
Specialized parts and tools for any number of organ modifications. Non-reusable.
A migratory songbird known for the male's striking flame-orange and black plumage, and clear whistling song.
A fertilized Oriole egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a chick. It can be eaten, but why would you do such a thing?
An unfertilized Oriole egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.

An ancient tome intricately made with a golden finish. Contains scriptures detailing the historical accounts of the under empires. /n/nCan be sold for a pretty penny for interested collectors and the like.

A culinary work of art, characterized by refined, even elaborate preparation and presentation of an aesthetically balanced, albeit low quantity sushi. In oshizushi, a block-shaped piece is formed using a wooden mold. The chef lines the bottom of the mold with the toppings, covers them with sushi rice, and then presses the lid of the mold down to create a compact, rectilinear block. The block is removed from the mold and then cut into bite-sized pieces.
The matriarch of a vulture bee colony originating from the regions of house oswin. Unlike typical bees, they consume carrion and produce a smokey and savory honey.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.

A tight mask that completely covers the head. The bandana on the front and the tinted goggles obfuscate the wearer's identity completely while providing some tox resistance.

The mask is often used by bandits and thieves, earning its fame from a mythical space outlaw, said to still be roaming the rim.
A cooking table with a stone oven designed for baking meals.
A pair of bib-and-brace overalls perfect for working in the field.

A high-tech device that can be installed onto a kidney or any compatible artificial kidney replacement. This particular model uses specialized mechanites and advanced filters in order to detect, neutralize and swiftly eject excess chemicals from the body. It can immediately prevent the symptoms of a drug overdose, but cannot cure the effects of long-term substance consumption.

The overgrown colossus is a gargantuan beast that arose naturally in some remote swamp-filled planet. They are reptilian in nature, with cold blood and a slow metabolism. They have six legs, two intertwined spines, and six eyes.

It has a symbiotic relationship with vegetation, with several small trees growing on its back. These trees photosynthesize and help provide nutrients for the overgrown colossus.

When tamed, the overgrown colossus can be periodically trimmed to obtain wood.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.

You know you have gone too far in your scientific experiments when you are implanting a human being with an ovipositor. This will enable the colonist to lay chicken eggs twice a day. It hurts as hell, though. Also, yuck.

While it was originally thought to be an egg thief, hence its name, it was discovered later to not be one at all, instead being a caring parent who took care of its young in a nest. It uses its jaws to crush hard foods such as fruits and seeds.

Scientific name: Oviraptor philoceratops
A bundle of seeds for oxalis. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A dense mat of harvested aquatic algae, cultivated for use in life support systems. Oxyalgae provides steady oxygen generation but spoils quickly if not processed.
A life-sustaining gas. Used to pressurize rooms, supply breathable air, or fuel specialized equipment and survival gear. Volatile when damaged.

A utility pack containing a large supply of compressed oxygen. When worn with vacuum-sealed apparel, it provides full immunity to vacuum by supplying breathable air. The pack only consumes oxygen while in vacuum and must be periodically reloaded. It also dramatically reduces exposure to pollution through the lungs.

A self-contained atmospheric unit that extracts trace oxygen from surrounding gases. It produces oxygen at a slow, steady rate, but requires no input materials. Needs to be connected to an oxygen tank via oxygen pipes to work.
Iced oysters, fresh, sweet and delicious, plastic fake.
Iced oysters, fresh, sweet and delicious
An unfinished drone. This will deploy into a drone.
A pack of RimSpirit Cigs.
A hearty and nutritious packaged bread, typically prepared by wood rangers. It takes a long time to rot but it can still deteriorate if left outside. Great for adventuring.
A hearty and nutritious packaged meal, packed for use in survival situations. It takes a long time to rot but it can still deteriorate if left outside. Great for adventuring.

A padded linen tunic reinforced with mail plates and overlapping tanned leather, providing lightweight bodily protection at a low cost. A variation of the leather vest, the padded leather covers more of the body and is therefore more protective, but is more cumbersome as well.
Comfortable seat for use in museums.
Comfortable seat for use in museums.
Comfortable seat for use in museums.
A quilted legwear that provides protection with padded fabric.
A thick padded coif coupled with a simple flat-top nasal helmet. Offers good protection of the head, and is also quite insulating in cold weather.
A wide-rimmed kettle helmet paired with a thick padded coif, offering good protection of the head.

A strong medieval helmet that provides full-head coverage. While it offers fantastic protection, ones vision is grealy obscured, thus it is only recommended for front line infantry, particularly those foregoing shields.
A cloth mantle vest, sewn similarly to a gambeson, with a thick wool filling. Provides additional padding when worn but fails to deflect spear thrusts that come under shields.

A pale blue liquid known as Painkiller Draught. When the user drinks it, it effectively reduces their sensation of pain, providing relief from discomfort and injuries. However, the sedative components of the draught also diminish the user's productivity and focus, making it harder to concentrate and complete tasks efficiently. This makes it suitable for recovery periods but less ideal when active mental or physical effort is required.

Long extinct giant birds, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The biggest penguin in history. While it's clearly best fitted for hunting fish, palaeeudyptes won't hesitate to take advantage of its huge size, and will attempt to hunt other vertebrates that are smaller than itself.
Fertilized palaeeudyptes egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby palaeeudyptes. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
A workbench equipped for piecing together fossils and amber into displayable works.

Pay a little more attention to your basin. Wow! Now you have a nicer basin. There is also a mirror that is perfect for seeing your face, which looks like you don't want to work every morning.
14L per use.
A pallet that can hold up to 12 stacks of various items.
A pallet capable of holding two stacks. Items stored on top of a pallet will never deteriorate and don't affect the beauty of their surroundings.
A bundle of seeds for pampas grass. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
Pancake and coffee.
A large sign consisting of a panel with room for plenty of text to write down whatever you feel like. Looks nice.
A bundle of seeds for pansy. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
These raw hides and pelts were removed from a creature, and with the right skills and tools, could be processed into tanned leather.

Trophies for the accomplished hunter, animal rugs are formed from stained and stuffed animal hides sewed to felt and padding to form rugs. Panther rugs, much like the animals themselves, fall into shadows during the night but marbled eyes illuminate in the darkness.
An empty sheet of paper. Useful for scribbling or writing notes.
A single printed document. If this is homework, it is probably long overdue.
A paper.
A stack of paper documents.
Paper files full of.. papers.
Paper file full of.. papers.
A handing rack for drying freshly written manuscripts. Increases workspeed when placed near a book scribe table.

A thick, fibrous pulp created from finely ground fibrous materials, soaked and blended into a smooth consistency. This mixture is the essential raw material for crafting paper, ready to be spread, pressed, and dried into sturdy sheets for writing and drawing.
A pack of new paper pack.
A pack of new paper pack.
A roll of Paper Towel.
A set of printed documents - probably nothing important.

The Paraceratherium was the biggest land mammal to ever exist. When you hibridize it with a sturdy muffalo, the resulting creature is the most powerful pack animal ever created. Incredibly stubborn and bad-tempered, though.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Produces wool and milk, and acts as an incredibly strong -albeit slow- pack beast.
Paraceramuffalo milk is rich and creamy. Probably too rich in fat, but certainly tasty.

Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest land mammal known to man, Paraceratherium, is a gentle creature, however its size alone can also make it quite a formidable foe to face.
Feeds on plants and trees, which it can easily reach with its extraordinarily long neck, the trait that makes it unique to other genera of rhinoceroses.

A docile herbivore that lives in large groups. They are best known for the tubular crest on the back of its skull. This crest was used in the production of long, resonating calls for various purposes, from warning others nearby of threats, to communicating between mates.

Scientific name: Parasaurolophus walkeri
Soft yet durable hide from an Alp, often used to craft lightweight armor or clothing with subtle protective qualities.

A durable material made from specially prepared animal skin, typically sheep, goat, or calf. Through a meticulous process of cleaning, stretching, and drying, parchment becomes smooth and resilient, suitable for writing, drawing, or painting. Widely used historically for manuscripts, legal documents, and artwork, parchment embodies a timeless medium prized for its longevity and elegance in preserving written or visual creations.
A potent tincture for pain relief and increased healing, but carries a risk of addiction with prolonged use.
A mixture of paregoric. Needs further brewing in order to be used.

A chemfuel-powered shuttle designed for long-distance travel. It is capable of reaching orbital locations.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Pilot x1, Passenger x3
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel

Passports.

Old and rugged patient gown. Provides no protection or insulation, but makes the medical procedures on a person wearing one just a little bit easier.

The gargantuan patriarch of the Sorne geneline serves as the primary male responsible for the survival and protection of the royal caste. His immense digger claws, essential for both hive construction and defense, double as formidable shields capable of absorbing extraordinary amounts of damage. Mounted on his back are vast insect jelly sacks, which provide the resources necessary for rapidly constructing any hive defenses. In battle, his sets of extremely sharp ripper blades and razor-sharp mandibles can efficiently dispatch any threat to the hive. The Patriarch possesses the ability to summon royal caste insectoids from deep underground tunnels, enabling reinforcements to swiftly emerge onto the surface. Upon death, it’s possible to extract a Sorne pherocore from his body.

A square paving tile.

A lightweight, modern personal defense weapon designed for maximum portability and quick engagement. Its high rate of fire in a long burst makes it highly effective at close to medium range. Due to light weight, it is very quick to draw.
A bundle of seeds for pea plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
An edible juicy fruit called peach or nectarine. A ripe peach will have a fragrant aroma and be delicious eaten fresh out of hand.
A bundle of seeds for peanut plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
Seeds with an oblong shape and a papery seed coat. Similar in taste and nutritional profile to tree nuts such as walnuts and almonds, but technically a legume.
Crispy green pears. While at first similar to apples, pears are slightly more fibrous and less sweet.
Spherical green seeds tucked safely away in a fleshy pod. Peas are notable for having potentially long shelf-lives when dried properly.

Pebblemits are bouldermits that have evolved in narrow, labyrinthine caves, where massive size is more a hindrance than an advantage. Instead of huge boulders, pebblemits use much smaller rocks as protection, slowly dragging them along the ground. Small blocks of stone periodically get loose from those rocks.
A stand that acts as a base to display your items.

A genetically reconstructed dromaeosaurid commissioned by bored glitterworld elites as a symbol of status and wealth. These beasts are made to compete in judged events where the owners win titles depending on how well their animals conform to their breeds standards.

When set loose, the raptors are usually short-lived since they depend on their human owners for survival. Their violent instincts having been bred out of them long ago. However, they are excellent companions and quite pretty.
A fertilized pedigreed raptor egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby pedigreed raptor. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
An unfertilized pedigreed raptor egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
A heavy coat insulated due to animal pelt, providing warmth and armor.

A decorative alarm clock with a pendulum.
One of the earliest effective medications for treating bacterial infections. Take once per day for maximum effect.
A luxurious gold-inlaid bed fit for the highborn. Very comfy and beautiful, it is a work of art in itself. Fits five.
A bundle of seeds for peony bush. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A bundle of seeds for pepper plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

Tiny, spicy, crimson pods often used in sauces, relishes, or powders. While the flavor itself is mild the capsaicin contained inside means humans find them oddly addicting, if painful when consumed in mass. Animals are known to avoid eating the plant entirely.

A luxurious blend of aromatic compounds and essential oils derived from flowers and botanicals, used to create delightful and captivating scents for personal use and ambiance. Each perfume is crafted to evoke emotions and memories, enhancing everyday experiences.

<color=#E5E54C>Trade considerations:</color>

<color=#E5E54C>Ingredients:</color> Making 10 perfume requires 25 ingredients at an average of 1.2 value (30), and sells for 6, giving a <color=#33CC33>50%</color> profit per unit.

<color=#E5E54C>Value per work:</color> Recipe requires 2500 work, which results on a value per work of <color=#33CC33>0.02</color>.

<color=#E5E54C>Caravan trading:</color> Its weight is 0.05 Kg, for a value per Kg of <color=#33CC33>120</color>.

<color=#E5E54C>Profit per day:</color> On average, profit per day is <color=#33CC33>0.35</color> (same as Yayo).

<color=#E5E54C>Extra use:</color> Perfume can be applied to increase social impact by 10% and negotiation ability by 5% for a day.
A long haired cat originating from desert wildcats, Persian cats are regal, intelligent and agile, which makes them excellent for hunting small rodents and birds.

A remote energy and computation enhancement device. Any friendly mechanoids in its effect radius will move and work faster. This boost will be overwritten if the mech enters the range of a standard mech booster. The effect of the persistent mech booster will remain on the mech up to 3 hours after leaving its area of effect.

An ultratech staff threaded with psychic focusing materials. While it is a solid melee weapon, its main purpose is to enhance the wielder's psychic sensitivity and neural heat dissipation, allowing more use of psychic powers.
This weapon has an onboard persona that can bond to only a single person. The wielder and intelligent weapon can synchronize their reflexes and attack with frightening speed, accuracy, and creativity. Once bonded to a wielder, the weapon's persona will refuse to be wielded by anyone else.

A single use psychic persona Effector. The psychic surge destroys a weapon persona's connections; removing all memories of friendship, loyalties and severing their psychic bond. Can only be used on a bonded weapon.

A massive sword fitted with an engine and tempered cutting teeth in place of a regular blade. One single swing from this brutal weapon can shred through armor, flesh and bone with ease, though managing to handle something so heavy in the first place is no simple task. Such a powerful blade is generally wielded by only the most honorable and distinguished stellic wardens.

This weapon has an onboard persona that can bond to only a single person. The wielder and intelligent weapon can synchronize their reflexes and attack with frightening speed, accuracy, and creativity. Once bonded to a wielder, the weapon's persona will refuse to be wielded by anyone else.

Through its array of sophisticated eltex lenses, the weapon is capable of magnifying psychic power into a concentrated bolt of energy that grows in power the more psychically sensitive the wielder is. However, the psionic nature of the projectiles is a double edged sword, with psychically dull enemies like mechanoids being able to reduce the damage to a minimum.

Each attack deals additional 15 damage that doesn't scale with psychic sensitivity.

Using an array of sophisticated eltex lenses embedded in its handle, the weapon is able to magnify psychic power and project it into an energy field around its head that grows in power the more psychically sensitive the wielder is. However, the generated psychic field wanes when cutting into psychically dull foes such as mechanoids due to psychic field dissonance between its wielder and target.

A single use psychic persona Effector. The psychic surge uncovers previously sealed neural-pathways, extending the targeted weapon persona with a new trait. Can only be used on persona weapons that has a valid trait to add and that is under the absolute maximum number of traits (defined in the settings).

A single use psychic persona Effector. The psychic surge destructively melds the personalities a chosen persona weapon into another, changing the personality of the latter with some traits chosen from either weapon. The donor weapon is destroyed in the process. If not enough compatible traits are found between both weapons, some new ones may also be added (depnding on the minimum amount of traits as defined in the mod settings).

A single use psychic persona Effector. The psychic surge collapses a portion of the persona's personality, removing a random trait from the targeted weapon. If this item were to be used on a persona with only one trait or none at all, the persona will be reformatted instead.

A single use psychic persona Effector. The psychic surge completely overwhelms a weapon persona, destroying who they were and completely rerolling the traits of the weapon's persona, while preserving their bond.

A defensive melee persona weapon usually assigned to every Imperial noble of rank Yeoman or above. While armor penetration is comparable to plasteel blades, the primary function is to dispense acidifer fluids and toxic vapors upon inflicted cuts. The effect only lasts a few seconds and is inflicted roughly half of the time due to the limited size of the weapon.

A very rare single use psychic persona Effector. The psychic surge destructively moves a portion of a chosen persona to another, extending the latter weapon persona with a chosen trait from the former. The donor weapon is destroyed in the process. Can only transfer to persona weapons that can accept the donor trait to add and that is under the absolute maximum number of traits (defined in the settings).
A miniature grav engine with a set of tiny thrusters that can create a weak field of altered gravity around it, allowing a person to hover over difficult terrain or through the vacuum of space.

The Pestigator is a massive and fearsome predator that reigns supreme in the polluted swamps of the rimworld. With its heavily armored form and powerful jaws, it is capable of inflicting massive damage on any opponent. Though slow on land, it is nimble and nearly invisible in water, making it a formidable adversary in its native habitat. The Pestigator is not to be underestimated, as its powerful bite can rip apart its prey with ease. Its insatiable hunger and aggression make it impossible to tame, making it a constant threat to any unfortunate enough to encounter it.
A small metal dish typically used for feeding pet animals such as cats or dogs. Can be used to store kibble.
A unique part of Alp biology, this solidified manifestation of the creature's final cry is a rare and eerie material used in crafting or dark rituals.
A bundle of seeds for petunia. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
Raw peyote fruits. Requires cleaning for further use.
A bundle of seeds for peyote. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

An artificial plant that perfectly recreates a rose through nanoscale steel processing and molecular arrangement control.
A proprietary surface treatment reproduces the characteristic luster and texture of real rose petals, despite being made entirely of metal.
...In other words, it's just a steel artificial flower.

Slightly increases room beauty, but has no other effect.Can be placed on top of other furniture, such as dressers and tables.Supports dyeing.

A high-tech bedroll crafted from advanced synthread fibers. Upon activating the air valve, it instantly inflates to provide a level of comfort comparable to a standard bed, even in the middle of a journey. However, it does not seem to improve the actual speed of rest.
Thanks to its specialized structure, it is significantly lighter and more comfortable than a conventional bedroll.

Note: Can only be made of synthread and does not support custom coloring with dye.

A pod-type storage designed to showcase special items.
Stored items do not deteriorate.
Holds only one item and cannot contain large objects.
When powered, it emits a small area of light.

A compact container-style storage unit.
Stored items will not deteriorate and won’t disrupt the room’s appearance.
Due to limited space, large items cannot be stored inside.
An object with ideoligious significance.

A rifle boasting immense cutting power that can penetrate solid material. Adapted from an industrial design, which uses a bulky capacitor to power its rapid bursts, the weapon’s phase-cycle wheel compresses energy into blades that can sever intermolecular bonds. Its original purpose was to cleanly quarry mineral-dense asteroids; now, in the hands of bloodthirsty psychos on the rim, it cleaves through armor, flesh, and bone with ease.

A precision rifle that projects immense cutting power. Its phase-cycle wheel focuses energy into a singular micro-blade, making it perfect for its original role in precision manufacturing. Such accuracy and power has been exploited by mercenaries and assassins to wreak havoc across the galaxy, from spacer societies to rimworld colonies.

A sidearm that boasts great cutting power. Built for tight spaces, its phase-cycle wheel condenses bursts of energy into sharp blades that can break intermolecular bonds. This combination of portability and penetrative power make it perfect for salvage operations, demolition, and carpentry. It also lends itself well to sieges and terror attacks, however, making it the preferred weapon of frontier crazies resourceful enough to get it.

An advanced implant which allows a mechanitor to rapidly relocate a nearby friendly mechanoid by phasing it into 'p-space' and then re-materializing it at a new location.

This implant can be self-installed without surgery.

Small, noble poultry that was genetically engineered to be an excellent small game animal. When pheasants run away from danger, they emit a psychic invisibility blast, making their allies hidden from sight.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Whenever a pheasant is in danger (it starts fleeing), it emits a psychic shockwave in radius of 6 cells around itself. It only does it once every 24 hours. This shockwave gives all pawns under player control in that radius Psychic Invisibility for a short period of time, making them untargetable by enemies.
A fertilized pheasant egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a peacock. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
An unfertilized pheasant egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.

An advanced device capable of changing the atomic structure of objects. It is extremely easy to use, but harder to craft. This device has caused a rampant riot of robberies ever since aristocrats used it to satisfy their royal preferences, while the poor found it an opportunity to improve their standard of living.

A genetically modified feline with avian characteristics, the phoenix owlcat was created as a durable alternative to fragile baseline cats. A loyal companion that isn't as easily hunted by hostile predators. The ancient folklore of cats having nine lives was used as a pattern to create the phoenix owlcat. A swarm of powerful mechanites in its bloodstream is capable of saving it from up to 9 lethal wounds before being lost to decoherence.
A Decorative Phonograph.
The phonograph decorated in Phnom Penh，gives a relaxed feeling
A framed photo of a field.
A framed photo of a night scene.

A compact photon-slingshot submachine gun. Using complex sets of micro-lenses, mirrors and magnets, it compresses photon particles into blindingly fast projectiles which sear and melt flesh, but that have a hard time getting through any kind of armor. The photon blasts dissipate quickly, lowering the range of the weapon.

A formidable hand tool meticulously crafted through the process of forging, where metal is heated, shaped, and tempered to create a robust and durable implement. Characterized by a pointed or chiseled end affixed to a sturdy handle, the forged pick excels in breaking up hard materials such as rock, concrete, or soil. Renowned for its strength and reliability, it is an essential tool in mining, construction, and geological exploration, providing precision and efficiency in challenging environments.
A fast car with high cargo capacity and great fuel efficiency on the world map. Good for traveling on flat roads, but will struggle on hills, snow or winter.

A mining tool used to batter stones and ores; although primarily used to gather economic resources, the mine features deadly picks at both ends, capable of decimating armor as effectively as it mines ore.

A protective suit that keeps the user safe in the vacuum of space. The suit restricts the wearer's movement, considerably reducing their movement speed.

Expensive and beautiful, prestige vacsuits like this is usually made for those of high status in the royal navy. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.

A helmet that efficiently recycles the user's oxygen, allowing them to breathe in the vacuum of space for hours at a time. The process isn't perfectly efficient, so the user must periodically return to a pressurized environment.

Expensive and beautiful, prestige vacsuit helmet like this is usually made for those of high status in the royal navy. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.

A prestige, noble version of the original Vanguard armor, that trades protection for flair. The mainstay of modern militaries outside of the rim. Offering a cataphract-level of protection without the induced mobility cost, Vanguard marines laugh in the face of danger.

A prestige, noble version of the original Vanguard helmet, that trades protection for flair. The mainstay of modern militaries outside of the rim. Offering a cataphract-level of protection without the induced mobility cost, Vanguard marines laugh in the face of danger.
Pink, melon-like edible fruits, used historically for both snacking as well as medicine by desert natives.
A desk on which believers can kneel while observing rituals, praying, or discussing.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.

A rudimentary cutting tool crafted from natural materials like stone, flint, or bone. Featuring a sharp, wedge-shaped blade securely attached to a wooden or bone handle, it embodies early human innovation in woodworking and survival. Used for chopping wood, shaping materials, and various tasks requiring efficient cutting, it represents an essential tool in ancient civilizations and early human societies.

A primitive bandage typically consists of strips of cloth, leaves, or other natural materials, used to cover and protect wounds or injuries. These bandages are rudimentary in nature, lacking modern adhesive or sterile properties, and are typically secured by tying or wrapping. While basic, they serve the fundamental purpose of providing some level of protection and support to the injured area.
A rudimentary barbell crafted from stone and wood. Used for various strength training exercises.

A simple yet effective grooming tool designed for use in taming and caring for animals. Crafted from basic materials such as bone or wood, this comb features strategically placed teeth to gently untangle fur and remove debris, promoting the health and well-being of domesticated creatures. With its rudimentary design and practical functionality.

Crafted from natural materials such as stone, bone, or obsidian, this rudimentary tool features a simple blade affixed to a basic handle. Designed for essential cutting tasks, it embodies the ingenuity of early human craftsmanship, offering reliability in wilderness survival scenarios and historical reenactments.

A rugged hand tool fashioned from durable materials such as wood, bone, or stone. Characterized by a pointed or chiseled end affixed to a sturdy handle, it serves as a versatile implement for digging, breaking up soil, and extracting minerals or resources. Reflecting early human ingenuity, it embodies the essential tool for survival and resource gathering in primitive environments.

The primitive leather-bound toolset is a collection of essential implements crafted for basic manual tasks, encompassing a chisel, a small hammer, and a file. Encased within a durable leather sheath, these tools are designed to facilitate precision workmanship in various materials, such as wood or metal.
A full body jumpsuit made out of thick fabric or leather, adorned with buttons for ease of use and a nametag for immediate identification. These jumpsuits are often worn by low-risk prisoners.

A full body jumpsuit made out of thick fabric or leather, adorned with buttons for ease of use and a nametag for immediate identification. These jumpsuits are often worn by medium-risk prisoners, more commonly known as
A full body jumpsuit made out of thick fabric or leather, adorned with buttons for ease of use and a nametag for immediate identification. These jumpsuits are often worn by high-risk prisoners.

A full body jumpsuit made out of thick fabric or leather, adorned with buttons for ease of use and a nametag for immediate identification. These jumpsuits are meant to be dyed a specific color that doesn't fit into the normal blue-orange-red combinations.
Blocks of pristine limestone.
A block of heavily processed minced meat, safe to eat but with an unappetizing taste.

An advanced brain implant designed to assist the user in research tasks and act as a digital encyclopedia on that and any similar subject. The subpersona can quickly and accurately analyze devices, substances and documents while also being able to perform complex calculations in fractions of a second.

A brain implant of such complexity requires time to synchronize with and adapt to its host in order to avoid excessive strain on the central nervous system, its effectiveness will slowly increase during this process. It's capable of syncing with other enhancements made to assist in similar tasks, greatly increasing efficiency.

Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest known kangaroo that ever existed. Unlike its modern equivalents, procoptodons move around not by hopping but by walking, just like hominids.
They are very dangerous due to their ability to throw unbelievably swift punches.
A supply crate filled with raw vegetable ingredients and fresh harvest goods.
A classroom projector that can be linked to a learning board to improve learning effectiveness.

A versatile fuel. Can be converted into chemfuel, or used as fuel for propane specific buildings, such as heaters or stoves. Insert inane and trite King of the Hill joke here (yes, I have heard them all, you are not original).

Raw propane bag. These jellyfish have a propane-based metabolism, and are able to survive, and even thrive, in unbelievably extreme conditions. They are not very edible, though, and consuming them could lead to experiencing some painful stomach cramps.
A hopper-like storage basin meant to input propane into the network, filling up connected storage tanks.

A device that burns propane fuel and turns it into heat. The propane heater wastes a lot of fuel when attempting to reach temperatures too different from ambient ones, but it's quite fuel conservative if configured carefully.
A work station for assembling machinery like guns and ammunition, or breaking down dead mechanoids.
Extracts usable metal from slag chunks and other mixed metal items.
A propane-fueled station for smithing non-mechanical weapons and tools.
A propane-fueled stove with an attached countertop for preparing meals.
A hopper-like storage basin meant to hold dispensed propane from storage tanks periodically for use later.
A portable flamethrower turret fueled with propane. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.
A eye prosthesis. It's not as efficient as the real thing but it's better than nothing.
A foot prosthesis. While it lacks a neural interface, its complex arrangement of internal joints allows it to mimic natural movement quite convincingly. Still, it is inferior to a real foot.
A hand prosthesis. While it lacks a neural interface, its complex arrangement of internal joints allows it to mimic natural movement quite convincingly. Still, it is inferior to a real hand.
A kidney prosthesis. It's not as efficient as the real thing but it's better than nothing.
A liver prosthesis. It's not as efficient as the real thing but it's better than nothing.
A lung prosthesis. It's not as efficient as the real thing but it's better than nothing.
A spine prosthesis. It's not as efficient as the real thing but it's better than nothing.
A stomach prosthesis. It's not as efficient as the real thing but it's better than nothing.
A classic rifle, the mainstay of any infantry-based military. This weapon uses a crude reverse-engineered implementation of a pulse-charging barrel.
A specific rifle implement with its action moved behind the grip, allowing more muzzle for less rifle. This weapon uses a crude reverse-engineered implementation of a pulse-charging barrel.
A single-shot, mid-range and mid-damage gun with a scope. This weapon uses a crude reverse-engineered implementation of a pulse-charging barrel.
A
-kinda weapon designed for suppresive fire and outfitted with a bipod. This weapon uses a crude reverse-engineered implementation of a pulse-charging barrel.
A handy sidearm with low stopping power, making up for it in weight and compactness. This weapon uses a crude reverse-engineered implementation of a pulse-charging barrel.
A magazine-fed, burst-fire shotgun built on a chain shotgun action, a proto-charge design that throws charged shells. Short-ranged, but extraordinarily dangerous up close.
A single-shot, high-range and high-damage gun with a scope and bipod. This weapon uses a crude reverse-engineered implementation of a pulse-charging barrel.
An unfinished drone. This will deploy into a drone.
Dried plums. Prunes take a very long time to deteriorate.

A psychic-command mechanoid micro-organ infused with an Archotech echo of martial authority. Generates localized command fields, amplifying allied effectiveness. It is necessary to produce certain advanced types of mechanoids and equipment. A mechanitor can study this chip to help unlock higher tiers of mechtech research.
A psycaster guide detailing a particular psycast, as well as some general psychic phenomena.

An implant that allows the user to project a pulse of pure mental pain. The implant is crafted from a modified nociosphere emitter, using archotech shards to harness its psychic capabilities. The user can release a wave of psychic agony, briefly incapacitating all creatures nearby. However, while the user is in pain, the implant also constantly causes a feedback loop of psychic pain to all creatures that spend too much time in the user's presence.

Decommissioned Imperial technology since the invention of psylink neuroformers, psychic amplifier upgrades a psylink in the user's mind. It cannot form a psylink by itself, and can only be used by colonists with already present psylink. The user presses the device over the eyes, where it links to the brain directly and restructures part of it. Afterwards, the device disintegrates into worthless ash.

An implant that allows the user to enthrall another person. The implant is crafted from a modified golden cube, using archotech shards to control its psychic influence. The user radiates an aura of perfection and beauty, enhanced by their psychic sensitivity, and gains the ability to focus this psychic field into the mind of another, rapidly captivating and luring them into the user's faction. The victim will always feel strong positive emotions for the beguiler but will enter a berserk rage when they die.
Artificial hearing aids that block psychic emanations, providing considerable resistance to mechanoids' psychic attacks.

Gives limited telekenetic ability, allowing the user to hover off the ground to ignore terrain movement costs, avoid triggering traps and move faster than they otherwise would. The effect is proportional to the user's psychic sensitivity.
This brain implant projects a personal psychic field that is incompatable with other psychic fields, such as those of nearby archotechs. Thus shields the user from their effects.
An ancient pulse blade of unkown design, driving the target insane and disorients it.
An ancient handgun of unkown design, firing a psychic pulse that disorients and downs the target or drive them insane.
An ancient grenade of unkown design, emitting a strong and rapid psychic pulse that disorients and downs the target or drive them insane.
An ancient lancer of unkown design, firing a fast psychic pulse lance that disorients and downs the target or drive them insane.
An ancient sniper of unkown design, firing a fast psychic pulse that disorients and downs the target or drive them insane.
An ancient rifle of unkown design, firing multiple psychic pulses that disorients and downs the target or drive them insane.
An ancient shotgun of unkown design, firing multiple, small psychic pulses in one shot that disorients and downs the target or drive them insane.
An ancient rapid fire rifle of unkown design, firing multiple psychic pulses in a short time that disorients and downs the target or drive them insane.

An implant that attunes its user to rip the psychic energies from slain foes. The implant uses dark archotechnology to harvest psyfocus from death, allowing its user to repurpose this energy, if they are capable.

An implant that sustains the user during meditation and psychic rituals. The implant uses dark archotechnology to allow its user to tap into the ambient psychic field of a distant archotech, enabling to enter a psychic trance that sustains their body.

A dose of semi-coherent mechanites which work as a conduit across the body to enhance the hosts psychic abilities.

For ease-of-use the mechanites are designed to be self-installable via a small handheld injector.  Due to how mechanites work only one strain can exist harmoniously inside the host’s body.  Upon injection any existing strain will be eliminated by the newly injected mechanites.  It is possible to remove mechanite strains entirely from a host, however it requires an expensive and difficult surgery.

A high-tech device that can be installed into a liver or any compatible artificial liver replacement. This particular model is capable of synthesizing small doses of substances similar in composition to well-known psychite products and releasing them into the body. It’s able to suppress psychite cravings, but properly curing an addiction is not possible with an implant such as this one.

A specialized apparatus designed to rejuvenate the psyfocus of deathresting psycasters by delicately nurturing their psychic centers. Employing a meticulous balance of sanguine infusions and harmonic neural stimulation, the well works in concert with the psycaster's innate psychic energies. As the individual rests within the deathrest casket, the Psychofluid Well revitalizes their psychic reservoirs, preparing them for future psychic exertions. To operate effectively, the device must be connected to a deathrest casket and requires a steady supply of hemogen to fuel its subtle yet powerful restorative functions.

Contrary to other deathrest machines, the psychofluid well regenerates 5% of total Psyfocus to the deathresting occupant every 1 hour, instead of acting all at once when the deathrest ends.
A bundle of seeds for psychoid plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A psychology book dealing with the more complex aspects of the human mind.
These fungi taste funny and produce a potent mood-increasing chemical high. However, if eaten too often, they can generate a mild addiction.

A perception-warping mechanoid micro-organ that regulates rapid displacement, charged-particle emissions, and brief periods of psychic imperceptibility. It is necessary to produce certain advanced types of mechanoids and equipment. A mechanitor can study this chip to help unlock higher tiers of mechtech research.

An advanced brain implant designed to assist the user in controlling their psychic powers and act as a digital encyclopedia on the subject of psycasting. The subpersona can utilize tiny fragments of eltex that have been weaved into its circuity, allowing for faster dissipation of neural heat and quicker buildup of psyfocus during meditation.

A brain implant of such complexity requires time to synchronize with and adapt to its host in order to avoid excessive strain on the central nervous system, its effectiveness will slowly increase during this process. It's capable of syncing with other enhancements made to assist in similar tasks, greatly increasing efficiency.
A sign about flying dinosaurs.

Pteranodon flies and hunts like modern albatross. Its streamlined skull and toothless jaws made diving into the water for fish an easy task.

Scientific name: Pteranodon longiceps

A small dog with physically distinctive features of a wrinkly, short-muzzled face, and curled tail. They are known for being extremely social and friendly, however due to years of genetic alterations they have a very short lifespan. Whatever life they have, they will always cheer up people around them.
A bar fixed at a height to support bodyweight exercises such as pull-ups and dips to strengthen the back, arms, and core muscles.

Long extinct giant arthropods, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The biggest land scorpion to ever exist.
Pulmonoscorpius is a solitary predator capable of taking down creatures way larger than itself with its deadly venom. Its sting should be stayed away from at all costs.
A mounted pulse-energy machine gun. Self-powered and portable, but requires frequent reloading. Doesn't explode when damaged.
Pirates use these in even the most remote and extreme environments to seek out lucrative raid targets.

A complex and deadly pulse-energy assault rifle. It fires powerful pulse plugs with high accuracy which disintegrate upon impact, releasing all of their kinetic energy against the target and stopping them in their tracks. Additionally, the pulse rifle is capable of releasing a sphere of volatile electro-pulse energy which can stun and damage electronics. 

Weapons like these are utilized by mega-corp militias to silence protests and rebellions, or to conquer planets for their own gains.

A portable pulse-energy submachine gun. It fires bursts of pulse plugs with high accuracy which disintegrate upon impact, releasing all of their kinetic energy against the target and stopping them in their tracks. 

These deadly weapons are often  by urbworld peacekeepers and private military companies alike.

A bulky and menacing pulse-energy powered minigun. Capable of firing large bursts of highly-accurate pulse plugs, which disintegrate upon impact releasing all of their kinetic energy against the target and stopping them in their tracks. 

This intimidating firearm is banned on many glitterworlds due to it's sheer destructive capabilities, yet it is still secretly used by various malicious organizations across the galaxy.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm replacement. This particular model includes a modified pump shotgun that can be fully retracted outside of combat, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.
A sweet, dense biscuit of pumpkin and flour with a caramelized confectionery glaze.
A creamy soup made from finely pureed pumpkin and a light assortment of spices.

Cheap, mass produced generic coffee seeped in an array of spices, oddly excluding any actual pumpkin. Thousands of years ago, this type of coffee was stereotypically consumed by red-haired hipsters with man buns.
A dense, rich pie made from mashed pumpkin mixed with strong spices, layered atop a sweet, flakey crust. A fall-favorite desert.

A smooth, thick blend made by processing fruits, vegetables, or legumes into a creamy consistency. Purees are used in cooking to create sauces, soups, or as a base for various dishes, adding texture and concentrated flavor.
