The pollution reclaimer is an imperfect solution to a disastrous problem. It cleans pollution from a large area around it in addition to vaporizing toxic wastepacks. Its function is imperfect due to the drastic rate it runs at and It has a constant chance to cause several severe ecological events such as the following: Releasing toxic waste into the air, causing a toxic downpour, generating a toxic smog in the local area up to several world tiles around where it is placed and spoiling relations over time with local neighboring factions. While it works well, ecologists and mechanitors alike still argue whether the side effects are worth the hassle.
Raw fungus. These particular fungi are more nutritive than usual, but there is a greater chance for them to cause food poisoning.

Long extinct giant reptiles, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

Quite possibly, the largest crocodilian of all time, and also the biggest reptile to roam the Earth after the extinction of dinosaurs.
It is so massive that even giant ground sloths have a place on its menu.
Fertilized purussaurus egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby purussaurus. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.

A hollow cylinder made of polyvinyl chloride meant for transporting fluids and flowing solids. PVC is a very reliable material for plumbing in general due to its cost-efficiency and durability that is comparable to better metal pipes. They are, however, unsuitable for more advanced use and are thus considered a weak pipe.
A gigantic stone structure whose outer surfaces are triangular and converge to a single step at the top.
An object with ideoligious significance.

A high-tech device that can be installed into any compatible artificial spine replacement. This particular module is capable of producing immense amounts of heat and trapping it in a bubble-like barrier it projects around its host, cooking and igniting everything within its range. While the user is safe from being directly affected by the implant when it's active, it will scorch both enemies and allies that do not possess sufficient protection from heat and fire.

A high-tech animal implant that can be installed onto the spine or any compatible artificial spine replacement. This particular module comes with a set of advanced artificial micro-organs that produce an extremely flammable venom-like substance that has a high likelihood of immediately igniting anything it comes in contact with. The substance gathers around the body parts that its host uses for combat, allowing it to be injected into or launched at its target with each bite, scratch or strike.

A high-tech device that can be installed into any compatible artificial limb or spine replacement. This particular model, upon detecting an attack on the user, sends out a directional burst of highly combustible micro-gas toward the attacker through the module's vent-like openings. Due to its limited effective range it is most potent in close-quarters combat, especially against assailants within melee range.
A simple quadra-wide bed that fits four people.

A simple quadra-wide bed that lays on the floor, usually made of cloth or leather, often lined with fur. It is lightweight and can be rolled up for easy transport, but it is not quite as comfortable as a typical bed. Caravans can use bedrolls while traveling for better sleep.
An ergonomically designed quad-wide bed to help support the spine, distribute body weight and overall enchance sleep quality. Fits four.
A traditional form of bedding from an Old Earth culture consisting of a mattress placed upon the floor and a duvet, wide enough to accommodate four people. Decoratively adorned with a bird motif.
A traditional form of bedding from an Old Earth culture consisting of a mattress placed upon the floor and a duvet, wide enough to accommodate four people. Decoratively adorned with a tree motif.
A luxurious gold-inlaid bed fit for the highborn. Very comfy and beautiful, it is a work of art in itself. Fits four.

The quagga is a subspecies of the plains zebra. It is distinguished from other zebras by its limited pattern of primarily brown and white stripes, mainly on the front part of the body. The rear is brown and without stripes, and appears more horse-like.

A quantum-restructing mechanoid micro-organ. It is necessary to produce certain advanced mechanoids and equipment.

A mechanitor can study this chip to help unlock higher tiers of mechtech research. Dropped by the Apoptosis.
A wooden hanging sign use to symbolize the purpose of a room.
A bucket full of oil used in quenching smoldering metals. Increases workspeed when placed near medieval workbenches.
A pie-adjacent breakfast food, consisting of layers of fluffy egg intermitted with delicious morsels of meat, baked into a hearty meal.

An ornate, quick-loading simple shotgun used most often for defending ones claim on the frontier, although also a favorite of bartenders and store owners as an imposing tool against rowdy patrons or thieves.

Tales of steamworld gunslingers would imply this weapon and ones like it are capable of occasional incredibly lucky shots.
An object with ideoligious significance.
Supply of quills and ink. Increases workspeed when placed near a book scribe table.

Long extinct giant reptiles, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

This terrestrial crocodile possesses long legs, which render it much better of a runner than its modern equivalents.
Quinkana's teeth are shaped like knives, which makes them perfect for practically cutting away parts of its prey.
Fertilized quinkana egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby quinkana. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
A wearable leather container designed for holding arrows. Wearing the quiver reduces the time it takes to shoot for bows and crossbows.
Small quiver for arrows.
Folding screens are an important part of the East Asian master bedroom, so why not add a pretty one to the mix?
This small and fluffy, solitary herbivore can swiftly hop away from danger.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.

For a combination of two relatively small animals, the rabbitcat is fucking massive and has a robust physique. It knows no fear and will tackle anything it wants to eat. Some say this was the other attempt to create the Rabbit of Caerbannog, because who says geneticists don’t have a sick sense of humour.

A rodent hybrid with recessive feline genes. Very intelligent considering the source material, these hybrids are fast, lethal and possess a robust physique with rapid natural regenerative capabilities. Quite stubborn so they require frequent, competent training but they aren’t afraid to show their appreciation.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Like all cat hybrids, they have an improved melee dodge ability and a short nuzzle period. All rodent hybrids have fast gestation, as long as a fertility unblocker was used when creating them in the genomorpher.

Legends say of an ancient and vicious monster, a creature so foul, so cruel that no man yet has fought with it and lived. This was a somewhat successful attempt, as its weakness lulls the enemy into a false sense of security so that it can rip their throat out. So do you feel lucky, punk?

A rodent hybrid with recessive avian genes. A tiny, weak, fast-moving pest with an insane appetite for its size. Incredibly fast gestation period and a 1% chance to instantly kill when attacking.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All rodent hybrids have fast gestation, as long as a fertility unblocker was used when creating them in the genomorpher.
Heats rooms using hot water from boilers. Requires 100 heating units.
A Decorative Radio.
A bundle of seeds for radish plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
An edible root vegetable that is very easy to grow and quick to harvest. Radishes are often planted by novice gardeners.

A high-tech device that can be installed into any compatible artificial spine replacement. This particular module is capable of producing immense amounts of harmful radiation and trapping it in a bubble-like barrier it projects around its host, poisoning everyone within its range. While the user is safe from being directly affected by the implant when it's active, it will hurt both enemies and allies that do not possess sufficient protection.

A peaceful herbivore bred to thrive in high radiation environments. Its digestive tract is composed of six bionic stomachs reinforced with a lead-lined biolattice designed to extract residual radioactive material from grass cells. This radioactive material is deposited in crystal-like formations that pierce the hard skin of the creature. These crystals can be harvested periodically and refined into uranium in a standard chemfuel refinery.

The technology behind creating such carefully engineered creatures is completely out of reach in most societies, so a radyak is a valued acquisition.

Giant petals of the rafflesia flower. Smell like rotting flesh and are very likely to cause food poisoning when consumed raw. Rafflesia petals have been used by medieval civilizations in creation of different draughts.
Raw ragadast fruits. Very toxic when uncooked.
A bundle of seeds for ragadast. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A set of rags meant to cover oneself, offers almost no protection or warmth, but meant to convey detachment from life's pleasures and peace with oneself.
An unfinished drone. This will deploy into a drone.
An unsuccessful outcome of ancient parasitic experiments, though it greatly enhances combat effectiveness, the victim lacks any semblance of intelligence and is utterly uncontrollable..

A rack for storting larger bows.
Items stored in this will not affect room beauty and they won't deteriorate, even if outside.

A rack for storting smaller baws.
Items stored in this will not affect room beauty and they won't deteriorate, even if outside.

A rack for storting differnt kind of ranged weapons.
Items stored in this will not affect room beauty and they won't deteriorate, even if outside.

A projectile-repulsion device. It will attempt to stop incoming projectiles or shrapnel, but does nothing against melee attacks or heat. It doesn't prevent the wearer from firing out, and shuts down instantly if hit by EMP.

A plasteel-woven mask that fully covers the head, offering good protection against dry desert heat. Its auto-tracking goggles allow the user to aim quickly and shoot swiftly. And with its built-in cowboy hat and breathable mouth cover, it hides its wearer's identity, lending them a mysterious charm.

This very mystique is found in many outlander folk tales, which speak of men fully clothed in black. Donning this peculiar mask while armed with phase shanks, they appear from the night when needed the most, before leaving at the first glimpse of sunset.

A high-tech device that can be installed into an eye or any compatible artificial eye replacement. This particular model is able to quickly analyze the user's surroundings and forward the data in a form of a simple interface. Its aim assist, projectile trajectory prediction and advanced zoom features make it especially useful for those that specialize in ranged combat.

An advanced brain implant designed to assist the user in ranged combat. The subpersona can quickly and accurately predict a projectile's trajectory even in harsh weather conditions.

A brain implant of such complexity requires time to synchronize with and adapt to its host in order to avoid excessive strain on the central nervous system, its effectiveness will slowly increase during this process. It's capable of syncing with other enhancements made to assist in similar tasks, greatly increasing efficiency.

A high-pressure archite-flow pump fitted with tri-phase accelerators and microchannel conduits that push volatile nanites through the injector lattice at extreme speed. Stabilizing fins vibrate as the pump regulates infusion pressure across the gene chamber.

Shortens the overall injection time by 12 hours when linked to an archogen injector.

Up to 9 rapid infusion pumps can link to a single archogen injector.

A large genetically modified creature that is known to make homes in tropical regions and are very territorial.

Bullets struggle to pierce its thick armor and its sharp claws can slice limbs clean off.

Raptor shrimps have impressive regenerative capabilities and shouldn't be considered dead until they unmistakably are.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.

A small raptor with a downy hide. It is an expert hunter and can be used as a speedy attack animal. Its down can be shed once a year.

Scientific name: Velociraptor mongoliensis
A sign showing members of the raptor family.
A bundle of seeds for raspberry bush. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

An interesting pack animal that packs an incredible punch that also pisses and shits everywhere. That ain’t even the worst part, because these rodents of unusual size are also plague carriers with complete immunity to toxicity. Sometimes scientists just can’t leave well enough alone.

A rodent hybrid with recessive muffalo genes. Quite clever, almost absurdly lethal and quick on its feet. While they are herbivores, they will still happily munch on corpses thanks to their large appetite. Not as short a gestation period compared to other primary rodent hybrids, but every bite transmits the plague.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All rodent hybrids have fast gestation, as long as a fertility unblocker was used when creating them in the genomorpher.
This milk has a rich, thick quality to it. It's origins, however, might be a bit dubious... Unless you trust mafia guys called Tony.
A bed covered in rattan mats, although it feels a bit cold to the touch.
Cabinets woven into various shapes using rattan.
A cool and comfortable rattan carpet with fringes on the edges.
A rattan chair, comfortable and environmentally friendly.
A double bed with a rattan mat and a blanket for more comfort.
A double sofa made of rattan, suitable for placing on the balcony to enjoy the sea breeze.
A table decorated with a rattan mat for easy cleaning.
The wardrobe woven with rattan strips emits a plant fragrance that helps with sleep.

A highly venomous snake, receiving its name from a rattle at the end of their tail. The sound generated sounds as a warning to any predators, however in case it doesn't work, rattlesnake's venom-fangs inflict extremely painful toxin.
A fertilized rattlesnake egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a rattlesnake. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
An unfertilized rattlesnake egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.

A large genetically-engineered insectoid that is a part of the black hive, an artificial ecosystem of insectoids designed to fight mechanoid invasions. The ravager was conceived as a space-bound bioweapon. Drop pods would be filled with ravagers and launched towards mechanoid ships. The insectoids would rip through the ship's plating and destroy any mechanoid inside. Ravagers proved to be too unreliable and the geneline was scrapped.

Several ravagers can be seen in derelict spaceships, stations, and asteroids, as well as aimlessly roaming the countryside. They are mostly adapted to their solitary life in space. These insects can cause additional damage to mechanoids.

A large domesticated ungulate, cows have been bred for millennia to produce huge amounts of milk, meat, and leather. They are exceptionally gentle creatures and will never seek revenge, no matter how many times they are harmed. Most of them are so adapted to farm life that they cannot survive in the wild.
Harvested bileceps. Can be cooked into meals or eaten raw.
Raw blisscap obtained by harvesting blisscap mushrooms. When eaten, makes people incredibly high, but also incredibly drowsy.
Raw fish. A resourceful penguin has fished this.
Raw glowstool fungus obtained by harvesting glowstools growing in caves. Raw glowstool have been used by medieval civilizations in creation of different draughts.
Raw herbs.
Raw, unprocessed honey harvested from an apiary, very sugary and fun to eat while also extremely long-lasting, perfect for taking on caravan trips, fermenting into mead, or baking into desserts.
Raw mithril, needs to be processed into ingots at a smelter to be usable.
A trusty wagon to carry novelties, artifacts, and goods across the unforgiving lands of the rim. Can be used to store items.
Unrefined chunks of plasteel. Can be smelted into usable plasteel bars.
Raw red slime. This stuff is edible. Barely.
The sacs of a very strange plant, partly inorganic, that seems to extract propane from the surrounding landscape and store it as an energy source. These sacs can be consumed as a very mild euphoric.
Minced meat mixed with herbs and spices.

Wood from trees or other fibrous plants. Useful for building structures and weapons. It is a good fuel for campfires and generators, and can be refined into chemfuel. In a pinch, a piece of wood can be used as a weapon or a leg.
A trusty wagon to carry novelties, artifacts, and goods across the unforgiving lands of the rim. Can be used to store items.
Logs that are stacked in an efficient manner to save more space.
Logs that are stacked in an efficient manner to save more space.
Logs that are stacked in an efficient manner to save more space.
A weak patch of leather that has not been exposed to tanning. Its hard and inflexible when dry but is very susceptible to water.

A genetically engineered species based on the black and white tegu, with several traits from the electric eel. The pair of fleshy tentacles extending from a ray-hound's skull are electrogenic and are used as a defense mechanism against predators. An electrical discharge from a ray-hound's tentacles can easily disable electronic circuits.

Ray-hounds make amenable pets, as they tend to become acclimated to their owners and are generally quite docile as adults.

A synthetic combat-enhancing drug developed by Forsakens to counter their weaknesses in combat. These pills reduce pain, slightly increase vision and blood pumping, and improve the user's metabolism. While they aren't addictive, the effect wears off rapidly. Only colonists with the Forsaken Knowledge gene will be able to synthetize this drug.

An aggressive and adaptable creature with a dual-jawed mouth that leads to two separate but intertwined digestive systems, each of them adapted to consume different types of food. This arrangement makes them extremely energy-efficient. Razorjacks can live in the most desolate conditions since their need for nutrients is very low.

Although it might seem canine at first, its genome has more in common with rodents, with some unusual genetic splicing thrown into the mix. Wounds caused by Razorjacks tend to get infected very easily.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.
A classy low-light option for a small area.

A book detailing different recipes and concepts related to new ingredients and culinary techniques.

Once read, it will provide a new favourite ingredient or meal to the reader, and then it will be destroyed (why is it destroyed? I see you haven't spent much time around a kitchen...)

A repurposed package of nutrient-rich bio-material, recovered from toxic waste through advanced recycling processes. The surface is heat-sealed for safe transport. Reclaimed Biopacks improve soil fertility if a stack of 5 of them deteriorate on standard soil. If damaged or burned, they emit a small amount of disgusting rot stink.
An ancient open-reel recorder
A pair of light power armor boots, fitted with strategically placed plasteel plates and servomotors. Their relatively light weight allows the servomotors to work without hinderance.

A pair of light power armor gloves, with plasteel plates covering the majority of the wearer's fingers and hand. Tactile amplifiers and built in neuro-memetic assistors help the wearer with reloading and aiming more efficiently.
A record player.

A low-intelligent microcomputer that monitors the brain activity of its host. By periodically intercepting and altering signals in the brain it allows a person to find joy in whatever they are doing. While it’s not as dangerous and harmful as joywires it has the detrimental effect of making a person unable to gain true joy or fulfillment from something which would otherwise be beneficial to their mood. Due to such a detrimental side effect this implant is typically only used in questionable military organizations and black companies.
A workbench for recycling wastepacks into other resources. Works at 50% of the speed of an electric recycling workbench.
A simple headwrap tied from a long strip of dark-red cloth. Provides a bit of warmth and padding for the noggin'.
A bundle of seeds for red beefsteak tomato plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A variety of tomatoes with a firm, meaty, rich, vibrant red colour. Its flavour is mild, juicy and balanced compared to other varieties.

Also known as sweet peppers, bell peppers are technically nightshades and part of the capsicum family, but they are the only chili pepper that carries a recessive gene that stops any capsaicin from being made in the fruit, thus making them not spicy.

A blob of bubbling organic matter that seems to be an extension of the terrain itself, a disfigured excrescence given a semblance of life.

The red goo seem to thrive in the bizarre environment of the ocular forest, nibbling on the aberrant vegetation and periodically cloning itself. Asexual creatures like this one can't be sterilized.
A fancy intricate silk rug tailored for nobility.

The red panda is a small mammal, slightly larger than a domestic cat, with a bear-like body and thick russet fur. The belly and limbs are black, and there are white markings on the side of the head and above its small eyes. Red pandas are very skillful and acrobatic animals that predominantly stay in trees. It is a solitary animal, mainly active from dusk to dawn, though they can be quite affectionate if properly tamed.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.
A bundle of seeds for red rose bush. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

A strange creature of unknown origin. It isn't carbon based, instead using gallium as the basis of its structure and life functions. This is considered physically impossible under normal circumstances, so the red spore may come from a place where the rules are wildly different from this universe.

The red spore is inherently unstable, with a low lifespan, prone to violent explosions, and unable to reproduce normally. As a floating creature, red spores ignore terrain movement costs.
A red stapler.
Useful for building structures and weapons. It is a good fuel for campfires.
This red tinged wood is oddly strong, and a sweet scent emanates from it. Less flammable than terrestrial wood, but quite ugly.

A combat-enhancing, powerful device that vaporizes a substance containing scarlet mechanites. After twenty hours, the drug stops working and the organism needs a substantial amount of time to regenerate due to massive overheating. If used frequently, Luciferium addiction may occur. However, the drug can be used as a last resort reserved for emergency situations.
A fancy intricate silk rug tailored for nobility.
Redback poison is known world wide for the ability drop a Daer.
A bundle of seeds for redcap. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A small truck with a refrigerated chamber that prevents perishable goods from spoiling. It suffers a lot in offroad or winter conditions.
A refueling pump that will automatically refuel chemfuel-powered vehicles standing on the interaction spot. Needs to be filled with chemfuel.
People eat off tables when chairs are placed facing them.
People eat off tables when chairs are placed facing them.
People eat off tables when chairs are placed facing them.
People eat off tables when chairs are placed facing them.

An insulated coil wrapped in ionized synapse wire and anchored with anti-reflux stabilizers that shield the injector chamber from archite backlash. When active, it emits a soft oscillation designed to suppress rejection-triggering impulses in the nanite stream.

Decreases the rejection chance of the injection procedure when linked to an archogen injector.

Up to 5 rejection buffer coils can link to a single archogen injector.
A religious text detailing the tenets and doctrines of a particular ideological structure.

An implant which increases a hacker's remote hacking distance.

This implant can be installed up to 2 times to increase its effect and requires an advanced cyberlink to function.

It can be self-installed without surgery.

An implant which increases a hacker's remote hacking distance.

This implant can be installed up to 1 time to increase its effect. To go higher, a more advanced port must be used.

It can be self-installed without surgery.

A pair of antigrain warheads connected to a remote triggering mechanism. It can be detonated at will, but the fuse time might vary. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.

A pair of armor-piercing shells connected to a remote triggering mechanism. It can be detonated at will, but the fuse time might vary. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.

A pair of high-explosive shells connected to a remote triggering mechanism. It can be detonated at will, but the fuse time might vary. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.

A pair of cluster shells connected to a remote triggering mechanism. It can be detonated at will, but the fuse time might vary. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.

An implant which allows the mechanitor to psychically attack and override a mechs IFF protocol, taking them under their control, provided the mechanoid is susceptible to psychic attack and the mechanitor has sufficient bandwidth.

This implant can be self-installed without surgery.

This implant can be installed up to 3 times to increase its range.

A pair of EMP shells connected to a remote triggering mechanism. It can be detonated at will, but the fuse time might vary. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.

A pair of firefoam shells connected to a remote triggering mechanism. It can be detonated at will, but the fuse time might vary. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.

A pair of incendiary shells connected to a remote triggering mechanism. It can be detonated at will, but the fuse time might vary. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.

An implant which allows the mechanitor to externally supercharging a recently-killed, allied mechanoid's self-repair processes, provided they have enough bandwidth to take that mech under their control. The mechanoid will come back with some but not all of its wounds healed.

This implant can be self-installed without surgery.

This implant can be installed up to 3 times to increase its range.

A pair of shrapnel shells connected to a remote triggering mechanism. It can be detonated at will, but the fuse time might vary. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.

A pair of smoke shells connected to a remote triggering mechanism. It can be detonated at will, but the fuse time might vary. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.
A small touchscreen data streaming tablet with wireless functionality. Requires a linked router to permit network surveillance.

A pair of tox shells connected to a remote triggering mechanism. It can be detonated at will, but the fuse time might vary. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.

An advanced implant which allows a mechanitor to resurrect the wreck of a friendly mechanoid. The device harvests nutrients from the host's body to produce mechanites which the mechanitor can use to revive a mechanoid and return it to combat readiness.

This implant can be self-installed without surgery.
Miscellaneous bits and bobs that can be used to repair weapons, apparel, and armor at a mending bench.
An ornate and surprisingly portable shotgun meant to be fired one handed from a mounted position. Packs a punch, earning the title

.

Tales of steamworld gunslingers would imply this weapon and ones like it are capable of occasional incredibly lucky shots.

A high-tech device that can be installed into a stomach or any compatible artificial stomach replacement. This particular model is equipped with a chemical processing system that breaks down nutrients the body could normally never use, leading to increased efficiency.

A small internal module designed to control the body’s reproduction functions.  Through the use of synthetic hormones and nanomachines the module is able to alter the user’s body achieving complete control of their organic functions relating to reproduction.

During pregnancy the implant will keep the body and its hormones in a stable state preventing resulting issues such as morning sickness and fluctuating moods.

A payload of reptile genetic material. Can be used at the genomorpher to create a growth cell of a hybrid animal. This tier 2 genome can only be used as primary genome.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All reptile hybrids have greatly increased minimum and maximum comfortable temperature. They also have melee and ranged venomous attacks.

<color=#E5E54C>Extraction:</color> Can only be extracted via any genome excavator from:
installed

Small and venomous, with a deadly fart, not quite what one was expecting for the perfect reptilian form. I mean, you’d think you’d get a tyrannosaurus rex or something but no, it seems that the humble iguana is here to stay. If anything, the shock of something so small moving so fast has got to be worth something.

A perfect reptile animal, paragon of all similar animals with no needless junk genetic data. Besides the various improvements to the baseline animal’s abilities, this paragon is oviparous and can manually rupture neck sacs containing venomous gas.
Fertilized reptile paragon egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked. If all goes well, it should hatch into a reptile paragon.
Unfertilized reptile paragon egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
A slate or chalkboard for sketching diagrams and sharing ideas. Increases work speed when placed near a research bench. Up to two research benches can be linked to one chalkboard.

A machine meant to calculate and conduct complex simulations often used by glitterworld research facilities.

It conducts passive research on its own.
Complex simulations can sometimes overload and cause an energy discharge.

Note that it must be connected to a research bench in order to work.
Increases research speed when placed near research table. Each research bench can  use two small research shelves.
A military-grade tactical respirator mask designed for use on the battlefield. Provides full protection from toxic damage, rendering the user fully immune to pathogen gases.
A belt containing a dose of resurrector serum. Injects the serum immediately after death.
A famed restaurant guide with recommendations for gourmet restaurants and popular refined eateries.
An old, rotted mattress on a rusty frame. Restored to be useable, though a bit uncomfortable.
An old, rotted mattress on a rusty frame. Restored to be useable, though a bit uncomfortable. Fits two people.
An ancient bed once used for forgotten surgical operations. Adjustable for a patient and festooned with built-in equipment, it improves medical outcomes over normal beds. Uncomfortable but efficient.
A chair built for restraining prisoners. Has mounted cuffs to prevent movement of the arms.
An upright wooden cross fitted with restraints for displaying and immobilizing a captive.
A vertical pole built for restraining prisoners. Has mounted cuffs to prevent movement of the arms or legs.
A large rack built for holding prisoners. Has mounted cuffs to prevent movement of the arms or legs.

A small durable core which contains a one-use super-dose of mechanites tuned to resurrect the dead. After the host dies, the core will sustain their mind and, when they choose, rebuild their body. The flesh will rapidly reform, replacing missing organs and healing wounds. The process is not perfect and may cause scarring or other health complications.

A high-tech device that can be installed into a heart or any compatible artificial heart replacement. This particular module is capable of reviving its host. The resurrection process begins shortly after death and might take a few hours or up to a few days depending on the state of the body, damage and decay caused by diseases or toxins slows down the process significantly, but causes no further complications. It needs to be loaded with a resurrector mech serum in order to work, a single serum can supply the implant with enough mechanites to perform two resurrections.

An implant that is formed of hundreds of telescopic, subdermally implanted bioferrite quills and connected to implanted nerves. The implant is crafted from harvested gorehulk nervous systems, using an archotech shard to safely fuse with the user. The retractable spines extend from the user's flesh to impale those who harm them in melee range.

A high-tech device that can be installed into any compatible artificial spine replacement. This particular module is functionally almost identical to the revenant vertebrae implant, the only difference being the option of installing the module alongside other spine replacements and enhancements.
A cute plush dinosaur.
A taught bandana for keeping hair out of the face. We Can Do It! ;)
A bundle of seeds for rice plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

A soft, creamy cheese with a mild flavor, often used in both savory and sweet dishes like pasta, pastries, and desserts. Very quick to make from milk, and a fast, easy way to make a profit from it.

<color=#E5E54C>Trade considerations:</color>

<color=#E5E54C>Ingredients:</color> Making 5 ricotta requires 1.25 nutrition from milk, with an average total value of 47.50, and sells for 12, giving a <color=#33CC33>20.83%</color> profit per unit.

<color=#E5E54C>Value per work:</color> Recipe requires 100 work, which results on a value per work of <color=#33CC33>0.60</color>.

<color=#E5E54C>Caravan trading:</color> Its weight is 0.1 Kg, for a value per Kg of <color=#33CC33>180</color>.

<color=#E5E54C>Profit per day:</color> Profit per day will depend on the animal producing the milk. With cows, it will be <color=#33CC33>1.40</color> (for reference Yayo is 0.35, but cows need to be fed too).
This dress is worn for horseback riding. Even though it is a dress, the figure is very dignified.
Classic slots, default stake is only 2$, perfect for beginners.
High stake slots, default stake is 6$.
A soft-topped bounded table for simulating a war game. A great way to test your strategic skills and a bit of luck.
Medium priced slots, default stake is 4$.
Rimclaws are giant apex predators mutated from iguana, well adapted to highly polluted environments. They are incredibly fast, powerful and intelligent.
A fertilized rimclaw egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby rimclaw. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
An unfertilized rimclaw egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.
A RIM brand rolling tray.
An object with ideoligious significance.
An enchanted ring that bestows upon the wearer additional movement speed—perfect for explorers looking to quickly cover ground and escape dangerous expeditions.
A treasure to merchants and traveling warriors alike, this ring grants increased carrying capacity for those long campaigns and trading caravans.
Through perseverance and wit brings the wonders of the world. Upon wearing this ring, will bless enlightenment to open the mind into the depths of madness and ingenuity.
A powerful ring that grants the wearer complete immunity to stun effects, ensuring uninterrupted movement and action during combat or critical situations.
A ring imbued with a magical power that helps the wearer tend to wounds and illnesses. The wearer also recovers from injuries faster.

A domesticated form of the African collared dove known by many names including Barbary dove, Ringed Turtle dove, and more. Known for its gentle cooing, pale grayish-fawn plumage, and a distinctive narrow black half-collar on the back of its neck.
A fertilized ringneck dove egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a chick. It can be eaten, but why would you do such a thing?
An unfertilized ringneck dove egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
A thick jacket with armor plates inserted on chests, arms, legs and back. Very effective at protecting against blunt trauma, this kind of armor is often used by riot police and heavy infantry alike.

A pair of boots bolstered with padded plates. A bit bulky, but good for preventing your digits from being removed by any sudden blunt force trauma, which helps when trying to detain more rowdy prisoners.

A pair of gloves fortified with padded plates. A bit bulky, but good for preventing your digits from being removed by any sudden blunt force trauma, which helps when trying to detain more rowdy prisoners.
A heavy combat helmet with a face covering plate. Often used by riot police units due to its effectiveness at protecting against blunt trauma.
An industrial heavy shield made out of reinforced steel. Provides a lot of protection against blunt damage, which makes it ideal for urbworld riot police.

A purely biological defense weapon created to fight against insectoids. They sport two viciously sharp claws specially designed to attach to chitinous plates and rip them apart.

Despite their fearsome appearance, ripper hounds can be extremely affectionate and loyal. They love to be pet by those they trust.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.
A can of RM40.
An ancient design of LED sign for marking road work and other can't-miss warnings.

A powerful, specialized tool designed for drilling holes into hard materials such as rock, concrete, or masonry. Featuring a pneumatic or hydraulic mechanism, along with hardened drill bits, the rock drill is capable of delivering high impact forces to penetrate tough surfaces efficiently. Widely used in construction, mining, and geological exploration, it enables workers to create boreholes for various purposes, including blasting, anchoring, and exploration.
Essentially a farm tractor repurposed to carry a rack of explosive rockets. It's fuel usage is high and it has very little armor, but it can easily barrage your enemies from a distance.

An older class of rocket weapon that requires manual control and reload. Fortunately, with the help of decent optics and a deadly blast radius its presence is still dreaded on the front lines. Makes efficient use of high-explosive shells. Gives good cover.
A transport pod fitted with many thrusters. Moves much faster than a regular transport pod, but consumes a lot of fuel.
Automated multi-tube rocket launcher mounted on a quadpod.

Much smaller in size than the emperor penguin, rockhopper penguins weigh less than 10 pounds. They were named for their distinctive hopping movements over the rocky hills and cliffs where they live and breed.
A fertilized rockhopper penguin egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby rockhopper penguin. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
An unfertilized rockhopper penguin egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.

A payload of rodent genetic material. Can be used at the genomorpher to create a growth cell of a hybrid animal. This tier 1 genome can be used as either a primary or secondary genome.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All rodent hybrids have a reduced body size, but greatly increased reproduction rates (if fertile).

<color=#E5E54C>Extraction:</color> Can be extracted via the genome extractor table or any genome excavator from:
installed

Look, I know what you’re thinking. Why is the rat the paragon of all rodents? And even if you’re not thinking that, this is rhetorical anyway so there. What other rodent has caused civilization to collapse due to poorly held beliefs and lack of proper hygiene. As such, we give you the King Rat. Or Queen Rat, if you want a whole colony showing up.

A perfect rodent animal, paragon of all similar animals with no needless junk genetic data. Besides the various improvements to the baseline animal’s abilities, this paragon has a very fast gestation period and its attacks transmit the plague.

Delicate fish eggs harvested from a variety of aquatic species, roe is prized for its briny, rich flavor and smooth texture.

<color=#E5E54C>Trade considerations:</color>

<color=#E5E54C>Ingredients:</color> Making 3 roe jars requires 50 fish with an average value of 1.1, for a total value of 55, and sells for 50, giving a <color=#33CC33>63.33%</color> profit per unit.

<color=#E5E54C>Value per work:</color> Recipe requires 10000 work, which results on a value per work of <color=#33CC33>0.02</color>.

<color=#E5E54C>Caravan trading:</color> Its weight is 0.1 Kg, for a value per Kg of <color=#33CC33>500</color>.

<color=#E5E54C>Profit per day:</color> Super hard to calculate, as it will depend on the fish acquired per day, which depends on size, pawn skill, etc.

An ornate high-power marksmen rifle originally designed for dispatching muffalo in a single shot. Once outfitted with a long-range scope and modernized reloading system it didn't take long for would-be bounty hunters to embrace the hunting instrument.

Tales of steamworld gunslingers would imply this weapon and ones like it are capable of occasional incredibly lucky shots.
A wooden rolling pin.
A basic room divider that keeps the privacy of your pawns.
A sign that automatically takes the name of the room it is placed in as its label and updates if the role of the room changes.
The petals from the flower of the rose plant.
Blocks of solid rose quartz.
A bundle of seeds for rose. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
Tea made from dehydrated or fresh rose petals. A non-caffeinated substitute for other hot beverages.
A masterpiece for true video game nerds who don't care about their bank balance.
a desk which has design that suits the use of metal materials.

A versatile weapon that can fire a continuous stream of needle-like projectiles. Its rotating barrel allows for sustained fire, making it effective against swarms of enemies. Although it lacks the pinpoint accuracy of its single-shot counterpart, the rotary needle gun more than compensates with its high rate of fire and capacity for suppressing large areas.
Do you like curves? Try this desk.
A large domestic dog and one of the oldest herding breeds. Being one of the most hard working dogs, it is a perfect companions for farmers and cattle herders.
An unstable weaved bed perfect for a sleepy baby. A high quality crib will make a baby happy. Multiple cribs can be placed in a bedroom without turning it into a barracks.
An uncomfortable desk where students can learn in general classes. Functions at low speed for most lessons.

A large monitor lizard adapted to life in extreme conditions. Their whole body and metabolism are adapted to environments of higher than normal acidity, thriving around acidic volcanic lakes with a water pH of 2 to 3. This immunity to acid allows them to prey on other creatures that use acid to deter predators.

The rough-plated monitor lays highly acidic eggs that, when hatching, can suddenly explode.

A fertilized rough-plated monitor egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby rough-plated monitor. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked. Rough-plated monitor eggs are violently unstable, and they explode when they hatch!
A round pedestal that can showcase a single item. Colonists can admire it like a work of art.
A round shield, provides decent coverage and protection against physical blows.

The rox is a majestic, large creature with thick, luxurious fur and two impressive horns crowning its head. Known for its gentle demeanor, this enormous beast provides rich, creamy milk, while its fur, sheared and spun into fine yarn, is highly prized for its warmth and softness. The rox's imposing size, combined with its benevolent nature and distinctive horns, makes it a beloved and essential part of any settlement.
A rich meal consisting of spiced steak with toasted potatoes, sauteed in its own beef broth. A delightfully rich and bold-tasting meal.
A Rox's horn. It is heavy, durable, and valuable. It is too bulky to be used as a weapon.

The fabled leather of a rox, made from skinning one of the mighty beasts. Though somewhat rough in its raw form, none can deny its incredible insulating capabilities due to the sheer density of rox hairs. That same density as well as innate composition makes it surprisingly flame- retardent, preventing oxygen from reaching any smoldering embers on the fur. That said, it is a heavy material to work with.
These raw hides and pelts were removed from a creature, and with the right skills and tools, could be processed into tanned leather.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.
Milk from a Rox.
Thick-cut chunks of seared meat arranged on a wooden stake, making for an easily-eaten, tasty meal.

Trophies for the accomplished hunter, animal rugs are formed from stained and stuffed animal hides sewed to felt and padding to form rugs. The polar bears found in frozen climates host great white fur that makes for cold-resistant rugs. Especially valuable to homesteads found in cold temperatures.
A thick slab of fatty rox meat, grilled to infuse smoky and savory flavors while seasoned with salt and stewed in ale. A luxurious feast that every king desires.

A heavier version of the two-handed axe, the greataxe’s weight allows for high raw damage as well as solid durability. A great option for splitting shields or unarmored enemies. Requires great strength to wield effectively. 

Fashioned with a piercing hammer made out of a rox’s horn, it allows for deadly armor penetrating attacks against heavily plated knights.
Thick, coarse and provides very good insulation. Rox wool clothes can keep the body warm even in very cold conditions.

Fermented beverage of deep golden colouring, a real lifeblood of social life in these parts. Few mugs in the tavern are all what's needed to forget about hardships of field work, dangers awaiting on the road or ill-considered marriage vows. Let the warm haze of drunkenness embrace you, no need to worry about anything. Not today.
Crushed berries infused with rox milk.

Rox cheese is a creamy, artisanal delight crafted from the rich milk of the rox. Its smooth texture and slightly tangy flavor make it a prized addition to any feast, perfect for pairing with rustic bread and hearty ales.
A luxurious, large, soft, comfy seat. Great for relaxation. Can be used at tables, work stations, and elsewhere.

A large flightless bird with colorful feathers. Royal aves are meadow aves that underwent selective crossbreeding to reduce their stubbornness and increase their fluffiness. Some of these prized pets get freed into the wild, a life that they are poorly adapted for. Plumage on royal aves are more flamboyant than a regular meadow ave and can rarely showcase an entire rainbow of color on their feathers.

Royal aves are amazing mounts, much faster than horses. If properly trained, they can be ridden into battle at incredible speeds.
A fertilized royal ave egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby royal ave. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.

Luxury clean bathroom basin for keeping your hands clean after using the toilet. High comfort, very attractive.
14L per use

Luxury bath that slow to use, but very comfortable and beautiful. Can be heated by placing an adjacent campfire or log boiler, or via plumbed hot water tanks. Does not require a sewage outlet.
190L per wash

A high-tech double bed featuring advanced hologlass technology. The translucent canopy projects a shimmering starscape, drifting colonists into a deep slumber as they dream of distant homeworlds and unknown galaxies.
It provides the same level of luxury and comfort as a jade royal bed, meeting the high expectations of titled nobility.

Note: This furniture uses a fixed grey and blue color scheme and does not support recoloring.
An ornate chest store by the nobles. Items stored in this will not affect room beauty and they won't deteriorate, even if outside. Multiple chests do not stack comfort bonuses.
A closet to store clothes efficiently and beautifully. Place near beds for a slight comfort bonus

A luxuriously comfortable gold bed with safe latticed sides, perfect for a sleepy baby. A high quality crib will make a baby happy. Multiple cribs can be placed in a bedroom without turning it into a barracks.
A fancy intricate silk rug tailored for nobility.
An elegant dresser framed with gold. Gives a comfort bonus to all nearby beds. Placing more than one dresser near the same bed has no effect.

A small luxurios gilded bedside table which makes nearby beds more comfortable. Must be placed directly adjacent to the head of the bed. Placing more than one end table near the same bed has no effect.

Arachnophobia is no joke for many people, and the researcher that created this armoured arachnid had an inherent desire to share their fear with others. Granted they passed out, frothing at the mouth, when the creature emerged from the pod, but damn it it’s hard to argue with results in a riding companion that can not only keep up with the competition, but also disable them and eat them on the go as a tasty snack.

An equine hybrid with recessive insectoid genes. A rather slow and filthy hybrid of this category, but it works very well as a ride due to the multiple legs easing the burden of long distance travel inherent to caravaning. However, their main advantage is that they are also incredibly capable in combat, being armour plated and capable of both high damage and ranged stunning attacks by shooting globs of sticky threads.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All equine hybrids are good for caravaning. A caravan with one of them needs a shorter resting period, only stopping to rest between 23:30 PM and 4 AM.

Neutroamine is rather difficult to manufacture due to the sterile environment needed in creating a synthetic precursor chemical. So some insane madman decided to create a living creature that can synthesise its own neutroamine. Granted it’s not a lot, but have enough of these disturbingly powerful and quick cobras and no one will ever try to rob you, or live long enough to get away.

A reptile hybrid with recessive insectoid genes. For an animal so small, it has an incredibly powerful bite and can spit venom. The physical form of techprints can range from scraps of paper with diagrams, all the way to advanced self-contained teaching machines. Regardless of form, they play the same role. They give your researchers the confidence that an idea is possible, and a rough idea of the designs used in more established societies.

Your researchers need the foundational knowledge offered by techprints to know where to start on a given technology. Only after enough techprints have been applied can your researchers work out the fine details of how to make use of the technology in your particular situation.

Applying techprints to a satisfied project fulfills half the remaining research progress. In addition, researchers always gain a boost to their intellectual skills when applying techprints, even on already-completed technologies.

A teddybear.

An emergency escape system utilizing translocation technology. It can teleport living beings to itself from anywhere within the visible area or even across the planet. A successful translocation requires the target to have an integrator implant installed, which prepares its brain for the sudden shock. This does not apply to mechanical beings.

It needs a steady flow of neutroamine to stabilize the process.
A simple tracking device designed to tune the user’s brain waves to accept sudden translocations. It establishes a link to a telepad.

A masterpiece of the culinary arts, this sushi nourishes the body, mind, and soul. Temaki is a large cone-shaped piece of nori on the outside and the ingredients spilling out the wide end. A typical temaki is about 10 centimetres long, and is eaten with fingers because it is too awkward to pick it up with chopsticks.
Absolutely and completely worthless, but when properly processed alongside an actual genome it can be trimmed down to an identical copy.
Capsules containing growth hormones that help speed up the hybrid’s growth process, halving the time it takes to complete.
Raw tendrilmoss obtained by harvesting tendrilmoss vines growing around insectoid tendril farms.

A combination of two ancient designs: a hammer, and a long stick. It's used to bludgeon enemies' armor inwards, hurting them with blunt trauma and sharp edges of their own apparel. It's shaped from a tenebrite crystal into a shape vaguely resembling the function.

A small, personal tent no larger than a single person bed. When pitched, such a tent will easily protect a pawn from elements such as heat or cold, however it’s not quite as restful, as one is still laying directly on the ground.
The blue nodules grow at the end of each branch / tentacle of a tentacular plant, and they produce an eerie rattling sound from time to time.

An incredibly rare and monstrously large insectoid of the Chelis geneline, the teramantis is the formidable leader of insectoid hives on the steppe planets of Chelis. Known as a prime male, this massive insectoid is equipped with lethal ripper claws sharp enough to cleave armored vehicles in two. Complementing its fearsome offensive capabilities, the teramantis boasts a large set of wings, granting it the ability to soar across the vast landscapes in pursuit of prey for hundreds of miles. Its aerial prowess and deadly strength make it a dreaded apex predator on Chelis, commanding respect and fear from all who dwell within its territory. Upon death, it’s possible to extract a Chelis pherocore from its body.

An amorphous, flesh coloured, translucent creature that lacks everything but the most basic instincts. It moves around slowly and sometimes devours plants it comes in contact with, incorporating it into its cytoplasm. There are some chunks of seemingly normal flesh floating inside it.

Teratogenic originators are an enormous clonal colony of pluripotent stem cells, capable of differentiating into different tissues. They were engineered by a group of unethical scientists as a cheap way to create lab-grown limbs suitable for transplants but the end results is less than ideal. These strange mutant limbs can be periodically excised from the creature and used at will. Asexual creatures like this one can't be sterilized.

A strange looking crustacean that was created with the intention to process minerals. They can feed on steel compounds and process them chemically to slowly turn them into sky steel, a type of material that is normally only found in asteroids.

The transmutation process is very slow, so it needs to spend a lot of time surrounded by steel. It can also slowly consume, but not convert, steel slag chunks.
A globe capable of accelerating research.
A cupboard with geometric pattern glass window. Place all of your pretentious bits and bobs inside the cupboard.

An ultratech arc lightning device capable of emitting a lightning bolt that disable electronic systems and sets enemies on fire.

By using advanced battery cells, this weapon is capable of warming up, boosting the firing speed with each consecutive shot when standing still.

Used widely by ultratech marines during mechanoid wars.

A common sight among glitterworld territories, where they lumber about as glorified power plants. Outside of those terrories, they are deployed as a mobile power source for glitterworld research expeditions. Their bodily chemical composition is capable of outputting power that far surpasses any known natural sources. Thus, they are widely valued by every technologically developing civilization throughout the galaxy.

While they would prefer to run away instead of fight, modified slugs are armored with plasteel shells, quad cores that can act as tesla cannons, and a tactical AI inserted within the brain that takes over and makes no hesitation to use all of its armament to obliterate any perceived threat nearby. Properly outfitted tetra slugs will slowly recharge batteries in their vicinity.
A sign about dinosaurs.
A cylindrical barrel for general storage. Items stored in this will not affect room beauty and they won't deteriorate, even if outside.
A textile rack that can hold up to 3 stacks of various textiles.
A box stuffed with fabrics, leathers, and specialty textiles for crafting.
A trusty wagon to carry novelties, artifacts, and goods across the unforgiving lands of the rim. Can be used to store items.
The chicken book. An unreadable mistery of a book. What is this about? Is it the cruel joke of an insane archotech?
This eye analyzes its surroundings with carefully planned discipline, missing no details.
A steamy, questionably-written play featuring a hardworking Saurid maid and her noble employer.

This gaudy looking eye seems to have a life of its own, trying to catch the attention of other people with carefully directed winks and furtive, sultry glances that beckon with a false allure. It allows its host to recover quicker from psychic exhaustion.
This strange mutant eye is covered by dense plates of bone instead of a normal fleshy eyelid, and seems to be almost impervious to pain.
A bloodshot eye with a triangular pupil. This horrible mutant eye confers the gift of improved psychic sight.
An eye that never blinks, keeping itself moist by unknown means. It pervades its host with a sense of preternatural calmness.
A weird mutant eye that is never fully open, being partially covered by a sickly looking eyelid. Strangely enough, it provides normal sight while protecting its host from psychic attacks.
An eye that can't stop blinking uncontrollably. While extremely distracting and disconcerting, it allows its host to cast more psychic powers before exhaustion.
Designed for therapy education, this couch provides a comfortable and private space for colonists to work on their mental stability and composure.

A large blackspider that has been biologically augmented with volatile chemical glands. Originally, it was bred by the creators of the black hive as a fearsome fire-breathing shock trooper, using thermal grenades capable of affecting mechanoids. They managed to quickly adapt to these biological grenades. The thermadon project was abandoned and they were released into the wild.

An implant designed to help regulate the bodies temperature allowing a person to endure harsher cold and heat without ill effects.  The implant integrates seamlessly with the body's natural systems, employing a combination of microthermal regulators and advanced bio-coolants. The implant constantly monitors the body's core temperature through a network of nanosensors embedded in the skin and circulatory system. When exposed to high temperatures, the system activates micro-cooling channels that dissipate heat by circulating a special coolant through the body. Conversely, in cold environments, the implant triggers a micro-heating mechanism, increasing blood flow and gently warming tissues to maintain a stable internal temperature.
A bundle of seeds for thermoregulus. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

A heavy duty sniper rifle loaded with thermobaric ammunition. A large powered scope hones in on possible targets allowing for better precision. The high-caliber cartridges disperse flammable aerosolized gas upon impact which explodes causing intense pressure waves and subsequently rarefaction. Thermobaric weapons are considered the best option against mechanoids, and were widely employed during the mechanoid wars.
Used to control electric and gas boilers. More than one can be placed. Connects via standard plumbing.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.
A basic room divider that keeps the privacy of your pawns. Capable of holding up a roof.
Coarse, strong wool. Provides heat and cold protection, as well as decent defense.
A basic room divider that keeps the privacy of your pawns. Capable of holding up a roof.
These raw hides and pelts were removed from a creature, and with the right skills and tools, could be processed into tanned leather.
Warm furs of the formidable unhold, renowned for their thickness and weatherproof nature, sought after for crafting resilient garments and protective gear.
Lightweight, thin leather from a small theropod or sauropod. Doesn't insulate well.
These raw hides and pelts were removed from a creature, and with the right skills and tools, could be processed into tanned leather.
Brittle, strange smelling wool. Not the best wool to craft apparel with, though it's better than nothing. Provides nice heat insulation.

A mystical organ from an Alp, known for its ability to perceive beyond the physical realm. Often sought after for use in powerful rituals or crafting items with enhanced perception or psychic abilities.
An object with ideoligious significance.
A bundle of seeds for thorn weed. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A volatile pod covered in sharp chitin thorns, produced by giant insects. If any target gets close to it, the pod expunges the thorns, after which it will take some time to grow them back.
Raw thorns of weed. Requires cleaning for further use.
The active numbing chemical found within thornweed needles, refined into a much more potent serum with fewer unwanted side effects.

A small carnivorous synapsid roughly similar in size to foxes with diets that typically consist of insects and small herbivores. Their tendency to burrow helped them survive through one of the mass extinction events back on Earth.

The Thrinaxodon is native to Tundra and Boreal Forest regions, able to survive the cold both due to their fur and burrowing habits. They are also a social creature and often found in packs, which usually result in them hunting larger prey when there is a lack of suitable low-risk sustenance.
A fertilized thrinaxodon egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby thrinaxodon. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
An unfertilized thrinaxodon egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.
A single-handed axe made for throwing. Light enough to be thrown accurately at medium range, it's also a great melee weapon in the hands of a capable warrior.
A set of crude rock or metal shards that can be thrown a short distance.

Throwspikes are short sticks sharpened on both sides. They take a while to throw, but can do reasonable damage when they hit. This weapon represents a bundle of throwspikes and can be thrown over and over.

Now here’s a creature you absolutely want to keep properly fed, and you’re going to need entire fields to support a single one. The ridiculous amount of chemfuel they produce means that the ceasing of their life functions is more accurately described as “thermonuclear”. So if they are going to blow up, send them as a surprise gift to friends and family who keep trying to kill you.

A colossal hybrid with recessive boomalope genes. The addition of chemfuel production has vastly increased the amount of food they need to survive, but they’re also smart enough to not need a pen. Consider keeping them far away from your growing fields if the local biome can grow vegetation fast enough to support one.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All colossal hybrids have very slow attacks, but hit very hard, and possess natural armor.

If you thought Thrumbos were tough and hit like a tank, may I present to you the answer to all your prayers. If you can feed the thing, this absolute unit would work extremely well as an assault force against any force foolish enough to threaten its feedstock. Plus you get to ride it on long journeys, possibly clearing entire forests on the way.

A colossal hybrid with recessive ursine genes. While proportionately it has a lower metabolism, its 50% increase in size still leaves it with a higher hunger rate than a thrumbo. They are however easier to train, hit much harder and can take even more punishment.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All colossal hybrids have very slow attacks, but hit very hard, and possess natural armor.
These raw hides and pelts were removed from a creature, and with the right skills and tools, could be processed into tanned leather.
A genetically modified thrumbo horn that can be implanted in a subject's forehead. Nasty.

Trophies for the accomplished hunter, animal rugs are formed from stained and stuffed animal hides sewed to felt and padding to form rugs. Few hunters can craft a trophy with a more refined and resistant coat than that of the thrumbo rug. Its long fur can catch the eye of any colonist, but the strong hide requires much work to tailor. Beware the horn while walking.
A synthetic skin substitute that is much thicker and a much better insulator than human skin. This provides a lot of defense and makes the subject more resistant to extremes of temperature.

The other half of the super predator duo, along with the Thrumwolf, exchanging some ferocity and durability in exchange for going for the trachea and spitting suffocating hairballs. That might not sound that dangerous but imagine having a fistful of hair pulled from a shower drain smothering your mouth, and you’ll realise that’s still not disgusting enough. But for those that it appreciates, it will often pin them down and snuggle them given the chance.

A colossal hybrid with recessive feline genes. A large predator with an insane appetite with a focus on ferocious attacks that restrict their prey’s breathing. Extremely agile with a soft spot for those it loves, best suited for biomes that support enough wildlife to sate its hunger.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All colossal hybrids have very slow attacks, but hit very hard, and possess natural armor.

This is probably the closest chickens will be able to get to recovering their past glory as super predators. They’ll often hunt any other animal for their next meal, multiple times a day, and you haven’t yet lived until you’ve ridden one on a long journey. If they could be further bred to cross mountains and oceans, they’d be almost perfect.

A colossal hybrid with recessive avian genes. The combination of genes has turned this somewhat peaceful herbivore/dendrovore into a full carnivore, which makes it easier to support their large appetite. As an intelligent predator, it can move incredibly quickly for its size and its attacks are incredibly fierce. It also lays massive eggs that can feed entire families.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All colossal hybrids have very slow attacks, but hit very hard, and possess natural armor.
Fertilized Thrumbochicken egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into one of these abominations. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Unfertilized Thrumbochicken egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.

About as close as anyone has ever gotten in making a recreation of dragons from folklore. Capable of surviving in extreme cold or heat, the only thing really missing is a pair of wings and an innate desire to hoard piles of gold for a nest. That and the fact that it isn’t carnivorous, instead having an appetite for vegetables and wood fibres.

A colossal hybrid with recessive reptile genes. With a mouth dripping with venom and tough, flexible scales covering the body, this hybrid makes for a nasty and incredibly durable combat hybrid. If that wasn’t enough, it can also breath out a fog of noxious fumes and move deceptively quickly.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All colossal hybrids have very slow attacks, but hit very hard, and possess natural armor. All reptile hybrids have good temperature tolerance ranges and venomous attacks.

Look, we know what you want, a thrumbo that won’t eat your crops before they’ve harvested, thereby wasting entire seasons of growth for your most valuable plants. And we’re here to tell you it doesn’t exist. But we’ve gotten close in that this one will typically harvest your plants before it eats them for worse nutritional gain. Unless it’s trees, in which case we got nothing.

A colossal hybrid with recessive humanoid genes. Considerably easier to train and maintain, this particular hybrid will help around the colony by cutting and harvesting designated plants. Unusually lean for how much it eats, it won’t provide much in butchering.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Humanoid hybrids will periodically engage other colonists in conversation, talking about a variety of topics. This increases the social recreation needs of those they interact with by 10% (subject to diminishing returns like all joy types). If using Ideology, humanoid hybrids are subject to precepts. All colossal hybrids have very slow attacks, but hit very hard, and possess natural armor. Thrumbomen will obey orders to cut and harvest plants around the colony.
These raw hides and pelts were removed from a creature, and with the right skills and tools, could be processed into tanned leather.

Practically an overgrown and intelligent pest capable of tunnelling underground, so not even a nuke could clear an infestation. And it truly would be an infestation, as it has a gestation period measured in days rather than weeks, with a single breeding pair capable of wiping out an entire agricultural planet.

A colossal hybrid with recessive rodent genes. Incredibly durable and fast breeding, this surprisingly small hybrid can work as a durable screening force. One of the weakest colossal hybrids in terms of attack power but very few can outlast its incredibly robust physique.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All colossal hybrids have very slow attacks, but hit very hard, and possess natural armor. Burrow underground: Thrumborats can burrow underground to make them almost immune to damage for a short while.

A leftover bioweapon from a now extinct civilisation designed to completely eradicate biomes with dense vegetation. Records indicate that the local indigineous tribes were very resistant to corporate takeover and the megacorp in charge wanted to reduce profit losses. Eventually the planet starved as they were unable to stop these creatures from feasting on farmlands and food reserves.

A colossal hybrid with recessive insectoid genes. A slow moving tank with limited regenerative capabilities, they are almost unkillable if it weren’t for their crippling hunger. As durable as a capital ship, any colony that could possibly support the diet of even a single one would be considered impervious to raids.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All colossal hybrids have very slow attacks, but hit very hard, and possess natural armor. They are always sterile and can't reproduce, even if a fertility booster is used to create them.

A huge, boar-like animal that will eat anything on its path. Thrumdraedons are cunning and resourceful.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All colossal hybrids have very slow attacks, but hit very hard, and possess natural armor. Keen senses ability: Twice a day, the Thrumdraeodon can activate an ability that gives it increased awareness of its surreoundings.

One of the largest creatures in existence, dwarfing even the thrumbo and the mighty Gallatross. Capable of transporting a massive amount of material, producing a luxurious and excellent wool as well as thick, nutritious milk, they are almost the perfect farm animal. That is as long as you don’t look at your feed costs and die of a heart attack, but the scientists that designed this hybrid never had to worry about such things. Food is something for the proles to worry about.

A colossal hybrid with recessive muffalo genes. Completely herbivorous and with an appetite large enough to cause even large colonies to starve within a single season. This hybrid can prove worth the food costs as it produces thick, delicious milk every couple of days as well as luxurious wool every couple of seasons. Slightly more dimwitted than its progenitor and will attempt to wander off in search of food if not kept penned up.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All colossal hybrids have very slow attacks, but hit very hard, and possess natural armor.
Milk from a thrumffalo. Very nutritive. Also with a sky-high cholesterol content, but in the Rim nobody judges you.

A very nice combination of two highly adaptive baseline creatures which arguably results in the best riding companion man could ask for. While this isn’t apparent in their speed, it definitely is so once a rider experiences the thundering beats of this horsey positively barreling through entire forests and marshland in order to earn its next sugar cube the size of a fist.

A colossal hybrid with recessive equine genes. While they have a lower muscle-to-fat ratio compared to their progenitor, the overall placement and shape of the horn vastly reduces their combat efficiency. Instead, they more than make up for this shortfall with an incredible endurance even compared to paragons. An excellent riding companion that is easier to train and can even carry an acceptable amount of luggage, the majority of which contains feed.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All equine hybrids are good for caravaning. A caravan with one of them needs a shorter resting period, only stopping to rest between 23:30 PM and 4 AM. Always starts as draftable, even if not using a controller booster to create it. Charge ability: when drafted, the player can use the charge ability to make the hybrid jump towards a target and cause massive damage with its horn to a single random body part. The ability can be triggered every 2 hours.

There’s a saying about the scientific community, namely “your scientists were so preoccupied with whether they could, they didn’t stop to think if they should”. This is entirely relevant to this creature, a super predator with practically no equal, a single one of these is enough to require an entire rainforest to support their daily sustenance. If that wasn’t bad enough, they were made along with the Thrumbocat as part of a duo.

A colossal hybrid with recessive canine genes. A large predator with an insane appetite with the necessary ferocity to support itself, very few colonies can support the diet of such a hybrid. Incredibly robust, fast and a terrifying ferocity, they will hunt multiple times a day and often go after prey much bigger than themselves.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All colossal hybrids have very slow attacks, but hit very hard, and possess natural armor.

A single-person burst rocket for short-ranged flight. With its integrated harness and guidance assistant, the thruster pack allows anyone to leap long distances at high speed, even over obstacles. It must be recharged after several uses.
Breaching explosive grenades. Powerful concussion bombs that are extremely effective against walls and structures, but do much less damage to small targets.

A swine-like mammal capable of generating large electric currents. It has a specialized nervous system that can synchronize the activity of disc-shaped, electricity-producing cells inside a specialized organ.

Though they were initially created to serve as a way to generate bio-electricity, thunderbeasts have naturally evolved over the centuries making them extremely unstable. They can release jolts of electricity at great distances and will negatively affect weather if they are slaughtered. Predators usually give them a wide berth.

A creature often seen in colder environments, it is recognized by its shaggy thick fur and stumpy but effective horn. They get their name from their tendency to bray out during the dawn of thunderstorms, which is used as a signal by farmers and drifters alike to seek refuge. They are reared in cold wastelands for their thick milk, comfortable fur, and tough but satiating meat.

Thunderox are resilient beasts and can slowly regenerate their health.
A shy and nocturnal carnivorous predator, with the general appearance of a medium-to-large-size dog, except for its stiff tail and abdominal pouch similar to a kangaroo's.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.
A bundle of seeds for tiger lily. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A bundle of seeds for tiger tooth Aloe plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
Timber that are stacked in an efficient manner to save more space.
Timber that are stacked in an efficient manner to save more space.
