These raw hides and pelts were removed from a creature, and with the right skills and tools, could be processed into tanned leather.

Trophies for the accomplished hunter, animal rugs are formed from stained and stuffed animal hides sewed to felt and padding to form rugs. The grizzled grayish-brown fur of the timber wolf may make for a valuable rug but comes with a high cost as the hunter will likely face the beast in a pack.
A bundle of seeds for timbercap. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A bundle of seeds for tinctoria. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A bundle of seeds for tinctshroom. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A box of tissues.
A bed specially designed for handling huge pawns. It can also function as a hospital bed.

Long extinct giant birds, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

Colloquially known as terror birds, titanis are large carnivorous flightless birds. Their abnormally huge beaks are incredibly deadly, and their strong legs not only allow them to easily outrun their prey, but can also serve vicious kicks.
Fertilized titanis egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby titanis. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.

Long extinct giant reptiles, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest snake ever discovered, Titanoboa, is capable of swallowing cows whole. It can kill even medium-sized animals in just seconds, and thus should be stayed away from at all costs.
Fertilized titanoboa egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby titanoboa. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.

An incredibly rare and monstrously large insectoid of the Nuchadus geneline, the titantick is a formidable engineered tick, designed to serve as a mobile fuel depot on the harsh magma planet of Nuchadus. This creature features an enormous chemfuel sack attached to its lower abdomen, which is prone to leaking vast quantities of fuel when damaged. In addition to its capacity to store fuel, the titantick can also project streams of burning chemfuel over long distances, making it a dangerous adversary in combat. The volatile nature of its fuel sack means that upon death, the titantick will explode spectacularly, but it’s still possible to extract a Nuchadus pherocore from his body.
Pipe, cut tobacco bag, pipe presse.Gentleman's time
A bundle of seeds for tobacco plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

A semicircular, open-bottomed garment designed to cover the entire body and shoulders. While similar to tribal clothing the toga is generally made with a more delicate touch and presents itself as dignified everyday wear.

Sanitation fixture used for the disposal of human urine and faeces.
14L per use
A sheet of fried, folded egg housing a tasteful cumilation of runny yolk and sauteed tomato.
An archotech tome of psycasting powers, allowing non-psychic people access to powerful fire-based skills.

A table designed for playing tongo. A complex, strategic game involving risking silver to buy-in into ventures like confronting or retreating.

The game originates on Avaris, the home planet of boglegs, and it is so complex that no computer has been able to properly play it to this day.

This building requires adjacent chairs or stools to use.
A simple tool belt with everything needed to nail a couple of planks or fix electrical appliances.
A collection of smithing tools. Increases workspeed when placed near medieval workbenches.
A toolbox.
A set of tools.
An object with ideoligious significance.
A belt with a number of wooden torches strapped to it. They can be lit up and thrown to set things ablaze. Can be refueled with wood.
a large bed with a unique streamlined design.

Tattered scraps of parchment, often found scattered in ancient ruins or dropped by fleeing bandits. Each fragment holds a piece of a larger puzzle, scribbled with cryptic hints, crude maps, and faded symbols. When pieced together, these notes reveal the locations of hidden hideouts, forgotten treasures, and other intriguing points of interest. The pursuit of these fragmented clues leads adventurers on a journey of discovery, testing their wits and perseverance.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. This particular model includes a compact storage and deployment apparatus for tornado generators. The core functions of the targeter remain the same and it has to be replaced after each use as a result. Due to its small size and low weight, the wielder can carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

A dark, foreboding purple liquid. When the user drinks it, it induces severe pain, incapacitating them to the point where movement becomes impossible. For prisoners, this intense agony causes a rapid decline in their will to resist, breaking down any mental barriers they may have. In the case of slaves, the draught completely suppresses their spirit, leaving them entirely subdued. This potion is used with caution due to its extreme effects.

A brightly-marked fruit-eater best known for its oversized, colorful bill; a structure that looks heavy and dangerous but is actually a lightweight lattice of keratin over a foam-like bone core, built for reaching fruit rather than fighting.

Toucans are Neotropical forest specialists, rarely found far from the dense tree cover of thick rainforests and cloud forests.
A fertilized toucan egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a chick. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
An unfertilized toucan egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
A touchscreen display table where students can sit and learn in general classes. Interactive examples appear on the screen to help students learn at lightning fast speed.
A discarded towel.
Impressive bathroom towel rail.

An experimental variation of an arm-blade with an integrated acidifier fluid dispenser. Upon contact, it dispenses a small amount of acidifier and toxic vapours. The effect only lasts a few seconds and is inflicted roughly half of the time. When retracted, neuromuscular synchronisation makes it appear and function like a normal arm.

A high-tech device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. This particular module is capable of producing a cloud of tox gas around its user by releasing a concoction of volatile chemicals through vent-like openings. Syncing with other modules of the same model allows it to work with greater efficiency.
Charge powered lethal gas canister causing toxic buildup over a very short period of time, strapped to a belt. Can be reloaded using tox grenades.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial leg replacement. This particular model includes a tox grenade dispenser which can be used similarly to a standard grenade belt or its contents can be launched directly from it with a swift leg motion. It is relatively small and well-hidden, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

A high-tech device that can be installed into any compatible artificial lung replacement. This particular module produces and mixes specialized chemicals that can be sent through the airways and launched out of the mouth or nose. The resulting chemical reaction creates a wave of tox gas. While the substances by themselves pose no risk for the host, the module provides no protection against the gas produced by combining them. Syncing with other modules of the same model allows it to work with greater efficiency.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. This particular module comes with a compact storage and launch system for deploying tox IED traps from a distance. The implant needs to be loaded with tox shells in order to function.

The Toxafox is a highly intelligent fox that has evolved to survive in the harshest of environments. With a keen sense of smell, it is capable of digging up waste packs buried deep underground, making it a persistent pest. Its presence in an area inadvertently generates more pollution, making it a major environmental hazard. Despite its small size, the Toxafox should not be underestimated. Its cunning and adaptability make it a formidable opponent in a world already wracked by toxicity and decay.

The Toxbear is a monstrous and deadly creature born from a polluted environment. Standing at an immense size, this mutated bear is a force to be reckoned with. With no natural predators, it roams and hunts at will, leaving destruction in its wake. Its aggressive behavior is fueled by cancerous growth around its head, making it nearly impervious to damage.

As the growth puts pressure on its brain, the Toxbear becomes increasingly violent, eventually turning completely rabid. Not long after that, toxbears are known to try and scratch their own brains out, resulting in their violent demise.

A defensive melee persona weapon usually assigned to every Imperial noble of rank Yeoman or above. While armor penetration is comparable to plasteel blades, the primary function is to dispense acidifer fluids and toxic vapors upon inflicted cuts. The effect only lasts a few seconds and is inflicted roughly half of the time due to the limited size of the weapon.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm replacement. This particular model includes a modified toxbomb launcher that can be fully retracted outside of combat, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

Raw meat from a toxic animal.

Chewy, gelatinous and disgusting.
A mechanoid-built gun that fires toxin-infused metal needles. It can fire long distances and will poison the target in addition to doing physical damage.
A hopper-like storage basin meant to input toxic waste into the network, filling up connected tanks.
A hopper-like storage basin meant to hold dispensed toxic waste from tanks periodically for use later.

The Toxiguana is a small, two-legged lizard that is well adapted to highly polluted environments. Standing about the size of a dog, this creature is not to be underestimated. It has a formidable defense mechanism, capable of spitting corrosive acid at any predator that threatens it. When it dies, a chemical reaction causes its body to rapidly decompose, releasing a toxic cloud of gas that can be dangerous to any living thing that comes into contact with it. The Toxiguana is a remarkable example of the resilience of life in even the harshest of environments.
A fertilized toxiguana egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby toxiguana. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
An unfertilized toxiguana egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
A bundle of seeds for toxipotato plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

The toxlion is a sad reflection of what once was a proud and powerful predator. Its toxic environment has left it weak and emaciated, forcing it to survive by feeding on waste. Despite its diminished state, the Toxlion is still a threat. Its bites and claws have a high chance of spreading the toxflu, and it hunts in large packs to make up for its lack of strength and speed.

Toxflu is a highly contagious and rapidly striking disease, characterized by fever, cough, fatigue, and difficulty breathing. It spreads quickly through contact with infected bodily fluids. Those who contract Toxflu can experience severe respiratory distress and, in severe cases, death. It goes away nearly as quickly as it appears, however anyone who interacted socially with a person suffering from toxflu has a chance of catching it.
A bundle of seeds for toxpuff. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

The Toxscorpion is a massive and fearsome creature, growing as large as a cow. Its thick carapace and powerful claws make it nearly invulnerable, capable of cutting through even metal. With no definite weak spot, the Toxscorpion is a formidable opponent. Mutated from exposure to radiation and toxins, its stinger injects a fast-acting poison that alters the DNA of its victims. This leads to toxic buildup and cancerous growths that must be swiftly removed before they spread, making the Toxscorpion one of the most dangerous creatures in the wasteland.

A high-tech device that can be installed into any compatible artificial limb or spine replacement. This particular model, upon detecting an attack on the user, sends out a directional burst of toxic micro-gas toward the attacker through the module's vent-like openings. Due to its limited effective range it is most potent in close-quarters combat, especially against assailants within melee range.
A wooden trailpost.
A broken wooden trailpost.
An old wooden trailpost.
A target dummy made out of wood, soil, and dried plant matter. Surprisingly durable, allows oneself to test their swordsmanship and train over time without risking fatal confrontation.
A training manual with a lot of specialized knowledge of a single skill.

A crystalline multi-lens console powered by phased neuro-optic conduits and reflective geno-beam sequencers that split archite outcomes into selectable possibility streams. Its prism array glows with shifting spectral patterns when a stable result is detected.

Allows choosing between two different archite genes on a successful injection.

Up to 1 trait selection prism can link to a single archogen injector.

A package of non-toxic rubbish, carefully sorted and compacted for efficient storage. The surface is heat-sealed for safe transport. Trash poses no risk of pollution or deterioration, making it safe for long-term storage. However, if burned, trash will release a moderate amount of tox gas as a byproduct of combustion.

A stack of solid bricks, created by compressing non-toxic trash into a brick form. The surface is heat-sealed for safe transport. Trashbricks are a durable building material for constructing walls and structures. If damaged or burned, they will release a moderate amount of toxic fumes. Trashbricks do not deteriorate.
The oversized and eye-catching purple travel bag is already broken.
An oversized and eye-catching purple travel bag. It is already broken, but seems to contain something inside.
Burger tray.
Burger tray.
Burger trays.
An indoor cardio machine that simulates walking or running. Ideal for improving stamina and cardiovascular health.

Carefully bound volumes filled with detailed knowledge and techniques on various subjects. Each book offers in-depth explanations and practical advice, helping readers master new skills. Written by experts and often accompanied by detailed diagrams, these books are valuable resources for learning and improvement.

An enchanted tome made back in the golden age. Each page seems to be immeasurably steeped in ambiguity, imbued with signs of magic. Its undecipherable phrases slowly turn into a recognizable language when stared upon. Uttering its words will surely grant change, however, rendering the book useless.

A treatise detailing the many uses in crafting of stainless steel.

The trebuchet relies on powerful torsion to launch stones over a great distance and with such power to destroy walls. This makes the trebuchet a fearsome siege weapon capable of ravaging defenses; where siege attackers used to climb palisades under enemy missiles, they can now create openings before the battle even begins. Upon seeing the great trebuchet deployed to fields, defenders should attempt to destroy it quickly.
A simple platform to saw raw wood into planks.

A triangular prism-shaped lamp.
Illuminates the surrounding area.
Light sources affect both work efficiency and movement speed.
A simple crate of tribal tools, supplies, and traditional equipment.
A kilt crafted using neolithic tools. While it may look primitive, it is effective at insulating the wearer.
A poncho crafted using neolithic tools. While it may look primitive, it is effective at insulating the wearer.
A sign about triceratops.
A sign explaining triceratops fossils.

One of the most well-known dinosaurs to even the least educated on the Rim, Triceratops had a large neck frill, two large brow horns, and a smaller nasal horn. They sometimes fought among themselves, whether it be for mates or territory and some remains even showed signs of having fought Tyrannosaurs.

Scientific name: Triceratops horridus
A thin and delicate pair of glasses fitted for the unique heads of the Avaloi. Others can wear it, but they don't look as glamorous.
A simple triple-wide bed that fits three people.

A simple triple-wide bed that lays on the floor, usually made of cloth or leather, often lined with fur. It is lightweight and can be rolled up for easy transport, but it is not quite as comfortable as a typical bed. Caravans can use bedrolls while traveling for better sleep.
An ergonomically designed triple-wide bed to help support the spine, distribute body weight and overall enchance sleep quality. Fits three.
A traditional form of bedding from an Old Earth culture consisting of a mattress placed upon the floor and a duvet, wide enough to accommodate three people. Decoratively adorned with a bird motif.
A traditional form of bedding from an Old Earth culture consisting of a mattress placed upon the floor and a duvet, wide enough to accommodate three people. Decoratively adorned with a tree motif.
A luxurious gold-inlaid bed fit for the highborn. Very comfy and beautiful, it is a work of art in itself. Fits three.
Tanned, dried, scraped troll skin.
These raw hides and pelts were removed from a creature, and with the right skills and tools, could be processed into tanned leather.

A suit of light minimally-powered armor. Lightweight plasteel-weave plates block attacks, and neuro-memetic assistors in the lower body redistribute weight carried by its user. It is slimmer than other powered armor and can fit under clothes.

Armor like this is often used by imperial conscripts and late-midworld military forces.

A high-tech and lightweight armored helmet with a protective plasteel-weave plate.

Armor like this is often used by imperial conscripts and late-midworld military forces.
A single trophy, allowing you to show off your achievements - real or imagined.
A gold trophy.
Tropical potted plants composed of plants such as Fusang and pineapple.
Several tropical flower pots, pineapple baskets, and coconut juice make up your vacation plan.
A standard pair of clothing for burghers and nobility alike.

Oil infused with the essence of truffles, prized for its deep, earthy aroma and luxurious flavor. A few drops can elevate even the simplest dish into a decadent delicacy.

<color=#E5E54C>Trade considerations</color>:

<color=#E5E54C>Ingredients:</color> Making 6 truffle oil requires 15 oil plus 50 raw fungus for a total of 205 value, and sells for 75, giving a <color=#33CC33>54.44%</color> profit per unit.

<color=#E5E54C>Fermentation time:</color> 20 days.

<color=#E5E54C>Caravan trading:</color> Its weight is 0.3 Kg, for a value per Kg of <color=#33CC33>1250</color>.

<color=#E5E54C>Profit per day:</color> On average, assuming corn to create the oil plus nutrifungus, profit per day is <color=#33CC33>1.28</color> (for reference Yayo is 0.35).

A simple tub shaped boat, it is slow moving and powered by a single frontal paddle. Used mainly to cross short distances and slow bodies of water. 

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Paddler x1, Passenger x1
an elegant and sturdy 3-seater sofa with a steel frame.
A beautiful but mild-scented flower known more for its vibrant colors than its fragrance.
A bundle of seeds for tulip. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A bundle of seeds for tulip. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A bundle of seeds for tulip. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A bundle of seeds for tundra cotton. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

A high-tech device that can be installed into an ear or any compatible ear replacement. This particular model is equipped with a compact comms array calibrated to receive audio data such as music. The sources of the data often vary, a mix of melodies from ancient satellite constructs, radio stations from neighboring planets and distant glitterworlds creates a very unique listening experience.
Slightly heavier than a normal shirt, a tunic is a great isolation against cold weather.

A cheeky little shit that likes to go around and play with switches, to satisfy their curiosity much like how an ignorant child would. Perhaps a little too smart for their own good. Their behaviour is similar to failed service animals that learn how to operate household items without restraint.

An avian hybrid with recessive humanoid genes. Surprisingly hardy, quick and very intelligent, these creatures make for a particularly filthy and hungry egg-layer. Their little wings are quite dextrous and can be used to flick switches.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Humanoid hybrids will periodically engage other colonists in conversation, talking about a variety of topics. This increases the social recreation needs of those they interact with by 10% (subject to diminishing returns like all joy types). If using Ideology, humanoid hybrids are subject to precepts. Turkeymen periodically flick switches around the colony (any building that can be toggled on / off by a colonist).
Fertilized turkeyman egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into one of these abominations. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
Unfertilized turkeyman egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.

A stockpile of specialized ammunition designed for automated turrets. Essential for keeping your defenses operational, this resource feeds directly into turrets or can be funneled through an ammo pipe network to distribute firepower efficiently across your colony. Without turret ammunition, even the most advanced automated defenses are little more than elaborate paperweights.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. This particular model includes a compact storage and deployment apparatus for turret packs. The core functions of the pack remains the same and it has to be replaced after each use as a result. Due to its small size and low weight, the wielder can carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.
An unfinished drone. This will deploy into a drone.

The turtle dove is a small, migratory dove distinguished by its reddish-brown wings with black speckles, a blue-gray head, and a distinctive black-and-white striped patch on the side of its neck. These birds are not domesticated and will wander.
A fertilized turtle dove egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a chick. It can be eaten, but why would you do such a thing?
An unfertilized turtle dove egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
A television remote.
The two-handed version of the winged mace, the long handle not only allows for higher damage but also greater armor penetration. The protruding flanges decimate both shields and metal plates.
An upgrade to the mallet, the two-handed hammer stacks a heavy metal head to multiply the force dealt to targets. The sheer force of hammer blows can crack solid plates and split strong shields.

The two-handed version of the morning star, warriors can trade their shields for further offensive potential. The handle’s longer reach allows for easier striking on mounts and greater armor penetration.
A basic weapon composed of a single accessible material like wood, the two-handed mallet can disrupt enemy formations, whether the enemies are armored or not.
A book about how to approach game design, especially in terms of crafting player experiences, mechanics, and interactions.
The automatic secretary dolls serve you,Violet Evergarden.
A Decorative Typewriter.
A Decorative Typewriter.

A pack of Typewriter Ribbons.
A work station with all the necessary equipment to write books. This station is equipped with a typewriter which speeds up the work significantly, but does require connection to power.
A bolt of very beautiful and luxurious violet cloth, perfect for clothing the distinguished.
Vastly boosts the metabolism and therefore the immune response of any lifeform that injects this medicine. Take once per day for maximum effect.
A bundle of seeds for uba sugarcane plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

A very primitive, giant cousin of rhinoceroses.
It is neither the most beautiful, nor the most intelligent animal in history, with its brain being merely the size of an orange, but it can make up for it with its strong back, which renders it a good partner for a journey.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.
A handy tool/weapon that can cut down both trees and legs of the unfortunate bystanders. Full plasteel - hyperweave build guarantees highest-tier of effectiveness available to humans.
An ultralight backpack woven from hyperweave that distributes weight and increases the wearer's carrying capacity.
A less-than-lethal applicator of blunt trauma to foreheads. Full plasteel - hyperweave build guarantees highest-tier of effectiveness available to humans.
A single-use ultra-tier launcher that fires an EMP rocket that disables electronics and mechanoids over a wide area.
A single-use ultra-tier launcher that fires a high-explosive rocket.
A single-use ultra-tier launcher that fires a toxic warhead that leaves a lingering cloud of toxic gas.
A short sword invented by the Romans. Its main use is to stab. And then twist. Full plasteel - hyperweave build guarantees highest-tier of effectiveness available to humans.

One of the oldest tools in human history - a blade with a handle. Useful for stabbing people and there's not a single job that doesn't benefit from a knife. Full plasteel - hyperweave build guarantees highest-tier of effectiveness available to humans.
A two-handed, long-bladed weapon invented for one-to-one combat. Useful for slashing and stabbing. Full plasteel - hyperweave build guarantees highest-tier of effectiveness available to humans.

A weapon designed for tackling mechanoids. Mounted electrical capacitors reload with the strikes and discharge EM Pulses to stun the attacked machine. Full plasteel - hyperweave build guarantees highest-tier of effectiveness available to humans.

A combination of two ancient designs: a hammer, and a long stick. It's used to bludgeon enemies' armor inwards, hurting them with blunt trauma and sharp edges of their own apparel. Full plasteel - hyperweave build guarantees highest-tier of effectiveness available to humans.

Possibly the oldest and most prolific weapon design in history of mankind. A tipped blade on a long stick. Full plasteel - hyperweave build guarantees highest-tier of effectiveness available to humans.
A nourishing fruit cultivated by forskakens on planets with a harsh environment.
A bundle of seeds for ultraviolett plant. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A floating chitinous creature covered in spikes and unblinking eyes. Created by infusing a very large animal with the strange energies from an extradimensional corruption.
An uncooked traditional beetroot soup. This needs to be cooked in an electric pot to be edible.
An uncooked fine soup. This needs to be cooked in an electric pot to be edible.
An uncooked fine stew. This needs to be cooked in a stew pot to be edible.
An uncooked gourmet soup. This needs to be cooked in an electric pot to be edible.
An uncooked lavish soup. This needs to be cooked in an electric pot to be edible.
An uncooked lavish stew. This needs to be cooked in a stew pot to be edible.
An uncooked simple soup. This needs to be cooked in an electric pot to be edible.
An uncooked simple stew. This needs to be cooked in a stew pot to be edible.
A clay pot designed for storing various items. Items stored inside do not affect the beauty of their surroundings.
Apple juice that is undergoing fermentation. Keep at room temperature to finish fermentation process.
Unfermented cider with a starter in an air-tight bottle. If left alone to develop the proper bacteria the end result will be a weak alcoholic beverage.

The Unhold is a towering giant, three times the size of a man, known for devouring sheep and draining ponds in a single gulp. Though tales paint them as destructive, they're not inherently malicious, preferring to scare off intruders with deafening roars rather than attacking. Usually solitary, Unholds are found alone or in small groups, fiercely defending their territory.

The beating heart of the fearsome unhold, pulsing with primal power and ancient vitality, considered to be a key ingredient for creating elixirs of endurance.
Robust hides of the formidable unhold, renowned for their thickness and weatherproof nature, sought after for crafting resilient garments and protective gear.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.
An axe bearing the marks of a master's hand. No two are forged alike.

A basic crate containing a random mix of low-value but useful items.
A premium crate packed with valuable goods and rare materials.
An elite crate holding exceptionally valuable or powerful items.
Unrefined fibers refined from deepchem. They can be weaved into synthread, hyperweave or devilstrand with proper techniques. Due to their plasticity, they are very fragile.
This crystal can be refined in a chemfuel refinery into uranium.

A dryad caste specialized in general protection and utility. Companion dryads are strong, fierce and loyal. They can clean, haul, fight and carry packs in caravans.

In general, dryads are mammal-like creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. They reproduce together with their tree, which contains a hidden dryad queen. Dryads can morph into various specialized castes.

Dryads are small mammalian creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree.

This particular dryad seems to be unshackled, and it will not leave the region if no Gauranlen trees are around.

The most commonly abused substance in glitterworld Olympic games. Upper gives the user a short burst of immense speed. It is moderately addictive, with long-term use leading to kidney failure and muscle spasms.

Complex uramaki sushi assembled with care from a wide selection of ingredients. Uramaki is a medium-sized cylindrical piece with two or more fillings, and it differs from other maki because the rice is on the outside and the nori seaweed inside.

A self-loading uranium slug cannon. Its ultra-dense uranium shells can punch through heavy armor. It's more accurate at longer ranges, and can't fire at all close up.

Being an extremely heavy weapon, this gun requires a power armor to be effectively used.

This weapon has limited number of uses.
A decorative container.

A payload of ursine genetic material. Can be used at the genomorpher to create a growth cell of a hybrid animal. This tier 1 genome can be used as either a primary or secondary genome.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All primary ursine hybrids have stunning attacks, and high body size.

<color=#E5E54C>Extraction:</color> Can be extracted via the genome extractor table or any genome excavator from:
installed

The absolute alpha of units, the chonkiest of bois, winner of consecutive Fat Bear Weeks before being disqualified due to winning too often.

A perfect ursine animal, paragon of all similar animals with no needless junk genetic data. Besides the various improvements to the baseline animal’s abilities, this paragon has a particularly powerful stun attack and can be slaughtered for a valuable pelt, which can either be used for decoration or sold.
An object with ideoligious significance.
Empty soda cups.
A fine V neck dress

A high-tech device that can be installed into a lung or any compatible artificial lung replacement. This particular model improves the user's survivability in the vacuum of space by storing and recycling oxygen. Like vacsuits, it is not perfectly efficient and requires additional equipment in order to provide full vacuum protection.

A pair of protective boots that slightly protect the wearer from the vacuum of space. These boots contain gravity stabilizers specially designed to keep the wearer steady during a gravship launch, which helps with gravship piloting.

A pair of protective gloves that slightly protect the wearer from the vacuum of space. These gloves possess vibration dampeners, which allow the wearer to maintain steady hands even during the turbulent launch of a gravship.

A vacuum cleaner, commonly known as a hoover or simply vacuum, is a household appliance designed for the removal of dust, dirt, and debris from floors, carpets, and other surfaces. Typically consisting of a motorized suction mechanism housed within a casing, vacuum cleaners utilize various attachments such as brushes and hoses to agitate and capture particles.
Vacuum toilet that doesn't require water and jettisons all waste into space via sewage dump ports.

An electrical warning lamp that emits flashing orange light if the vacuum in the room reaches dangerous levels. Undrafted crewmembers will make their way out of the room when the warning light turns on. Draws power directly from the grav engine.
a luxurious, high-end bed for aristocrats. If you need a bed that matches your title, use this bed.
A high-security container filled with rare, high-value goods.
An object with ideoligious significance.

An implant that extends high speed virtual neurons into the nervous system, allowing for short bursts of inhuman speed. This implant puts incredible strain on the nervous system and can lead to worsening psychosis if used too frequently.
The mainstay of modern militaries outside of the rim. Offering a cataphract-level of protection without the induced mobility cost, Vanguard marines laugh in the face of danger.
The mainstay of modern militaries outside of the rim. Offering a cataphract-level of protection without the induced mobility cost, Vanguard marines laugh in the face of danger.

Delicate, creamy-white flowers with a light, sweet fragrance. While the flowers are beautiful, it’s the pods they produce that are prized for their warm, rich scent. We put some vanilla in your Vanilla Expanded so you can expand vanilla while you vanilla your expansion.
A bundle of seeds for vanilla. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.
A workbench for tailoring feminine fashion by hand.
A small, decorative vase is a great way to personalise a room. Just try not to break it!

A steel doorframe.
The yellow-and-black stripes and keypad-like detail give off the vibe of a quarantine block or research facility.

Slightly improves room beauty, but has no other effects. Mostly paintable.

A savory, salty paste born from wort and vegetable puree. Rich in umami, it’s as polarizing as it is iconic.

<color=#E5E54C>Trade considerations</color>:

<color=#E5E54C>Ingredients:</color> Making 5 vegemite requires 20 wort plus 3 puree for a total of 80 value, and sells for 30, giving a <color=#33CC33>46.67%</color> profit per unit.

<color=#E5E54C>Fermentation time:</color> 10 days.

<color=#E5E54C>Caravan trading:</color> Its weight is 0.3 Kg, for a value per Kg of <color=#33CC33>100</color>.

<color=#E5E54C>Profit per day:</color> On average, assuming potatoes to create the puree plus wort, profit per day is <color=#33CC33>0.70</color> (for reference Yayo is 0.35).

A small work station containing a presser and an industrial decanter centrifuge to separate vegetable extract from mash. The high G-forces generated by the decanter centrifuge allow you to extract vegetable milk from rice, almonds, coconuts, oats and soybeans.
A rich stew of chopped vegetables, sauteed and boiled in a lightly seasoned broth. A hearty, yet healthy meal.
A long forgotten shelf containing vegetables.
The alternator is an extremely vital engine part for any vehicle that has electrical systems. Some very basic systems can get away and some more complex vehicles can require more than one.

An insulated rechargeable battery and wiring which powers numerous electronic functions. Acts as a surge protector for electronic systems and multiple batteries can augment or even replace a vehicle's engine.
Literally the part that gets a vehicle moving in the first place, no vehicle can be assembled without one. Exceedingly large or heavy vehicles could require more than one.
A series of pipes, catalysts and fittings that transfer the exhaust from the vehicle engine away from the driver’s cabin. Engines that will be put under a lot of strain require more exhausts.

Carefully manufactured fuel storage and injection systems. Ideal for vehicles that require greater fuel capacity or even increased fuel consumption without increasing the likelihood of gas leaks or engine damage.

A series of pipes, tubes, fans, pumps, and the radiator itself, ready to be installed in a vehicle that is expected to endure heavy loads. The harder the engine will have to work, the more radiators required to keep it cool.

A series of transmissions, springs and shock absorbers that redirect or reduce forces transferred through the wheels. Generally, the greater the mass and cargo capacity of the vehicle, the more suspensions are needed.

A dedicated, automatic transmission system delicately machined from hardened and durable materials. Due to its comparatively complex design, these are required in vehicles that require immense torque or excessive rotational speeds.

One of the most ancient technologies developed by man, the wheel takes the power from the engine and translates it into movement. As wheels have to not only move the vehicle in whichever direction necessary but also withstand the combined weight, larger and heavier vehicles can need several or dozens of them.
Reinforced and machined wiring parts to improve electricity conduction. Typically required in vehicles that have a lot of synchronized or delicate electronic systems.

Meaning “swift robber”, these turkey-sized predators are fearless, flightless, feathered little bastards that can hunt creatures up to twice their size by coordinating in packs. Of particular note are their enlarged sickle-shaped claws on each hindfoot with which they kick to slash, pierce and disembowel their prey.

Velociraptors typically prefer to hunt alone so as to not share their quarry, behaving similarly to birds of prey by leaping onto smaller, easier targets and gripping them in their jaws and claws. They have excellent hearing for tracking prey and are very opportunistic, scavenging on carrion during droughts, famines, or general periods of poor health.

Being based on ancient InGen gen patterns, these specific Velociraptors are female only.
A fertilized velociraptor egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby velociraptor. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
The vending machine that has been destroyed.
A standard vending machine for guests.
A cheap option for vending to guests, an optimal choice for instances where you don't want to setup a full market zone or build vending machines.
A stand that perfect for placing a simple TV.

The old basin didn't even have a mirror. Ta-da! This basin has a mirror attached to the storage cabinet.
14L per use.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into a jaw or any compatible artificial jaw replacement. This particular module is nearly identical to a standard venom fangs implant in terms of functionality.

An advanced artificial tail. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while a biogel nerve-extension spliced into the tailbone gives exquisit control. The user can stab the stinger into their enemies and inject venom into the wound.

A high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into any compatible artificial arm replacement. This particular module is nearly identical to a standard venom talon implant in terms of functionality.

Not actually a mite, the venomite is a genetically-engineered giant insectoid the size of a lion. Designed to inflict maximum damage to organic enemies, venomite is capable of spitting globs of highly corrosive acid over long distances. Upon impact, it will cause severe burns, but won’t result in permanent damage. Relatively easy to defeat in close quarters due to shorter ripper blades than the Sorne variety. It is quite slow in open terrain.
This hybrid implant substitutes the subject's jaw with a set of venomous fangs. Useful in combat, but not very comfortable.

A high-tech animal implant that can be installed onto the spine or any compatible artificial spine replacement. This particular module comes with a set of advanced artificial micro-organs that produce an extremely toxic venom-like substance that has a high likelihood of causing severe toxic buildup in any being it comes in contact with. The substance gathers around the body parts that its host uses for combat, allowing it to be injected into or launched at its target with each bite, scratch or strike.

A specialized rack designed to display numerous melee and ranged weapons for armories and outposts. Items stored inside will not deteriorate over time. 

<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> 
Stack size total: 16 
Stack per tile: 8 

Allowed items: Ranged weapons, Melee weapons, Explosives
A vertical weapon rack that can display up to 6 weapons.
A simple vest stitched from treated and tanned leathers, both comfortable and pragmatic. The thick leather is a decent balance between protection and encumbrance.
An object with ideoligious significance.
Used for organizing recipes and vials. Increases workspeed when placed near an alchemy bench or cauldron.
a lamp with chrome pillar.

Vigor pill fills the user's need for rest, allowing them to work for extended periods without getting tired. However, taking vigor pills runs the risk of developing an addiction.

In the most competitive universities and communities of many kingdoms, high-achievers are sometimes called 'vigor-men' because of the association with this drug.
A mixture of vigor pill. Needs further brewing in order to be used.
A stone bas relief of viking imagery for decorating a floor.
A stone bas relief of viking imagery for decorating a floor.

A sharp, acidic liquid created by fermenting produce, used for cooking, preserving food, and crafting artisan goods. It adds tangy flavor and extends the shelf life of various dishes.

An classic and very stylish car, which provides its passengers with a mood bonus. The loud engine has high visibility and low fuel efficiency, but it has decent cargo. It will travel fast on roads, but struggle in hills and cold terrain.
A stack of vinyl records.
A soft, powdery, and sweet-smelling flower, often used to add a gentle floral note to perfumes.
A bundle of seeds for violet. Opening this seed bundle will allow the crop to be planted by your faction.

A specialized lab-grade machine is designed to modify virus DNA from provided disease samples. Upon activation, it infects all living creatures in an enclosed, fully roofed room with mutated viruses and provides a way to extract their pathogens. The number of pathogens that can be yielded from an organism depends on its size and infection severity. The bigger the species, the more pathogens drop from it.

All creatures in the same room will get infected unless they remain in a small safe zone around the replicator or possess environmental toxic resistance exceeding 80%.

Note that large, tamed creatures in their pens are optimal targets for virus replication.

A specialized computation and nutrient-storage device designed to keep hackers inside cyberpods alive. It places the body in a state of suspended animation.

Only one can connect to a pod.

A synthetic combat-enhancing drug developed by Forsakens to counter their weaknesses in combat. These pills reduce pain, while slightly increasing consciousness, breathing and manipulation. While they aren't addictive, the effect wears off rapidly. Only colonists with the Forsaken Knowledge gene will be able to synthetize this drug.

A nano-mesh controlled by a visual/tactile neural interface. It allows for dynamic adaptations of the user's vocal cords to adapt their voice to a more attractive or dominant tone, enhancing their ability to speak.
A miniature noise cancelling unit installed above the voicebox, designed to remotely mute the victim.

A high-tech device that can be installed into a jaw or any compatible jaw replacement. This particular module allows its user to adjust their voice on the fly, making it more pleasant to listen to. The implant can also partially drown out a person's irritating speech patterns.

An implant that attunes its user to the monolith. The implant uses dark archotechnology to allow its user to hear the whispers of the void. The greater the void's link to reality, the greater the user's psychic sensitivity and madness grows.
A backpack containing a voidlink relay to access the vast amounts of data present on this system's mechanoid voidlink network. It can vastly increase a mechanitor's maximum total bandwidth.

A jagged, irregular mass of metallic material that feels wet to the touch but leaves no residue. It is impervious to damage. It can be forged, with great difficulty, into fantastic weapons, armor, and fortifications.

An advanced brain implant designed to assist the user in handling anomalous objects and act as a digital encyclopedia on that particular subject. The subpersona can alter its user's brain chemistry on the fly, shielding them from certain types of harmful or disorienting psychic phenomena that can impede the process of containing or studying anomalous material.

A brain implant of such complexity requires time to synchronize with and adapt to its host in order to avoid excessive strain on the central nervous system, its effectiveness will slowly increase during this process. It's capable of syncing with other enhancements made to assist in similar tasks, greatly increasing efficiency.

A pulsating, crude piece of dark archotechnology containing one or more infuse-able xenogenes.

It needs to be stabbed into the host’s body for it to infuse its genes, rewriting its genetic code near permanently with psychic manipulation.

After the infusion is complete, the spike disintegrates itself and makes a person bedridden for a few days.

An ornate pistol meant to provide the strength of a full-sized rifle with the portability of a revolver. Surprisingly high ammo capacity and range at the cost of a long time to reload and rather poor accuracy due to recoil.

Tales of steamworld gunslingers would imply this weapon and ones like it are capable of occasional incredibly lucky shots.
A light, automatic lens array carbine. It fires beams of compressed photons that sear flesh. It has decent range, good power, good accuracy.  Ineffective against any armor.

A cumbersome, automatic lens array chaingun. It fires volleys of beams composed of compressed photons that sear flesh. It has decent range, but is inaccurate. The wider cooling cylinder allows it to fire far more beams than other volt weapons. Ineffective against any armor.
An ergonomic lens array marksman rifle. It fires beams of compressed photons that sear flesh. It has good range and good accuracy thanks to the elongated cylinder. Ineffective against any armor.

A stubby lens array pistol. It fires beams of compressed photons that sear flesh. It has a short cooldown thanks to the large cooling cylinder, it has low range but good accuracy in close quarters. Ineffective against any armor.

A simple, single-fire lens array rifle. It fires beams of compressed photons that sear flesh. Needs time to cool down between each shot, but it can make tighter beams, giving it a better range. Ineffective against any armor.

A heavy, long-range lens array sniper rifle. It fires tight beams of compressed photons that sear flesh. It compresses beams far better than other volt weapons, allowing them to travel for longer. The tight beams are also more capable at punching through armor, but are still quite ineffective at it.

A stocky lens array scatterer. It fires beams of compressed photons that sear flesh. It has low range but high power. The scattering lens makes the beams split upon firing.  Ineffective against any armor.

. It has no sleeves and is mainly worn under a suit jacket.
A crushed and powdered form of wake-up. When applied to a gourmet meal, it provides a very diluted version of the drug without risk of addictions.

A high-tech device that can be installed into a liver or any compatible artificial liver replacement. This particular model is capable of synthesizing small doses of wake-up and releasing them into the body. It’s able to suppress wake-up cravings, but properly curing an addiction is not possible with an implant such as this one.
Freezer unit for creating a walk-in freezer. Connect to outdoor air-con units. Requires 300 cooling units.
A small, portable radio that permits important communication between colonists at notable distances.
These dresses are intended to be worn outdoors. Now and then, fashionable women seem eager to incorporate trendy styles and colors.
A decorative wall banner. Can be mounted on walls.
A wall-mounted variant of the firefoam popper. When it detects fire, it bursts and sprays fire-retardant foam in a circular area around itself. Can also be triggered manually.
A wall-mounted version of an orbital trade beacon, required for orbital trading. You can only sell goods to orbital traders if they're near an orbital trade beacon. Can be placed indoors.
A simple sign that can be hung on walls or doors.
A simple LED sign that can be hung on walls or doors.

A short range wall mounted taser turret typically used indoors. It delivers an electric shock aimed at temporarily disrupting muscle functions and inflicting pain without usually causing significant injury.
A wall-mounted version of a tool cabinet. Increases work speed when placed near a workbench. One workbench can use up to two tool cabinets.
A surveillance camera mounted to a wall. Must be powered and connected to a surveillance station or router via video cables to function.
A cheap and rough wooden board mounted to a wall, uncomfortable and thus commonly used in prisons.
Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals, or eaten raw.
A paper containing criminal info.
